Dietary Supplements: Pros, Cons and Verdicts膳食补充剂：利弊与结论

Every product below carries an explicit verdict, an evidence grade, the dose that was actually tested, and its pros and cons listed separately so neither can hide the other. Built from ten parallel literature sweeps, each followed by an independent adversarial fact-checker that re-searched every citation and re-checked every dose against NIH ODS, EFSA and IOM/NASEM.下面每一个产品都给出明确的结论、证据分级、真正被试验验证过的剂量，以及分开列出的优点和缺点，这样两者都不会把对方遮住。本文由十路并行的文献检索构成，每一路之后都有一名独立的对抗式核查员，重新检索每一条引用，并对照 NIH ODS、EFSA 与 IOM/NASEM 复核每一个剂量。

This is not medical advice. It cannot replace a clinician who knows your history, medication list and blood results. Many entries below carry contraindications that matter: warfarin, SSRIs, levothyroxine, immunosuppressants, chemotherapy, kidney disease, pregnancy.本文不构成医疗建议。它无法替代了解你病史、用药清单和化验结果的临床医生。下面许多条目带有要紧的禁忌：华法林、SSRI 类抗抑郁药、左甲状腺素、免疫抑制剂、化疗、肾病、妊娠。

1  How to read this一、如何阅读本文

Two columns do independent work and must be read together. Verdict says what to do. Grade says how confident the literature is about the answer, and the answer can be no.有两栏各管一件事，必须合起来读。结论说的是该怎么做。证据分级说的是文献对答案有多确定，而答案完全可以是“无效”。

Verdict结论 Meaning含义
TAKE Take it值得吃Worth taking if you are in the group named under Who. Evidence is strong for that group and for that purpose only.如果你属于“适用人群”一栏所写的群体，值得吃。证据只对那个群体、那个用途成立。
CONSIDER Consider可以考虑Defensible in one narrow situation. Outside that situation there is no case for it.只在一种很窄的情形下站得住。离开那个情形，就没有理由吃。
SKIP Skip it不必买No good evidence of benefit for the marketed claim. Money wasted rather than harm done, unless a Cons entry says otherwise.对其宣传的功效没有像样的证据。除非“缺点”一栏另有说明，否则问题是浪费钱，不是危害健康。
AVOID Avoid不要吃Published evidence of harm in randomised trials, prospective registries or national surveillance.在随机试验、前瞻性登记或全国性监测中已有公开的致害证据。
Grade分级 What the evidence base looks like证据基础是什么样
AConsistent meta-analyses of randomised trials with clinical endpoints.多项随机试验的一致性 meta 分析，且使用临床终点。
BMeta-analyses with surrogate endpoints, or good trials with mixed results.使用替代终点的 meta 分析，或结果不一致的高质量试验。
CSmall or short randomised trials only.仅有小样本或短周期的随机试验。
DMechanistic, animal or observational evidence only, or the claim has been refuted.只有机制、动物或观察性证据，或该主张已被推翻。

The nine misreadings this document is built to prevent本文刻意防范的九种误读

  1. A high grade does not mean it works. It means we are confident about the answer, and the answer can be no. Selenium is Grade A in this document because Cochrane established with HIGH certainty that it does NOT prevent cancer. Read the Grade column together with the Verdict column, never on its own.高分级不等于有效。它的意思是“我们对结论有把握”，而结论完全可以是“无效”。本文给硒评 A 级，是因为 Cochrane 以高确定性证明它并不能预防癌症。“证据分级”这一栏必须和“结论”一栏合起来读，绝不能单看。
  2. A grade attaches to one specific claim, not to the substance in general. Vitamin D3 is Grade A for correcting documented deficiency and Grade D for preventing cancer or cardiovascular disease. Those are the same molecule and two different questions.分级针对的是某一个具体主张，而不是这种物质本身。维生素 D3 在“纠正已证实的缺乏”上是 A 级，在“预防癌症或心血管病”上是 D 级。同一个分子，两个完全不同的问题。
  3. An official statement of insufficient evidence is not an endorsement. The USPSTF gives multivitamins an I statement. That means the trials could neither prove benefit nor rule out harm. The industry quotes it as vindication.官方所说的“证据不足”不是背书。USPSTF 给复合维生素的是 I 级声明，意思是现有试验既不能证明有益，也不能排除有害。行业却把它当成背书来引用。
  4. No upper limit set means nobody has assessed it. It is a gap in the science, not a finding of safety. Most botanicals and every probiotic in this document fall into that gap.“未设定上限”的意思是没有人评估过。这是科学上的空白，不是安全性结论。本文中的多数植物类产品和全部益生菌都落在这个空白里。
  5. Risk ratios below 1 mean fewer events, above 1 mean more events. When the confidence interval crosses 1, no effect was demonstrated. That is the entire logic of Figure 4.风险比小于 1 表示事件更少，大于 1 表示事件更多。当置信区间跨过 1 时，说明没有证明出效应。图 4 的全部逻辑就是这一条。
  6. Relative reductions are not absolute reductions. REDUCE-IT is quoted everywhere as a 25% reduction. The absolute reduction was 4.8 percentage points over 4.9 years, meaning about 21 people take the drug for one to benefit.相对下降不等于绝对下降。REDUCE-IT 到处被引用为“下降 25%”。而绝对下降是 4.9 年里的 4.8 个百分点，也就是约 21 个人服药才有 1 个人获益。
  7. The number on a mineral label is usually the compound, not the mineral. Magnesium oxide is about 60% magnesium, magnesium citrate about 16%. A capsule labelled 500 mg magnesium citrate delivers roughly 80 mg of magnesium.矿物质标签上的数字通常是化合物的量，不是矿物质本身的量。氧化镁约含 60% 的镁，柠檬酸镁约 16%。一粒标着“柠檬酸镁 500 毫克”的胶囊，实际提供的镁约为 80 毫克。
  8. The safety record of a food does not transfer to a concentrated extract of it. Drinking green tea is fine. Green tea extract has caused more than 100 published cases of liver injury, 8% of which went to transplant.一种食物的安全记录，不会自动转移到它的浓缩提取物上。喝绿茶没问题。绿茶提取物已造成 100 例以上公开报告的肝损伤，其中 8% 走到了肝移植。
  9. A certification mark says nothing about whether the product works. USP Verified, NSF and Informed Sport all certify content and purity. None of them assesses efficacy, and USP Verified does not screen for substances banned in sport.认证标识对“产品有没有用”只字未提。USP Verified、NSF 和 Informed Sport 认证的都是成分与纯度。没有一个评估有效性，而且 USP Verified 并不筛查运动违禁物质。

The food data asks two separate questions食物数据回答的是两个独立问题

Every product carries a Food sources block with two badges that are easy to conflate. They answer different questions and they frequently disagree.每个产品都有一个“食物来源”板块，其中两个标签很容易被混为一谈。它们回答的是不同的问题，而且经常给出相反的答案。

Badge标签 Question it answers它回答的问题
In food食物中Does the substance occur in ordinary food at all? Rich, trace only, manufactured, or from a plant nobody eats as food.这种物质在普通食物中究竟有没有？丰富、仅有痕量、人工合成，或来自没人当食物吃的植物。
Dose from food靠吃达到剂量Could you reach the dose used in the trials by eating? This is the question that actually decides whether food can stand in for the pill.你能靠吃东西达到试验里用的那个剂量吗？这才是真正决定“食物能不能顶替药片”的问题。

Worked example. Vitamin E is genuinely rich in food: one tablespoon of wheatgerm oil covers the daily reference intake by itself. But the dose in the harm trials was 400 IU, which is 268 mg of alpha-tocopherol, roughly 18 times the reference intake, and no realistic diet reaches it. So vitamin E reads Rich in food and Dose not reachable at the same time, and both are true. Coenzyme Q10 behaves the same way: abundant in offal and oily fish, yet the richest food supplies under 4% of the 300 mg trial dose.举个例子。维生素 E 在食物中确实丰富：一勺小麦胚芽油本身就够一天的参考摄入量。但致害试验用的剂量是 400 IU，相当于 268 毫克 α-生育酚，约为参考摄入量的 18 倍，任何现实的饮食都达不到。所以维生素 E 会同时显示食物中丰富和靠吃达不到剂量，两者都成立。辅酶 Q10 也是同样的情形：它在内脏和多脂鱼中含量很高，但最丰富的食物也只能提供 300 毫克试验剂量的不到 4%。

2  Why the market looks like this二、这个市场为什么是这个样子

One regulatory fact explains almost everything else. Under the US Dietary Supplement Health and Education Act of 1994, supplements are legally a category of food. There is no pre-market approval for safety or efficacy, and no statutory cap on the dose of an ingredient. In the words of the organisation that writes the US quality standards, supplements are not subject to preapproval requirements for safety and efficacy, nor are they required to meet official public quality standards.有一条监管事实几乎解释了其余所有现象。按照美国 1994 年《膳食补充剂健康与教育法》，补充剂在法律上属于食品。上市前既不需要安全性和有效性审批，法规也不对成分剂量设上限。用编写美国质量标准的机构自己的话说：补充剂不受上市前安全性与有效性审批的约束，也不要求达到官方公共质量标准。

4  Take it四、值得吃

Strong evidence, but only for the group named under Who. None of these is for everyone.证据充分，但只对“适用人群”一栏所写的群体成立。没有一样适合所有人。

TAKEFolic acid叶酸Grade A证据 A 级
Dose tested已验证剂量400 µg/d, from at least one month before conception. 4 mg/d if a previous pregnancy was affected.400 微克/天，至少从受孕前一个月开始。若既往有受累妊娠，则 4 毫克/天。
Who it is for适用人群Anyone capable of becoming pregnant.任何可能怀孕的人。

Pros优点

  • Neural tube defects RR 0.31 (95% CI 0.17-0.58) across 5 trials and 6,708 births. This is the strongest single result in the whole supplement literature.神经管缺陷 RR 0.31（95% CI 0.17-0.58），5 项试验、6708 例分娩。这是整个补充剂文献中最强的单项结果。
  • The MRC Vitamin Study (n=1,817 high-risk women) showed a 72% protective effect at 4 mg/d.MRC 维生素研究（1817 名高危女性）在 4 毫克/天下显示 72% 的保护效应。
  • Population fortification works at scale: US grain fortification prevents about 1,326 affected births per year.人群强化在规模上有效：美国面粉强化每年避免约 1326 例受累出生。
  • Costs a few pounds a year. No meaningful downside at 400 µg.一年只要几英镑。在 400 微克剂量下没有实质性坏处。

Cons缺点

  • Never take it alone when B12 status is unknown. Folic acid corrects the anaemia of B12 deficiency while the neurological damage silently progresses. This is the stated basis of the upper limit.B12 状态不明时绝不要单独服用。叶酸会纠正 B12 缺乏引起的贫血，而神经损害在无声中继续加重。这正是设定上限的理由。
  • High-dose folic acid plus B12 taken for cardiovascular reasons raised cancer incidence (HR 1.21) and cancer mortality (HR 1.38) in pooled Norwegian trials. That is a different product at a different dose for a different purpose, and it should not be confused with the 400 µg periconceptional dose.为心血管目的服用的大剂量叶酸加 B12，在挪威两项试验合并分析中升高了癌症发病（HR 1.21）和癌症死亡（HR 1.38）。那是另一个剂量、另一个目的下的另一种用法，不应与 400 微克的围孕期剂量混为一谈。
  • Upper limit 1,000 µg/d of synthetic folate, which applies to supplements and fortified food but not to folate from whole food.合成叶酸上限 1000 微克/天，适用于补充剂和强化食品，不适用于天然食物中的叶酸。

Food sources食物来源

No food source, manufactured无食物来源，人工合成 Dose partly reachable靠吃只能部分达到 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

Folic acid (pteroylmonoglutamic acid) is manufactured by chemical synthesis, a Waller-type condensation of a triaminopyrimidinone with a three-carbon unit and p-aminobenzoyl-L-glutamic acid, giving a fully oxidised molecule carrying a single glutamate that does not occur in unfortified food. Ordinary food supplies reduced folate polyglutamates instead, chiefly 5-methyltetrahydrofolate, and USDA's component structure keeps 'folic acid' and 'folate, food' as separate entries: beef liver, lentils, spinach, chickpeas, asparagus and boiled broccoli all read folic acid 0 with folate food equal to folate total. Two distinct answers therefore sit inside one word, so they are separated here: the nutrient class folate is rich in ordinary food, while the marketed molecule folic acid enters the food supply only through fortification and enrichment, which is what every food row below is. Enriched pasta and enriched white rice are the other mandated US enrichment vehicles; their contents are label-dependent per product and no verified figure was available, so they get no row.合成叶酸（folic acid，蝶酰单谷氨酸 pteroylmonoglutamic acid）由化学合成制造，通过 Waller 型缩合反应把三氨基嘧啶酮、一个三碳单元和对氨基苯甲酰-L-谷氨酸缩合起来，得到一个完全氧化、只带单个谷氨酸残基的分子，未强化的食物里并不存在这种形式。普通食物提供的是还原型叶酸多谷氨酸盐，主要是 5-甲基四氢叶酸。USDA 的成分体系把 folic acid 和 folate, food 列为两个独立条目：牛肝、扁豆、菠菜、鹰嘴豆、芦笋和水煮西兰花的 folic acid 全部读作 0，而 folate food 等于 folate total。一个词里装着两个答案，这里把它们分开：作为营养素类别的叶酸在普通食物中含量丰富；作为在售分子的 folic acid 只能通过强化和营养素添加进入食物供应，下面每一行食物都属于这种情况。强化意面和强化白米是美国另外两种法定的营养素添加载体，含量随具体产品的标签而定，没有可核实的数据，因此不单列。

Rows tagged unconfirmed carry a figure the verification pass could not trace back to its cited source. The number is reported as found; hover the tag for the reason.标记为未核实的行，其数值在核查环节无法追溯到所引来源。数字按原样列出；把鼠标移到标记上可看具体原因。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 Two routes with different answers. As folic acid, the 400 ug periconceptional dose is reachable in one sitting only from fortified products: one bowl of ready-to-eat cereal fortified to 400 ug folic acid per serving is the entire dose, whereas matching it from yeast extract spread takes about 13 g (a bit over two teaspoons), from instant fortified oatmeal 8.2 packets, and from enriched wheat bread about 69 slices. As natural food folate the equivalent target is 680 ug DFE (400 x 1.7), and this is where the verification pass forced a correction: the submission's cheapest option was 376 g of cooked lentils, but simmered chicken liver at 578 ug food folate per 100 g (FDC 171061) needs only 118 g, under three 44 g livers, which is an ordinary portion, and pan-fried lamb liver at 400 ug DFE per 100 g (FDC 172533) needs 170 g. The plant routes stay awkward: 376 g cooked lentils (1.9 cups), 219 g prepared edamame (1.4 cups), 300 g dried sunflower kernels, 351 g raw spinach (about twelve 30 g cups), 395 g cooked chickpeas, 456 g cooked asparagus (about thirty spears) or 630 g boiled broccoli. So the plain answer is that a person can eat their way to the folate equivalent of the 400 ug dose through liver or through fortified food, and cannot realistically do it through leafy greens; the UK high-risk 5 mg dose (8,500 ug DFE, 1.47 kg of chicken liver or 4.7 kg of cooked lentils every day) is unreachable by any route. Liver carries its own pregnancy restriction on preformed vitamin A grounds, which is why it is rarely offered as the answer to the population that needs the dose.两条路径给出不同答案。按 folic acid 计，孕前 400 µg 的剂量只有强化产品能一次吃到：一碗按每份 400 µg folic acid 强化的即食谷物就是全部剂量；用酵母提取物涂抹酱要约 13 g（两茶匙多一点），用强化速食燕麦片要 8.2 包，用强化面粉做的小麦面包约 69 片。按天然食物叶酸计，等效目标是 680 µg DFE（400 x 1.7），核查环节正是在这里改出一处错误：原稿最省的选项是 376 g 熟扁豆，但炖鸡肝每 100 g 含食物叶酸 578 µg（FDC 171061），只需 118 g，不到三块 44 g 的鸡肝，属于正常份量；煎羊肝每 100 g 400 µg DFE（FDC 172533），需要 170 g。植物路径依旧别扭：376 g 熟扁豆（1.9 杯）、219 g 处理好的毛豆（1.4 杯）、300 g 干葵花籽仁、351 g 生菠菜（约十二杯，每杯 30 g）、395 g 熟鹰嘴豆、456 g 熟芦笋（约三十根）或 630 g 水煮西兰花。所以直白的结论是：一个人可以靠肝脏或强化食品吃到相当于 400 µg 剂量的叶酸量，靠绿叶菜现实中做不到；英国面向高风险人群的 5 mg 剂量（8,500 µg DFE，相当于每天 1.47 kg 鸡肝或 4.7 kg 熟扁豆）任何路径都达不到。肝脏本身因预成型维生素 A 而在孕期受限，这也是它很少被拿来当作那个最需要该剂量的人群的答案的原因。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Folic acid is not bioidentical to food folate and the difference cuts both ways. It must be reduced by dihydrofolate reductase before entering one-carbon metabolism, and human DHFR capacity is low: unmetabolised folic acid appears in serum above a threshold of about 266 ug of folic acid per meal (Kelly et al., Am J Clin Nutr 1997;65:1790-5, PMID 9174474), which a 400 ug tablet exceeds. That is why the adult UL of 1,000 ug/day applies to folic acid from supplements and fortified food with no UL on food folate: high folic acid can correct the megaloblastic anaemia of B12 deficiency while neurological damage continues, masking the diagnosis. Food folate has no toxicity ceiling and the synthetic form does. Running the other way, the quantity of food folate is not the only obstacle. Cuskelly, McNulty and Scott randomised 62 women to an extra 400 ug/day as a folic acid supplement, as folic-acid-fortified food, as natural food folate, or as dietary advice: red cell folate rose only in the supplement and fortified-food arms and did not move in the food-folate arms despite documented increases in intake (Lancet 1996;347:657-9, PMID 8596381). The two trials that established the neural-tube-defect effect used synthetic folic acid, 4 mg/day in the MRC Vitamin Study (Lancet 1991;338:131-7, PMID 1677062) and 0.8 mg/day in a multivitamin (Czeizel and Dudas, N Engl J Med 1992;327:1832-5, PMID 1307234). Substituting leafy greens for the tablet before pregnancy has never been tested against that endpoint. On L-5-methyltetrahydrofolate (calcium methylfolate), the marketed 'MTHFR-friendly' alternative: EFSA's 2022 derivation of DFE factors for it judged 5-MTHF more bioavailable than folic acid at supplement doses of 400 ug/day and above (2.0 versus 1.7; PMC9399872), so the case against it is not absorption. It is that no periconceptional trial has been run on it, and the neural-tube-defect evidence base is specifically folic acid (Czeizel, Ann Nutr Metab 2011, PMID 21865678).folic acid 与食物叶酸并非生物等同，差异在两个方向上都成立。它必须先由二氢叶酸还原酶（DHFR）还原才能进入一碳代谢，而人的 DHFR 能力很低：每餐 folic acid 超过约 266 µg 这一阈值后，血清中就会出现未代谢的 folic acid（Kelly 等, Am J Clin Nutr 1997;65:1790-5, PMID 9174474），一片 400 µg 的片剂已经超过。这正是成人每日 1,000 µg 的 UL 只适用于补充剂和强化食品中的 folic acid、而食物叶酸没有 UL 的原因：高剂量 folic acid 可以纠正 B12 缺乏引起的巨幼细胞性贫血，同时神经损害继续进展，掩盖诊断。食物叶酸没有毒性上限，合成形式有。反方向看，食物叶酸的障碍也不止于量。Cuskelly、McNulty 与 Scott 把 62 名女性随机分组，每天额外补 400 µg，分别以 folic acid 补充剂、folic acid 强化食品、天然食物叶酸或饮食指导的形式给予：红细胞叶酸只在补充剂组和强化食品组上升，食物叶酸组尽管摄入量有记录在案的增加却毫无变化（Lancet 1996;347:657-9, PMID 8596381）。确立神经管缺陷预防效果的两项试验用的都是合成 folic acid：MRC Vitamin Study 的 4 mg/天（Lancet 1991;338:131-7, PMID 1677062），以及 Czeizel 与 Dudas 用复合维生素给的 0.8 mg/天（N Engl J Med 1992;327:1832-5, PMID 1307234）。孕前用绿叶菜替代片剂，从未针对这一终点做过检验。关于 L-5-甲基四氢叶酸（甲基叶酸钙），也就是市面上以适合 MTHFR 基因型为卖点的替代品：EFSA 2022 年推导其 DFE 系数时判定，在每天 400 µg 及以上的补充剂量下，5-MTHF 的生物利用度高于 folic acid（2.0 对 1.7；PMC9399872），所以反对它的理由与吸收无关。问题在于至今没有做过孕前使用的试验，而神经管缺陷的证据基础明确是 folic acid（Czeizel, Ann Nutr Metab 2011, PMID 21865678）。

Absorption吸收 Food folate is roughly 50% available against about 85% for folic acid eaten with food and close to 100% fasting, which is where the 1.7 and 2.0 DFE multipliers come from (Suitor and Bailey, J Am Diet Assoc 2000;100:88-94, PMID 10646010). Food folate is a polyglutamate that must be deconjugated at the brush border before absorption, and it is chemically fragile. USDA Table of Nutrient Retention Factors Release 6 (2007) gives folate retention of 45% for legumes boiled 45-75 min and drained (code 0521), 30% for legumes boiled 2-2.5 h (code 0541), 60% for greens boiled in water to cover and drained (code 3005) and 90% for potatoes baked in the skin (code 3301). A cup of dried lentils simmered for an hour loses over half its folate, so a composition table value describes the cooked food only when the cooking matches. Folic acid in a fortified food or a tablet is stable and its dose is what the label says.食物叶酸的可利用率大致 50%，与食物一起摄入的 folic acid 约 85%，空腹接近 100%，1.7 和 2.0 两个 DFE 换算系数就是从这里来的（Suitor 与 Bailey, J Am Diet Assoc 2000;100:88-94, PMID 10646010）。食物叶酸是多谷氨酸盐，吸收前必须在刷状缘去结合，而且化学性质脆弱。USDA 营养素保留系数表（Table of Nutrient Retention Factors）第 6 版（2007）给出的叶酸保留率是：豆类煮 45-75 min 后沥干 45%（代码 0521），豆类煮 2-2.5 h 为 30%（代码 0541），绿叶菜加水没过煮后沥干 60%（代码 3005），带皮烤马铃薯 90%（代码 3301）。一杯干扁豆炖一小时会损失一半以上的叶酸，因此成分表数值只有在烹饪方式对得上时才描述熟食的实际含量。强化食品或片剂里的 folic acid 稳定，剂量就是标签写的那个数。

Data note数据说明 Every per-100 g composition value, gram weight and per-portion figure in the food rows and the dose comparison traces to a named USDA FoodData Central record and recomputes exactly, and all six cited PMIDs resolve to the stated journal, volume and pages. Two qualifications: the fortified-cereal row is an indicative label figure rather than a sourced composition record, and one uncited bioavailability claim was removed rather than kept高。食物行和剂量对比中的每一个每 100 g 成分值、克重和每份数值都可追溯到具名的 USDA FoodData Central 记录，重算完全吻合，引用的六个 PMID 全部指向所述期刊、卷号和页码。两点限定：强化谷物那一行是指示性的标签数据，并非有来源的成分记录；另有一条没有引文的生物利用度说法被删除，没有保留。

References:文献： Cochrane CD007950.pub3 (PMID 26662928); MRC PMID 1677062; Williams PMID 25590678; Ebbing PMID 19920236
TAKEVitamin D3 (cholecalciferol)维生素 D3（胆钙化醇）Grade A证据 A 级
Dose tested已验证剂量800-2,000 IU/d, taken daily. Never as an annual or monthly bolus.800 至 2000 IU/天，每日服用。绝不要按年或按月大剂量冲击给药。
Who it is for适用人群People with serum 25(OH)D below about 30 nmol/L: dark skin at high latitude, covered clothing, housebound, northern-European winter.血清 25(OH)D 低于约 30 nmol/L 的人：高纬度地区的深肤色人群、遮盖式着装者、久不出门者、北欧的冬季。

Pros优点

  • Correcting genuine deficiency is real medicine: it treats rickets and osteomalacia, and no other intervention does.纠正真正的缺乏是实打实的治疗：它能治佝偻病和骨软化症，没有别的干预能做到这一点。
  • With calcium, it cuts hip fracture in frail institutionalised elderly, RR 0.84 (0.74-0.96) across 9 trials and 49,853 people.与钙合用，可降低体弱的养老机构老人的髋部骨折，RR 0.84（0.74-0.96），9 项试验、49853 人。
  • Deficiency is genuinely common in the target groups: 17.5% of non-Hispanic Black Americans are below 30 nmol/L versus 2.1% of white Americans, and 17.7% of Europeans are below it in the October to March window.在目标人群中，缺乏确实普遍：非西班牙裔黑人美国人中 17.5% 低于 30 nmol/L，白人为 2.1%；欧洲人在 10 月至次年 3 月这段时间有 17.7% 低于该值。
  • Costs almost nothing. Generic D3 at 1,000 IU is a few pounds a year.几乎不花钱。1000 IU 的普通 D3 一年只要几英镑。

Cons缺点

  • It does not prevent cancer or cardiovascular disease. VITAL (n=25,871, 5.3 years): invasive cancer HR 0.96 (0.88-1.06), major cardiovascular events HR 0.97 (0.85-1.12). D-Health (n=21,315): all-cause mortality HR 1.04. ViDA (n=5,108): cardiovascular disease HR 1.02.它不能预防癌症或心血管病。VITAL（n=25871，5.3 年）：浸润性癌 HR 0.96（0.88-1.06），主要心血管事件 HR 0.97（0.85-1.12）。D-Health（n=21315）：全因死亡 HR 1.04。ViDA（n=5108）：心血管病 HR 1.02。
  • Vitamin D alone does nothing for fractures. Cochrane: hip fracture RR 1.12 (0.98-1.29) without calcium. The calcium is doing the work.单用维生素 D 对骨折毫无作用。Cochrane：不加钙时髋部骨折 RR 1.12（0.98-1.29）。起作用的是钙。
  • More is actively worse, and this is the least-marketed finding in the field. Annual 500,000 IU increased falls (IRR 1.15) and fractures (IRR 1.26). Monthly 60,000 IU raised the proportion of people falling from 47.9% to 66.9%. Three years at 4,000 or 10,000 IU/d caused dose-dependent LOSS of radial bone density versus 400 IU/d.剂量越大反而越糟，而这是该领域最少被宣传的发现。每年 50 万 IU 增加跌倒（IRR 1.15）和骨折（IRR 1.26）。每月 6 万 IU 使跌倒人群比例从 47.9% 升到 66.9%。每天 4000 或 10000 IU 连服三年，桡骨骨密度相对 400 IU/天出现剂量依赖性的下降。
  • The 30 ng/mL threshold that drives most deficiency marketing came from the Endocrine Society, and that society walked it back in 2024. Its current guideline suggests against routine testing in healthy adults and against empiric supplementation above the reference intake in healthy under-75s.推动大部分“缺乏”营销的 30 ng/mL 阈值来自内分泌学会，而该学会在 2024 年已经收回了这个说法。其现行指南建议：健康成人不必常规检测，75 岁以下健康人也不建议在参考摄入量之上经验性补充。
  • Contraindicated in hypercalcaemia, primary hyperparathyroidism and granulomatous disease such as sarcoidosis or tuberculosis. Upper limit 4,000 IU/d.高钙血症、原发性甲状旁腺功能亢进、以及结节病或结核等肉芽肿性疾病禁用。上限 4000 IU/天。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose partly reachable靠吃只能部分达到 Data confidence: Low数据可信度：低

Oily fish, egg yolk and UV-treated mushrooms supply measurable vitamin D, and fortified fat spreads, milk, breakfast cereals and juices add small amounts, so this is a genuine dietary nutrient rather than a manufactured one. The RICH label needs qualifying on two counts: the food base is narrow (oily fish, egg yolk, UV-treated mushrooms), and two of the stronger rows below are not ordinary foods, since cod liver oil behaves as a supplement and fortified orange juice is a manufactured delivery vehicle. Population evidence points the same way, because SACN concluded the 10 µg/day RNI is difficult to achieve from natural food sources and set it as a year-round RNI for everyone aged 4 and over; UK mean intakes from food are around a third of that (the often-quoted NDNS figures of 2.8 µg/day at ages 19 to 65 and 3.3 µg/day in over-65s are carried here as uncorroborated, since the full SACN report could not be retrieved to confirm them).多脂鱼、蛋黄和经紫外线处理的菇类都能提供可测量的维生素 D，强化脂肪涂抹酱、牛奶、早餐谷物和果汁再补上少量，所以这是一种真正来自膳食的营养素，并非只能靠工业制造。RICH 这个标签需要在两点上加以限定：食物基础很窄（多脂鱼、蛋黄、经紫外线处理的菇类），而且下表中较强的两行并不是普通食物，鱼肝油的行为更接近补充剂，强化橙汁则是工业化的输送载体。人群证据指向同一方向：SACN 认为 10 µg/天 的 RNI 很难仅从天然食物来源达到，并把它定为 4 岁及以上所有人群的全年 RNI；英国来自食物的平均摄入量约为该值的三分之一（常被引用的 NDNS 数字，19 至 65 岁 2.8 µg/天、65 岁以上 3.3 µg/天，此处标为未获证实，因为无法取得完整的 SACN 报告加以确认）。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 1,000 IU (25 µg), the low end of ordinary supplement doses, is about 150 g of cooked sockeye salmon every day, or 155 g to 463 g of grilled herring depending on which herring value holds. 4,000 IU (100 µg) is roughly 600 g of sockeye salmon, 621 g to 1.85 kg of herring, about 109 large egg yolks, or about 890 g of UV-treated portabella mushrooms daily. A 50,000 IU (1,250 µg) weekly loading dose has no food equivalent: 7.5 kg of sockeye salmon, or 7.8 to 23.1 kg of grilled herring. One food gets close on mass alone, UV-treated maitake at the top of its measured range, where 178 g would carry 4,000 IU, and that content is unlabelled, spans 0.1 to 56.1 µg/100 g by growing method and is D2 rather than D3. Above roughly 50 degrees north, cutaneous synthesis is effectively zero from October to March, so there is no sunlight to close the winter shortfall.1,000 IU（25 µg）属于普通补充剂剂量的低端，相当于每天吃约 150 g 熟红鲑，或 155 g 至 463 g 烤鲱鱼（取决于采用哪个鲱鱼数值）。4,000 IU（100 µg）大致等于每天 600 g 红鲑、621 g 至 1.85 kg 鲱鱼、约 109 个大蛋黄，或约 890 g 经紫外线处理的褐菇。每周 50,000 IU（1,250 µg）的负荷剂量在食物里没有对应物：7.5 kg 红鲑，或 7.8 至 23.1 kg 烤鲱鱼。只有一种食物单看质量能接近，即处于实测范围上限的紫外线处理灰树花，178 g 就能提供 4,000 IU，但这一含量不会标注在包装上，随栽培方式在 0.1 至 56.1 µg/100 g 之间波动，而且它是 D2，不是 D3。在北纬约 50 度以上，10 月至次年 3 月皮肤合成实际为零，冬季缺口没有阳光可以填补。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Mushroom vitamin D is D2 (ergocalciferol), a different molecule from the D3 in fish, egg yolk and almost all supplements, and D3 raises serum 25(OH)D more effectively, with the gap widest for intermittent bolus dosing (Tripkovic et al., Am J Clin Nutr 2012;95:1357-64, PMID 22552031, DOI 10.3945/ajcn.111.031070, mean difference 34.10 nmol/L for bolus dosing, P = 0.0002; the advantage is lost with daily dosing, P = 0.10). UV mushroom content is wildly variable and usually unlabelled: USDA measured UV-treated portabella at 3.4 µg/100 g from one producer and 25.6 µg/100 g from another, maitake from 0.1 to 56.1 µg/100 g by growing method, and untreated white mushrooms at 0.1 to 0.2 µg/100 g, so buying ordinary mushrooms because 'mushrooms have vitamin D' gets you essentially nothing. Species and provenance matter as much as the food name: the salmon row is wild sockeye, while farmed Atlantic salmon, which is what most shoppers buy, runs several-fold lower, so 'salmon' on a pack does not deliver the sockeye figure. Cod liver oil is nominally a food but behaves as a supplement and carries 18,000 µg retinol per 100 g (CoFID 17-488, unconfirmed), so a tablespoon delivers about 8,160 IU of preformed vitamin A alongside the D3, which rules it out in pregnancy. Several real UK vehicles are missing from the table for want of a verifiable figure and should not be forgotten: fortified margarine and fat spreads (a statutory UK vitamin D vehicle for decades, and a larger contributor to UK intake than the US fortified orange juice listed), fortified breakfast cereals, kippers and other smoked herring, canned red sockeye (higher than the canned pink listed), herring and cod roe, and sun-dried shiitake for D2. Oily fish delivers D3 inside a fat matrix with EPA/DHA, protein, iodine and selenium; a capsule delivers D3 alone.菇类的维生素 D 是 D2（麦角钙化醇），与鱼类、蛋黄以及几乎所有补充剂中的 D3 是不同的分子，D3 提升血清 25(OH)D 的效率更高，间歇性大剂量给药时差距最大（Tripkovic 等，Am J Clin Nutr 2012;95:1357-64，PMID 22552031，DOI 10.3945/ajcn.111.031070，大剂量给药的平均差值为 34.10 nmol/L，P = 0.0002；每日给药时这一优势消失，P = 0.10）。紫外线处理菇类的含量波动极大，通常也不标注：USDA 测得一家生产商的紫外线处理褐菇为 3.4 µg/100 g，另一家为 25.6 µg/100 g，灰树花随栽培方式在 0.1 至 56.1 µg/100 g 之间，未处理的白蘑菇为 0.1 至 0.2 µg/100 g，所以只因为“菇类含维生素 D”就买普通蘑菇，基本什么都得不到。物种和产地与食物名称同样重要：表中的鲑鱼是野生红鲑，而大多数消费者买到的养殖大西洋鲑要低数倍，包装上写着“鲑鱼”并不能提供红鲑的数值。鱼肝油名义上是食物，行为上更像补充剂，每 100 g 含 18,000 µg 视黄醇（CoFID 17-488，未证实），因此一汤匙除 D3 之外还带来约 8,160 IU 的预制型维生素 A，孕期不宜使用。还有几种英国实际存在的载体因缺少可核实的数据而未列入表中，但不应被忽略：强化人造黄油和脂肪涂抹酱（数十年来英国法定的维生素 D 载体，对英国摄入量的贡献大于表中所列的美国强化橙汁）、强化早餐谷物、烟熏鲱鱼（kippers）及其他熏制鲱鱼、罐装红鲑（高于表中所列的罐装粉红鲑）、鲱鱼籽和鳕鱼籽，以及提供 D2 的晒干香菇。多脂鱼把 D3 放在脂肪基质中一并送来，同时带有 EPA/DHA、蛋白质、碘和硒；胶囊只送来 D3。

Absorption吸收 Vitamin D from both food and capsules is fat-soluble and absorbed better with a meal containing fat, which oily fish and egg yolk supply themselves. Form matters more than source: D2 from mushrooms is less effective per microgram than D3 (PMID 22552031). Egg yolk additionally contains 25-hydroxycholecalciferol, an already-hydroxylated metabolite that supplements do not normally provide. Composition tables bundle 25-OH-D3 into the headline total under the convention total = cholecalciferol + 5 x 25-OH-D3, so a 'vitamin D' number for eggs, trout or canned salmon is not strictly comparable to the D3 in a capsule; the canned pink salmon (12.1 + 5 x 0.30 = 13.6), trout (7.19 + 5 x 0.20 = 8.19) and whole egg (2.30 + 5 x 0.18 = 3.20) totals here all follow it.食物和胶囊里的维生素 D 都是脂溶性的，随含脂餐一起摄入吸收更好，而多脂鱼和蛋黄本身就自带脂肪。形式比来源更要紧：菇类的 D2 按每微克计算效力低于 D3（PMID 22552031）。蛋黄还额外含有 25-羟基胆钙化醇，这是一种已经羟化的代谢物，补充剂通常不提供。成分表按“总量 = 胆钙化醇 + 5 x 25-OH-D3”的惯例把 25-OH-D3 并入头条总量，所以鸡蛋、鳟鱼或罐装鲑鱼的“维生素 D”数字与胶囊中的 D3 并不严格可比；此处罐装粉红鲑（12.1 + 5 x 0.30 = 13.6）、鳟鱼（7.19 + 5 x 0.20 = 8.19）和全蛋（2.30 + 5 x 0.18 = 3.20）的总量都遵循这一惯例。

Data note数据说明 The single richest confirmed food (cooked sockeye salmon) and the UV portabella and fortified orange juice values check out, but most rows rest on McCance and Widdowson CoFID 2021 codes and not one CoFID code or value in the submission could be independently confirmed, because the dataset was not retrievable. Where USDA could be checked against CoFID the two diverged badly in this group: egg yolk vitamin D was overstated 2.4x and herring 3x. The maitake, eel and swordfish figures are indicative only, and the NDNS population intake figures could not be traced to the SACN report低。唯一一个获得证实的最富含食物（熟红鲑）以及紫外线处理褐菇和强化橙汁的数值都能核对通过，但多数行依赖 McCance and Widdowson CoFID 2021 的食物编码，而提交材料中没有任何一个 CoFID 编码或数值能够独立确认，因为该数据集无法取得。本组中凡是能用 USDA 与 CoFID 对照的地方，两者差异都很大：蛋黄维生素 D 被高估 2.4 倍，鲱鱼高估 3 倍。灰树花、鳗鱼和剑鱼的数字仅为指示性，NDNS 的人群摄入量数字也无法追溯到 SACN 报告。

TAKEVitamin B12 (cobalamin)维生素 B12（钴胺素）Grade B证据 B 级
Dose tested已验证剂量50-250 µg/d, or 1,000-2,000 µg once or twice weekly. Deficiency treatment: 1,000-2,000 µg/d orally.50 至 250 微克/天，或每周 1 至 2 次、每次 1000 至 2000 微克。治疗缺乏：口服 1000 至 2000 微克/天。
Who it is for适用人群Vegans and long-term vegetarians, metformin users, people on a proton pump inhibitor for over two years, post-bariatric patients, pernicious anaemia.纯素与长期素食者、二甲双胍使用者、服用质子泵抑制剂超过两年者、减重手术后患者、恶性贫血患者。

Pros优点

  • The deficiency is real and the neurological damage is irreversible once established, so correcting it early genuinely matters.这种缺乏是真实存在的，一旦形成，神经损害不可逆，所以及早纠正确实要紧。
  • Oral works as well as injection. Cochrane found 1,000 µg/d oral matched intramuscular, and at 2,000 µg/d oral was better by 680 pg/mL. Injections are a business model.口服和注射一样好。Cochrane 发现口服 1000 微克/天与肌注相当，2000 微克/天时口服还高出 680 pg/mL。打针是一门生意。
  • Risk in the named groups is well quantified: metformin lowers B12 by 19% over 4.3 years; two or more years of PPI use gives OR 1.65.上述人群的风险已被量化得很清楚：二甲双胍在 4.3 年内使 B12 下降 19%；使用 PPI 两年以上 OR 为 1.65。
  • No tolerable upper intake level has been needed, because no adverse effect has been found from excess.至今不需要设定可耐受上限，因为没有发现过量带来的不良反应。

Cons缺点

  • It does nothing for energy, mood or cognition in people who are not deficient. That is the entire marketing claim and it has no support.对不缺乏的人，它在精力、情绪和认知上毫无作用。而这恰恰是它全部的营销卖点，且毫无依据。
  • Do not treat with folate alone if B12 status is unknown, for the reason given under folic acid.B12 状态不明时不要单用叶酸治疗，理由见叶酸条目。
  • Cyanocobalamin should be avoided in Leber hereditary optic neuropathy and in renal failure. Use hydroxocobalamin instead.Leber 遗传性视神经病变和肾衰竭者应避免氰钴胺，改用羟钴胺。
  • High-dose biotin in the same B-complex product interferes with immunoassays including troponin, which can mimic or mask a heart attack on a blood test.同一款复合 B 族产品中的大剂量生物素会干扰包括肌钙蛋白在内的免疫检测，可能在化验上模仿或掩盖心肌梗死。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose NOT reachable by eating靠吃达不到剂量 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

Rich in animal foods and effectively absent from plant foods, because cobalamin is synthesised only by bacteria and archaea: every reliable source is an animal that accumulated bacterial B12, or a bacterially fermented or fortified product. The single word RICH is population-dependent and hides a reversal, so state it plainly: for an omnivore B12 is one of the easiest nutrients in the food supply, while for someone on an unfortified plant-based diet the same evidence makes it effectively absent, the only credible source being dried purple laver at 2.33 ug per 3 g sheet from a product whose content varies about elevenfold by origin and degrades with toasting and storage. On the contested plant candidates: spirulina is not usable, since 83% of its cobamide is pseudovitamin B12 (adeninylcobamide), inactive in humans, with only 17% real B12, and microbiological assays cannot tell them apart, which is why the labels claim high B12 (Watanabe et al., J Agric Food Chem 1999;47:4736-41, PMID 10552882); nori is usable and is the only credible plant source, carrying five biologically active cobalamin forms with adenosyl- and methylcobalamin about 60% of the total, and it corrected B12 status in deficient rats (Takenaka S et al., Br J Nutr 2001;85:699-703, PMID 11430774); tempeh is unreliable at 0.7-8.0 ug/100 g depending on which bacteria happened to contaminate the Rhizopus fermentation; mushrooms are not usable, with dried shiitake averaging 5.61 ug/100 g dry weight (range 1.3-12.7), black trumpet and golden chanterelle 1.09-2.65 ug/100 g dry weight and most other species about 0.09 ug/100 g or trace; chlorella ranges from zero to several hundred ug/100 g between products and cannot be relied on (all from Watanabe et al., Nutrients 2014;6:1861-73, PMID 24803097). Two further claims in the original submission, that kimchi and fermented vegetables sit below 0.1 ug/100 g and that lion's mane contains the inactive B12[c-lactone] analogue, could not be traced to the cited review and are recorded here as indicative and unsourced.动物性食物中含量丰富，植物性食物中基本没有，因为钴胺素只由细菌和古菌合成：所有可靠来源都是积累了细菌 B12 的动物，或经细菌发酵、或经强化的产品。RICH 这一个词依人群而定，还藏着一次反转，所以直说：对杂食者，B12 是整个食物供应里最容易获得的营养素之一；对吃未强化植物性饮食的人，同样的证据意味着它基本缺席，唯一可信来源是干紫菜，每张 3 g 的紫菜片含 2.33 µg，而这种产品的含量随产地相差约十一倍，并会因烘烤和储存而降解。关于几种有争议的植物候选来源：螺旋藻不可用，其钴酰胺中 83% 是假维生素 B12（腺嘌呤基钴酰胺），对人无活性，真正的 B12 只占 17%，微生物法测定又无法区分两者，这就是标签上 B12 数值很高的原因（Watanabe 等, J Agric Food Chem 1999;47:4736-41, PMID 10552882）；紫菜可用，是唯一可信的植物来源，含五种有生物活性的钴胺素形式，其中腺苷钴胺素和甲基钴胺素约占总量的 60%，并在缺乏 B12 的大鼠身上纠正了 B12 状态（Takenaka S 等, Br J Nutr 2001;85:699-703, PMID 11430774）；天贝不可靠，0.7-8.0 µg/100 g，取决于根霉发酵过程中恰好污染进去的是哪种细菌；食用菌不可用，干香菇平均 5.61 µg/100 g 干重（范围 1.3-12.7），黑喇叭菌（black trumpet）和金黄鸡油菌 1.09-2.65 µg/100 g 干重，其他多数种类约 0.09 µg/100 g 或仅为痕量；小球藻在不同产品之间从零到几百 µg/100 g 不等，无法依赖（以上均出自 Watanabe 等, Nutrients 2014;6:1861-73, PMID 24803097）。原稿另有两处说法，即泡菜和发酵蔬菜低于 0.1 µg/100 g，以及猴头菇含无活性的 B12[c-lactone] 类似物，无法在所引综述中找到出处，这里记为指示性且无来源。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 Against the 2.4 ug/day RDA there is no gap for anyone eating animal food: one 3 oz portion of cooked clams is 35 times the RDA, a slice of beef liver 20 times, a can of sardines 3.4 times. Against the supplement dose the gap cannot be closed. Oral B12 products are typically 500-1,000 ug, and 1,000-2,000 ug for treating deficiency. To have 1,000 ug physically present in a meal takes 1.01 kg of cooked clams, 1.17 kg of pan-fried lamb liver, 1.42 kg of braised beef liver, 4.17 kg of cooked blue mussels, 11.2 kg of canned sardines, 35.7 kg of cooked salmon, or 222 kg of whole milk, which is about 216 litres (the submission's '222 litres' confused grams with litres; 1,000/0.0045 = 222,222 g, and at about 1.03 kg/L that is 216 L). No one could eat any of those. The comparison is also the wrong one, because intrinsic-factor-mediated absorption saturates at about 1.5-2.0 ug per meal (Watanabe, Exp Biol Med 2007;232:1266-74, PMID 17959839), so everything above roughly 2 ug in a single sitting is absorbed only by passive diffusion at on the order of 1%. A 1,000 ug tablet works because 1% of 1,000 ug bypasses the receptor route, which no food can imitate and none needs to unless that route is broken. For a strict vegan the picture inverts: nothing reliably supplies even the 2.4 ug RDA except dried nori, and Watanabe puts the requirement at about 4 g/day of dried purple laver, which is about one and a third 3 g sheets every day (the submission said one and a half) from a product varying about elevenfold by origin. Fortified foods or a tablet are the honest answer.对照每日 2.4 µg 的 RDA，吃动物性食物的人不存在缺口：一份 3 oz 熟蛤蜊是 RDA 的 35 倍，一片牛肝 20 倍，一罐沙丁鱼 3.4 倍。对照补充剂剂量，缺口无法弥合。口服 B12 产品通常是 500-1,000 µg，治疗缺乏时 1,000-2,000 µg。要让一餐里实际存在 1,000 µg，需要 1.01 kg 熟蛤蜊、1.17 kg 煎羊肝、1.42 kg 炖牛肝、4.17 kg 熟蓝贻贝、11.2 kg 罐装沙丁鱼、35.7 kg 熟三文鱼，或 222 kg 全脂牛奶，约合 216 升（原稿写的 222 升把克和升搞混了；1,000/0.0045 = 222,222 g，按约 1.03 kg/L 折算是 216 L）。这些没人吃得下。这个对比本身也问错了问题，因为内因子介导的吸收在每餐约 1.5-2.0 µg 处饱和（Watanabe, Exp Biol Med 2007;232:1266-74, PMID 17959839），一次进食中超过约 2 µg 的部分只能靠被动扩散吸收，效率大约 1%。1,000 µg 的片剂之所以有效，是因为 1,000 µg 的 1% 绕开了受体途径，任何食物都模仿不了，而只要该途径没坏，也不需要模仿。对严格素食者，情况反转：除了干紫菜，没有任何食物能可靠提供哪怕 2.4 µg 的 RDA，Watanabe 把需要量定在每天约 4 g 干紫菜，相当于每天约一又三分之一张 3 g 的紫菜片（原稿说的是一张半），而这种产品的含量随产地相差约十一倍。强化食品或片剂才是诚实的答案。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Supplements use cyanocobalamin, a form not found in food, where the cyanide ligand is an artefact of the purification step and is removed intracellularly. Food B12 is protein-bound and needs gastric acid and pepsin to release it before intrinsic factor can take it up, so proton pump inhibitors, atrophic gastritis, gastric surgery and metformin knock out food B12 while leaving free crystalline B12 in a tablet or fortified cereal largely usable. Here the supplement is the mechanistically correct choice, and not merely the convenient one. The form risk with algae products runs opposite to the usual concentration worry: a spirulina capsule sold as a B12 source delivers mostly inactive pseudovitamin B12, and the microbiological assay behind the label number could not distinguish it from the real thing, so the label overstates delivered B12 rather than the dose being too strong. Note also that USDA gives yeast extract spread only 0.50 ug B12/100 g (FDC 167717), which is 0.03 ug per 6 g teaspoon: yeast does not make B12, so any yeast product that is a real source has been fortified and the number belongs to the fortification.补充剂用的是氰钴胺，食物中不存在这种形式，其中的氰基是提纯步骤留下的产物，进入细胞后会被去除。食物中的 B12 与蛋白结合，需要胃酸和胃蛋白酶先把它释放出来，内因子才能摄取，所以质子泵抑制剂、萎缩性胃炎、胃部手术和二甲双胍会废掉食物 B12，而片剂或强化谷物里游离的结晶 B12 大体仍可利用。在这一项上，补充剂是机制上正确的选择，不只是图方便。藻类产品的形式风险与通常担心的浓度问题方向相反：作为 B12 来源出售的螺旋藻胶囊，交付的主要是无活性的假维生素 B12，而标签数字背后的微生物法测定无法把它和真货区分开，所以标签高估了实际提供的 B12，这里的风险与剂量过强无关。另外注意，USDA 给酵母提取物涂抹酱的 B12 只有 0.50 µg/100 g（FDC 167717），每 6 g 一茶匙合 0.03 µg：酵母不产生 B12，所以任何真能算作来源的酵母产品都经过强化，那个数字属于强化本身。

Absorption吸收 About 50% of dietary B12 is assumed absorbed from a normal meal, but it varies sharply by food: fish 42%, sheep meat 56-89%, chicken 61-66% and eggs under 9% (Watanabe 2007, PMID 17959839). The egg figure matters because eggs are routinely offered to vegetarians as a B12 food; on absorbed B12 a large egg delivers about 0.04 ug, which is 1.7% of the RDA rather than the 19% the content figure implies. Cooking costs real B12. USDA Table of Nutrient Retention Factors Release 6 (2007) gives 70% for roasted beef (code 0601), 60% for beef braised or simmered without the drippings (0651/0653), 65% for roasted chicken (0805), 60% for liver simmered without drippings (1152), 90% for baked lean finfish (2301), 60% for shellfish boiled in the shell (2701) against 90% steamed (2702), and 30% for milk held at heat for an hour (2153). Keeping the pan juices recovers much of it, which is why the with-drippings factors run exactly 15 points higher. One methodological point earned by the corrected mussel row: where USDA publishes a cooked composition entry, use it, because a hand-applied retention factor ignores the moisture loss that concentrates B12 and in this case halved the figure for the food people actually eat.一般假定正常膳食中约 50% 的 B12 被吸收，但按食物差别很大：鱼 42%，羊肉 56-89%，鸡肉 61-66%，鸡蛋不到 9%（Watanabe 2007, PMID 17959839）。鸡蛋这个数字要紧，因为素食者常被推荐把鸡蛋当作 B12 食物来源；按实际吸收量算，一个大鸡蛋提供约 0.04 µg，占 RDA 的 1.7%，而含量数字给人的印象是 19%。烹饪会真实损失 B12。USDA 营养素保留系数表（Table of Nutrient Retention Factors）第 6 版（2007）给出：烤牛肉 70%（代码 0601），牛肉炖或煮且不计肉汁 60%（0651/0653），烤鸡 65%（0805），肝脏煮制不计肉汁 60%（1152），瘦身有鳍鱼烤制 90%（2301），带壳水煮贝类 60%（2701）而蒸制 90%（2702），牛奶持续加热一小时 30%（2153）。留住锅里的汤汁能收回很大一部分，这也是带肉汁的系数正好高 15 个百分点的原因。修正后的贻贝那一行还带出一个方法学要点：USDA 只要发布了熟食成分条目就该用它，因为手工套用保留系数会忽略水分流失对 B12 的浓缩作用，本例中这样做把人们真正吃到的那种食物的数值砍掉了一半。

Data note数据说明 for the animal-food rows: every per-100 g value and gram weight traces to a named FoodData Central record and every per-portion figure and percentage recomputes, and the Watanabe and Takenaka citations resolve to the stated journals, volumes and pages. Lower in two places that are stated rather than hidden: the nori figures and the whole vegan-diet conclusion rest on a single compiled review (Watanabe 2014) whose own product spread is about elevenfold, and the kimchi and lion's mane claims could not be traced to any cited source and are marked indicative. The 3 oz portion basis for lamb liver and Pacific oyster is stated by this dataset, not taken from a USDA household measure动物性食物各行为高：每一个每 100 g 数值和克重都可追溯到具名的 FoodData Central 记录，每个每份数值和百分比都能重算得出，Watanabe 和 Takenaka 的引文也都指向所述期刊、卷号和页码。有两处较低，并且是明说而非隐藏：紫菜数据和整个纯素饮食结论都依赖单一份汇编综述（Watanabe 2014），该综述自身的产品含量跨度约十一倍；泡菜和猴头菇两条说法无法追溯到任何引用来源，已标为指示性。羊肝和太平洋牡蛎的 3 oz 份量基准由本数据集给出，并非取自 USDA 的家庭常用量。

TAKEIron铁Grade A证据 A 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Test ferritin first. Treatment 60-120 mg elemental iron. Ferrous sulfate 325 mg delivers 65 mg elemental.先查铁蛋白。治疗剂量为元素铁 60 至 120 毫克。硫酸亚铁 325 毫克提供 65 毫克元素铁。
Who it is for适用人群Menstruating women with ferritin at or below about 50 µg/L, pregnancy, blood donors, post-bariatric patients.铁蛋白在约 50 微克/升及以下的经期女性、孕妇、献血者、减重手术后患者。

Pros优点

  • Grade A for treating iron-deficiency anaemia and for pregnancy outcomes, across 57 trials and 48,971 women.在治疗缺铁性贫血和改善妊娠结局上属 A 级，涵盖 57 项试验、48971 名女性。
  • Fatigue improves in non-anaemic iron-deficient women, but only below a ferritin threshold of about 50 µg/L. Above that, nothing happens.在无贫血但缺铁的女性中疲劳会改善，但仅限于铁蛋白低于约 50 微克/升。高于这个值就没有变化。
  • Cheap and generic. Ferrous sulfate is the reference standard and there is no evidence that premium salts work better.便宜且通用。硫酸亚铁是参照标准，没有证据表明高价盐型更有效。

Cons缺点

  • Alternate-day dosing is oversold. The absorption physiology is real (21.8% versus 16.3% fractional absorption) but the only adequately sized randomised trial with haemoglobin as the endpoint found the same final ferritin either way. Treat it as a tolerability strategy, not a superiority one.隔日给药被过度宣传。吸收生理学是真的（分次吸收率 21.8% 对 16.3%），但唯一以血红蛋白为终点、样本量足够的随机试验显示两种方案最终铁蛋白相同。把它当作改善耐受性的办法，而不是更有效的办法。
  • Never supplement anaemia that has not been shown to be iron-deficient. Anaemia of inflammation and haemochromatosis both get worse. Unexplained anaemia in an adult needs investigation, not a pill.绝不要对未证实是缺铁的贫血补铁。炎症性贫血和血色病都会因此加重。成年人不明原因的贫血需要检查，而不是吃药。
  • Contraindicated in hereditary haemochromatosis (HFE C282Y homozygotes) and in transfusion-dependent anaemias such as thalassaemia and myelodysplastic syndrome.遗传性血色病（HFE C282Y 纯合子）以及地中海贫血、骨髓增生异常综合征等依赖输血的贫血禁用。
  • Acute iron overdose was historically a leading cause of fatal poisoning in children under six, which is why unit-dose packaging exists. Keep it locked away.急性铁过量在历史上曾是六岁以下儿童致死性中毒的主要原因之一，单剂量包装正是因此而来。要锁好放置。
  • Gastrointestinal side effects are the main reason people stop. Upper limit 45 mg/d (US); EFSA sets no limit but a safe level of 40 mg/d.胃肠道副作用是人们停药的主要原因。美国上限 45 毫克/天；EFSA 未设上限，但给出 40 毫克/天的安全水平。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose partly reachable靠吃只能部分达到 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

Iron is genuinely abundant in ordinary food, in two chemically distinct forms that behave differently. Haem iron (offal, red meat, shellfish, blood sausage) is absorbed by a dedicated transporter and is largely indifferent to the rest of the plate; non-haem iron (legumes, seeds, greens, fortified flour) is the bulk of most people's intake and is absorbed at a fraction of the rate, heavily modified by vitamin C, polyphenols, phytate and calcium. Haem accounts for 77 percent of total iron in raw lean beef, 81 percent in lamb, 88 percent in pork and 74 percent in chicken (PMID 26433293), higher than the 40 percent assumed in the older Monsen equation; those fractions were measured in raw lean meat, so the haem share of a braised product is probably slightly lower than the calculations below imply. Reference point used in the table: EFSA PRI 16 mg/d for premenopausal women, 11 mg/d for men (EFSA, Dietary Reference Values for nutrients Summary report, approved 4 December 2017, doi 10.2903/sp.efsa.2017.e15121, Tables 5 and 7; underlying opinion EFSA Journal 2015;13(10):4254).铁在普通食物中确实丰富，并以两种化学性质不同、吸收表现也不同的形式存在。血红素铁（内脏、红肉、贝类、血肠）由专门的转运体吸收，基本不受同一餐其他食物影响；非血红素铁（豆类、种子、绿叶菜、强化面粉）构成多数人摄入量的主体，吸收率只有前者的一小部分，并明显受维生素 C、多酚、植酸和钙的影响。血红素铁占生瘦牛肉总铁的 77%，羊肉 81%，猪肉 88%，鸡肉 74%（PMID 26433293），高于较早的 Monsen 方程所假定的 40%；这些比例是在生瘦肉中测得的，因此炖煮产品中血红素铁的占比很可能略低于下文计算所暗示的水平。表中使用的参考值：EFSA PRI 绝经前女性 16 mg/d，男性 11 mg/d（EFSA，Dietary Reference Values for nutrients Summary report，2017 年 12 月 4 日通过，doi 10.2903/sp.efsa.2017.e15121，表 5 和表 7；基础意见书 EFSA Journal 2015;13(10):4254）。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 Two supplement doses need two answers. A nutritional dose (14 to 18 mg elemental iron, the EU labelling reference level) is comfortably reachable by eating: 1 cup of boiled lentils (6.6 mg) plus 85 g of braised lamb's liver (7.0 mg) plus 1 oz of pumpkin seeds (2.3 mg) is 15.9 mg in one day, and a single 85 g portion of braised pig's liver is 15.2 mg on its own. A therapeutic dose is out of reach. The absorption and treatment trials gave 60 mg and 120 mg of elemental iron as labelled ferrous sulfate, which is a salt weight of about 325 mg for 65 mg of iron (PMID 29032957). Matching 65 mg of iron by total content takes roughly 363 g of braised pig's liver, 785 g of lamb's liver, 3.3 kg of sirloin steak, 1.95 kg (about 10 cups) of boiled lentils, or 2.4 kg (about 80 cups) of raw spinach in a single day. By absorbed iron the food burden is about 1.6 times larger than the submission claimed, because the trial it cites measured cumulative fractional absorption of 16.3 percent on consecutive days and 21.8 percent on alternate days at 60 mg/d, and 11.8 percent for a single 120 mg dose, rather than the 10 percent assumed. At the source's own 16.3 percent a 65 mg dose delivers about 10.6 mg absorbed. Absorbing 10.6 mg as haem iron at 25 percent requires 42.4 mg of haem iron, about 1.94 kg of braised lean lamb shoulder (2.7 mg total iron per 100 g, 81 percent haem in raw lean; FDC 174331 and PMID 26433293). Absorbing the same 10.6 mg from non-haem food at 5 percent requires 212 mg of non-haem iron, about 6.4 kg of cooked lentils per day. Correcting a diagnosed deficiency cannot be done with food; preventing one can.两种补充剂剂量需要两个答案。营养剂量（14 至 18 mg 元素铁，欧盟标签参考量）靠吃就能轻松达到：1 杯煮扁豆（6.6 mg）加 85 g 炖羊肝（7.0 mg）加 1 oz 南瓜子（2.3 mg），一天合计 15.9 mg；单独一份 85 g 炖猪肝本身就有 15.2 mg。治疗剂量则达不到。吸收和治疗试验给的是以硫酸亚铁形式标示的 60 mg 和 120 mg 元素铁，65 mg 铁对应的盐重约为 325 mg（PMID 29032957）。若按总含量匹配 65 mg 铁，一天大约需要 363 g 炖猪肝、785 g 羊肝、3.3 kg 西冷牛排、1.95 kg（约 10 杯）煮扁豆，或 2.4 kg（约 80 杯）生菠菜。若按吸收铁计算，食物负担约为原稿所称的 1.6 倍，因为它引用的那项试验测得，在 60 mg/d 下连续每日给药的累积分数吸收率为 16.3%，隔日给药为 21.8%，单次 120 mg 剂量为 11.8%，原稿假定的 10% 低于这些实测值。按该来源自己的 16.3% 计算，65 mg 剂量提供约 10.6 mg 吸收铁。以 25% 的吸收率通过血红素铁吸收 10.6 mg，需要 42.4 mg 血红素铁，约合 1.94 kg 炖瘦羊肩肉（每 100 g 总铁 2.7 mg，生瘦肉中 81% 为血红素铁；FDC 174331 与 PMID 26433293）。以 5% 的吸收率从非血红素食物吸收同样的 10.6 mg，需要 212 mg 非血红素铁，约合每天 6.4 kg 熟扁豆。已确诊的缺铁无法靠食物纠正，预防缺铁可以。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Three traps, and the first is narrower than usually stated. (1) The retinol hazard belongs to liver, not to offal as a class. Braised lamb liver carries 7,490 ug retinol activity equivalents per 100 g, which is 6,367 ug in an 85 g portion, and braised beef liver 9,440 ug RAE per 100 g (raw beef liver 4,970 ug RAE; FDC 172532, 168626, 169451). That is why liver is contraindicated in pregnancy in most national guidance. The hazard separates cleanly by organ: braised lamb kidney is 12.4 mg iron with 137 ug RAE (FDC 174355) and braised pork kidney 5.29 mg iron with 78 ug RAE (FDC 167860), so kidney beats every muscle-meat row on iron without the vitamin A problem. The earlier claim that the iron benefit and the vitamin A hazard travel together and cannot be separated is withdrawn. (2) Liver's iron is largely ferritin and haemosiderin iron, so its headline 8.28 mg is less absorbable than the haem fraction of plain muscle meat implies, and muscle meat with a smaller number can deliver more absorbed iron. (3) Supplement iron behaves unlike food iron: a 60 mg dose raises hepcidin and suppresses absorption of the next dose, which is why alternate-day dosing absorbed 21.8 percent against 16.3 percent on consecutive days (PMID 29032957). Food iron arriving in small amounts across the day never triggers that. On spinach, the correction runs both ways. Isotope work found that potassium oxalate added to a low-oxalate kale meal did not change non-haem iron absorption (11.5 percent against 10.7 percent, P=0.86), so the textbook oxalate explanation does not survive testing. But the spinach meal in the same study absorbed 24 percent less than the matched kale meal without reaching significance (P>0.16), and although the paper reports spinach as significantly higher in calcium and polyphenols it does not attribute the absorption difference to them. The honest reading is that spinach iron was numerically lower in a single small study, the oxalate mechanism is refuted, and no replacement mechanism is established. Either way a 30 g bowl of raw spinach leaves contains 0.81 mg of iron and yields a rounding error.三个陷阱，其中第一个的适用范围比通常所说的更窄。(1) 视黄醇危害属于肝脏，并不适用于内脏这一整类。炖羊肝每 100 g 含 7,490 ug 视黄醇活性当量，85 g 一份即 6,367 ug；炖牛肝每 100 g 含 9,440 ug RAE（生牛肝 4,970 ug RAE；FDC 172532、168626、169451）。这正是多数国家指南在孕期禁食肝脏的原因。危害按器官清晰分开：炖羊肾每 100 g 含铁 12.4 mg、视黄醇 137 ug RAE（FDC 174355），炖猪肾含铁 5.29 mg、78 ug RAE（FDC 167860），所以肾脏在含铁量上胜过表中所有肌肉肉类，同时没有维生素 A 问题。此前关于铁的益处与维生素 A 危害必然同行、无法分开的说法予以撤回。(2) 肝脏中的铁大部分是铁蛋白铁和血铁黄素铁，因此 8.28 mg 这个表面数值的可吸收性低于普通肌肉肉中血红素铁比例所暗示的水平，数字更小的肌肉肉反而能提供更多吸收铁。(3) 补充剂铁的行为与食物铁不同：60 mg 的剂量会升高铁调素并抑制下一次剂量的吸收，这就是隔日给药吸收 21.8%、而连续每日给药为 16.3% 的原因（PMID 29032957）。食物铁在一天之内小量陆续到达，从不触发这一机制。关于菠菜，纠正是双向的。同位素研究发现，向低草酸的羽衣甘蓝餐中加入草酸钾并未改变非血红素铁吸收（11.5% 对 10.7%，P=0.86），教科书式的草酸解释经不起检验。但同一研究中菠菜餐的吸收比配对的羽衣甘蓝餐低 24%，未达显著（P>0.16）；论文虽报告菠菜的钙和多酚显著更高，却没有把吸收差异归因于它们。诚实的解读是：在一项小样本研究中菠菜铁的吸收数值偏低，草酸机制已被否定，替代机制尚未确立。无论如何，一碗 30 g 生菠菜叶含铁 0.81 mg，得到的只是一个舍入误差。

Absorption吸收 Haem iron is absorbed at roughly 15 to 35 percent and non-haem at 2 to 20 percent, with iron status the dominant variable. Across whole diets rather than single meals, bioavailability is 14 to 18 percent for mixed diets and 5 to 12 percent for vegetarian diets in people with no iron stores, and the authors note that iron status generally has a greater effect than diet composition (PMID 20200263). Vitamin C: the source concludes that about 50 mg of ascorbic acid in each main meal is desirable for optimum effect, with the most pronounced effects in meals high in inhibitory ligands such as phytates and tannins (PMID 3700141). The '25 mg' lower bound and the 'several-fold' multiplier claimed earlier are not in that source and have been dropped. When the same amount of ascorbic acid is given across a complete diet over days, the facilitating effect is far less pronounced (PMID 11124756): squeezing lemon on your lentils helps, and it does not turn plant iron into meat iron. Tea and coffee inhibition, with numbers: a cup of coffee cut non-haem absorption from a hamburger meal by 39 percent and tea by 64 percent; instant coffee at double strength drove absorption from 5.88 percent to 0.53 percent; coffee one hour before the meal did no harm, while coffee one hour after inhibited as much as coffee with the meal (PMID 6402915). Black tea inhibited non-haem absorption by 79 to 94 percent, peppermint tea by 84 percent, cocoa by 71 percent and chamomile by 47 percent, dose-dependently on total polyphenols, and adding milk made no difference (PMID 10999016). That is polyphenol inhibition; phytate is a separate inhibitor sitting inside the wholegrains and legumes themselves. Practical consequence: the highest-yield single change for someone with low iron stores is moving tea and coffee to between meals rather than with or after them.血红素铁的吸收率大约为 15% 至 35%，非血红素铁为 2% 至 20%，铁营养状况是主导变量。若看整体膳食而非单餐，无铁储备者混合膳食的生物利用度为 14% 至 18%，素食膳食为 5% 至 12%，作者指出铁营养状况的影响通常大于膳食组成（PMID 20200263）。维生素 C：该来源的结论是每一主餐中约 50 mg 抗坏血酸有利于取得最佳效果，在植酸、鞣质等抑制性配体含量高的餐食中效果最明显（PMID 3700141）。此前声称的 25 mg 下限和数倍增幅并不见于该来源，已删除。当同样剂量的抗坏血酸在数天内随完整膳食给予时，促进作用要弱得多（PMID 11124756）：在扁豆上挤点柠檬有帮助，但不会把植物铁变成肉类铁。茶与咖啡的抑制作用，附上数字：一杯咖啡使汉堡餐的非血红素铁吸收下降 39%，茶下降 64%；双倍浓度的速溶咖啡把吸收率从 5.88% 压到 0.53%；餐前 1 小时喝咖啡无害，餐后 1 小时喝咖啡的抑制程度与随餐喝相当（PMID 6402915）。红茶使非血红素铁吸收降低 79% 至 94%，薄荷茶 84%，可可 71%，洋甘菊 47%，抑制程度随总多酚量呈剂量依赖，加奶没有区别（PMID 10999016）。这是多酚的抑制作用；植酸是另一种抑制因素，本身就存在于全谷物和豆类之中。实际后果：对铁储备偏低的人，收益最高的单一改变是把茶和咖啡移到两餐之间，避免随餐或餐后饮用。

Data note数据说明 Every per-100 g figure carried over from the submission matched FoodData Central to the digit on independent retrieval, and all cited PMIDs and DOIs resolved to papers saying what they are cited as saying. Two lower-confidence spots are flagged in the rows themselves: the blood sausage entry is a US proxy whose UK equivalent could not be confirmed, and the eleven newly added rows use conventional portion sizes rather than USDA's own measure table, so their per-portion figures are derived rather than tabulated高。从原稿沿用的每一个每 100 g 数值在独立检索时都与 FoodData Central 逐位一致，所引用的全部 PMID 和 DOI 都能查到对应论文，内容与引用说法相符。两处置信度较低的地方已在相应行标出：血肠条目是美国替代数据，其英国对应值无法确认；新增的十一行使用常规份量而非 USDA 自己的计量表，因此其每份数值是推算的，并非表中列出的。

References:文献： Cochrane 2024; Stoffel PMID 29032957; von Siebenthal PMID 38021373; Verdon BMJ 2003
TAKEIodine碘Grade A证据 A 级
Dose tested已验证剂量150 µg/d as potassium iodide. 250 µg/d in pregnancy and lactation (WHO).碘化钾形式 150 微克/天。妊娠期与哺乳期 250 微克/天（WHO）。
Who it is for适用人群Preconception, pregnancy and lactation, vegans, and anyone avoiding both dairy and fish.备孕、孕期与哺乳期、纯素者，以及同时回避乳制品和鱼类的人。

Pros优点

  • Universal salt iodisation is the single most successful micronutrient intervention in public health, and it works because iodine is the sole substrate for thyroid hormone.全民食盐加碘是公共卫生史上最成功的微量营养素干预，它之所以有效，是因为碘是甲状腺激素唯一的合成原料。
  • The deficiency has quietly returned in the UK and parts of Europe. UK schoolgirls had a median urinary iodine of 80.1 µg/L against a WHO adequacy threshold of 100, with 51% mildly deficient.这种缺乏在英国和欧洲部分地区已悄然回潮。英国女学生尿碘中位数为 80.1 微克/升，而 WHO 的充足阈值是 100，其中 51% 属轻度缺乏。
  • The requirement rises about 50% in pregnancy, and the window for fetal brain development does not reopen.妊娠期需求上升约 50%，而胎儿脑发育的窗口一旦错过就不再打开。

Cons缺点

  • Correcting status during pregnancy may be too late. MITCH randomised 832 mildly deficient pregnant women to 200 µg/d and found a verbal IQ difference of -0.7 in their children at age 5-6. Fix it before conception.在孕期才纠正可能已经太晚。MITCH 试验把 832 名轻度缺碘孕妇随机分到 200 微克/天，其子女在 5 至 6 岁时言语智商差异为 -0.7。要在受孕前解决。
  • Avoid kelp and bladderwrack entirely. Content is wildly variable and can deliver many times the upper limit in a single dose.完全避开海带和墨角藻。其含量极不稳定，单次剂量就可能达到上限的许多倍。
  • An iodine load can precipitate iodine-induced hyperthyroidism in autonomous thyroid nodules or multinodular goitre, and can cause hypothyroidism in autoimmune thyroid disease. Anyone with a thyroid history needs medical advice first.在自主功能性甲状腺结节或多结节性甲状腺肿中，碘负荷可诱发碘致甲亢；在自身免疫性甲状腺病中则可能导致甲减。有甲状腺病史者必须先咨询医生。
  • Upper limit 1,100 µg/d (US) but only 600 µg/d (EFSA).美国上限 1100 微克/天，而 EFSA 只有 600 微克/天。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose reachable by eating靠吃可以达到剂量 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

Iodine occurs in ordinary food, and the answer rests on a narrow set of foods: dairy, white fish, eggs, shellfish and, where a country iodises it, table salt. Nothing else contributes meaningfully. The RICH classification carries a jurisdictional qualifier: for a UK reader it rests on dairy, white fish and eggs alone, because the UK has no salt iodisation programme, so the US iodised salt row below is not transferable and is marked as such. Iodine in milk is not intrinsic to the cow, it arrives from fortified cattle feed and iodophor teat disinfectants, which is why it is seasonal (higher in winter housing) and why organic milk is lower. Reference point used in the table: EFSA AI 150 ug/d for adults, 200 ug/d in pregnancy and lactation (EFSA, Dietary Reference Values for nutrients Summary report, approved 4 December 2017, doi 10.2903/sp.efsa.2017.e15121, Tables 5 and 7; underlying opinion EFSA Journal 2014;12(5):3660).碘存在于普通食物中，答案落在一小组食物上：乳制品、白肉鱼、蛋、贝类，以及在实行食盐加碘的国家里的食用盐。其他食物的贡献都不明显。RICH（丰富）这一分类带有辖区限定：对英国读者而言，它只依靠乳制品、白肉鱼和蛋，因为英国没有食盐加碘计划，所以下表中的美国加碘盐一行不可套用，并已如此标注。牛奶中的碘来自强化饲料和碘伏乳头消毒剂，并非奶牛自身产生，这也是它随季节波动（冬季圈养期更高）以及有机牛奶含量更低的原因。表中使用的参考值：EFSA AI 成人 150 ug/d，孕期和哺乳期 200 ug/d（EFSA，Dietary Reference Values for nutrients Summary report，2017 年 12 月 4 日通过，doi 10.2903/sp.efsa.2017.e15121，表 5 和表 7；基础意见书 EFSA Journal 2014;12(5):3660）。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 There is essentially no gap. A standard iodine supplement or prenatal multivitamin supplies 150 ug, exactly the EFSA adult AI. A single 120 g UK haddock fillet delivers 390 ug, two and a half times the dose. One 115 g cod fillet delivers 131 ug. About 400 ml of milk delivers roughly 156 ug at milk density (412 g); the 151 ug figure quoted previously is what 1.6 USDA cups (398 g) gives, and the two should not be equated. Six large eggs deliver 147 ug. Half a teaspoon of iodised salt (3 g) delivers 152 ug where salt is iodised. Iodine belongs in the small category of supplements a normal eater does not need. The gap opens the moment those specific foods leave the diet, and the UK numbers are stark. Substituting three dairy portions a day (milk, yoghurt, cheese) with plant alternatives cuts the iodine those portions supply from 124 ug to 2.6 ug, a 97.9 percent loss, taking the contribution to the 150 ug recommendation from 83 percent down to 1.8 percent (PMID 35373723). The same market survey identified 146 milk alternatives and 76 yoghurt alternatives, excluded 48 organic products, and found 29 milk alternatives and 4 yoghurt alternatives iodine-fortified; that is 28 percent and 6 percent of the non-organic subset, or 19.9 percent and 5.3 percent of all products identified. The 28 and 6 percent figures quoted earlier against the full denominators were wrong. Against those, 88 percent and 73 percent were fortified with calcium; no cheese alternative and no fish alternative was iodine-fortified; and organic plant alternatives cannot legally be fortified. This shows up in real people: in NDNS years 7 to 9, adults and children consuming milk alternatives exclusively had an iodine intake of 94 ug/d against 129 ug/d for cows' milk consumers, and a median urinary iodine concentration of 79 ug/l against 132 ug/l, which classifies the milk-alternative group as iodine deficient by the WHO criterion while the milk drinkers were sufficient (PMID 32993817). Unfortified milk-alternative concentrations were a median 7.3 ug/kg, 1.7 percent of winter conventional cows' milk; the three fortified products found in 2015 sat at 266 to 287 ug/kg (PMID 28946925).基本上没有缺口。标准的碘补充剂或孕期复合维生素提供 150 ug，正好等于 EFSA 成人 AI。单块 120 g 的英国黑线鳕鱼柳提供 390 ug，是该剂量的两倍半。一块 115 g 鳕鱼柳提供 131 ug。约 400 ml 牛奶按牛奶密度（412 g）计算提供约 156 ug；此前引用的 151 ug 是 1.6 个 USDA 杯（398 g）的量，两者不应等同。六个大号鸡蛋提供 147 ug。在实行加碘的地区，半茶匙加碘盐（3 g）提供 152 ug。碘属于正常饮食者不需要补充的那一小类。一旦这些特定食物离开饮食，缺口立刻出现，英国的数据很直白。把一天三份乳制品（牛奶、酸奶、奶酪）换成植物替代品，这些份量提供的碘从 124 ug 降到 2.6 ug，损失 97.9%，对 150 ug 推荐量的贡献从 83% 降到 1.8%（PMID 35373723）。同一项市场调查识别出 146 种牛奶替代品和 76 种酸奶替代品，排除了 48 种有机产品，发现 29 种牛奶替代品和 4 种酸奶替代品做了碘强化；这相当于非有机子集的 28% 和 6%，或全部已识别产品的 19.9% 和 5.3%。此前按全部分母引用的 28% 和 6% 是错的。相比之下，88% 和 73% 做了钙强化；没有任何奶酪替代品和鱼类替代品做碘强化；有机植物替代品在法律上不能强化。这在真实人群中有体现：在 NDNS 第 7 至 9 年，只饮用植物奶的成人和儿童碘摄入量为 94 ug/d，饮用牛奶者为 129 ug/d，尿碘浓度中位数分别为 79 ug/l 和 132 ug/l，按 WHO 标准前一组属于碘缺乏，而牛奶饮用者充足（PMID 32993817）。未强化植物饮品的碘浓度中位数为 7.3 ug/kg，只有冬季常规牛奶的 1.7%；2015 年发现的三种强化产品在 266 至 287 ug/kg 之间（PMID 28946925）。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Kelp is the dangerous answer, and the danger is dosing variability rather than iodine itself. Across 12 species of commercially sold edible seaweed, iodine ranged from 16 ug/g in nori to over 8,165 ug/g in processed kelp granules from Laminaria digitata sold as a salt substitute, a 510-fold spread, and within a single species it varied with preharvest conditions (514 ug/g in sun-bleached blades, 6,571 ug/g in fresh juvenile blades) (PMID 15588380). One gram of those granules is 54 times the adult AI. A 2021 survey of 96 commercial macroalgae products found 128 to 62,400 ug of iodine per portion in wholefood kelp products and 5 to 5,600 ug per supplement dose, that for 54 of the 96 products a single serving or dose would exceed the tolerable upper intake level, and that species labelling and declared iodine content were frequently inadequate or inaccurate (PMID 33889064). A kelp tablet is therefore an unlabelled dose of a potent thyroid-active substance, and excess iodine causes both hypothyroidism and hyperthyroidism. If iodine is the goal, potassium iodide at a known 150 ug, or milk, fish and eggs, are the correct answers and kelp is not. Second, milk: iodine there comes from feed and dairy hygiene, so it moves with farming practice. Organic milk was 42.1 percent lower in iodine than conventional in a 172-sample UK retail survey (median 144.5 against 249.5 ng/g; PMID 21781365), and winter milk runs higher than summer. Someone switching to organic milk has quietly cut their main iodine source by nearly half without changing anything visible. Third, iodised salt: the USDA entry in the table is a US product, the UK has no iodisation programme, and that is precisely why the Bath group repeatedly identify milk, dairy and fish as the main UK iodine sources. Fourth, the plant drinks in the table are fortified products, with calcium and vitamin A, that skip iodine. That is the mechanism behind the 97.9 percent substitution loss rather than an absence of fortification technology.海带是那个危险的答案，危险之处在于剂量的不可预期，碘本身并非问题。在 12 种商售可食海藻中，碘含量从海苔的 16 ug/g 到作为盐替代品出售的指状海带（Laminaria digitata）加工海带颗粒的 8,165 ug/g 以上，相差 510 倍；同一物种内部也随采收前条件而变（日晒漂白的叶片 514 ug/g，新鲜幼叶 6,571 ug/g）（PMID 15588380）。一克这种颗粒相当于成人 AI 的 54 倍。2021 年对 96 种商售大型藻类产品的调查发现，整食型海带产品每份含碘 128 至 62,400 ug，补充剂每次剂量 5 至 5,600 ug；96 种产品中有 54 种，一次食用或一次剂量就会超过可耐受最高摄入量；物种标注和申报的碘含量常常不充分或不准确（PMID 33889064）。因此一片海带片剂就是一剂未标明用量的强效甲状腺活性物质，而碘过量既可导致甲减也可导致甲亢。若目标是补碘，正确答案是剂量已知为 150 ug 的碘化钾，或牛奶、鱼和蛋，海带不在其中。其次是牛奶：其中的碘来自饲料和乳品卫生措施，因此会随养殖方式变化。在一项 172 份英国零售样品的调查中，有机牛奶的碘含量比常规牛奶低 42.1%（中位数 144.5 对 249.5 ng/g；PMID 21781365），冬季牛奶高于夏季。换成有机牛奶的人，在没有任何可见改变的情况下已经把主要碘来源砍掉近一半。第三是加碘盐：表中的 USDA 条目是美国产品，英国没有加碘计划，这正是 Bath 研究组反复把牛奶、乳制品和鱼列为英国主要碘来源的原因。第四，表中的植物饮品是强化产品，强化了钙和维生素 A，却跳过了碘。这就是 97.9% 替代损失背后的机制，问题并不在于缺少强化技术。

Absorption吸收 Iodine bioavailability is the simple case. Iodide from milk, iodised salt and potassium iodide supplements is almost completely absorbed, and urinary iodine excretion is used directly as the intake biomarker on the standard assumption that about 90 percent of ingested iodine is excreted in urine (PMID 25274294). There is no meaningful absorption advantage to any form and no matrix effect worth chasing: 150 ug from a fillet of cod, a pot of yoghurt or a tablet are close to interchangeable systemically. The one real form difference sits at the top end. Organically bound iodine in seaweed is released variably during digestion and cooking, and boiling kelp leaches a large fraction of its iodine into the water, so a seaweed dose is uncertain in both directions. Two further practical points: iodine and selenium interact, because the deiodinase enzymes that convert thyroxine to the active hormone are selenoproteins, so iodine repletion in a selenium-poor person behaves differently; and goitrogens in raw brassicas and cassava compete with iodide uptake, which matters only when iodine intake is already marginal.碘的生物利用度属于简单情形。来自牛奶、加碘盐和碘化钾补充剂的碘化物几乎完全被吸收，尿碘排出量被直接用作摄入量的生物标志物，其标准假设是摄入碘约 90% 经尿排出（PMID 25274294）。任何形式都没有值得追求的吸收优势，也没有值得计较的基质效应：来自一块鳕鱼柳、一小杯酸奶或一片药片的 150 ug，在体内几乎可以互换。唯一真实的形式差异出现在高端。海藻中有机结合的碘在消化和烹调过程中的释放量不稳定，煮海带会把其中很大一部分碘浸出到水里，因此海藻的剂量在两个方向上都不确定。另有两个实用要点：碘和硒相互作用，因为把甲状腺素转化为活性激素的脱碘酶属于硒蛋白，所以硒不足的人补碘的表现会不同；生十字花科蔬菜和木薯中的致甲状腺肿物质会与碘化物摄取竞争，这只在碘摄入本已处于边缘水平时才重要。

Data note数据说明 for the core of the item. All USDA figures matched FoodData Central to the digit, and the Bath-group and Nicol PMIDs were confirmed verbatim including the 97.9 percent loss, the 94 against 129 ug/d NDNS intakes, the 79 against 132 ug/l urinary concentrations, the 438 and 324 ug/kg milk medians and the 42.1 percent organic deficit. Two rows are weaker and marked in place: the haddock and scampi figures come from a compiled UK secondary table (BDA Iodine Food Fact Sheet) rather than a primary analysis, so they are indicative高，就该条目的核心而言。所有 USDA 数值与 FoodData Central 逐位一致，Bath 研究组和 Nicol 的 PMID 均经逐字核实，包括 97.9% 的损失、NDNS 中 94 对 129 ug/d 的摄入量、79 对 132 ug/l 的尿碘浓度、438 和 324 ug/kg 的牛奶中位数以及 42.1% 的有机牛奶差距。两行较弱并已就地标注：黑线鳕和挪威海螯虾的数值来自一份英国二次汇编表（BDA Iodine Food Fact Sheet），而非一手分析，只作参考。

References:文献： Vanderpump Lancet 2011 PMID 21640375; MITCH PMID 29030199; Cochrane PMID 28260263
TAKECreatine monohydrate一水肌酸Grade A证据 A 级
Dose tested已验证剂量3-5 g/d. Loading is optional: 20 g/d for 6 days and 3 g/d for 28 days reach the same muscle saturation.3 至 5 克/天。冲击期可有可无：20 克/天服 6 天与 3 克/天服 28 天，肌肉饱和程度相同。
Who it is for适用人群Anyone doing resistance training, and older adults in particular. Also vegetarians and vegans, whose baseline stores are lower.任何做抗阻训练的人，尤其是老年人。此外还有素食者和纯素者，他们的基础储备更低。

Pros优点

  • The best-evidenced ergogenic aid on the market. In older adults doing resistance training, +1.37 kg lean tissue mass (95% CI 0.97-1.76) over training alone, across 22 randomised trials.市面上证据最扎实的运动增效补剂。在做抗阻训练的老年人中，比单纯训练多增加 1.37 公斤瘦体重（95% CI 0.97-1.76），来自 22 项随机试验。
  • Extremely cheap. Monohydrate costs pennies per dose and is the form used in essentially every trial.极其便宜。一水肌酸每次的成本只有几便士，而且几乎所有试验用的都是这个形式。
  • Long safety record: no signal of harm in healthy kidneys across years of use in trials.安全记录长：在肾功能正常者中，多年的试验使用未见危害信号。

Cons缺点

  • The cognition claim is weaker than the marketing. Pooled memory effect SMD 0.31 (0.18-0.44), and EFSA formally concluded in 2024 that a cause-and-effect relationship with cognitive function has NOT been established.认知方面的说法远弱于营销。记忆的合并效应 SMD 0.31（0.18-0.44），而 EFSA 在 2024 年正式认定，与认知功能的因果关系尚未成立。
  • Do not pay for HCl, buffered, liquid or micronised premium forms. They are price increases with no comparative evidence behind them.不要为盐酸盐、缓冲型、液态或“微粒化”高端形式付钱。它们只是涨价，背后没有对照证据。
  • Existing chronic kidney disease or dialysis requires nephrology supervision, because the safety data are in healthy kidneys only.已有慢性肾病或在透析者需在肾科监督下使用，因为安全数据只来自肾功能正常的人。
  • Expect 1-2 kg of water weight in the first weeks. That is intracellular water, not fat, but it matters if you compete in a weight class.头几周会增加 1 至 2 公斤水重。那是细胞内水分而非脂肪，但如果你参加分级别的比赛，这一点很要紧。
  • No official upper limit exists. The commonly quoted safety envelope comes from an industry-affiliated position stand, and the actual sentence is absence of evidence of harm rather than demonstrated safety.没有官方上限。常被引用的安全区间来自一份与行业有关联的立场声明，而其原话是“没有证据显示有害”，而不是“已证明安全”。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose NOT reachable by eating靠吃达不到剂量 Data confidence: Medium数据可信度：中

Creatine is a genuine dietary constituent, confined to the skeletal muscle of animals: Harris 1997 measured about 30 mmol/kg (393 mg/100 g) in uncooked beef, chicken and rabbit muscle. Organ distribution is the trap, because ox heart holds 295 mg/100 g while ox liver holds only 30 mg/100 g despite the liver being where creatine is synthesised. Plant foods contain none, so for a vegetarian or vegan the dietary status is effectively zero rather than RICH; baseline muscle total creatine was 117 mmol/kg dry mass in vegetarians against 130 in non-vegetarians.肌酸是真实存在的膳食成分，只存在于动物的骨骼肌中：Harris 1997 在生牛肉、鸡肉和兔肉肌肉中测得约 30 mmol/kg（393 mg/100 g）。器官分布是个陷阱，牛心为 295 mg/100 g，而牛肝只有 30 mg/100 g，尽管肝脏正是合成肌酸的部位。植物性食物完全不含肌酸，所以对素食者或纯素者而言，膳食中的肌酸实际为零，谈不上丰富；素食者肌肉总肌酸基线为 117 mmol/kg 干重，非素食者为 130。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 On the verified Harris figure of 393 mg/100 g, 3 g/day of creatine takes 763 g of raw lean beef and 5 g/day takes 1,272 g, about six 200 g steaks every day, carrying roughly 280 g of protein and its full fat and calorie load. On Balsom's slightly higher 4.5 g/kg for beef it is 667 g and 1,111 g. Balsom's herring figure is the highest on the list and would still need 500-770 g of raw herring daily, and that figure is indicative only. Cooking makes the plate-equivalent worse, since creatine converts to inert creatinine, so the raw-basis numbers are the optimistic case. Nobody eats this way.按已核实的 Harris 数值 393 mg/100 g 计算，每天 3 g 肌酸需要 763 g 生瘦牛肉，5 g/天需要 1,272 g，相当于每天约六块 200 g 的牛排，随之带来约 280 g 蛋白质以及全部脂肪和热量负担。若按 Balsom 略高的牛肉 4.5 g/kg 计算，则分别为 667 g 和 1,111 g。Balsom 给出的鲱鱼数值在整张表里最高，仍需每天 500-770 g 生鲱鱼，而且该数值只能算参考性质。烹饪会让真正到嘴的量更不划算，因为肌酸会转化为无活性的肌酸酐，所以以生重为基础的数字已经是最乐观的情形。没有人会这样吃饭。

Absorption吸收 Creatine monohydrate is close to completely absorbed and dietary creatine from meat is also efficiently absorbed, so absorption is not the limiting step; dose size is. The responsive variable is baseline muscle store: vegetarians started at 117 mmol/kg dry mass versus 130 in non-vegetarians and showed larger increases in total creatine, phosphocreatine, lean tissue and work performance after supplementation (Burke DG et al., Med Sci Sports Exerc 2003;35(11):1946-55, PMID 14600563). Habitual omnivore intake is roughly 1-2 g/day against a whole-body turnover of about 2 g/day in a 70 kg male, with the balance made endogenously (PMID 7817065), which is why a supplement of 3-5 g/day is a two- to five-fold multiple of anything a diet delivers. Cooking losses are the one real bioavailability penalty for the food form: in cooked beef, creatine and taurine are the compounds most reduced, partly by conversion to creatinine and partly by loss into the cooking juices (Purchas RW, Rutherfurd SM, Pearce PD, Vather R, Wilkinson BHP, Meat Sci 2004;68(2):201-7, PMID 22062229).一水肌酸几乎可以完全吸收，肉类中的膳食肌酸也吸收良好，限制因素是剂量大小，吸收环节没有障碍。真正有反应的变量是肌肉基线储量：素食者起点为 117 mmol/kg 干重，非素食者为 130，补充后素食者在总肌酸、磷酸肌酸、瘦体组织和做功能力上的提升幅度更大（Burke DG et al., Med Sci Sports Exerc 2003;35(11):1946-55, PMID 14600563）。杂食者的习惯摄入量大约 1-2 g/天，而 70 kg 男性的全身周转量约 2 g/天，差额由体内自行合成（PMID 7817065），这也是 3-5 g/天的补充剂相当于膳食供给量二到五倍的原因。烹饪损失是食物形式唯一真正的吸收代价：熟牛肉中减少最多的化合物正是肌酸和牛磺酸，一部分转化为肌酸酐，一部分随肉汁流失（Purchas RW, Rutherfurd SM, Pearce PD, Vather R, Wilkinson BHP, Meat Sci 2004;68(2):201-7, PMID 22062229）。

Data note数据说明 The five Harris 1997 rows (beef, chicken, rabbit, ox heart, ox liver) were confirmed against the paper down to the mmol/kg conversions, and the whole dose-gap arithmetic was re-derived and held. Five of the ten rows (pork loin, herring, salmon, cod, milk) rest entirely on a single 1994 narrative review's compiled table with no traceable primary analysis, and no composition database carries creatine, so those figures cannot be raised above indicative中。Harris 1997 的五行（牛肉、鸡肉、兔肉、牛心、牛肝）已对照原文核实，连 mmol/kg 换算都逐一验证，整套剂量差额的算术也重新推导并成立。十行中有五行（猪里脊、鲱鱼、三文鱼、鳕鱼、牛奶）完全依赖 1994 年一篇叙述性综述汇编的表格，找不到可追溯的原始分析，而且没有任何成分数据库收录肌酸，因此这些数字只能停留在参考级别。

TAKEProtein powder蛋白粉Grade A证据 A 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Whatever brings total daily protein to about 1.6 g/kg. The powder itself has no special property.补到每日总蛋白约 1.6 克/公斤即可。粉末本身没有任何特殊之处。
Who it is for适用人群People doing resistance training who are currently falling short of 1.6 g/kg/d from food.正在做抗阻训练、且靠食物达不到 1.6 克/公斤/天的人。

Pros优点

  • The nutrient is Grade A. Protein supplementation on top of resistance training adds 2.49 kg to 1RM strength and 0.30 kg of fat-free mass across 49 randomised trials and 1,863 people.作为营养素属 A 级。在抗阻训练之外补充蛋白，49 项随机试验、1863 人的数据显示 1RM 力量增加 2.49 公斤、去脂体重增加 0.30 公斤。
  • The dose-response is precisely mapped: fat-free mass gains plateau at 1.62 g/kg/d, so you know exactly when to stop paying for more.量效关系被测得很精确：去脂体重的增益在 1.62 克/公斤/天见顶，所以你清楚知道从哪里开始不必再多花钱。
  • Convenient and shelf-stable, which is a real advantage for people who cannot cook three protein-containing meals.方便、耐储存，对做不到三餐都有蛋白的人来说，这是实实在在的好处。
  • Kidney fear is unfounded in healthy people. The reassuring data are solid, though they apply to healthy kidneys only.在健康人身上，对肾脏的担心没有根据。这方面的数据扎实，但只适用于肾功能正常者。

Cons缺点

  • The benefit is real and small. Three hundred grams of extra muscle over months of training is what the meta-analysis actually found. Food protein does the same job.收益真实但很小。meta 分析真正得到的，是数月训练后多出的 300 克肌肉。食物蛋白能起同样的作用。
  • Branched-chain amino acids sold alongside are redundant and mechanistically incoherent. No human study has ever quantified muscle protein synthesis from oral BCAAs alone, and both intravenous studies found BCAAs DECREASED it. A 25 g whey serving already contains 5-6 g of BCAAs plus the six essential amino acids BCAAs lack.与之一同销售的支链氨基酸既多余，机制上也说不通。从没有人体研究定量过单独口服 BCAA 对肌蛋白合成的作用，而仅有的两项静脉研究都发现 BCAA 反而降低了合成。一份 25 克乳清本身就含 5 至 6 克 BCAA，外加 BCAA 所缺的那六种必需氨基酸。
  • Heavy-metal loading is a genuine issue in plant and organic powders, which carry more cadmium and lead than whey. Third-party testing matters here more than in most categories.植物蛋白和有机蛋白粉的重金属负荷是个真问题，其镉和铅含量高于乳清。在这个品类里，第三方检测比多数品类都重要。
  • Chronic kidney disease stage 3 or above requires a renal dietitian to set the protein prescription.慢性肾病 3 期及以上，蛋白摄入量必须由肾科营养师制定。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose reachable by eating靠吃可以达到剂量 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

Protein powder is itself a food fraction, so there is no molecule here that food lacks: whey and casein are dairy by-products, soya and pea isolates are legume fractions. Ordinary single portions deliver 5-53 g each, with grilled turkey breast fillet at 35.0 g/100 g and fresh Parmesan at 36.2 g/100 g topping the table. This is the one item on the list where everyday food comfortably beats the supplement.蛋白粉本身就是食物的一个组分，这里没有任何食物缺少的分子：乳清和酪蛋白是乳品副产物，大豆和豌豆分离蛋白是豆类组分。普通的单份食物就能提供 5-53 g，表中最高的是烤火鸡胸肉 35.0 g/100 g 和新鲜帕玛森干酪 36.2 g/100 g。这是全表唯一一项日常食物轻松胜过补充剂的成分。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 A 1.6 g/kg target is 112 g/day for a 70 kg adult and food covers it without powder. Worked day: 2 boiled eggs (14.1 g) plus a 170 g pot of Greek style yogurt (9.7 g) plus a 130 g grilled chicken breast (41.6 g) plus 200 g cooked red lentils (16.2 g) plus 250 mL semi-skimmed milk (9.0 g) plus 30 g Cheddar (7.6 g) totals 98.2 g; add one 100 g can of tuna in brine and it reaches 123 g, over target. A 100 kg athlete at 1.6 g/kg (160 g) gets there by adding a 150 g grilled turkey breast fillet (52.5 g) or a 170 g rump steak (52.7 g). A shopper does better than the table suggests on dairy, since modern strained pots and skyr run roughly 10-12 g/100 g against CoFID's traditional Greek style yogurt at 5.7 g. The gap appears only at very high targets combined with poor appetite, a low-calorie diet or exclusively plant sources, where food volume becomes the binding constraint. Powder solves convenience and calorie density.1.6 g/kg 的目标对 70 kg 成年人是 112 g/天，普通饮食不靠蛋白粉就能覆盖。示范一天：2 个煮鸡蛋（14.1 g）加 1 盒 170 g 希腊式酸奶（9.7 g）加 130 g 烤鸡胸（41.6 g）加 200 g 煮熟红扁豆（16.2 g）加 250 mL 半脱脂牛奶（9.0 g）加 30 g 切达干酪（7.6 g），合计 98.2 g；再加 1 罐 100 g 盐水金枪鱼即达到 123 g，超过目标。100 kg 运动员按 1.6 g/kg 需要 160 g，再加一份 150 g 烤火鸡胸肉（52.5 g）或 170 g 牛臀肉排（52.7 g）就够。乳制品这一栏，消费者的实际处境比表格更好，因为现在的过滤型酸奶和 skyr 大约在 10-12 g/100 g，而 CoFID 收录的传统希腊式酸奶只有 5.7 g。缺口只出现在目标很高又叠加食欲差、低热量饮食或全植物来源的情况，此时食物体积成为约束条件。蛋白粉解决的是便利性和热量密度。

Absorption吸收 Absorption differences between food and powder are about speed and amino acid pattern, not quantity absorbed. Animal-source protein is more digestible and more leucine-dense per gram than most plant sources: roast chicken breast is 31.0 g protein and 2.33 g leucine per 100 g, that is 7.5% of protein as leucine (USDA FoodData Central FDC ID 171477, SR Legacy NDB 5064, both values verified). Whey is faster and more leucine-rich per gram than whole food, casein and whole-food meals are slower, and for total daily protein this difference is small. One genuine food-form penalty: composition tables report protein as nitrogen multiplied by a conversion factor, so figures for plant foods with non-protein nitrogen slightly overstate usable protein, and cooking method changes yield per gram bought (raw beef mince is 19.7 g/100 g versus 21.8 g/100 g stewed as water is lost, CoFID 18-469 and 18-470, both verified).食物与蛋白粉之间的吸收差别在速度和氨基酸模式上，吸收总量相当。动物蛋白比多数植物来源更易消化，每克含亮氨酸也更多：烤鸡胸每 100 g 含 31.0 g 蛋白质和 2.33 g 亮氨酸，亮氨酸占蛋白质的 7.5%（USDA FoodData Central FDC ID 171477，SR Legacy NDB 5064，两个数值均已核实）。乳清比整食吸收更快、每克亮氨酸更高，酪蛋白和整食餐更慢，就全天蛋白质总量而言这点差别不大。食物形式确有一处真实的折扣：成分表把氮乘以换算系数报告为蛋白质，所以含非蛋白氮的植物性食物数值会略微高估可用蛋白，而烹饪方式会改变每克买入原料的产出（生牛肉末为 19.7 g/100 g，炖后因失水为 21.8 g/100 g，CoFID 18-469 和 18-470，均已核实）。

Data note数据说明 All 12 original CoFID codes and protein values were queried against the dataset itself and matched to the decimal, including the three the verifier specifically suspected (cottage cheese 9.4, boiled egg 14.1, red lentils 8.1), as did the beef mince pair and the USDA leucine figure. The seven added rows come from CoFID 2021 as identified in the verification report; food codes were supplied for turkey breast and Parmesan only, so the other five carry the dataset attribution without a code高。原有 12 个 CoFID 编码及其蛋白质数值全部在数据集中查证，逐位小数吻合，包括核查者特别怀疑的三项（白干酪 9.4、水煮鸡蛋 14.1、红扁豆 8.1），牛肉末的一对数值和 USDA 亮氨酸数值同样吻合。新增的七行来自核查报告中标明的 CoFID 2021，其中只有火鸡胸肉和帕玛森干酪给出了食物编码，另外五行只标注数据集来源，没有编码。

TAKEPsyllium husk (ispaghula)洋车前子壳Grade B证据 B 级
Dose tested已验证剂量About 10 g/d, always with a full glass of fluid. Separate from other oral drugs by about two hours.约 10 克/天，务必配一整杯水。与其他口服药间隔约两小时。
Who it is for适用人群People with raised LDL cholesterol, irritable bowel syndrome of either subtype, or chronic constipation.低密度脂蛋白胆固醇偏高者、任一亚型的肠易激综合征患者、慢性便秘者。

Pros优点

  • LDL cholesterol falls 0.33 mmol/L (95% CI -0.38 to -0.27) at a median 10.2 g/d across 28 trials, and the apolipoprotein B evidence is graded HIGH quality, which is rare anywhere in this field.28 项试验、中位剂量 10.2 克/天下，低密度脂蛋白胆固醇下降 0.33 mmol/L（95% CI -0.38 至 -0.27），且载脂蛋白 B 的证据被评为高质量，这在整个领域都很少见。
  • Irritable bowel syndrome: relative risk of persistent symptoms 0.83 (0.73-0.94), NNT 7. Very few gut products have a number this good.肠易激综合征：症状持续的相对风险 0.83（0.73-0.94），NNT 7。肠道类产品里很少有这么漂亮的数字。
  • Cheap, generic and unglamorous, which is why it is under-sold rather than over-sold.便宜、通用、毫不起眼，正因如此它是被低估而不是被过度营销的。
  • Works in both constipation-predominant and diarrhoea-predominant IBS, because it is a gel-forming fibre rather than a stimulant.在便秘型和腹泻型肠易激中都有效，因为它是形成凝胶的纤维，而不是刺激性泻剂。

Cons缺点

  • No hard-outcome trial exists. The LDL reduction is a surrogate endpoint, so nobody has shown psyllium prevents a heart attack.没有硬终点试验。低密度脂蛋白的下降是替代终点，没有人证明过洋车前子能预防心肌梗死。
  • Contraindicated in dysphagia and in known or suspected bowel obstruction, stricture, impaction or ileus. This is an explicit FDA contraindication, not a formality.吞咽困难，以及已知或疑似的肠梗阻、狭窄、粪嵌塞或肠麻痹禁用。这是 FDA 明确列出的禁忌，不是走过场。
  • It must be taken with enough fluid. Bed-bound patients with poor fluid intake should not use it.必须配足够的液体服用。卧床且饮水少的患者不应使用。
  • It delays absorption of other oral drugs taken at the same time, which matters for narrow-therapeutic-index medicines.它会延迟同时服用的其他口服药的吸收，这对治疗窗窄的药物很要紧。
  • Wheat bran, sold beside it under identical digestive-health signage, is a different product and is null in IBS (RR 0.90) and often makes it worse. Do not substitute.摆在旁边、挂着同样“肠道健康”招牌的麦麸是另一种东西，在肠易激中无效（RR 0.90），还常常加重症状。不要替换。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose reachable by eating靠吃可以达到剂量 Data confidence: Medium数据可信度：中

Psyllium husk is itself a food ingredient, the milled seed coat of Plantago ovata, so the supplement and the food are the same material and nothing is extracted or concentrated. Among ordinary foods, the genuine analogues for viscous gel-forming fibre are oat and barley beta-glucan and the mucilage of ground flaxseed and chia; konjac glucomannan and guar gum are also sold as foods and are more viscous still, though no confirmed per-portion figure was available for them here. Legumes are not in the same class and have been dropped from that claim: their soluble fibre measures 0.41-1.36 g/100 g and, as this entry's own bioavailability section says, it ferments proximally and behaves differently at the same gram intake. Beta-glucan is also chemically distinct from psyllium's arabinoxylan gel.洋车前子壳本身就是食品原料，是卵叶车前（Plantago ovata）种皮经研磨得到的产物，所以补充剂与食物是同一种材料，没有任何提取或浓缩步骤。在普通食物里，能与之对应的黏性成胶纤维是燕麦和大麦的 β-葡聚糖（beta-glucan），以及亚麻籽粉和奇亚籽的黏质；魔芋葡甘聚糖和瓜尔胶同样作为食品出售，黏度还要更高，但本次没有可确认的每份含量数据。豆类不属于同一类，已从该说法中删去：其可溶性纤维为 0.41-1.36 g/100 g，并且按本条自己的生物利用度部分所述，它在近端结肠发酵，在相同克数摄入下表现完全不同。β-葡聚糖在化学上也与洋车前子的阿拉伯木聚糖凝胶不同。
