Rows tagged unconfirmed carry a figure the verification pass could not trace back to its cited source. The number is reported as found; hover the tag for the reason.标记为未核实的行，其数值在核查环节无法追溯到所引来源。数字按原样列出；把鼠标移到标记上可看具体原因。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 The 10 g/day husk dose that beat placebo in primary-care IBS (Bijkerk 2009, BMJ 339:b3154, PMID 19713235) is about one heaped tablespoon of a product sold as food, and 9 g of husk powder already supplies 6.0 g of soluble fibre, so for psyllium itself the gap is zero. Matching that 6-7 g of soluble fibre from other ordinary foods is a different question: at 0.42 g/100 g you would need roughly 1.6 kg of cooked porridge (about 6.8 cups), and canned kidney beans at 1.36 g/100 g would take about 493 g, which is 2.8 cups at 177 g per cup, corrected from the submission's 3 cups. Both of those soluble-fibre fractions come from one study table that could not be retrieved, so treat the kilogram figures as indicative. The separate and easier target of 3 g/day of oat or barley beta-glucan is reachable by eating: about 67-75 g of dry rolled oats at 4-4.5% w/w, about 40-55 g of oat bran at 5.5-8%, or about 75 g of barley at 4%. The submission's 40-50 g of dry oats applied an oat-bran-level percentage to whole oats and has been corrected.在基层医疗 IBS 研究中优于安慰剂的 10 g/day 壳粉剂量（Bijkerk 2009, BMJ 339:b3154, PMID 19713235）大约是一满汤匙作为食品出售的产品，9 g 壳粉本身已提供 6.0 g 可溶性纤维，所以对洋车前子而言差距为零。用其他普通食物凑出这 6-7 g 可溶性纤维是另一回事：按 0.42 g/100 g 计算需要约 1.6 kg 煮好的燕麦粥（约 6.8 杯），罐装红腰豆按 1.36 g/100 g 计算需要约 493 g，即按每杯 177 g 折算的 2.8 杯（原稿写 3 杯，已更正）。这两个可溶性纤维分项都来自同一份无法调取的研究表格，因此这些千克级数字只能视为指示性。另一个更容易达到的目标是每天 3 g 燕麦或大麦 β-葡聚糖（beta-glucan），单靠吃就能实现：按 4-4.5% w/w 计约 67-75 g 干燕麦片，按 5.5-8% 计约 40-55 g 燕麦麸，或按 4% 计约 75 g 大麦。原稿写 40-50 g 干燕麦，是把燕麦麸水平的百分比套到整燕麦上，已更正。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 There is no extract-versus-food problem because psyllium husk is unprocessed plant material, but three real caveats apply. Physical: the husk must be taken with a full glass of fluid, since a gel-forming dose swallowed dry can obstruct the oesophagus or bowel. Compositional: 'soluble fibre' on a label is not one substance. Psyllium's arabinoxylan gel is viscous and poorly fermented, while inulin carries the same soluble-fibre label and ferments fast with gas production, which is the opposite of what an IBS patient wants, so gram-for-gram substitution is a mistake. Processing: oat beta-glucan's benefit tracks viscosity, which depends on molecular weight, and milling, extrusion and prolonged heating degrade it, so a heavily processed oat product with an identical gram figure on the label is not equivalent to whole rolled oats.洋车前子壳是未加工的植物材料，因此不存在提取物与食物之别的问题，但有三个真实的注意点。物理层面：服用时必须配一整杯液体，干吞成胶剂量可能堵塞食管或肠道。成分层面：标签上的“可溶性纤维”并非单一物质。洋车前子的阿拉伯木聚糖凝胶黏度高、难发酵，而菊粉挂着同样的可溶性纤维标签，却发酵快并产气，这与 IBS 患者的需求正好相反，按克数等量替换是个错误。加工层面：燕麦 β-葡聚糖（beta-glucan）的获益跟随黏度，而黏度取决于分子量，研磨、挤压膨化和长时间加热都会使其降解，所以标签克数相同的深加工燕麦产品并不等同于整粒燕麦片。

Absorption吸收 Nothing here is absorbed, so bioavailability means viscosity, water-holding and fermentability. Psyllium holds water through the whole colon with a low gas yield, which is why it helps both constipation and diarrhoea; legume soluble fibre and inulin are largely fermented in the proximal colon and behave quite differently at the same gram intake. Analytical method is a genuine source of confusion: AOAC 991.43 gravimetric soluble-fibre values run systematically higher than the enzymatic-chemical (Englyst/NSP) values used in UK tables, so soluble-fibre numbers from different tables should not be mixed. Head-to-head evidence supports the distinction between fibre classes: at the same 10 g dose, psyllium beat placebo at one and two months while wheat bran did not (PMID 19713235).这里的物质都不被吸收，所以生物利用度指的是黏度、持水能力和可发酵性。洋车前子在整个结肠都能持水且产气量低，这是它对便秘和腹泻都有帮助的原因；豆类可溶性纤维和菊粉主要在近端结肠被发酵，在相同克数摄入下表现相差很大。分析方法是混乱的真实来源：AOAC 991.43 重量法测得的可溶性纤维值系统性高于英国食物成分表采用的酶化学法（Englyst/NSP）值，所以不同表格的可溶性纤维数字不应混用。头对头证据支持纤维类别之间的区分：同为 10 g 剂量，洋车前子在第一个月和第二个月均优于安慰剂，小麦麸则没有（PMID 19713235）。

Data note数据说明 The USDA total-fibre values (oat bran 15.4, barley 3.8) and the Bijkerk trial details were confirmed. Two weaknesses remain: the headline psyllium composition rests on a branded manufacturer-label record whose own total-fibre field reads 0 g, and every soluble/insoluble split for oatmeal and legumes comes from one 2002 table that could not be retrieved. The added flax and chia figures are the verification report's own range, not a traced composition record中。USDA 的总纤维值（燕麦麸 15.4，大麦 3.8）和 Bijkerk 试验细节已确认。仍有两处薄弱：洋车前子的主打成分数据依赖一份品牌厂家标签记录，而该记录自身的总纤维字段读数为 0 g；燕麦粥和豆类的所有可溶/不可溶分项都来自一份无法调取的 2002 年表格。新增的亚麻籽和奇亚籽数字取自核查报告自己给出的范围，并非可追溯的成分记录。

References:文献： Jovanovski PMID 30239559; Moayyedi PMID 25070054; Bijkerk BMJ 2009 PMID 19713235; Reynolds Lancet 2019 PMID 30638909
TAKECaffeine咖啡因Grade A证据 A 级
Dose tested已验证剂量3-6 mg/kg body mass, about 60 minutes before exercise. For a 70 kg person that is 210-420 mg.按体重 3 至 6 毫克/公斤，运动前约 60 分钟服用。70 公斤的人为 210 至 420 毫克。
Who it is for适用人群Almost anyone training, trained or untrained. Also shift workers and the sleep-deprived, for the separate alertness effect.几乎所有训练的人，无论是否受过训练。此外还有轮班工作者和睡眠不足者，用的是另一个提高警觉的效应。

Pros优点

  • The most reliably ergogenic legal substance in this document. An umbrella review of 11 systematic reviews containing 21 meta-analyses, all of moderate or high quality, found benefit for aerobic endurance, strength, muscle endurance, power, jumping and speed.本文中最可靠的合法运动增效物质。一项涵盖 11 篇系统综述、21 项 meta 分析的伞式综述（全部为中高质量）显示，对有氧耐力、力量、肌耐力、爆发力、弹跳和速度均有益。
  • Cheap, well characterised, and the dose-response is known.便宜、特性清楚，量效关系已知。
  • The mechanism is central rather than metabolic, so it works by reducing perceived effort and pain, which is why it helps across so many different tasks.其机制是中枢性而非代谢性的，通过降低主观用力感和疼痛感起作用，这也是它在如此多不同任务上都有效的原因。

Cons缺点

  • Genotype changes the sign of the effect. CYP1A2 AA carriers gain (SMD 0.30), AC carriers gain a little (0.16), and CC carriers get WORSE (SMD -0.22). Most people do not know their genotype.基因型会改变效应的方向。CYP1A2 的 AA 型获益（SMD 0.30），AC 型略有获益（0.16），而 CC 型表现变差（SMD -0.22）。多数人并不知道自己的基因型。
  • 9 mg/kg brings a high incidence of side effects with no added benefit. More is not better past 6 mg/kg.9 毫克/公斤会带来大量副作用而没有额外收益。超过 6 毫克/公斤就不是越多越好。
  • The fat-burner claim is the oversold part of the category. Thermogenesis is real and trivial.“燃脂”是这个品类里被过度吹嘘的部分。产热效应真实但微不足道。
  • Contraindicated or needing care in uncontrolled hypertension, arrhythmia, anxiety and panic disorder. EFSA caps pregnancy at 200 mg/d, and derives no safe intake for children.未控制的高血压、心律失常、焦虑症和惊恐障碍者禁用或需谨慎。EFSA 把妊娠期上限定在 200 毫克/天，对儿童则无法推导出安全摄入量。
  • Fluvoxamine is a potent CYP1A2 inhibitor and can raise caffeine exposure severalfold. Taken late, it damages the sleep that training depends on.氟伏沙明是强效 CYP1A2 抑制剂，可使咖啡因暴露量成倍升高。服用时间太晚则会损害训练所依赖的睡眠。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose reachable by eating靠吃可以达到剂量 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

Caffeine in ordinary drinks sits at the same scale as the supplement dose: USDA gives home brewed coffee 40 mg/100 g and restaurant espresso 212 mg/100 g, and the Brazilian caffeine table gives espresso 279 mg/100 mL. Guarana seed powder at roughly 2-6 g/100 g and instant coffee powder on a dry basis at roughly 3-4 g/100 g overshoot a full dose from a spoonful, though neither figure was traced to a primary analysis in this review. Tea, matcha, cola and dark chocolate all contribute at tens of milligrams per serving, and yerba mate belongs in the same group though no figure was available to place it.日常饮品里的咖啡因与补充剂剂量处在同一量级：USDA 给出家庭冲煮咖啡 40 mg/100 g、餐厅浓缩咖啡 212 mg/100 g，巴西咖啡因数据表给出浓缩咖啡 279 mg/100 mL。瓜拉纳籽粉约 2-6 g/100 g，速溶咖啡粉以干重计约 3-4 g/100 g，一勺就超过一个完整剂量，不过本次核查未能把这两个数字追溯到原始分析。茶、抹茶、可乐和黑巧克力每份都能贡献几十毫克，马黛茶属于同一档，只是没有可用数值来定位它。

Rows tagged unconfirmed carry a figure the verification pass could not trace back to its cited source. The number is reported as found; hover the tag for the reason.标记为未核实的行，其数值在核查环节无法追溯到所引来源。数字按原样列出；把鼠标移到标记上可看具体原因。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 An ergogenic 3-6 mg/kg is 210-420 mg for a 70 kg adult, which is two to four mugs of home brewed coffee at 96 mg each; a 200 mg pre-workout dose is about two mugs or three single espresso shots. What food cannot deliver is a known dose. Measured caffeine in caffeinated specialty coffees ranged 58-259 mg per dose, mean 188 mg (SD 36) for a 16 oz cup, and the same beverage bought from the same outlet on six consecutive days ranged 259-564 mg, a 2.2-fold swing in what the customer thought was an identical drink. Decaffeinated versions still contained up to 17.7 mg per dose. Matcha spans 18.9-44.4 mg/g, so one teaspoon is anywhere from 38 to 89 mg. Reaching the dose from drinks is trivial; hitting it within plus or minus 20% is not, which is why trials use capsules.具有运动增益作用的 3-6 mg/kg 对 70 kg 成年人是 210-420 mg，相当于两到四大杯家庭冲煮咖啡（每杯 96 mg）；200 mg 的训练前剂量约为两大杯，或三份单份浓缩咖啡。食物给不出的是一个已知剂量。含咖啡因的精品咖啡实测每份为 58-259 mg，16 oz 一杯的均值为 188 mg（SD 36）；同一家门店连续六天买同一款饮品，实测范围 259-564 mg，顾客以为一模一样的饮料相差 2.2 倍。脱咖啡因版本每份仍含最多 17.7 mg。抹茶跨度为 18.9-44.4 mg/g，一茶匙从 38 mg 到 89 mg 都有可能。靠饮品达到剂量很容易；把误差控制在正负 20% 以内很难，这就是试验采用胶囊的原因。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 The caveat is inverted here. Anhydrous caffeine powder is the same molecule and is dangerous precisely because it is concentrated: a level teaspoon is several grams, in the range associated with fatal poisoning, whereas the same amount as brewed coffee would be 30 to 50 mugs and physically self-limiting. Whole-drink forms carry matrix effects that change the experience and the risk profile. Coffee brings chlorogenic acids and, when unfiltered, diterpenes that raise LDL; tea and matcha bring L-theanine and catechins that alter the subjective stimulation; energy drinks bring sugar, taurine and often glucuronolactone, so a caffeine dose from a can is never only caffeine. Guarana concentrates the same molecule in a seed powder, which is how many energy products reach their potency without looking like a caffeine tablet. Tea and coffee polyphenols also inhibit non-haem iron absorption when taken with meals, a cost the capsule does not impose. Energy drink and specialty coffee servings are large and easy to stack, and label values are nominal rather than analysed.这一项的提醒是反向的。无水咖啡因粉是同一分子，危险恰恰来自它的浓度：一平茶匙就有几克，落在与致死性中毒相关的区间，而同样的量换成冲煮咖啡是 30 到 50 大杯，生理上自然会喝不下去。完整饮品形式带有基质效应，会改变体验和风险特征。咖啡带来绿原酸，未过滤时还带来会升高 LDL 的二萜；茶和抹茶带来 L-茶氨酸和儿茶素，改变主观兴奋感；能量饮料带来糖、牛磺酸，常常还有葡萄糖醛酸内酯，所以一罐提供的咖啡因剂量从来不只是咖啡因。瓜拉纳把同一分子浓缩在籽粉里，许多能量产品正是靠它达到效力，外观上又不像咖啡因药片。茶和咖啡的多酚随餐摄入还会抑制非血红素铁的吸收，这是胶囊没有的代价。能量饮料和精品咖啡的份量偏大，容易叠加，而标签数值只是标称值，并未经过分析测定。

Absorption吸收 Caffeine is essentially completely absorbed from every form tested, so there is no meaningful absorption penalty for the food route; the differences are in rate and in dose certainty. Liquids reach peak plasma concentrations faster than capsules, chewing gum faster still, and a hot drink sipped over 20 minutes produces a flatter curve than a capsule swallowed at once, which matters for timing a pre-exercise dose and not for total exposure. Analytical values differ between databases for the same drink because brewing dominates: USDA lists brewed coffee at 40 mg/100 g and espresso at 212 mg/100 g (FDC 171890, 171891), while the Brazilian table lists espresso at 279 mg/100 mL (DOI 10.3390/nu14204417). Both are correct for what they measured, which is the whole point: the food is the variable, and the absorption is not.所有受试形式的咖啡因基本都能完全吸收，走食物途径没有值得一提的吸收折扣；差别在速率和剂量确定性上。液体比胶囊更快达到血浆峰值，咀嚼胶更快；一杯热饮分 20 分钟慢慢喝，曲线比一口吞下的胶囊平缓，这影响运动前的服用时机，不影响总暴露量。同一种饮品在不同数据库之间的分析值不同，因为冲煮方式起主导作用：USDA 列出冲煮咖啡 40 mg/100 g、浓缩咖啡 212 mg/100 g（FDC 171890、171891），巴西数据表列出浓缩咖啡 279 mg/100 mL（DOI 10.3390/nu14204417）。就各自测定的对象而言两者都对，这恰恰是要点所在：变量在食物本身，吸收环节没有变量。

Data note数据说明 for the database and BraCaffT rows. All four USDA FDC IDs were verified down to NDB number, description and nutrient value; all six BraCaffT values, the matcha range and every McCusker variability figure were confirmed verbatim. The two added rows, guarana and instant coffee powder, rest on approximate ranges from the verification report with no primary source traced, and are labelled indicative. Yerba mate is a known omission with no figure to place it数据库行和 BraCaffT 行为高。四个 USDA FDC ID 全部核实到 NDB 编号、描述和营养素数值；六个 BraCaffT 数值、抹茶范围以及 McCusker 的每一项变异性数据都逐字确认。新增的两行，瓜拉纳籽粉和速溶咖啡粉，依据的是核查报告给出的近似范围，没有追溯到原始来源，已标为参考性质。马黛茶是已知的遗漏，没有可用数值来定位。

References:文献： Guest ISSN PMID 33388079; Grgic PMID 30926628; Barreto PMID 37844569; EFSA J 2015;13(5):4102
TAKEOmega-3 (EPA and DHA)Omega-3（EPA 与 DHA）Grade B证据 B 级
Dose tested已验证剂量4 g/d of prescription-grade product if fasting triglycerides are at or above 500 mg/dL. Otherwise eat oily fish.若空腹甘油三酯达到或超过 500 mg/dL，用处方级产品 4 克/天。否则请吃多脂鱼。
Who it is for适用人群People with severe hypertriglyceridaemia. Separately, pregnant women with genuinely low baseline DHA, and people who eat essentially no fish.重度高甘油三酯血症患者。另外还有基础 DHA 确实偏低的孕妇，以及基本不吃鱼的人。

Pros优点

  • Triglyceride lowering is genuine pharmacology: 4 g/d cuts triglycerides by at least 30% in severe hypertriglyceridaemia, and the AHA endorses this specific indication.降甘油三酯是实打实的药理作用：在重度高甘油三酯血症中，4 克/天至少降低 30%，美国心脏协会明确支持这一适应证。
  • REDUCE-IT was strongly positive in statin-treated patients with established cardiovascular disease: primary composite 17.2% versus 22.0%, HR 0.75 (0.68-0.83), an absolute reduction of 4.8 percentage points over 4.9 years.REDUCE-IT 在已服他汀且患有心血管病的人群中结果强阳性：主要复合终点 17.2% 对 22.0%，HR 0.75（0.68-0.83），4.9 年内绝对下降 4.8 个百分点。
  • Pregnancy: Cochrane found preterm birth before 37 weeks RR 0.89 (0.81-0.97) and before 34 weeks RR 0.58 (0.44-0.77), both graded high quality, across 70 trials and 19,927 women.妊娠期：Cochrane 在 70 项试验、19927 名女性中发现，37 周前早产 RR 0.89（0.81-0.97），34 周前早产 RR 0.58（0.44-0.77），两项均被评为高质量。

Cons缺点

  • It does not prevent cardiovascular disease at supplement doses. Cochrane, 86 trials and 162,796 people: all-cause mortality RR 0.97 (0.93-1.01) at HIGH certainty, stroke RR 1.02. VITAL and ASCEND both missed their primary endpoints at 1 g/d.在补充剂剂量下，它不能预防心血管病。Cochrane 纳入 86 项试验、162796 人：全因死亡 RR 0.97（0.93-1.01），高确定性；卒中 RR 1.02。VITAL 和 ASCEND 在 1 克/天下都未达主要终点。
  • The two big high-dose trials contradict each other. STRENGTH tested 4 g/d of EPA plus DHA against corn oil in 13,078 people and was flatly null (HR 0.99), stopped for futility. REDUCE-IT used a mineral-oil placebo that raised LDL, apolipoprotein B and hs-CRP in the control arm, so part of its 25% may be placebo-arm harm. Quote both trials or neither.两项大型高剂量试验互相矛盾。STRENGTH 在 13078 人中用 4 克/天的 EPA 加 DHA 对比玉米油，结果完全阴性（HR 0.99），因无效终止。REDUCE-IT 用的矿物油安慰剂使对照组的低密度脂蛋白、载脂蛋白 B 和超敏 C 反应蛋白升高，因此那 25% 中可能有一部分来自对照组受损。要引就两项一起引，否则一项也别引。
  • Atrial fibrillation risk rises with dose: HR 1.25 (1.07-1.46), dose-dependent across 7 trials. Prior atrial fibrillation is a reason to stay away.房颤风险随剂量上升：7 项试验中 HR 1.25（1.07-1.46），呈剂量依赖。有房颤史就是不该用的理由。
  • Bleeding risk on warfarin, direct oral anticoagulants, aspirin and clopidogrel. REDUCE-IT showed serious bleeding 2.7% versus 2.1%.与华法林、直接口服抗凝药、阿司匹林和氯吡格雷合用有出血风险。REDUCE-IT 中严重出血为 2.7% 对 2.1%。
  • Product quality is poor. Half of North American products exceeded voluntary oxidation limits, and 38% of Australian products exceeded primary oxidation limits, with premium pricing giving no advantage. Buy encapsulated, unflavoured and in date.产品质量差。北美一半的产品超过自愿性氧化限值，澳大利亚 38% 的产品超过初级氧化限值，而高价并不带来优势。要买胶囊装、无调味、在有效期内的。
  • Pregnancy is not straightforward either: ORIP (n=5,486, 900 mg/d) was null and showed excess very-large-for-gestational-age infants. Benefit concentrates in women with low baseline DHA.妊娠期也并不简单：ORIP（n=5486，900 毫克/天）为阴性，并出现超大于胎龄儿增多。获益集中在基础 DHA 偏低的女性身上。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose partly reachable靠吃只能部分达到 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

Oily fish supply EPA and DHA in gram quantities per ordinary portion, so this is one of the few supplement categories where food competes with capsules at physiological doses. One 143 g herring fillet or one 130 g salmon portion delivers 1.8-2.9 g EPA+DHA, roughly seven to twelve times a single day's EFSA Adequate Intake of 250 mg (EFSA Journal 2010;8(3):1461, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2010.1461; EFSA DRVs summary 2017). The lower end of that range is deliberate: the USDA farmed-salmon entry reflects older analyses, and in over 3,000 Scottish farmed salmon EPA+DHA fell from 2.74 g to 1.36 g per 100 g wet weight between 2006 and 2015 as feed shifted from fish oil to vegetable oil (Sprague 2016, DOI 10.1038/srep21892), giving 1.8 g for the same 130 g portion. Treat the farmed-salmon figures below as an upper bound and roughly halve them for current farmed fish. The richest sources in the USDA database are not fillets at all: caviar carries 6,540 mg EPA+DHA per 100 g and mixed fish roe 2,343 mg, both above cooked herring.多脂鱼每份常规食用量就能提供克级的 EPA 和 DHA，因此在生理剂量层面，这是少数几类食物能与胶囊正面竞争的补充剂。一片 143 g 的鲱鱼柳或一份 130 g 的三文鱼可提供 1.8-2.9 g EPA+DHA，约为 EFSA 单日适宜摄入量 250 mg 的七到十二倍（EFSA Journal 2010;8(3):1461, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2010.1461；EFSA DRVs summary 2017）。这个区间的下限是刻意保留的：USDA 的养殖三文鱼条目反映的是较早的分析数据，而在 3,000 多条苏格兰养殖三文鱼中，随着饲料从鱼油转向植物油，2006 至 2015 年间 EPA+DHA 从每 100 g 湿重 2.74 g 降至 1.36 g（Sprague 2016, DOI 10.1038/srep21892），同样 130 g 的一份就只有 1.8 g。下表中的养殖三文鱼数值应视为上限，对当前的养殖鱼大致折半。USDA 数据库里含量最高的来源都不是鱼柳：鱼子酱每 100 g 含 6,540 mg EPA+DHA，混合鱼卵含 2,343 mg，两者都高于熟鲱鱼。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 Two doses with two different answers. The physiological dose (EFSA AI 250 mg/day, evidence range 250-500 mg/day) is easily eaten: one 143 g herring fillet a week averages 410 mg/day, one 130 g farmed salmon portion 399 mg/day, one wild salmon portion 342 mg/day. Two mackerel fillets, two 92 g tins of sardines or two 45 g tins of anchovies a week give 258-302 mg/day. In portion terms 250-500 mg/day is 0.6-1.3 salmon portions, 0.6-1.2 herring fillets, 1.7-3.3 mackerel fillets, 1.9-3.9 tins of sardines, 1.9-3.8 tins of anchovies, 2.8-5.6 trout fillets, or 1.2-2.4 USDA 172 g cans of albacore per week. Tinned light tuna is the weakest realistic route at 370 mg per 165 g can, which is 5 cans a week for 250 mg/day and 9 cans a week for 500 mg/day. The pharmacological dose of 4 g/day used in trials and in prescription products (AHA Science Advisory, Circulation 2019, DOI 10.1161/CIR.0000000000000709; REDUCE-IT used 4 g icosapent ethyl) cannot be eaten. It requires 199 g/day of herring (1.4 kg/week), 186 g/day of farmed salmon on 2006-era composition or 294 g/day on 2015 composition (1.3-2.1 kg/week), 288 g/day of pickled herring, 333 g/day of mackerel (3.8 fillets a day), 407 g/day of sardines (4.4 tins a day), 195 g/day of anchovies (4.3 tins a day, with the sodium load that implies), 61 g/day of caviar (about four tablespoons a day), or 464 g/day of tinned albacore. Above roughly 1 g/day of EPA+DHA, supplements are the only realistic route.两种剂量，两个不同的答案。生理剂量（EFSA AI 250 mg/day，证据区间 250-500 mg/day）很容易靠吃达到：每周一片 143 g 鲱鱼柳平均折合 410 mg/day，每周一份 130 g 养殖三文鱼 399 mg/day，一份野生三文鱼 342 mg/day。每周两片鲭鱼柳、两罐 92 g 沙丁鱼或两罐 45 g 凤尾鱼可提供 258-302 mg/day。换算成份数，250-500 mg/day 相当于每周 0.6-1.3 份三文鱼、0.6-1.2 片鲱鱼柳、1.7-3.3 片鲭鱼柳、1.9-3.9 罐沙丁鱼、1.9-3.8 罐凤尾鱼、2.8-5.6 片鳟鱼柳，或 1.2-2.4 罐 USDA 172 g 装长鳍金枪鱼。罐装淡肉金枪鱼是现实可行路径中最弱的一条，每 165 g 罐仅 370 mg，要达到 250 mg/day 需每周 5 罐，500 mg/day 需每周 9 罐。试验和处方产品所用的 4 g/day 药理剂量（AHA Science Advisory, Circulation 2019, DOI 10.1161/CIR.0000000000000709；REDUCE-IT 使用 4 g icosapent ethyl，即二十碳五烯酸乙酯）无法靠吃达到。它需要每天 199 g 鲱鱼（每周 1.4 kg），按 2006 年成分计每天 186 g 养殖三文鱼、按 2015 年成分计每天 294 g（每周 1.3-2.1 kg），每天 288 g 醋渍鲱鱼，每天 333 g 鲭鱼（每天 3.8 片鱼柳），每天 407 g 沙丁鱼（每天 4.4 罐），每天 195 g 凤尾鱼（每天 4.3 罐，随之而来的还有相应的钠负荷），每天 61 g 鱼子酱（约每天四汤匙），或每天 464 g 罐装长鳍金枪鱼。EPA+DHA 超过大约 1 g/day 之后，补充剂是唯一现实的途径。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Whole fish and fish oil are not interchangeable in the evidence base. VITAL randomised 25,871 adults to a 1 g/day capsule supplying 840 mg EPA+DHA (460 mg EPA, 380 mg DHA) and found no reduction in major cardiovascular events (HR 0.92, 95% CI 0.80-1.06) or cancer incidence (HR 1.03) over 5.3 years (Manson 2019, PMID 30415637). The benefit at 4 g/day in REDUCE-IT came from purified prescription EPA rather than a food-equivalent mixture, and high-dose omega-3 carries an atrial fibrillation signal that eating fish does not. On contaminants, the direction of the tradeoff is clear but the numbers are weaker than they look: the FDA/EPA per-species mercury means quoted in the earlier draft (1.45 ppm Gulf of Mexico tilefish, 1.00 swordfish, 0.98 shark, 0.73 king mackerel, 0.35 albacore, 0.13 canned light tuna, 0.01-0.08 for sardine, salmon, anchovy, Atlantic mackerel, trout and herring) could not be retrieved from any live FDA or EPA page, so treat every one of them as indicative and unconfirmed. The tilefish figure in particular should be re-checked, since FDA's published Gulf of Mexico mean is usually cited as 1.123 ppm. What the surviving EPA page does confirm is the qualitative placement: anchovies, Atlantic mackerel, sardines and trout are all 'Best Choices'. Independent synthesis in Karimi 2012 (PMID 22732656) gives grand means of 0.882 ppm for shark and 0.883 ppm for tilefish, and 0.450 ppm for fresh or frozen tuna, which is not the canned product and should not be read as such. The earlier claim that high-mercury predators are also mediocre omega-3 sources has been withdrawn: it rested on a swordfish figure of 108 mg EPA per 85 g with no FDC ID that could not be traced, and an EPA-only figure understates a DHA-dominant fish. Dioxins run the other way, concentrating in the fat of oily fish. EFSA cut the tolerable weekly intake to 2 pg TEQ/kg body weight and reported it exceeded across all European age groups with fatty fish among the top contributors (EFSA Journal 2018;16(11):5333, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2018.5333, document confirmed; the '5 to 15 fold' exceedance figure inside it was not independently verified). Refined fish oils must meet 1.75 pg WHO-TEQ/g fat for dioxins and 6.0 pg/g fat for dioxins plus dioxin-like PCBs under Regulation (EU) 2023/915 (limits not re-verified in this pass), so a purified concentrate can carry a lower contaminant load per gram of EPA+DHA than the fish it came from. One processing detail: draining oil-packed tuna pours away omega-3, and it takes both fatty acids with it. Canned white tuna in oil retains 66 mg EPA and 178 mg DHA per 100 g after draining, a total of 244 mg, against 233 mg EPA and 629 mg DHA (862 mg total) for the water-packed product, a 72% loss of total EPA+DHA (USDA FDC 175157 versus 175158, both confirmed).在证据层面，整鱼和鱼油不能互换。VITAL 将 25,871 名成人随机分配至每日 1 g 胶囊（提供 840 mg EPA+DHA，其中 EPA 460 mg、DHA 380 mg），在 5.3 年间未见主要心血管事件减少（HR 0.92, 95% CI 0.80-1.06），癌症发病率也无下降（HR 1.03）（Manson 2019, PMID 30415637）。REDUCE-IT 中 4 g/day 的获益来自纯化的处方级 EPA，这种成分与食物提供的等效混合物并不等同；高剂量欧米伽-3 还带有吃鱼所没有的心房颤动信号。在污染物问题上，权衡的方向是清楚的，但数字比看上去要弱：早前草稿引用的 FDA/EPA 分物种汞均值（墨西哥湾方头鱼 1.45 ppm、剑鱼 1.00、鲨鱼 0.98、王鲭 0.73、长鳍金枪鱼 0.35、罐装淡肉金枪鱼 0.13，沙丁鱼、三文鱼、凤尾鱼、大西洋鲭、鳟鱼和鲱鱼为 0.01-0.08）无法从任何在线的 FDA 或 EPA 页面检索到，因此每一个都应当作参考性且未经确认的数值。其中方头鱼的数值尤其需要复核，因为 FDA 公布的墨西哥湾均值通常被引作 1.123 ppm。仍可访问的 EPA 页面能够确认的是定性分档：凤尾鱼、大西洋鲭、沙丁鱼和鳟鱼均属“最佳选择”（Best Choices）。Karimi 2012（PMID 22732656）的独立汇总给出鲨鱼总均值 0.882 ppm、方头鱼 0.883 ppm，以及鲜或冻金枪鱼 0.450 ppm；后者指的是鲜冻产品，不能当成罐装产品来读。早前关于高汞掠食性鱼类同时也是平庸欧米伽-3 来源的说法已撤回：它依据的是一个每 85 g 含 108 mg EPA 的剑鱼数值，无 FDC ID 且无法追溯，而只看 EPA 的数字会低估以 DHA 为主的鱼类。二噁英的方向相反，它富集在多脂鱼的脂肪中。EFSA 将每周耐受摄入量下调至 2 pg TEQ/kg 体重，并报告欧洲所有年龄组均已超标，多脂鱼是主要贡献来源之一（EFSA Journal 2018;16(11):5333, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2018.5333，文件已确认；其中“超标 5 至 15 倍”的数字未经独立核实）。按 Regulation (EU) 2023/915，精炼鱼油的二噁英须不高于 1.75 pg WHO-TEQ/g 脂肪，二噁英加类二噁英 PCBs 须不高于 6.0 pg/g 脂肪（本轮未重新核实这些限值），因此按每克 EPA+DHA 计，纯化浓缩物的污染物负荷可以低于其原料鱼。一个加工细节：沥掉油浸金枪鱼的油会把欧米伽-3 一起倒掉，两种脂肪酸都会流失。油浸白肉金枪鱼罐头沥干后每 100 g 保留 66 mg EPA 和 178 mg DHA，合计 244 mg；水浸产品为 233 mg EPA 和 629 mg DHA（合计 862 mg），EPA+DHA 总量损失 72%（USDA FDC 175157 对 175158，两者均已确认）。

Absorption吸收 Chemical form changes absorption measurably. Using natural triglyceride fish oil as the 100% reference, the bioavailability index was 124% for re-esterified triglyceride and 73% for ethyl ester (Dyerberg 2010, PMID 20638827, both values confirmed). The 91% figure for free fatty acid and the 3.1-3.6 g/day matched dose range are consistent with the paper as usually cited but were not independently confirmed. Most cheap concentrates are ethyl esters, which also depend more on a fat-containing meal for absorption, so a 1,000 mg ethyl-ester capsule taken on an empty stomach does not deliver what the label implies. Fish is delivered as natural triglyceride inside a fat and protein matrix and needs no such allowance. Preparation matters more than cooking method: canning in oil and then draining removes omega-3, whereas canning in water and draining does not.化学形式对吸收有可测量的影响。以天然甘油三酯型鱼油为 100% 参照，重新酯化甘油三酯的生物利用度指数为 124%，乙酯型为 73%（Dyerberg 2010, PMID 20638827，两个数值均已确认）。游离脂肪酸的 91% 以及 3.1-3.6 g/day 的匹配剂量区间与该文献常见的引用一致，但未经独立确认。多数廉价浓缩产品是乙酯型，其吸收也更依赖含脂餐食，因此空腹服用一粒 1,000 mg 乙酯型胶囊，实际摄入达不到标签暗示的水平。鱼肉中的欧米伽-3 以天然甘油三酯形式存在于脂肪和蛋白质基质中，无需这类附加条件。加工方式比烹饪方法更重要：油浸罐装再沥干会带走欧米伽-3，水浸罐装沥干则不会。

Data note数据说明 All eleven USDA composition rows resolved to exactly the described food with the stated EPA and DHA values, and roughly 60 dose-gap calculations recomputed correctly. The two defects were invented portion weights, now replaced with USDA's own measures. Confidence drops only on the peripheral material: the FDA/EPA per-species mercury means, the EU 2023/915 dioxin limits and the swordfish EPA figure are unconfirmed and are labelled as such高。全部十一行 USDA 成分数据都精确对应所描述的食物及所列 EPA 和 DHA 数值，约 60 项剂量差距计算复算无误。两处缺陷是编造的份量重量，现已替换为 USDA 自带的计量。信心下降只出现在周边材料上：FDA/EPA 分物种汞均值、EU 2023/915 二噁英限值和剑鱼 EPA 数值均未确认，并已如实标注。

5  Consider it, in one narrow situation五、可以考虑，但只限一种很窄的情形

Defensible in one specific situation. Outside it, there is no case.只在一种特定情形下站得住。离开那个情形就没有理由。

CONSIDERMagnesium镁Grade B证据 B 级
Dose tested已验证剂量365 mg/d elemental for blood pressure. Note magnesium oxide is 60% elemental, citrate 16%, bisglycinate 14%.降血压用元素镁 365 毫克/天。注意氧化镁含 60% 元素镁，柠檬酸镁 16%，甘氨酸螯合镁 14%。
Who it is for适用人群People with documented low magnesium, chronic proton pump inhibitor or diuretic users, alcohol use disorder, and treated hypertensives.已证实镁偏低者、长期使用质子泵抑制剂或利尿剂者、酒精使用障碍者、已在服药的高血压患者。

Pros优点

  • Blood pressure falls by a real amount in the right people: -5.97 mmHg systolic in the hypomagnesaemic and -7.68 mmHg in treated hypertensives.在合适的人身上血压确有下降：低镁血症者收缩压降 5.97 mmHg，已服药的高血压患者降 7.68 mmHg。
  • Proton-pump-inhibitor-induced hypomagnesaemia is an established, under-recognised clinical problem that this genuinely fixes.质子泵抑制剂引起的低镁血症是一个确凿而常被忽视的临床问题，补镁确实能解决。
  • Cheap, and dietary intake is genuinely low in many Western diets.便宜，而且在许多西方饮食中摄入量确实偏低。

Cons缺点

  • In replete normotensive people the pooled blood pressure effect did not reach significance. The general-population heart-health pitch is unsupported.在镁充足且血压正常的人中，合并的降压效应未达显著。面向普通人群的“护心”说法没有依据。
  • The sleep claim, now the dominant marketing angle, rests on 3 trials and 151 older adults, all at moderate to high risk of bias, and the review authors called the literature substandard for making recommendations.如今主导营销的助眠说法，只建立在 3 项试验、151 名老年人之上，全部为中高偏倚风险，综述作者直言这些文献的质量不足以据此提出建议。
  • The 600 mg/d migraine dose exceeds the US supplemental upper limit of 350 mg and is 2.4 times the EFSA limit of 250 mg. Diarrhoea is the dose-limiting effect.偏头痛用的 600 毫克/天超过美国 350 毫克的补充剂上限，是 EFSA 250 毫克上限的 2.4 倍。腹泻是剂量限制性反应。
  • Contraindicated without supervision in chronic kidney disease stage 4-5 and dialysis, where hypermagnesaemia causes bradycardia, hypotension and respiratory depression. Also in myasthenia gravis.慢性肾病 4 至 5 期和透析患者未经监督禁用，高镁血症会导致心动过缓、低血压和呼吸抑制。重症肌无力同样禁用。
  • Chelates tetracyclines, fluoroquinolones and bisphosphonates. Separate by 2-4 hours.会与四环素类、氟喹诺酮类和双膦酸盐螯合。间隔 2 至 4 小时。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose reachable by eating靠吃可以达到剂量 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

Magnesium sits in the chlorophyll molecule and in the outer layers of seeds and grains, so every unrefined plant food carries some; nuts, seeds, cocoa, wholegrains, legumes and dark leafy greens are all meaningful contributors, and a mixed diet built on them reaches the adult RDA (420 mg/day men 31+, 320 mg/day women 31+, Institute of Medicine 1997) with no supplement. Refining is what strips it, and the honest like-for-like comparison is CoFID wholemeal bread at 66 mg/100 g against white bread at 22 mg/100 g (11-981 and 11-1145), a three-fold gap. The wheat bran figure of 389 mg/100 g (CoFID 11-906) is a dry milling fraction, so setting it against a roughly 40%-water baked loaf inflates the effect of refining to eighteen-fold and should not be used that way.镁存在于叶绿素分子中，也集中在种子和谷物的外层，因此任何未精制的植物性食物都含有一定量；坚果、种子、可可、全谷物、豆类和深色叶菜都是有意义的贡献者，以它们为基础的混合膳食无需补充剂就能达到成人 RDA（31 岁以上男性 420 mg/天，31 岁以上女性 320 mg/天，Institute of Medicine 1997）。真正把镁剥掉的是精制加工，诚实的同类对比是 CoFID 全麦面包 66 mg/100 g 对白面包 22 mg/100 g（11-981 和 11-1145），相差三倍。麦麸的 389 mg/100 g（CoFID 11-906）是干磨组分，把它拿去和含水量约 40% 的烤制面包对比，会把精制的影响夸大到十八倍，不应这样使用。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 Supplements are sold at 200 to 400 mg elemental magnesium, which is the whole daily requirement, and ordinary food covers that range easily. A worked day: 1 oz pumpkin seeds (156 mg) plus 1 cup cooked black beans (120 mg) plus 1 oz 70-85% dark chocolate (65 mg) is 341 mg before anything else on the plate is counted. Single-food routes are absurd by comparison: 400 mg from dark chocolate alone means 175 g of bar, roughly 1,000 kcal, and 400 mg from wholemeal bread alone means 533 g, about 17 slices. Nobody needs a single-food route, because the mixed-diet route is three normal portions. The safety asymmetry matters more than the arithmetic: the Institute of Medicine set the 350 mg/day upper limit for supplemental magnesium only, and it explicitly excludes magnesium naturally present in food and water, so 700 mg of magnesium from seeds and beans carries no upper limit while 400 mg from tablets is already over the supplemental ceiling. A comparable 250 mg/day EU limit for magnesium added through supplements or fortified foods is normally attributed to the SCF 2001 opinion; the source text could not be retrieved during verification, so that figure is carried here as indicative and unconfirmed.补充剂的售卖规格是 200 至 400 mg 元素镁，也就是一整天的需要量，而普通食物很容易覆盖这个区间。一天的实际算法：1 oz 南瓜籽（156 mg）加 1 杯熟黑豆（120 mg）加 1 oz 70-85% 黑巧克力（65 mg），在盘子里其他东西都还没算进来时就已经是 341 mg。相比之下，单一食物路线荒唐得多：只靠黑巧克力吃到 400 mg 意味着 175 g 巧克力，大约 1,000 kcal；只靠全麦面包吃到 400 mg 意味着 533 g，约 17 片。没有人需要单一食物路线，混合膳食路线只是三份正常分量。算术之外，安全性上的不对称影响更大：Institute of Medicine 设定的 350 mg/天 上限只针对补充剂形式的镁，并明确排除食物和水中天然存在的镁，因此来自种子和豆类的 700 mg 镁不受上限约束，而来自片剂的 400 mg 已经超过补充剂的上限。欧盟对通过补充剂或强化食品添加的镁设有相当的 250 mg/天 限值，通常归于 SCF 2001 意见书；核查期间无法获取原文，因此该数字在此仅作参考，未经确认。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 The difference is dose kinetics rather than chemistry. Food delivers magnesium in small amounts across a day inside a matrix that slows release, so the unabsorbed fraction stays small and osmotic diarrhoea does not happen. A 400 mg bolus of a soluble magnesium salt leaves a large unabsorbed load in the gut lumen, and that load is the mechanism of the laxative effect that set the upper limit in the first place. Magnesium citrate and magnesium hydroxide are marketed as laxatives at doses close to supplement doses. In anyone with reduced renal clearance (CKD stage 4-5, elderly patients on multiple drugs) supplements can cause symptomatic hypermagnesaemia, while food magnesium is handled by renal excretion across the normal intake range. There is no situation where the food form is the risky one.差别在于剂量动力学，与化学性质无关。食物在一天之内以小剂量提供镁，并且处在减缓释放的基质里，未被吸收的部分始终很少，不会引起渗透性腹泻。一次 400 mg 可溶性镁盐会在肠腔留下大量未吸收的负荷，这一负荷正是当初设定上限所依据的导泻机制。柠檬酸镁和氢氧化镁本身就以接近补充剂剂量的剂量作为泻药销售。在肾清除率下降的人群中（CKD 4-5 期、同时服用多种药物的老年患者），补充剂可造成有症状的高镁血症，而食物来源的镁在正常摄入范围内由肾排泄处理。不存在食物形式反而更危险的情形。

Absorption吸收 Net absorption of dietary magnesium is 40 to 60% at an intake averaging 380 mg/day, falling to 15-36% at higher daily intakes of 550 to 850 mg (Institute of Medicine DRI report 1997, Chapter 6, NCBI Bookshelf NBK109816). NIH ODS quotes 30-40% for public guidance, so the working figure should be the lower half of the DRI range rather than the 50% midpoint. Phytate is the main food inhibitor and can cut fractional absorption by up to 60% in a dose-dependent way, so the magnesium in bran, seeds and legumes is not fully realised. Oxalate matters much less than the textbook version implies: Bohn et al. (Br J Nutr 2004;91:601-606) measured 26.7% fractional absorption from a spinach meal against 36.5% from kale and concluded the spinach penalty is at least partly counterbalanced by its higher native magnesium content, so a cooked cup of spinach delivers roughly 42 mg absorbed against roughly 11 mg from a cooked cup of kale. Supplement forms differ sharply among themselves: Firoz and Graber (Magnesium Research 2001;14(4):257-262, PMID 11794633) measured fractional absorption of about 4% for magnesium oxide against 9-11% for the lactate, aspartate and chloride forms, and magnesium oxide is the cheapest and most widely sold form. A 400 mg magnesium oxide tablet can therefore deliver less absorbed magnesium than a handful of pumpkin seeds while producing the loose stools.在平均摄入 380 mg/天 时，膳食镁的净吸收率为 40 至 60%；当日摄入量升到 550 至 850 mg，吸收率降至 15-36%（Institute of Medicine DRI 报告 1997，第 6 章，NCBI Bookshelf NBK109816）。NIH ODS 在公众指导中引用 30-40%，因此实际取值应落在 DRI 区间的下半段，而不取 50% 的中点。植酸是食物中的主要抑制因素，可以按剂量依赖的方式把吸收分数削减最多 60%，所以麦麸、种子和豆类里的镁并没有被完全实现。草酸的影响远小于教科书版本的说法：Bohn 等（Br J Nutr 2004;91:601-606）测得菠菜餐的吸收分数为 26.7%，羽衣甘蓝为 36.5%，并认为菠菜的损失至少部分被其本身较高的镁含量抵消，因此一杯熟菠菜实际提供约 42 mg 吸收量，一杯熟羽衣甘蓝约 11 mg。补充剂各形式之间差别很大：Firoz 和 Graber（Magnesium Research 2001;14(4):257-262，PMID 11794633）测得氧化镁的吸收分数约 4%，乳酸镁、天门冬氨酸镁和氯化镁为 9-11%，而氧化镁恰恰是最便宜、卖得最多的形式。因此一片 400 mg 氧化镁提供的可吸收镁可能少于一小把南瓜籽，同时还带来稀便。

Data note数据说明 for composition and arithmetic: verification checked every cited FDC ID against the USDA SR Legacy April 2018 dataset and every CoFID code against CoFID 2021, and found no fabricated identifier, no wrong per-100 g value and no wrong portion weight, with all per-portion multiplications reproducing. Two lower-confidence pockets are flagged in place: the mineral water row carries no sourced figure at all, and the flaxseed, wheat germ, wheat bran and cocoa portion weights are conventions rather than dataset portions. The EU SCF 250 mg/day added-magnesium limit is consistent with the standard figure but was not confirmable from the source text组成与算术为高：核查把每个引用的 FDC ID 对照 USDA SR Legacy 2018 年 4 月数据集、每个 CoFID 代码对照 CoFID 2021 逐一检查，未发现编造的标识符、错误的每 100 g 数值或错误的分量重量，所有按分量的乘算也都能复现。两处置信度较低的地方已就地标注：矿泉水那一行完全没有来源数值；亚麻籽、小麦胚芽、麦麸和可可粉的分量重量属于惯例，并非数据集分量。欧盟 SCF 关于添加镁 250 mg/天 的限值与通行数字一致，但无法从原文确认。

References:文献： Argeros Hypertension 2025 PMID 41000008; Mah & Pitre PMID 33865376; Peikert PMID 8792038
CONSIDERZinc lozenges锌含片Grade B证据 B 级
Dose tested已验证剂量75-100 mg/d elemental, split into 6-8 lozenges, started within 24 hours of symptom onset and stopped when symptoms resolve.元素锌 75 至 100 毫克/天，分 6 至 8 片含服，症状出现 24 小时内开始，症状消失即停。
Who it is for适用人群Someone at the very start of a cold who will actually follow the lozenge schedule.感冒刚起、且真的能按含片时间表执行的人。

Pros优点

  • Cold duration shortens. Hemila found -33% (21-45%) across lozenge trials, with no additional benefit above 100 mg/d.感冒病程会缩短。Hemila 在含片试验中得到 -33%（21-45%），且超过 100 毫克/天没有额外收益。
  • Cheap, and the treatment window is short enough that the copper risk does not apply.便宜，而且疗程短到不会触发铜缺乏的风险。
  • Zinc for acute childhood diarrhoea in deficient populations is a separate and much stronger indication, used as standard of care in low-income settings.在缺锌人群中用锌治疗儿童急性腹泻是另一个适应证，证据强得多，在低收入地区已是标准治疗。

Cons缺点

  • The evidence is genuinely contested, and honest reporting means saying so. Cochrane 2024 rated duration LOW certainty at -2.37 days, found prevention null and severity null. Hemila published a methodological rebuttal alleging Cochrane pooled a 190 mg/d lozenge trial with a 0.046 mg/d nasal trial, a 4,300-fold dose difference.证据确实存在争议，诚实的做法是把这一点说出来。Cochrane 2024 把病程缩短 2.37 天评为低确定性，并发现预防无效、严重程度无改善。Hemila 发表了方法学反驳，指出 Cochrane 把一项 190 毫克/天的含片试验与一项 0.046 毫克/天的鼻用试验合并，剂量相差 4300 倍。
  • Chronic intake above 40 mg/d causes copper depletion, which produces sideroblastic anaemia, neutropenia and an irreversible myelopathy that mimics subacute combined degeneration. This is the reason the treatment must be short.长期摄入超过 40 毫克/天会造成铜缺乏，引起铁粒幼细胞性贫血、中性粒细胞减少，以及一种模仿亚急性联合变性的不可逆脊髓病。这正是疗程必须短的原因。
  • Formulation matters and most retail lozenges are wrong. Citric acid and sorbitol bind zinc and stop it being released.剂型很关键，而多数零售含片是错的。柠檬酸和山梨醇会结合锌，使其无法释放。
  • Chelates fluoroquinolones and tetracyclines. Nasal zinc caused permanent anosmia and should never be used.会与氟喹诺酮类和四环素类螯合。鼻用锌曾造成永久性嗅觉丧失，绝不可使用。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose NOT reachable by eating靠吃达不到剂量 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

Two separate questions share a mineral name here, and they get different answers. Zinc the nutrient is abundant in ordinary food: oysters are the outlier of the entire composition table, red meat and offal follow, and wheat germ, seeds and legumes carry useful amounts, so on the question of whether the substance is in food the answer is RICH. Zinc lozenges are not a nutritional product: the trials used more than 75 mg/day of elemental zinc, most commonly 80 to 92 mg/day and in two trials 192 to 207 mg/day, delivered as slowly dissolving zinc acetate or gluconate lozenges taken roughly every two hours while awake (PMID 28515951), and the mechanism depends on free zinc ions released in the mouth and throat over 20 to 30 minutes in contact with the pharyngeal mucosa. Food zinc is swallowed and absorbed in the small intestine, so no amount of it reproduces the intended local effect, which is why dose_from_food is NO while food_status is RICH. Reference point used in the table: EFSA PRI 7.5 mg/d for adult women and 9.4 mg/d for adult men at a phytate intake of 300 mg/d (EFSA, Dietary Reference Values for nutrients Summary report, approved 4 December 2017, doi 10.2903/sp.efsa.2017.e15121, Tables 5 and 7; underlying opinion EFSA Journal 2014;12(10):3844).这里有两个不同的问题共用一个矿物名称，它们得到不同的答案。作为营养素的锌在普通食物中很丰富：牡蛎是整张成分表的极端值，红肉和内脏其次，小麦胚芽、种子和豆类也提供可用的量，所以就这种物质是否存在于食物中而言，答案是 RICH。锌含片并非营养产品：试验使用的是每天超过 75 mg 元素锌，最常见为每天 80 至 92 mg，两项试验为每天 192 至 207 mg，以缓慢溶解的醋酸锌或葡萄糖酸锌含片给药，清醒时约每两小时一次（PMID 28515951），其机制依赖在口腔和咽部释放的游离锌离子在 20 至 30 分钟内与咽部黏膜保持接触。食物中的锌被吞下并在小肠吸收，任何量都无法复制这种预期的局部作用，这就是 dose_from_food 为 NO 而 food_status 为 RICH 的原因。表中使用的参考值：在植酸摄入 300 mg/d 的条件下，EFSA PRI 成年女性 7.5 mg/d、成年男性 9.4 mg/d（EFSA，Dietary Reference Values for nutrients Summary report，2017 年 12 月 4 日通过，doi 10.2903/sp.efsa.2017.e15121，表 5 和表 7；基础意见书 EFSA Journal 2014;12(10):3844）。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 The lozenge dose fails on arithmetic and then fails again on route. Arithmetically, hitting the 80 mg/day of elemental zinc used in the trials (PMID 28515951) every day for the duration of a cold takes 204 g of raw oyster meat, roughly 14 to 15 medium oysters; or 102 g of cooked oysters; or 88 g of canned oysters, about 11 of them; or 479 g of toasted wheat-germ cereal; or 989 g of braised lean beef chuck; or 1.10 kg of braised lamb shoulder; or 1.05 kg of pumpkin seed kernels; or 5.23 kg of boiled chickpeas; or 6.30 kg of boiled lentils. Only oysters make it look even arithmetically plausible, and 14 raw oysters a day for a week is a Vibrio and norovirus decision rather than a nutrition one. Closing the arithmetic would still not reproduce the product, because the lozenge trials work through free Zn2+ released in the oropharynx and held against the mucosa, and swallowed zinc from food or from a capsule bypasses that route entirely. On scale, 80 to 92 mg/day is roughly 11 to 12 times the EFSA female PRI of 7.5 mg/d (10.7 and 12.3 times); the 'eight times' figure quoted earlier corresponds to the male PRI of 9.4 mg/d, not the female one named in the sentence. Separately, and this is the part food answers easily, the nutritional dose is trivially reachable: 85 g of braised lean beef chuck (6.9 mg) or 6 medium raw oysters (33.4 mg) meets or vastly exceeds the 7.5 to 9.4 mg PRI in one portion.含片剂量先在算术上不成立，接着在给药途径上再次不成立。就算术而言，要在感冒期间每天达到试验所用的 80 mg 元素锌（PMID 28515951），需要 204 g 生牡蛎肉，约 14 至 15 个中等大小牡蛎；或 102 g 熟牡蛎；或 88 g 罐装牡蛎，约 11 个；或 479 g 焙烤小麦胚芽谷物；或 989 g 炖瘦牛肩肉；或 1.10 kg 炖羊肩肉；或 1.05 kg 南瓜子仁；或 5.23 kg 煮鹰嘴豆；或 6.30 kg 煮扁豆。只有牡蛎在算术上看起来还有些可能，而连续一周每天吃 14 个生牡蛎，要权衡的是弧菌和诺如病毒的风险，与营养无关。即便把算术凑齐，也复制不出这个产品，因为含片试验的作用依赖在口咽部释放并停留在黏膜上的游离 Zn2+，而来自食物或胶囊的锌被吞下后完全绕过这条途径。在量级上，每天 80 至 92 mg 约为 EFSA 女性 PRI 7.5 mg/d 的 11 至 12 倍（10.7 倍和 12.3 倍）；此前引用的八倍对应的是男性 PRI 9.4 mg/d，并非句中提到的女性值。另外一点是食物能轻松回答的：营养剂量非常容易达到，85 g 炖瘦牛肩肉（6.9 mg）或 6 个中等大小生牡蛎（33.4 mg），一份就达到或远超 7.5 至 9.4 mg 的 PRI。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Zinc gluconate lozenges shortened colds by 28 percent and zinc acetate lozenges by 40 percent, a 12-point difference that was not statistically significant (95% CI -12 to +36), and there is no evidence that doses above 100 mg/day do better than 80 to 92 mg/day (PMID 28515951). The salt matters less than people claim and the lozenge format matters more. Zinc capsules, tablets, syrups and food are not substitutes in this indication, because the local contact is the point. Two safety notes follow from the numbers: 80 to 92 mg/day is roughly 11 to 12 times the EFSA female PRI and well above nutritional upper levels, defensible only for a few days because sustained high zinc antagonises copper absorption; and this is a short pharmacological course with an actual end date, unlike a nutrient. One earlier claim about the oyster records has to be withdrawn. Cooking does concentrate oyster zinc by moisture loss (raw 89.0 g water, cooked 78.2 g; dry matter 11.0 g against 21.8 g, so solids exactly double and zinc exactly doubles from 39.3 to 78.6 mg per 100 g). Canning does not work that way: canned oysters hold 85.1 g water and 14.9 g dry matter, only 1.35 times the raw solids, yet 2.3 times the zinc at 91.0 mg, which is 1.7 times richer per gram of solids (611 mg zinc per 100 g dry matter against 357 raw and 361 cooked). The canned entry reflects different material or different analyses rather than moisture loss. Per-100 g comparisons across preparation states remain misleading either way unless the yield is tracked.葡萄糖酸锌含片使感冒病程缩短 28%，醋酸锌含片缩短 40%，两者相差 12 个百分点，未达统计显著（95% CI -12 至 +36）；也没有证据表明每天超过 100 mg 的剂量优于 80 至 92 mg（PMID 28515951）。盐型的重要性低于人们所说，含片这一剂型的重要性更高。在这一适应症下，锌胶囊、片剂、糖浆和食物都不能替代含片，局部接触才是关键。从这些数字引出两条安全提示：每天 80 至 92 mg 约为 EFSA 女性 PRI 的 11 至 12 倍，远高于营养性上限，只有在数天之内才站得住脚，因为长期高锌会拮抗铜的吸收；这是一个有明确终点的短期药理疗程，与长期摄入的营养素不同。此前关于牡蛎数据条目的一个说法必须撤回。烹熟确实通过失水提高了牡蛎的锌浓度（生品含水 89.0 g，熟品 78.2 g；干物质 11.0 g 对 21.8 g，固形物正好翻倍，锌也正好从每 100 g 39.3 mg 翻倍到 78.6 mg）。罐装不是这样：罐装牡蛎含水 85.1 g、干物质 14.9 g，只有生品固形物的 1.35 倍，锌却是 2.3 倍，达到 91.0 mg，按固形物计算浓 1.7 倍（每 100 g 干物质含锌 611 mg，生品 357 mg，熟品 361 mg）。罐装条目反映的是不同原料或不同分析，与失水无关。无论哪种情形，除非同时追踪出品率，跨加工状态的每 100 g 比较仍然会误导。

Absorption吸收 Oysters are the outlier of the entire food composition table. At 39.3 mg/100 g raw and up to 91.0 mg/100 g canned they carry four to twelve times the zinc of red meat, which is itself the next best category, and they are why oysters answer every zinc question. Beyond oysters, absorption efficiency does most of the work and phytate is the variable. Human whole-body-retention studies of matched cereal meals found fractional zinc absorption of 26.8 percent from a rye bread meal containing 100 umol of phytic acid, falling to 8.4 percent from oatmeal porridge containing 600 umol, a threefold loss driven by phytate alone (PMID 2824731). Fractional absorption is not the whole story, and the earlier version of this section had the direction of the bread comparison backwards. A related study found that a lower absolute amount of zinc was absorbed from white bread than from the same amount of wholemeal bread, because wholemeal supplies more zinc and the phytate penalty on fractional absorption did not overturn that content advantage; white bread only won once both breads were enriched with zinc chloride. Adding milk products did improve zinc absorption from the wholemeal meal (PMID 7361691). Replacing 25 percent of the beef protein in a composite meal with defatted soy flour lowered both the zinc content and the zinc absorbed, while the same substitution in a chicken meal changed neither (PMID 6893252). EFSA builds phytate straight into the requirement: the adult male PRI rises from 9.4 mg/d at 300 mg phytate/day to 11.7, 14.0 and 16.3 mg/d at 600, 900 and 1,200 mg, and the female PRI from 7.5 to 9.3, 11.0 and 12.7 mg/d across the same range, ratios of 1.73 and 1.69. A high-legume, high-wholegrain diet therefore needs about 70 percent more zinc on the label to deliver the same absorbed zinc. On mitigations, the evidence is narrower than previously claimed: the cited review covers added Aspergillus niger phytase (12 iron studies, 5 zinc studies) and states that for zinc not enough information is available to determine optimal activities (PMID 24050000), so added phytase is supported while soaking, sprouting and sourdough fermentation need a fermentation-specific source. Animal protein and milk in the same meal do raise absorption, and vegetarians consequently sit at the top of the EFSA PRI range rather than the bottom (PMID 12936958).牡蛎是整张食物成分表的极端值。生品每 100 g 39.3 mg，罐装最高每 100 g 91.0 mg，是红肉的四到十二倍，而红肉本身已是次优类别，这也是牡蛎能回答所有锌相关问题的原因。牡蛎之外，吸收效率承担了大部分工作，植酸是那个变量。对配对谷物餐的人体全身滞留研究发现，含 100 umol 植酸的黑麦面包餐锌分数吸收率为 26.8%，含 600 umol 的燕麦粥降到 8.4%，仅由植酸造成三倍的差距（PMID 2824731）。分数吸收率不是全部，本节此前的版本把面包比较的方向弄反了。一项相关研究发现，从白面包吸收的锌绝对量低于同等量的全麦面包，因为全麦提供更多锌，植酸对分数吸收率的惩罚没有抵消这一含量优势；只有当两种面包都用氯化锌强化后，白面包才占优。在全麦餐中加入乳制品确实改善了锌的吸收（PMID 7361691）。在一份复合餐中用脱脂大豆粉替代 25% 的牛肉蛋白，锌含量和吸收的锌都下降，而在鸡肉餐中做同样替代则两者都没有变化（PMID 6893252）。EFSA 把植酸直接纳入需要量：成年男性 PRI 从植酸 300 mg/d 时的 9.4 mg/d，在 600、900 和 1,200 mg 时升至 11.7、14.0 和 16.3 mg/d；女性 PRI 在同一区间从 7.5 升至 9.3、11.0 和 12.7 mg/d，比值分别为 1.73 和 1.69。因此高豆类、高全谷物的膳食需要标签上多出约 70% 的锌，才能提供同样的吸收锌。关于缓解措施，证据比此前所称更窄：所引综述涵盖的是添加黑曲霉（Aspergillus niger）植酸酶（12 项铁研究、5 项锌研究），并指出就锌而言现有信息不足以确定最佳酶活（PMID 24050000），所以添加植酸酶有支持，而浸泡、发芽和酸面团发酵需要专门针对发酵的来源。同餐中的动物蛋白和牛奶确实提高吸收，素食者因此落在 EFSA PRI 区间的上端（PMID 12936958）。

Data note数据说明 All eleven original per-100 g figures were confirmed to the digit against FoodData Central, the Hemila lozenge meta-analysis was confirmed on every parameter (dose threshold, the 80 to 92 and 192 to 207 mg/day bands, 40 against 28 percent by salt, no benefit above 100 mg/day), and the EFSA phytate-graded PRI table matched the source text. The six added rows use conventional portion sizes rather than USDA measure-table entries, so their per-portion figures are derived and are flagged as such in place高。原稿全部十一个每 100 g 数值都与 FoodData Central 逐位核实一致，Hemila 的含片荟萃分析在每一项参数上都得到确认（剂量阈值、每天 80 至 92 mg 和 192 至 207 mg 两个区间、按盐型 40% 对 28%、每天超过 100 mg 无额外益处），EFSA 按植酸分级的 PRI 表与来源文本一致。新增的六行使用常规份量而非 USDA 计量表条目，因此其每份数值是推算的，并已就地标注。

References:文献： Cochrane Nault PMID 38719213; Hemila PMID 28515951; Hemila & Chalker PMID 39478818
CONSIDERMelatonin褪黑素Grade B证据 B 级
Dose tested已验证剂量0.5-5 mg. Timing is the active ingredient, not dose. For phase advance, 0.5 mg taken 2-4 hours before dim-light melatonin onset.0.5 至 5 毫克。起作用的是服用时间，不是剂量。要提前相位，在暗光褪黑素起始前 2 至 4 小时服 0.5 毫克。
Who it is for适用人群Jet lag eastward across five or more time zones, delayed sleep-wake phase disorder, shift work, and blind people with free-running rhythms.向东跨越五个及以上时区的时差、睡眠时相延迟障碍、轮班工作，以及节律自由运转的盲人。

Pros优点

  • Circadian phase-shifting is real pharmacology with a mapped phase-response curve. For jet lag across five or more zones the NNT is 2, and 9 of 10 trials were positive.昼夜节律相位调整是真实的药理作用，其相位反应曲线已被测绘。对跨五个以上时区的时差，NNT 为 2，10 项试验中有 9 项阳性。
  • In delayed sleep-wake phase disorder, sleep onset advanced by 0.67 hours and endogenous melatonin onset by 1.18 hours.在睡眠时相延迟障碍中，入睡时间提前 0.67 小时，内源性褪黑素起始提前 1.18 小时。
  • Short-term safety is good and it is not habit-forming in the way sedatives are.短期安全性良好，也不像镇静剂那样形成依赖。

Cons缺点

  • For ordinary insomnia it barely does anything: 7 minutes off sleep latency and 8 minutes more total sleep across 19 trials and 1,683 people. The AASM guideline explicitly suggests clinicians NOT use it for insomnia.对普通失眠几乎没用：19 项试验、1683 人的数据是入睡潜伏期缩短 7 分钟、总睡眠时间增加 8 分钟。美国睡眠医学会指南明确建议临床不要用它治失眠。
  • Retail dose accuracy is the worst documented in this document. 22 of 25 gummy products were inaccurately labelled, at 74-347% of the declared amount, and one product labelled 3 mg contained no melatonin at all but 31.3 mg of CBD. A separate analysis of 31 products found -83% to +478% of label and serotonin contamination in 8 of them.零售剂量准确度是本文中记录到最差的。25 个软糖产品中有 22 个标签不准确，实测为标示量的 74 至 347%，其中一个标注 3 毫克的产品完全不含褪黑素，却含 31.3 毫克 CBD。另一项对 31 个产品的分析发现含量为标示量的 -83% 至 +478%，其中 8 个检出血清素污染。
  • Not for children. The gummy format plus up to 347% overdosing plus palatability is a bad combination.不要给儿童。软糖剂型、最高 347% 的超量、加上好吃，是很糟的组合。
  • Retail doses of 5-10 mg are far above what the pharmacology needs and can shift the clock the wrong way if taken at the wrong time.零售常见的 5 至 10 毫克远高于药理所需，而且在错误的时间服用还会把生物钟推向错误的方向。
  • Cochrane specifically flagged caution in people on warfarin and people with epilepsy. Fluvoxamine markedly raises melatonin exposure via CYP1A2 inhibition.Cochrane 特别提示华法林使用者和癫痫患者需谨慎。氟伏沙明通过抑制 CYP1A2 显著升高褪黑素暴露量。

Food sources食物来源

Trace amounts only仅有痕量 Dose NOT reachable by eating靠吃达不到剂量 Data confidence: Medium数据可信度：中

Melatonin is genuinely present across a wide range of plant and animal foods, and the richest of them are not the fruits and nuts usually named: roasted coffee, red wine and germinated legumes carry far more than tart cherries or walnuts. Even so, every realistic portion sits one to four orders of magnitude below a 0.5-5 mg supplement dose. The supplement is a separate article from the dietary substance: commercial melatonin is chemically synthesised rather than extracted from food, so a product sold as natural melatonin is a manufactured molecule and would be labelled SYNTHETIC if this field described the pill instead of the substance.褪黑素确实广泛存在于各类植物性和动物性食物中，其中含量最高的并不是人们常提到的那些水果和坚果：烘焙咖啡、红葡萄酒和发芽豆类的含量远高于酸樱桃或核桃。即便如此，任何现实份量都比 0.5-5 mg 的补充剂剂量低一到四个数量级。补充剂与膳食中的这种物质属于两回事：市售褪黑素为化学合成产物，并非从食物中提取，所以标着“天然褪黑素”出售的产品其实是人工制造的分子；如果本字段描述的是药片而非物质本身，标签应为 SYNTHETIC。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 1 mg requires roughly 104 g of roasted coffee grounds, the closest any food comes, and grounds are not consumed whole (brewing transfers an uncharacterised fraction to the cup); or 7.7 L of red wine; or about 918 g of dry-matter germinated lentils; or 1.9 kg dry-matter germinated kidney beans; or 5.3 kg of white mustard seed; or 9.7 kg of dried goji at the review value of 103 ng/g dry weight; or 23 kg of fenugreek seed, 34 kg of sunflower seed, 42 kg of tomato, 74 kg of Montmorency cherries, 89 kg of strawberries, 286 kg of walnuts, 485 kg of Balaton cherries, 818 kg of almonds, about 655-670 kg of egg (13,100-13,400 eggs) and about 64,500 L of milk. Pistachios cannot be given a single number: the point estimate is 383 kg but the reported SD (3096 pg/g) exceeds the mean (2609 pg/g), so the true requirement is uncertain by roughly an order of magnitude in either direction. Halve all of these for a 0.5 mg dose, multiply by five for 5 mg. The submission's headline claim that goji berries are the one food a human could theoretically eat to a dose does not survive correction, because it rested on an unreplicated outlier; at the authoritative value no food in the table reaches a supplement dose in an edible quantity.要摄入 1 mg，大约需要 104 g 烘焙咖啡粉，这是所有食物中最接近的，而咖啡粉不会被整份吃下（冲泡时转入杯中的比例未经表征）；或 7.7 L 红葡萄酒；或约 918 g 干物质计的发芽扁豆；或 1.9 kg 干物质计的发芽菜豆；或 5.3 kg 白芥子；或按综述值 103 ng/g 干重计算的 9.7 kg 干枸杞；或 23 kg 葫芦巴籽、34 kg 葵花籽、42 kg 番茄、74 kg Montmorency 酸樱桃、89 kg 草莓、286 kg 核桃、485 kg Balaton 酸樱桃、818 kg 杏仁、约 655-670 kg 鸡蛋（13,100-13,400 个）以及约 64,500 L 牛奶。开心果无法给出单一数值：点估计为 383 kg，但报告的标准差（3096 pg/g）超过均值（2609 pg/g），因此真实需求量在两个方向上都有约一个数量级的不确定性。0.5 mg 剂量把上述数字减半，5 mg 剂量乘以五。原稿的核心结论称枸杞是人类理论上唯一能吃到剂量的食物，经修正后不成立，因为它依赖一个未被重复验证的离群值；按权威值计算，表中没有任何食物能在可食用的份量内达到补充剂剂量。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Food melatonin is not a smaller version of a tablet. Tart cherry juice concentrate measurably raises urinary 6-sulfatoxymelatonin and improved actigraphy-measured sleep efficiency at 2 x 30 mL/day (Howatson et al. Eur J Nutr 2012;51(8):909-916, PMID 22038497, verified), yet no melatonin content figure for the concentrate could be sourced here, so the one preparation with a positive human sleep outcome remains uncosted; the melatonin delivered is a fraction of a microgram, and most of the effect probably comes from the polyphenol matrix and tryptophan availability. Cultivar swamps everything: Montmorency and Balaton are the same species and differ 6.5-fold. Two melatonin-rich botanicals bear on this list for context: Scutellaria (huang-qin) at about 7,110 ng/g dry weight and St John's wort at about 4,490 ng/g dry weight, the latter classified NOT_FOOD in its own entry while being among the richest melatonin-bearing plants on record. On the pistachio dispute: one 2014 spectrofluorimetric paper reported roughly 233 ug/g dry weight, about 89,300 times the LC-MS/MS value, and it carries a published Expression of Concern (original PMID 24878439; EoC Spectrochim Acta A 2019;217:322, PMID 31027610). At that disputed figure 4.3 g of pistachios, about seven kernels, would supply 1 mg, which is exactly why the number should be treated as unconfirmed rather than as a food-based melatonin strategy. The Expression of Concern record lists only the four original authors and states no replication failure, so the submission's attribution of it to a German federal risk-assessment body has been removed. On the supplement side, doses commonly sold at 3-10 mg are ten to thirty times a physiological replacement dose, independent testing of commercial products has repeatedly found large deviations from label content plus occasional serotonin contamination, and melatonin is a prescription-only medicine in the UK and much of the EU while sold freely as a supplement in the US.食物中的褪黑素并不等于一片药的缩小版。酸樱桃浓缩汁按每天 2 x 30 mL 服用，可测量地升高尿中 6-硫酸氧褪黑素，并改善了活动记录仪测得的睡眠效率（Howatson 等，Eur J Nutr 2012;51(8):909-916, PMID 22038497，已核实），但本次未能找到该浓缩汁的褪黑素含量数据，所以唯一在人体睡眠终点上取得阳性结果的制剂仍无法折算；它提供的褪黑素不足一微克，效应大部分可能来自多酚基质和色氨酸的可得性。品种差异盖过其他一切因素：Montmorency 和 Balaton 属同一物种，含量相差 6.5 倍。两种富含褪黑素的药用植物可作参照：黄芩约 7,110 ng/g 干重，圣约翰草约 4,490 ng/g 干重，后者在自己的条目中归为 NOT_FOOD，同时又属于已记录的褪黑素含量最高的植物之列。关于开心果的争议：2014 年一篇荧光分光法论文报告约 233 µg/g 干重，约为 LC-MS/MS 值的 89,300 倍，该文已被公开发表关注声明（原文 PMID 24878439；关注声明见 Spectrochim Acta A 2019;217:322, PMID 31027610）。按这个存疑数值，4.3 g 开心果（约七粒）就能提供 1 mg，正因如此，这个数字应被视为未经确认，不能当成靠食物补充褪黑素的方案。关注声明记录只列出四位原作者，也没有提到任何重复实验失败，因此原稿把它归因于德国联邦风险评估机构的说法已被删除。补充剂一侧：常见售卖的 3-10 mg 剂量是生理替代剂量的十到三十倍；对市售产品的独立检测多次发现含量与标签严重偏离，并偶有血清素污染；褪黑素在英国和欧盟大部分地区属处方药，在美国则作为补充剂自由销售。

Absorption吸收 Absolute oral bioavailability of melatonin is low and highly variable, averaging about 15% (reported range roughly 9-33%, with individual values spanning a five-fold spread), because up to 85% is removed on first pass, mainly by hepatic CYP1A2. CYP1A2 modifiers therefore matter more than the source: caffeine raises plasma melatonin from a given dose, smoking lowers it. Nothing is known about whether the nanogram to low-microgram quantities in a food matrix follow the same kinetics, and at those quantities the question is close to academic. Anyone comparing natural melatonin in pistachios with a tablet is comparing a sub-microgram intake against a supra-physiological one.褪黑素的口服绝对生物利用度低且个体差异极大，平均约 15%（报告范围大致 9-33%，个体值相差可达五倍），原因是最多 85% 在首过过程中被清除，主要经肝脏 CYP1A2。因此影响 CYP1A2 的因素比来源更重要：咖啡因会提高同等剂量下的血浆褪黑素，吸烟则会降低。食物基质中纳克到低微克级的量是否遵循同样的动力学，目前一无所知，而在这个量级上该问题几乎只有学术意义。把开心果里的“天然褪黑素”和药片相比，等于拿亚微克级的摄入量去比一个超生理剂量。

Data note数据说明 The cherry values, the walnut value, the pistachio LC-MS/MS value, the milk value, the disputed 233 ug/g figure and the 89,300x ratio were all verified against primary sources, and the bioavailability figure matches the established literature. Against that, the entry's original anchor (goji) had to be replaced with a review value, the egg figure had to be re-based from dry solids to fresh weight, and the ten added rows all rest on a single compiled secondary review table (PMC5409706) whose primary measurements were not re-traced in this pass中。樱桃数值、核桃数值、开心果的 LC-MS/MS 数值、牛奶数值、存疑的 233 µg/g 数值以及 89,300 倍的比值均已对照原始文献核实，生物利用度数字也与既有文献一致。另一方面，本条目原来的锚点（枸杞）不得不换成综述值，鸡蛋数值不得不从干固形物基准改算为鲜重基准，而新增的十行全部依赖一份汇编性的二手综述表格（PMC5409706），本轮未回溯其原始测定。

References:文献： Burgess PMID 20410229; van Geijlswijk PMID 21120122; Ferracioli-Oda PMID 23691095; Cohen JAMA 2023 PMID 37097362; Erland & Saxena PMID 27855744; Sateia AASM PMID 27998379
CONSIDERProbiotics, named strain only益生菌，仅限指定菌株Grade B证据 B 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Antibiotic-associated diarrhoea in children: at least 5 billion CFU/d. C. difficile prevention: 10-50 billion CFU/d. Infant colic: L. reuteri DSM 17938 at 100 million CFU/d.儿童抗生素相关腹泻：至少 50 亿 CFU/天。预防艰难梭菌：100 至 500 亿 CFU/天。婴儿肠绞痛：罗伊氏乳杆菌 DSM 17938，1 亿 CFU/天。
Who it is for适用人群Children on a course of antibiotics, adults on antibiotics with elevated C. difficile risk, and exclusively breastfed infants with colic.正在用抗生素的儿童、艰难梭菌风险升高且在用抗生素的成人、以及纯母乳喂养的肠绞痛婴儿。

Pros优点

  • Paediatric antibiotic-associated diarrhoea: 8% versus 19%, RR 0.45 (0.36-0.56), NNT 9 at the higher dose. This is a genuinely useful number.儿童抗生素相关腹泻：8% 对 19%，RR 0.45（0.36-0.56），高剂量下 NNT 为 9。这是一个真正有用的数字。
  • C. difficile prevention during antibiotics: RR 0.50 (0.38-0.64), 1.6% versus 3.2%.抗生素期间预防艰难梭菌：RR 0.50（0.38-0.64），1.6% 对 3.2%。
  • Infant colic in exclusively breastfed babies: NNT 2.6 for treatment success at day 21, which is a striking number for a benign intervention with a defined stop point.纯母乳喂养婴儿的肠绞痛：第 21 天治疗成功的 NNT 为 2.6。对一个温和且有明确停用节点的干预来说，这个数字相当亮眼。
  • Pouchitis maintenance after antibiotic-induced remission has a real randomised result: remission maintained in 17 of 20 versus 1 of 16.抗生素诱导缓解后的贮袋炎维持治疗有实实在在的随机结果：20 人中 17 人维持缓解，对照组 16 人中仅 1 人。

Cons缺点

  • The category claim is unfalsifiable marketing. Evidence attaches to a named strain at a defined dose. Disaggregate 82 trials and 10,332 IBS patients by strain and GRADE certainty collapses to low or very low almost everywhere.品类式声称是无法证伪的营销话术。证据只依附于特定菌株在特定剂量下的表现。把 82 项试验、10332 名肠易激患者按菌株拆开，GRADE 确定性几乎处处塌到低或极低。
  • C. difficile prevention has NNT 65 at LOW certainty, so 64 of 65 people get nothing. The absolute benefit scales with baseline risk.预防艰难梭菌的 NNT 是 65，确定性为低，也就是 65 人中有 64 人什么也得不到。绝对获益随基线风险而变。
  • The largest trial ever run was null. PLACIDE randomised 2,981 hospitalised patients over 65 and found no effect on either antibiotic-associated diarrhoea (RR 1.04) or C. difficile.规模最大的试验是阴性的。PLACIDE 随机了 2981 名 65 岁以上住院患者，对抗生素相关腹泻（RR 1.04）和艰难梭菌均无效应。
  • The AGA recommends AGAINST probiotics for irritable bowel syndrome outside clinical trials.美国胃肠病学会建议，在临床试验之外不要用益生菌治疗肠易激综合征。
  • There is a real harm signal in the critically ill. In predicted severe acute pancreatitis, mortality was 16% versus 6% (RR 2.53) with 9 cases of bowel ischaemia, 8 fatal, versus zero on placebo. The FDA also warned providers after a preterm infant died of probiotic-associated sepsis.在危重患者中存在真实的危害信号。在预测为重症急性胰腺炎的患者中，死亡率 16% 对 6%（RR 2.53），并出现 9 例肠缺血、其中 8 例死亡，安慰剂组为零。此外，在一名早产儿死于益生菌相关脓毒症后，FDA 也向医疗机构发出了警示。
  • Absolute contraindications: central venous catheter, neutropenia, severe immunocompromise, critical illness, and preterm infants outside a supervised protocol.绝对禁忌：中心静脉置管、中性粒细胞减少、重度免疫抑制、危重症，以及未在监督方案内的早产儿。

Food sources食物来源

No food source, manufactured无食物来源，人工合成 Dose NOT reachable by eating靠吃达不到剂量 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

SYNTHETIC here means no dietary source, not an artificial molecule: a named probiotic strain is a live organism, a single clonal isolate held in a culture bank, grown in industrial fermenters, freeze-dried and encapsulated. No food contains it. Fermented foods do carry large numbers of live lactic acid bacteria, but the species and strains present are whichever organisms grow in that food and its starter, never the deposited trial strain. Because probiotic efficacy is demonstrated strain by strain, a food supplying a different strain of the same species is a different product. Live-organism loads for fermented foods are given under the generic multi-strain entry.此处 SYNTHETIC 的含义是没有膳食来源。它并非人工合成的分子：一个指名益生菌菌株是活的生物体，是保藏在菌种库里的单一克隆分离株，在工业发酵罐中培养、冻干并装囊。没有任何食物含有它。发酵食品确实携带大量活的乳酸菌，但其中的菌种和菌株是能在该食物及其发酵剂中生长的那些微生物，从来不是保藏的试验菌株。由于益生菌的疗效是逐一菌株验证的，提供同一菌种不同菌株的食物属于另一种产品。发酵食品的活菌载量列在通用多菌株条目下。

No food rows: there is no ordinary food that supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有食物条目：没有任何普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 The gap is categorical and no quantity of food closes it. Named-strain doses in trials run from about 1x10^8 to 1x10^10 CFU/day; Bifidobacterium longum 35624 (formerly classified as infantis) was effective at 1x10^8, a figure the source trial expressed as CFU/mL rather than CFU/day (PMID 16863564). A single cup of kefir at 2.5x10^8 CFU/mL supplies roughly 6x10^10 live lactic acid bacteria (DOI 10.3390/foods15101616), so the raw CFU total is easily exceeded by food. The fraction of those cells belonging to the trialled strain is zero, which makes the CFU comparison meaningless for a strain-specific claim.这个差距是类别性的，任何食物量都无法弥合。试验中指名菌株的剂量大致为 1x10^8 至 1x10^10 CFU/day；Bifidobacterium longum 35624（原归类为 infantis）在 1x10^8 有效，而原始试验把这个数字表述为 CFU/mL 而非 CFU/day（PMID 16863564）。一杯 2.5x10^8 CFU/mL 的开菲尔提供约 6x10^10 个活乳酸菌（DOI 10.3390/foods15101616），所以单看 CFU 总数，食物轻松超过。这些菌体中属于受试菌株的比例为零，这使得 CFU 比较对于菌株特异性的主张毫无意义。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 This is the most important form caveat in the group. Clinical evidence for probiotics is strain-specific, and often formulation-specific and indication-specific on top of that. Yoghurt, kefir, sauerkraut, kimchi, miso, natto and tempeh do not contain the strains tested in the trials, so evidence generated with a named strain does not transfer to any fermented food, and does not transfer to a different strain of the same species either. Eating fermented food is a reasonable dietary habit with its own emerging evidence base, and it is a separate thing from taking a named strain at a defined dose for a specific clinical effect. Two practical points: heat kills the organisms, so a pasteurised or cooked ferment (canned sauerkraut, miso stirred into boiling soup, baked tempeh) delivers no live cells; and species-level labelling on a supplement such as 'contains Lactobacillus acidophilus' without a strain designation carries no more transferable evidence than a food does.这是本组中最重要的剂型注意点。益生菌的临床证据是菌株特异的，往往还叠加配方特异和适应证特异。酸奶、开菲尔、德式酸菜、韩式泡菜、味噌、纳豆和天贝都不含试验所用的菌株，所以用指名菌株得到的证据无法转移到任何发酵食品，也无法转移到同一菌种的另一个菌株。吃发酵食品是合理的饮食习惯，本身有正在积累的证据基础，这与为特定临床效果按确定剂量服用指名菌株是两件事。两个实用要点：加热会杀死这些微生物，因此经巴氏杀菌或加热烹调的发酵物（罐装德式酸菜、拌入沸汤的味噌、烤过的天贝）不提供活菌；补充剂上只标到菌种层面，例如“含嗜酸乳杆菌（Lactobacillus acidophilus）”而无菌株编号，其证据可转移性与食物无异。

Absorption吸收 Survival of gastric acid and bile is strain-dependent, and the delivery matrix changes it: the fat and buffering capacity of a dairy food improves survival relative to a bare capsule, while enteric coating or microencapsulation is used to achieve the same in supplements. Dose is not monotonic, which is the clearest evidence that formulation matters as much as CFU count. In a 362-patient dose-ranging trial in primary-care IBS, B. infantis 35624 at 1x10^8 was significantly superior to placebo and to all other doses, while 1x10^6 and 1x10^10 were not; the paper attributes the failure of the highest dose to significant formulation problems (Whorwell et al., Am J Gastroenterol 2006;101:1581-1590, PMID 16863564). Two generalisability caveats the submission omitted: the trial enrolled women only, and doses were expressed as CFU/mL in the paper rather than CFU/day. A higher label CFU is therefore not better, and label CFU at manufacture is not the same as viable CFU at end of shelf life.对胃酸和胆汁的存活取决于菌株，递送基质也会改变它：乳制品的脂肪和缓冲能力使存活率优于裸胶囊，补充剂则用肠溶包衣或微囊化达到同样目的。剂量效应并非单调递增，这是配方与 CFU 数同等重要的最清晰证据。在一项纳入 362 例基层医疗 IBS 患者的剂量探索试验中，B. infantis 35624 在 1x10^8 显著优于安慰剂及其他所有剂量，1x10^6 和 1x10^10 则没有；论文把最高剂量失效归因于明显的配方问题（Whorwell et al., Am J Gastroenterol 2006;101:1581-1590, PMID 16863564）。原稿漏掉了两条外推性注意点：试验只纳入女性，论文中的剂量以 CFU/mL 而非 CFU/day 表述。因此标签 CFU 越高并不意味着越好，出厂时的标签 CFU 也不等于保质期末的活菌 CFU。

Data note数据说明 The claim is categorical (no food contains a deposited trial strain) and the supporting trial was verified: 362 patients, doses 1x10^6, 1x10^8 and 1x10^10, with the 1x10^8 arm significantly superior to placebo and all other doses. The one detail that failed verification, the gelling mechanism for the top dose, has been removed and replaced with the paper's own wording高。该主张是类别性的（没有食物含有保藏的试验菌株），支持性试验已核实：362 例患者，剂量为 1x10^6、1x10^8 和 1x10^10，其中 1x10^8 组显著优于安慰剂和其他所有剂量。唯一未通过核实的细节，即最高剂量的成胶机制，已删除并改用论文自身的表述。

References:文献： Cochrane Guo PMID 31039287; Cochrane CD006095.pub5 PMID 40931979; Sung PMID 29279326; PLACIDE PMID 23932219; Goodoory & Ford PMID 37541528; AGA PMID 32531291; PROPATRIA PMID 18279948
CONSIDERBerberine小檗碱Grade B证据 B 级
Dose tested已验证剂量500 mg two or three times daily with meals. Note dihydroberberine and phytosome forms are more bioavailable and are not milligram-equivalent.500 毫克，每日 2 至 3 次，随餐服用。注意二氢小檗碱和植物体形式生物利用度更高，毫克数不能等同换算。
Who it is for适用人群Adults with type 2 diabetes or prediabetes not reaching glycaemic targets, as an add-on, with a prescriber informed.2 型糖尿病或糖尿病前期、血糖未达标的成人，作为加用药物，且需告知处方医生。

Pros优点

  • The effect is real and clinically sized, which is unusual in this document: fasting glucose -0.82 mmol/L, HbA1c -0.63%, across 37 trials and 3,048 patients. That HbA1c reduction is in the range of a real drug.效应真实且具临床规模，这在本文中并不多见：空腹血糖降低 0.82 mmol/L，糖化血红蛋白降低 0.63%，来自 37 项试验、3048 名患者。这个糖化血红蛋白降幅已接近真正的药物。
  • Total adverse events were lower than comparators in the pooled analysis (RR 0.73), and it does not cause hypoglycaemia on its own.在合并分析中总不良事件低于对照药（RR 0.73），且单用不引起低血糖。

Cons缺点

  • The marketing understates the pharmacology rather than overstating it, and that is the danger. This behaves like a drug and should be treated as one.它的营销是低估而不是高估了其药理作用，危险恰恰在这里。它的行为像药，就应当被当作药来对待。
  • The most dangerous interaction in this document: 600 mg/d for three months raised ciclosporin trough concentrations by 88.9% in 52 renal transplant recipients. Note that this interaction dose is BELOW the typical glycaemic dose.本文中最危险的相互作用：52 名肾移植受者服用 600 毫克/天共三个月，环孢素谷浓度升高 88.9%。注意这个产生相互作用的剂量低于常规降糖剂量。
  • Berberine alone showed no statistical advantage over lifestyle change. The benefit appears as an add-on to an existing oral hypoglycaemic.单用小檗碱相对生活方式干预没有统计学优势。获益体现在与已有口服降糖药联用时。
  • The trial base is dominated by small Chinese trials that meta-analysts repeatedly describe as having low methodological quality.试验基础以小型中国试验为主，meta 分析作者反复指出其方法学质量偏低。
  • No upper limit exists. Toxicology review reports dose-dependent gastrointestinal ulceration, immunotoxicity, phototoxicity, neurotoxicity and cardiotoxicity. Contraindicated in pregnancy and in neonates (kernicterus risk).没有设定上限。毒理学综述报告了剂量依赖的胃肠道溃疡、免疫毒性、光毒性、神经毒性和心脏毒性。妊娠期和新生儿禁用（核黄疸风险）。

Food sources食物来源

From a plant not eaten as food来自不作食物食用的植物 Dose NOT reachable by eating靠吃达不到剂量 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

Berberine is an isoquinoline alkaloid from the roots, rhizomes and stem bark of medicinal plants: Berberis vulgaris (common barberry), B. aristata, B. asiatica and B. lycium, Coptis chinensis (huang lian) rhizome, Hydrastis canadensis (goldenseal), Mahonia aquifolium (Oregon grape) and Phellodendron amurense. None of these organs is eaten as food. Accumulation is highest in root tissue, 1.6-4.3% of dry weight across Berberis species, and B. vulgaris bark carries over 8% total alkaloids of which about 5% is berberine (Neag et al., Front Pharmacol 2018, PMC6111450, verified). Barberry fruit is the one part genuinely eaten, as zereshk in Iranian rice dishes, and it is the wrong organ: the whole-plant survey reporting up to 26,482 ug/g berberine in root and no detectable alkaloids in fruit pulp across 96 accessions was done on Berberis darwinii, the Chilean michay, which is a congener of the zereshk species rather than the same plant, and in that study leaves and seeds did carry detectable (lower) alkaloid levels, so only the pulp was non-detect (Molecules 2025;30(8):1849, PMID 40333914). The species question is closed by a separate group working directly on B. vulgaris fruit, which reports that the flowers, fruit pulp and seeds have little or no significant alkaloid content and describes their fruit extract as nearly devoid of berberine (Iran J Pharm Res 2011;10(1):97-104, PMID 24363687).小檗碱是一种异喹啉类生物碱，来自多种药用植物的根、根茎和茎皮：欧洲小檗（Berberis vulgaris，刺檗）、B. aristata、B. asiatica 和 B. lycium，黄连（Coptis chinensis）根茎，北美黄连（Hydrastis canadensis，goldenseal），俄勒冈葡萄（Mahonia aquifolium）以及黄檗（Phellodendron amurense）。这些器官都不作为食物食用。蓄积以根组织最高，小檗属各物种为干重的 1.6-4.3%，欧洲小檗树皮总生物碱超过 8%，其中约 5% 是小檗碱（Neag 等，Front Pharmacol 2018, PMC6111450，已核实）。小檗果实是真正被吃的部分，即伊朗米饭菜里的 zereshk（干酸浆果），而它属于另一个器官：那项在 96 个种质中报告根部小檗碱高达 26,482 µg/g、果肉未检出生物碱的全株调查，用的是达尔文小檗（Berberis darwinii，智利 michay），它是 zereshk 所属物种的同属近缘种，并非同一种植物；而且在该研究中叶和种子确实含有可检出的（较低的）生物碱水平，只有果肉为未检出（Molecules 2025;30(8):1849, PMID 40333914）。物种问题由另一组直接研究 B. vulgaris 果实的工作作了结：该研究报告花、果肉和种子几乎不含或不含有意义量的生物碱，并把其果实提取物描述为几乎不含小檗碱（Iran J Pharm Res 2011;10(1):97-104, PMID 24363687）。

No food rows: there is no ordinary food that supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有食物条目：没有任何普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 Trials use 500 mg two or three times daily, 1000-1500 mg/day. At the 5% berberine content of B. vulgaris root bark that is 20-30 g of dried root bark per day, which is a herbal decoction rather than a meal. Via the edible fruit the gap is not a large number, it is undefined: berberine is below the limit of detection in barberry pulp, so no portion size reaches the dose at all. A generous serving of zereshk polow uses perhaps 30-50 g of dried berries spread across several people and contributes no measurable berberine. Coptis rhizome and goldenseal root would need 1-3 g of dried herb and neither is eaten as food.试验用量为每次 500 mg、每天两到三次，即 1000-1500 mg/天。按欧洲小檗根皮 5% 的小檗碱含量计算，相当于每天 20-30 g 干根皮，这属于草药煎剂的范畴，不是一餐饭。走可食用果实这条路，差距无法用一个倍数表示，它是未定义的：小檗碱在小檗果肉中低于检出限，任何份量都达不到剂量。一份量足的 zereshk polow（酸浆果抓饭）大约用 30-50 g 干果，还要分给好几个人，提供的小檗碱不可测。黄连根茎和北美黄连根需要 1-3 g 干药材，而两者都不作为食物食用。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 This is the clearest case in the set where a food and its supplement share only a plant name. Eating zereshk supplies vitamin C, anthocyanins and organic acids, with no pharmacological berberine effect. The isolated alkaloid at 1000-1500 mg/day behaves like a drug: it inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 and is a P-glycoprotein substrate and inhibitor, so it can raise levels of co-administered medicines; it commonly causes constipation, cramping and diarrhoea; and it is contraindicated in pregnancy and in neonates because berberine displaces bilirubin from albumin and has been linked to kernicterus risk. Whole-plant root extracts also carry berbamine, palmatine and, in goldenseal, hydrastine, so a barberry root extract and a purified berberine HCl capsule are not the same product. Goldenseal is additionally a conservation concern and a frequent target of species adulteration.本组数据中，食物与其补充剂只共享一个植物名的情况，这一条最为典型。吃 zereshk 得到的是维生素 C、花青素和有机酸，没有小檗碱的药理作用。分离出的生物碱在 1000-1500 mg/天的用量下表现如同药物：它抑制 CYP3A4 和 CYP2D6，同时是 P-糖蛋白的底物和抑制剂，因而可能升高同服药物的浓度；常见不良反应为便秘、腹部绞痛和腹泻；孕妇和新生儿禁用，因为小檗碱会把胆红素从白蛋白上置换下来，并与核黄疸风险相关。全株根提取物还含小檗胺和巴马汀，北美黄连中另含北美黄连碱（hydrastine），所以小檗根提取物和纯化的盐酸小檗碱胶囊是两种不同产品。北美黄连另外还涉及物种保护问题，也是物种掺假的常见对象。

Absorption吸收 Berberine's oral bioavailability is under 1%, measured at 0.36-0.68% in rats, with roughly 99.5% eliminated during gastrointestinal and hepatic first pass through poor solubility, self-aggregation in gastric acid, P-glycoprotein efflux and CYP-mediated intestinal metabolism (Expert Opin Drug Metab Toxicol 2023;19(3), PMID 37057922). Much of berberine's metabolic effect is thought to be exerted in the gut lumen and on the microbiome rather than systemically, so low bioavailability does not mean inactive. It does mean trace amounts from any food would be pharmacologically irrelevant, and it means formulation comparisons (plain salt, phytosome, micelle) can change exposure by an order of magnitude at the same labelled dose.小檗碱的口服生物利用度低于 1%，在大鼠中测得 0.36-0.68%，约 99.5% 在胃肠道和肝脏首过过程中被清除，机制包括溶解性差、在胃酸中自聚集、P-糖蛋白外排以及 CYP 介导的肠道代谢（Expert Opin Drug Metab Toxicol 2023;19(3), PMID 37057922）。一般认为小檗碱的代谢效应大部分发挥在肠腔内和对微生物组的作用上，而非全身性作用，所以生物利用度低并不等于没有活性。它确实意味着食物中的任何微量在药理上都无关紧要，也意味着剂型比较（普通盐、磷脂复合物、胶束）在同一标注剂量下可使暴露量相差一个数量级。

Data note数据说明 Every quantitative claim in this entry was checked and matched its source verbatim: the 1.6-4.3% root range, the 8% total alkaloid / 5% berberine figure for B. vulgaris bark, the 26,482 ug/g root maximum, the 96-accession pulp non-detect, and the 20-30 g root-bark dose equivalent. The NOT_FOOD classification was challenged and upheld高。本条目中每一项定量说法都经过核对并与来源逐字相符：1.6-4.3% 的根部含量范围、欧洲小檗树皮总生物碱 8% 与小檗碱约 5% 的数据、根部最高 26,482 µg/g、96 个种质的果肉未检出，以及 20-30 g 根皮的剂量等效量。NOT_FOOD 分类经过质疑后仍然维持。

References:文献： Xie PMID 36467075; Lan PMID 25498346; Dong PMID 23118793; ciclosporin interaction PMID 16133554
CONSIDERVitamin C维生素 CGrade C证据 C 级
Dose tested已验证剂量200 mg/d if taken regularly. Higher doses do not shorten colds further and cause osmotic diarrhoea.若规律服用，200 毫克/天。更高剂量并不能进一步缩短感冒，反而引起渗透性腹泻。
Who it is for适用人群Smokers, heavy alcohol users, people on very restricted diets, and those under extreme physical stress such as marathon runners.吸烟者、大量饮酒者、饮食极度受限者，以及处于极端身体应激下的人，比如马拉松跑者。

Pros优点

  • It cures scurvy, which is an unambiguous deficiency disease, and scurvy still occurs in food-insecure and alcohol-dependent populations.它能治愈坏血病，这是一种毫不含糊的缺乏症，而坏血病在食物不安全和酒精依赖人群中至今仍会出现。
  • Under extreme physical stress such as marathons and sub-arctic exercise, prophylactic vitamin C halved cold incidence. That subgroup effect is real.在马拉松、亚寒带运动等极端身体应激下，预防性补充维生素 C 使感冒发生率减半。这个亚组效应是真实的。
  • Smokers genuinely need 35 mg/d more than non-smokers because of higher turnover.吸烟者由于周转率更高，确实比不吸烟者每天多需要 35 毫克。

Cons缺点

  • It does not prevent colds in the general population: RR 0.97 (0.94-1.00) across 29 comparisons and 11,306 people. This is the founding claim of the modern supplement industry and it is false.它不能预防普通人群的感冒：29 项比较、11306 人的数据是 RR 0.97（0.94-1.00）。这是现代补充剂行业的奠基性主张，而它是错的。
  • Duration falls only 8% in adults and 14% in children, which is roughly half a day.病程在成人中只缩短 8%，儿童 14%，大约是半天。
  • Intravenous vitamin C in sepsis is HARMFUL. The LOVIT trial (n=863) found more death or persistent organ dysfunction in the treatment arm.脓毒症静脉用维生素 C 是有害的。LOVIT 试验（n=863）发现治疗组死亡或持续器官功能障碍更多。
  • Avoid with a history of calcium oxalate kidney stones or hyperoxaluria, and in renal impairment, because ascorbate is metabolised to oxalate.有草酸钙肾结石史或高草酸尿者、以及肾功能不全者应避免，因为抗坏血酸会代谢为草酸。
  • Upper limit 2,000 mg/d, set on osmotic diarrhoea.上限 2000 毫克/天，依据是渗透性腹泻。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose reachable by eating靠吃可以达到剂量 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

Genuinely rich and cheap in ordinary food, and the verification pass challenged this classification and upheld it as the strongest in the set: one 119 g red pepper (152 mg) or one 55 g guava (125 mg) exceeds the 90 mg adult male RDA on its own, with no trace-amount inflation anywhere in the list. Synthetic ascorbic acid is manufactured (Reichstein or two-step fermentation from glucose), but it is the identical molecule, so the synthetic label carries no penalty here. Percentages below are given against both DRI values, since the RDA is 90 mg for men and 75 mg for women and quoting only the male figure understates every food's contribution for women by 20%. Rose hips, camu-camu, chilli peppers, papaya and Brussels sprouts are further rich sources for which no verified figure was available, so they get no row.在普通食物里真正丰富而且便宜。核查环节对这一分类提出质疑并予以确认，认定它是整组里最扎实的一项：一个 119 g 的红甜椒（152 mg）或一个 55 g 的番石榴（125 mg）单独就超过成人男性 90 mg 的 RDA，整份清单里没有任何靠痕量堆数字的地方。合成抗坏血酸是制造出来的（Reichstein 法，或以葡萄糖为原料的两步发酵法），但它是完全相同的分子，所以合成这个标签在这里不带任何折扣。下面的百分比同时给出两个 DRI 数值，因为 RDA 男性为 90 mg、女性为 75 mg，只引男性数字会把每种食物对女性的贡献低估 20%。玫瑰果、卡姆果（camu-camu）、辣椒、木瓜和抱子甘蓝也是富含来源，但没有可核实的数据，因此不单列。
