To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 This is the one item in the set where the supplement dose is physically reachable by eating. A 1,000 mg tablet equals 60 g of raw acerola, about 12 small fruits, or 439 g of guava (8 fruits), or 552 g of blackcurrants, or 781 g of raw red pepper (about 6.6 medium peppers), or 1.07 kg of raw kale, or 1.70 kg of strawberries, or 1.88 kg of orange (14 medium oranges), or 2.0 kg of fresh orange juice, which is about 1.9 litres (the submission's '2.0 litres' confused grams with litres). A 500 mg dose is 3.3 red peppers or 7 oranges. Eccentric for most of that list, and trivially easy through acerola, so a person genuinely could eat this dose. The real gap is that the dose above roughly 200 mg is pointless rather than unreachable. Levine et al. gave 30-2,500 mg/day under depletion-repletion control: bioavailability was complete at a single 200 mg dose and fell off at 500 mg and above with the absorbed excess appearing in urine, while leucocytes saturated at 100 mg/day and plasma at 1,000 mg/day (PNAS 1996;93:3704-9, PMID 8623000, DOI 10.1073/pnas.93.8.3704). Four or five servings of ordinary fruit and vegetables reach the physiologically useful plateau, and the 1,000 mg tablet mostly funds expensive urine. The number that should temper any composition table is what survives handling: see cooking and storage below.这是整组里唯一一个靠吃就能在物理上达到补充剂剂量的项目。1,000 mg 的片剂等于 60 g 生针叶樱桃，约 12 颗小果，或 439 g 番石榴（8 个），或 552 g 黑加仑，或 781 g 生红甜椒（约 6.6 个中等大小），或 1.07 kg 生羽衣甘蓝，或 1.70 kg 草莓，或 1.88 kg 橙子（14 个中等大小），或 2.0 kg 鲜榨橙汁，约合 1.9 升（原稿写的 2.0 升把克和升搞混了）。500 mg 的剂量是 3.3 个红甜椒或 7 个橙子。这份清单上大多数选项都很古怪，通过针叶樱桃则轻而易举，所以一个人确实吃得到这个剂量。真正的问题在别处：超过约 200 mg 的剂量吃得到，只是没有意义。Levine 等在耗竭-补足的对照条件下给予 30-2,500 mg/天：单次 200 mg 剂量的生物利用度是完全的，500 mg 及以上开始下降，吸收后多余的部分出现在尿中；白细胞在 100 mg/天饱和，血浆在 1,000 mg/天饱和（PNAS 1996;93:3704-9, PMID 8623000, DOI 10.1073/pnas.93.8.3704）。四到五份普通蔬果就能达到生理上有用的平台，1,000 mg 的片剂多半只是在为昂贵的尿液付钱。该给成分表打折的那个数字是经过处理后还剩下多少，见下面的烹饪与储存部分。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Effectively NONE on the molecule. Synthetic and food-derived vitamin C are chemically identical and all steady-state human comparative bioavailability studies show no difference, with some acute pharmacokinetic studies showing minor transient differences of no physiological consequence (Carr and Vissers, Nutrients 2013;5:4284-304, PMID 24169506, DOI 10.3390/nu5114284). That kills the claim that natural vitamin C is better absorbed, and it means acerola, camu-camu and rose hip products carry no absorption advantage; most such products are in any case standardised by adding synthetic ascorbic acid, so the buyer gets the synthetic molecule with fruit powder attached. Note that acerola still earns a food row on content alone, at 1,680 mg/100 g the richest verified source in the database, which is a separate matter from the debunked absorption claim. What the whole food genuinely adds is the rest of the matrix, potassium, folate, carotenoids, flavonoids and fibre, none of which is in the tablet and none of which the vitamin C evidence is about. Where a caveat does bite is the textbook recommendation to eat spinach: its vitamin C is modest at 28.1 mg/100 g, a realistic 30 g cup gives 8.4 mg, and boiling extracts most of what is there, moving 60% of the vitamin C and 50% of the flavonoids of fresh-cut spinach into the cooking water (Gil, Ferreres and Tomas-Barberan, J Agric Food Chem 1999;47:2213-7, PMID 10794612). Recommending boiled spinach for vitamin C comes close to recommending the cooking water. Raw kale at 93.4 mg/100 g is the green that actually delivers, three times the spinach figure.就分子本身而言基本没有。合成与来自食物的维生素 C 化学上完全相同，所有稳态条件下的人体比较生物利用度研究都显示没有差别，部分急性药代动力学研究显示的轻微短暂差异没有生理意义（Carr 与 Vissers, Nutrients 2013;5:4284-304, PMID 24169506, DOI 10.3390/nu5114284）。这否掉了天然维生素 C 吸收更好的说法，也意味着针叶樱桃、卡姆果和玫瑰果产品在吸收上没有优势；这类产品本来大多靠添加合成抗坏血酸来做标准化，买家拿到的是带着果粉的合成分子。要注意针叶樱桃仍然凭含量单独占一行，1,680 mg/100 g 是数据库中已核实的最富来源，这与被否掉的吸收说法是两件事。整个食物真正多给的是基质里的其余成分，钾、叶酸、类胡萝卜素、类黄酮和膳食纤维，片剂里都没有，而维生素 C 的证据讲的也不是这些。真正需要警告的是教科书式的吃菠菜补维生素 C 这条建议：菠菜的维生素 C 含量一般，28.1 mg/100 g，现实中一杯 30 g 只给 8.4 mg，而水煮会把里面的大部分萃取出去，鲜切菠菜有 60% 的维生素 C 和 50% 的类黄酮进了煮菜的水里（Gil、Ferreres 与 Tomas-Barberan, J Agric Food Chem 1999;47:2213-7, PMID 10794612）。推荐用水煮菠菜补维生素 C，差不多等于推荐那锅水。生羽衣甘蓝 93.4 mg/100 g 才是真正管用的绿叶菜，是菠菜数字的三倍。

Absorption吸收 Absorption is near-complete up to about 200 mg per dose via the sodium-dependent transporter SVCT1, declines above 500 mg, and plasma saturates at 1,000 mg/day (PMID 8623000). Absorption is therefore not the variable that matters; retention before eating is. Cooking and storage losses, all from USDA Table of Nutrient Retention Factors Release 6 (2007), ascorbic acid column: greens boiled in water to cover and drained retain 55% (code 3005), greens boiled in a little water and drained 60% (3004), greens stir-fried 85% (3015), greens cooked from frozen and drained 60% (3019); other vegetables boiled in water to cover and drained 75% (3775), steamed 85% (3784); potatoes baked in the skin 80% (3301), boiled pared and drained 75% (3308), and only 25% when boiled after storage and browned (3311); canned fruit 50% (0154) and dried fruit 20% (0158). Steaming beats boiling and draining consistently: in broccoli every method except steaming caused significant loss of vitamin C and chlorophyll (Yuan et al., J Zhejiang Univ Sci B 2009;10:580-8, PMID 19650196, DOI 10.1631/jzus.b0920051). Storage compounds it: 15 days at 4 C across 19 fruits and vegetables lowered vitamin C and cut total phenolics by up to 29.67%, though total anthocyanins showed minimal change in that study despite the title (Galani et al., Antioxidants 2017;6(3):59, PMID 28737734). Practical upshot: a week-old boiled vegetable can deliver a quarter of its table value, so the 27% loss between raw broccoli at 89.2 mg/100 g and boiled broccoli at 64.9 mg/100 g is the optimistic case rather than the worst one.每次剂量约 200 mg 以内，经钠依赖性转运体 SVCT1 的吸收接近完全，超过 500 mg 后下降，血浆在 1,000 mg/天饱和（PMID 8623000）。决定实际摄入的是入口前还能保留多少，吸收本身不构成变量。烹饪与储存损失全部出自 USDA 营养素保留系数表（Table of Nutrient Retention Factors）第 6 版（2007）的抗坏血酸一栏：绿叶菜加水没过煮后沥干保留 55%（代码 3005），加少量水煮后沥干 60%（3004），快炒 85%（3015），从冷冻直接烹制后沥干 60%（3019）；其他蔬菜加水没过煮后沥干 75%（3775），蒸 85%（3784）；带皮烤马铃薯 80%（3301），削皮水煮沥干 75%（3308），储存后再水煮并褐变的只有 25%（3311）；罐装水果 50%（0154），干制水果 20%（0158）。蒸一贯优于水煮后沥干：在西兰花上，除蒸制以外的每一种方法都造成维生素 C 和叶绿素的显著损失（Yuan 等, J Zhejiang Univ Sci B 2009;10:580-8, PMID 19650196, DOI 10.1631/jzus.b0920051）。储存会叠加：19 种蔬果在 4 C 下放 15 天，维生素 C 下降，总酚类最多减少 29.67%，不过该研究中总花青素变化很小，与标题给人的印象不同（Galani 等, Antioxidants 2017;6(3):59, PMID 28737734）。实际结论：放了一周又水煮过的蔬菜可能只剩成分表数值的四分之一，所以生西兰花 89.2 mg/100 g 到水煮西兰花 64.9 mg/100 g 之间那 27% 的损失属于乐观情形，最坏的情况比这更糟。

Data note数据说明 All ten original per-100 g values and all gram weights matched named FoodData Central records exactly, including the raw and boiled broccoli split, and every per-portion figure recomputed. All five cited PMIDs resolve to the stated journal, volume and pages with findings matching the abstracts, and eleven retention factors were verified row by row against Release 6. Two smaller qualifications: the acerola and kale figures come from the verification report's own FDC lookups rather than the original submission, and the 100 g kale portion basis is stated by this dataset rather than taken from a USDA household measure高。原稿的十个每 100 g 数值和所有克重都与具名的 FoodData Central 记录完全吻合，包括生西兰花与水煮西兰花的拆分，每个每份数值都能重算得出。引用的五个 PMID 全部指向所述期刊、卷号和页码，结论与摘要一致，十一个保留系数逐行对照第 6 版核实。两点较小的限定：针叶樱桃和羽衣甘蓝的数据来自核查环节自行查询的 FDC 记录，并非原稿提供；羽衣甘蓝 100 g 的份量基准由本数据集给出，并非取自 USDA 的家庭常用量。

CONSIDERCoenzyme Q10 / ubiquinol辅酶 Q10 / 泛醇Grade B证据 B 级
Dose tested已验证剂量100 mg three times daily, the Q-SYMBIO regimen. Ubiquinol is more bioavailable and doses do not transfer 1:1 from ubiquinone.100 毫克每日三次，即 Q-SYMBIO 方案。泛醇生物利用度更高，与泛醌之间剂量不能一比一换算。
Who it is for适用人群Patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction, already on guideline therapy, with cardiology input.射血分数降低的心衰患者，且已在接受指南推荐治疗，需心内科参与决定。

Pros优点

  • Q-SYMBIO is the only clinical-endpoint result in the whole longevity and metabolic category: n=420, 2 years, major adverse cardiovascular events 15% versus 26%, HR 0.50 (0.32-0.80).Q-SYMBIO 是整个抗衰老与代谢品类中唯一有临床终点的结果：n=420，2 年，主要不良心血管事件 15% 对 26%，HR 0.50（0.32-0.80）。
  • Genuine primary CoQ10 deficiency is a real, rare condition where replacement is the treatment.真正的原发性辅酶 Q10 缺乏是一种真实存在的罕见病，替代治疗就是它的疗法。

Cons缺点

  • Q-SYMBIO is a single unreplicated trial. The NIHR health technology assessment covering 26 trials and 2,250 participants flagged important concerns about risk of bias, plausibility of effect sizes and applicability, and found all-cause mortality RR 0.68 (0.45-1.03), not significant.Q-SYMBIO 是一项未被重复验证的单一试验。NIHR 的卫生技术评估涵盖 26 项试验、2250 名受试者，对其偏倚风险、效应量的合理性和适用性提出重要质疑，并得出全因死亡 RR 0.68（0.45-1.03），不显著。
  • For statin-associated muscle symptoms, which is where most retail CoQ10 is actually sold, it does nothing: weighted mean difference -0.42 (-1.47 to 0.62) and adherence RR 0.99 across 7 trials.在他汀相关肌痛这个零售辅酶 Q10 的真正主销场景上，它毫无作用：7 项试验的加权均数差为 -0.42（-1.47 至 0.62），依从性 RR 0.99。
  • Warfarin interaction: CoQ10 is structurally similar to vitamin K, and one cross-sectional analysis of patients presenting with anticoagulant overdose found an association with bleeding.与华法林的相互作用：辅酶 Q10 结构上与维生素 K 相似，一项针对抗凝药过量就诊患者的横断面分析发现其与出血相关。
  • Expensive relative to everything else in this document, and the 1,200 mg observed safe level comes from a risk assessment whose authors were affiliated with an industry trade body.相对本文中其他产品价格昂贵，而 1200 毫克的“观察安全水平”出自一份作者与行业协会有关联的风险评估。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose NOT reachable by eating靠吃达不到剂量 Data confidence: Medium数据可信度：中

Organ meats and oily fish are genuine, substantial sources, so the substance question and the dose question separate cleanly here. Pork heart at 118.1-282 mg/kg is the richest food in the literature, beef heart is 113 mg/kg, chicken heart 92.3-192 mg/kg, chicken liver 116.2-132.2 mg/kg and mackerel dark flesh 43-67 mg/kg. Total habitual dietary intake is only 3.8 mg/day in women and 5.4 mg/day in men (Mattila & Kumpulainen 2001), so a single 100 g portion of heart is two to five days of ordinary intake. That is what RICH means in this dataset. It does not mean the supplement dose is reachable, which it is not. Supplement CoQ10 is produced by microbial fermentation or chemical synthesis, not extracted from beef.内脏和油性鱼类是真实且可观的来源，所以这里“物质是否存在”与“剂量能否达到”可以清楚分开。文献中最富含的食物是猪心，118.1-282 mg/kg；牛心 113 mg/kg，鸡心 92.3-192 mg/kg，鸡肝 116.2-132.2 mg/kg，鲭鱼暗色肉 43-67 mg/kg。膳食总习惯摄入量只有女性 3.8 mg/天、男性 5.4 mg/天（Mattila & Kumpulainen 2001），因此单独一份 100 g 心脏就等于两到五天的普通摄入量。这就是本数据集中 RICH（丰富）的含义。它并不意味着补剂剂量可以达到，那是达不到的。补剂辅酶 Q10 由微生物发酵或化学合成制得，不从牛肉中提取。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 A 300 mg/day dose needs 1.06 kg of pork heart at its richest measured value, rising to 2.54 kg at its low end; 1.6 to 3.3 kg of chicken hearts; 2.65 kg of beef heart; or 4.7 kg of the very richest sardines, about 51 tins, rising past 60 kg if the tins sit at the low end of the measured range. The submission's '2.7 kg of beef heart' was presented as the floor only because pork heart, the richest source of all, was missing. Against a whole day's ordinary dietary CoQ10 of 3.8-5.4 mg, a 300 mg capsule is about 56 to 79 days of eating in one dose and a 100 mg capsule about 19 to 26 days. The one boundary case worth stating: 355 g of pork heart at its richest measured value does reach 100 mg, which is a real meal in some cuisines but not a diet anyone sustains. Anyone whose reason for taking CoQ10 is a claimed pharmacological effect at 100-300 mg cannot get there by eating; anyone whose reason is a low-CoQ10 diet can move the needle with a weekly portion of heart, liver or oily fish.300 mg/天 的剂量需要按最富实测值计的 1.06 kg 猪心，按其低值则升到 2.54 kg；或 1.6 到 3.3 kg 鸡心；或 2.65 kg 牛心；或最富含的沙丁鱼 4.7 kg，约 51 罐，若罐头处于实测区间低端则超过 60 kg。原提交稿的“2.7 kg 牛心”之所以被当作下限，只是因为漏掉了最富含的猪心。对照一整天普通膳食辅酶 Q10 的 3.8-5.4 mg，一粒 300 mg 胶囊约等于一次吃下 56 到 79 天的量，100 mg 胶囊约 19 到 26 天。有一个边界情形值得说明：按最富实测值，355 g 猪心确实能达到 100 mg，在某些饮食文化里这是一顿真实的饭，但没人会长期这样吃。凡是因为宣称的 100-300 mg 药理作用而服用辅酶 Q10 的人，靠吃达不到；凡是因为膳食辅酶 Q10 偏低而服用的人，每周一份心脏、肝脏或油性鱼就能改变局面。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Significant. CoQ10 is a large lipophilic quinone (MW 863) and crystalline ubiquinone powder in a dry tablet absorbs very poorly; commercial products use oil suspensions, solubilisates or reduced-form ubiquinol precisely because the raw molecule does not dissolve. Absorption is saturable, so a 300 mg dose does not deliver proportionally more than a 100 mg dose. Food has one genuine advantage: CoQ10 in meat and fish comes packaged with fat, and supplemental CoQ10 taken with a fatty meal absorbs materially better, so a capsule swallowed on an empty stomach may deliver less than the label implies. Cooking costs some of the food content, with reported losses of roughly 15-32% frying pork cutlets and about 15% grilling beef. Most body CoQ10 is made endogenously and the biosynthetic pathway shares its early steps with cholesterol synthesis, which is the basis of the statin argument; neither food nor supplement changes that pathway.显著。辅酶 Q10 是大分子亲脂性醌（MW 863），干片中的结晶泛醌粉末吸收极差；商品之所以采用油悬液、增溶体系或还原型泛醇，正是因为原始分子不溶。吸收是可饱和的，300 mg 剂量送达的量并不按比例高于 100 mg。食物有一个真实优势：肉和鱼里的辅酶 Q10 天然与脂肪一同包装，而补充的辅酶 Q10 随含脂餐服用吸收明显更好，所以空腹吞下的胶囊送达量可能低于标签所示。烹饪会损失一部分含量，已报告猪排油炸损失约 15-32%，牛肉烤制约 15%。体内辅酶 Q10 大部分为内源合成，其生物合成通路的早期步骤与胆固醇合成共用，这也是他汀相关论点的基础；食物和补剂都不改变这条通路。

Absorption吸收 Low and formulation-dependent for the supplement, which is the honest headline. Ubiquinol (reduced) and solubilised formulations achieve higher plasma levels than plain crystalline ubiquinone, and all forms depend on dietary fat and bile for uptake. In the food matrix CoQ10 sits in mitochondrial membranes and is co-ingested with fat, so uptake per milligram is probably as good as or better than a dry capsule, but the milligram totals are 10 to 80 times too small: the richest single portion in the table is 28.2 mg against a 300 mg dose. The reduced-to-oxidised split also differs between foods: a Japanese survey of 70 food items found ubiquinol-10 above 20 ug/g in pork shoulder, bovine liver, chicken heart, horse mackerel, young yellowtail and soybean oil (Kubo H, Fujii K, Kawabe T, Matsumoto S, Kishida H, Hosoe K, 'Food content of ubiquinol-10 and ubiquinone-10 in the Japanese diet', J Food Compos Anal 2008;21(3):199-210, DOI 10.1016/j.jfca.2007.10.003), so ubiquinol is not an exclusively supplemental form.补剂的生物利用度低且高度依赖剂型，这是诚实的结论。还原型泛醇和增溶剂型达到的血药浓度高于普通结晶泛醌，所有形式的吸收都依赖膳食脂肪和胆汁。在食物基质中，辅酶 Q10 位于线粒体膜内并与脂肪同时摄入，每毫克的吸收大概不亚于甚至优于干粉胶囊，问题在于毫克总量小了 10 到 80 倍：表中最富的单份是 28.2 mg，对照 300 mg 剂量。还原型与氧化型的比例在不同食物间也不同：一项针对 70 种日本食品的调查发现，猪肩肉、牛肝、鸡心、竹荚鱼、小鰤鱼和大豆油中泛醇-10 高于 20 µg/g（Kubo H, Fujii K, Kawabe T, Matsumoto S, Kishida H, Hosoe K, 'Food content of ubiquinol-10 and ubiquinone-10 in the Japanese diet', J Food Compos Anal 2008;21(3):199-210, DOI 10.1016/j.jfca.2007.10.003），可见泛醇并非补剂独有的形式。

Data note数据说明 Eight of the Pravst table values were confirmed, along with the habitual intake figures and every per-portion conversion built on them, but the confirmation came from a reproduction of the table rather than the paywalled original. The two richest rows are weaker: pork heart's provenance was not pinned to a specific primary reference, and chicken heart comes from a secondary compilation after the submission's figure turned out to belong to chicken liver. The USDA FDC IDs are unconfirmed中。Pravst 表中的八个数值，以及习惯摄入量数据和基于它们的每份换算，全部得到确认，但确认依据是该表的复制版而非付费墙后的原文。最富的两条条目较弱：猪心的出处未能锁定到具体原始文献，鸡心来自二次汇编，起因是原提交稿的数字其实属于鸡肝。USDA FDC ID 未经确认。

CONSIDERAlpha-lipoic acid硫辛酸Grade B证据 B 级
Dose tested已验证剂量600 mg/d orally. The strong evidence is for the intravenous route at the same dose, which consumers cannot access.口服 600 毫克/天。强证据来自同剂量的静脉给药，而消费者无法使用这一途径。
Who it is for适用人群People with symptomatic diabetic distal symmetric polyneuropathy, specifically positive sensory symptoms such as burning and paraesthesia.有症状的糖尿病远端对称性多发性神经病患者，特别是有烧灼感、感觉异常等阳性感觉症状者。

Pros优点

  • Licensed as a drug for diabetic polyneuropathy in Germany, which is a higher bar than any supplement in this document clears.在德国作为糖尿病多发性神经病的药物获批，这个门槛高于本文中任何一款补充剂。
  • The intravenous meta-analysis (4 trials, 1,258 patients) found consistent relief of positive neuropathic symptoms.静脉给药的 meta 分析（4 项试验、1258 名患者）发现对阳性神经病理性症状有一致的缓解。
  • Secondary endpoints in the long oral trial did improve, including neuropathy impairment scores.长期口服试验的次要终点确有改善，包括神经病变损害评分。

Cons缺点

  • The definitive oral trial failed. NATHAN 1 randomised 460 patients to 600 mg/d for 4 years and missed its primary endpoint (P=0.105).决定性的口服试验失败了。NATHAN 1 把 460 名患者随机到 600 毫克/天，持续 4 年，未达主要终点（P=0.105）。
  • Serious adverse events in that trial were 38.1% on alpha-lipoic acid versus 28.0% on placebo, an excess that is rarely mentioned in marketing.该试验中严重不良事件在硫辛酸组为 38.1%，安慰剂组为 28.0%，这个超出的部分在营销中几乎从不被提及。
  • It is a leading trigger of insulin autoimmune syndrome (Hirata disease) in people carrying HLA-DRB1*04 alleles, producing anti-insulin antibodies and severe hypoglycaemia in non-diabetics. Almost nobody knows their HLA status.在携带 HLA-DRB1*04 等位基因的人中，它是胰岛素自身免疫综合征（平田病）的主要诱因之一，可产生抗胰岛素抗体并在非糖尿病者中引起严重低血糖。几乎没有人知道自己的 HLA 型别。
  • No upper limit has been set by any authority.没有任何权威机构为其设定上限。

Food sources食物来源

Trace amounts only仅有痕量 Dose NOT reachable by eating靠吃达不到剂量 Data confidence: Low数据可信度：低

TRACE was challenged and upheld, and the qualitative point matters more than the numbers: alpha-lipoic acid exists in food only as lipoyllysine, covalently attached to lysine residues in the E2 subunits of mitochondrial keto-acid dehydrogenases. Free racemic ALA, which is what a capsule contains, does not occur in food at all. The measured food quantities are in the range 0.003 to 0.40 mg per 100 g, four to five orders of magnitude below a 600 mg capsule. Supplemental ALA is chemically synthesised, so the supplement is best read as a synthetic compound with a bound, chemically different trace analogue in food.TRACE（痕量）曾被质疑，经复核维持，而且定性的一点比数字更要紧：α-硫辛酸在食物中只以硫辛酰赖氨酸的形式存在，共价连接在线粒体酮酸脱氢酶 E2 亚基的赖氨酸残基上。胶囊里装的游离消旋 ALA，在食物中完全不存在。实测的食物含量在每 100 g 0.003 到 0.40 mg 之间，比 600 mg 胶囊低四到五个数量级。补充用 ALA 为化学合成，因此这种补剂可以读作一种合成化合物，食物里对应的只是结合态、化学性质不同的痕量类似物。

Rows tagged unconfirmed carry a figure the verification pass could not trace back to its cited source. The number is reported as found; hover the tag for the reason.标记为未核实的行，其数值在核查环节无法追溯到所引来源。数字按原样列出；把鼠标移到标记上可看具体原因。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 Using the confirmed plant figures, a 600 mg dose is about 2,143 kg of raw spinach a day, roughly 71,000 cups, and broccoli is similar. Using the richest meat value (turkey heart at 0.40 mg/100 g) it is 150 kg of heart a day, though that meat figure is itself unconfirmed. The arithmetic understates the problem. What food contains is lipoyllysine, lipoic acid amide-bonded to protein-bound lysine, and human lipoamidase activity releases very little free lipoic acid from that bond, so the free-ALA yield from eating spinach is close to unmeasurable rather than merely small. A 600 mg fasting capsule produces micromolar plasma peaks of free racemic lipoic acid; no quantity of food produces a detectable free-ALA peak at all. This is the clearest food-supplement discontinuity in the group.按已确认的植物数值，600 mg 剂量约合每天 2,143 kg 生菠菜，大约 71,000 杯，西兰花的量级相仿。按最富的肉类值（火鸡心 0.40 mg/100 g）是每天 150 kg 心脏，而这个肉类数值本身未经确认。这些算术还低估了问题。食物里含的是硫辛酰赖氨酸，硫辛酸以酰胺键连在蛋白结合的赖氨酸上，人体硫辛酰胺酶从这种键上释放出的游离硫辛酸极少，所以吃菠菜得到的游离 ALA 接近无法测出。600 mg 空腹胶囊能产生微摩尔级的游离消旋硫辛酸血药峰值；任何数量的食物都产生不出可检测的游离 ALA 峰。这是本组中食物与补剂断裂得最彻底的一条。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Large, and it cuts against the supplement. Supplemental ALA is chemically synthesised as a 50:50 racemate of R- and S-lipoic acid, while nature makes only the R enantiomer and only protein-bound, so the capsule contains a molecule (S-lipoic acid) that does not exist in food. Absorption differs by design as well: capsules are dosed fasting because food reduces ALA absorption by roughly 20-30%, whereas the trace food form is unavoidably eaten with food. On safety, the whole food is unremarkable and the concentrated free acid is not. High-dose free ALA has been linked to insulin autoimmune syndrome with severe hypoglycaemia in genetically susceptible people, and there is a paediatric accidental-overdose literature with seizures and death. Spinach has done none of that. If you want the antioxidant-vegetable benefit, eat the vegetables; if you want the 600 mg neuropathy dose from the ALADIN and SYDNEY trials, understand that it is a synthetic drug-dose racemate with its own risk profile.很大，而且不利于补剂。补充用 ALA 化学合成为 R- 与 S- 硫辛酸各占 50:50 的消旋体，自然界只造 R 型，且只以蛋白结合态存在，所以胶囊里含有一种食物中根本不存在的分子（S- 硫辛酸）。吸收方式也是设计上的差别：胶囊要求空腹服用，因为食物会把 ALA 吸收降低大约 20-30%，而食物中的痕量形式不可避免地是随餐吃下去的。安全性上，整体食物平平无奇，浓缩的游离酸则不然。高剂量游离 ALA 在遗传易感人群中与胰岛素自身免疫综合征和严重低血糖有关联，还有儿童意外过量导致惊厥和死亡的文献。菠菜从没造成过这些。想要抗氧化蔬菜的益处，就吃蔬菜；想要 ALADIN 和 SYDNEY 试验里 600 mg 的神经病变剂量，就要明白那是一种合成的药物剂量消旋体，带着自身的风险特征。

Absorption吸收 Free supplemental ALA is absorbed reasonably well but cleared very fast, with a plasma half-life on the order of half an hour, and the R enantiomer reaches higher plasma levels than S. Food lipoyllysine is a different question: it is not a bioavailable source of free lipoic acid, because the lipoyl group stays bound to the enzyme protein and is largely digested along with it rather than released as the free dithiol. The measurement literature reflects this, noting that free lipoic acid in tissues is low if present at all and that essentially all of it is protein-bound. Spinach carries the usual oxalate caveat for other purposes, but oxalate is not why spinach fails as a lipoic acid source; it fails because there is almost none there and what is there is chemically locked up.游离的补充用 ALA 吸收尚可，清除极快，血浆半衰期约半小时，R 型达到的血药水平高于 S 型。食物中的硫辛酰赖氨酸是另一回事：它不构成游离硫辛酸的可利用来源，硫辛酰基仍然结合在酶蛋白上，多半随蛋白一起被消化，不会以游离二硫醇形式释放。测定文献也印证这点，指出组织中的游离硫辛酸即便存在也很低，几乎全部为蛋白结合态。菠菜在别的方面有草酸的常见告诫，但它作为硫辛酸来源之所以不行，原因是里面几乎没有，而且有的那点在化学上被锁住了，与草酸无关。

Data note数据说明 The three richest rows, which set the top of the ranking and the headline dose gap, come from a paper whose per-tissue table sits behind the ACS paywall and could not be traced past a method-validation abstract. They are also contradicted on rank order by the Lodge dataset, which puts kidney above heart. Only the Lodge plant values (spinach 3.15 and broccoli 0.94 ug/g dry weight) and their dry-to-fresh conversions were independently confirmed, and the tomato value was not. The qualitative conclusion is unaffected, since every candidate figure is four to five orders of magnitude below a 600 mg dose低。设定排序顶端和头条剂量差距的三条最富条目来自一篇论文，其分组织数据表在 ACS 付费墙之后，除方法验证摘要之外无法追溯。它们的排序还与 Lodge 数据集相矛盾，后者把肾排在心脏之上。只有 Lodge 的植物数值（菠菜 3.15、西兰花 0.94 µg/g 干重）及其干重到鲜重的换算得到独立确认，番茄值未获确认。定性结论不受影响，因为所有候选数字都比 600 mg 剂量低四到五个数量级。

CONSIDERBeta-alanineβ-丙氨酸Grade C证据 C 级
Dose tested已验证剂量4-6 g/d for at least 2-4 weeks, split into doses of about 1.6 g to limit paraesthesia. Total accumulated dose matters more than daily dose.4 至 6 克/天，至少持续 2 至 4 周，分成每次约 1.6 克以减少刺痛感。累积总量比每日剂量更重要。
Who it is for适用人群Athletes whose limiting factor is acidosis in the one to four minute window: middle distance, rowing, combat sports, high-repetition lifting.限制因素是 1 至 4 分钟区间酸中毒的运动员：中距离项目、赛艇、格斗类、高次数举重。

Pros优点

  • The mechanism is sound and confirmed: it raises intramuscular carnosine, which buffers protons.机制清楚且已被证实：它提高肌内肌肽含量，从而缓冲质子。
  • The IOC consensus statement places buffering agents on its short list of supplements with robust performance evidence.国际奥委会共识声明把缓冲类物质列入其“具备可靠成绩证据”的短名单。
  • Cheap, and paraesthesia aside, no established contraindication or drug interaction exists.便宜，而且除刺痛感外，没有已确立的禁忌或药物相互作用。

Cons缺点

  • The overall pooled effect is SMD 0.18 (0.08-0.28) across 40 studies and 1,461 people. Statistically significant and practically tiny.40 项研究、1461 人的总体合并效应是 SMD 0.18（0.08-0.28）。统计学显著，实际微乎其微。
  • In the 0.5 to 10 minute window where it should work best, exercise CAPACITY improved (SMD 0.50) but exercise PERFORMANCE did not (SMD 0.11, 95% CI -0.20 to 0.42, non-significant). Capacity is a laboratory measure; performance is what a race is.在本该最有效的 0.5 至 10 分钟区间，运动能力有改善（SMD 0.50），但运动成绩没有（SMD 0.11，95% CI -0.20 至 0.42，不显著）。能力是实验室指标，成绩才是比赛。
  • The meta-analysis is routinely quoted for the flattering subgroup and never for the null one.meta 分析被反复引用其好看的亚组，而从不引用阴性的那个。
  • No long-term safety data beyond a few months, and no upper limit set by any authority.没有超过数月的长期安全数据，也没有任何权威机构设定上限。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose NOT reachable by eating靠吃达不到剂量 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

Free beta-alanine, the molecule in the tub, is manufactured and no food supplies it in that form, which is a question about form rather than about dietary presence. What food supplies is beta-alanine bound into the histidine dipeptides carnosine and anserine, hydrolysed after ingestion, at hundreds of milligrams of beta-alanine equivalent per 100 g of white muscle: 346 mg/100 g in commercial broiler breast and 767 mg/100 g in the native Korean strain measured in the same study. Per portion that is 589 mg and 1,304 mg, 18% and 41% of a 3.2 g daily dose, at or above the per-portion contribution creatine makes, and isomolar oral L-carnosine raised muscle carnosine as much as free beta-alanine did (65.8% versus 64.2%), so the dietary route is biologically real. The earlier TRACE label was wrong by the dataset's own yardstick; poultry dark meat is the weak part of the picture, at 19.51-36.19 mg carnosine per 100 g.罐子里的游离 β-丙氨酸是工业合成的，没有任何食物以这种形式提供它，这属于形式问题，与膳食中是否存在无关。食物提供的是结合在组氨酸二肽（肌肽和鹅肌肽）中的 β-丙氨酸，摄入后水解释放，白肌每 100 g 可达数百毫克 β-丙氨酸当量：同一项研究中，商业肉鸡胸肉为 346 mg/100 g，韩国本土品系为 767 mg/100 g。折成每份分别是 589 mg 和 1,304 mg，相当于 3.2 g 每日剂量的 18% 和 41%，达到或超过肌酸的每份贡献；等摩尔口服 L-肌肽提升肌肉肌肽的幅度与游离 β-丙氨酸相当（65.8% 对 64.2%），所以膳食途径在生物学上是成立的。按本数据集自己的标准，此前的 TRACE（微量）标签给错了；这幅图景中薄弱的部分是禽类红肉，肌肽只有 19.51-36.19 mg/100 g。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 Carnosine is 39.4% beta-alanine by mass (89.09/226.23) and anserine 37.1% (89.09/240.26). The lowest dose shown to work is 3.2 g/day for 4 weeks, which raised muscle carnosine 42.1%. From commercial broiler breast at 346 mg beta-alanine equivalent per 100 g, counting both dipeptides, that is 923 g of raw chicken breast every day for the whole loading month, roughly 210 g of protein from one food; counting carnosine alone it is 3.15 kg/day. The carnosine-dense native strain at 767 mg/100 g cuts the requirement to 417 g/day, a large but conceivable portion, except that the breed is not what a supermarket sells. Beef takes 3.8 kg of raw steak per day and chicken thigh over 20 kg. No food delivers free beta-alanine at all.肌肽按质量含 39.4% 的 β-丙氨酸（89.09/226.23），鹅肌肽含 37.1%（89.09/240.26）。已证实有效的最低剂量是 3.2 g/天、持续 4 周，可使肌肉肌肽提升 42.1%。以商业肉鸡胸肉每 100 g 含 346 mg β-丙氨酸当量（两种二肽合计）计算，整个装载月里每天要吃 923 g 生鸡胸，单一食物就带来约 210 g 蛋白质；若只计肌肽，则是 3.15 kg/天。肌肽含量高的本土品系为 767 mg/100 g，需求量降到 417 g/天，份量虽大但可以想象，问题是超市并不卖这个品种。牛肉需要每天 3.8 kg 生牛排，鸡腿肉超过 20 kg。没有任何食物提供游离 β-丙氨酸。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 MAJOR, and it cuts both ways. Ingested carnosine does not reach muscle intact: after histidine dipeptides were given in chicken broth at 40 mg/kg beta-alanine equivalent, carnosine was undetectable in plasma while plasma beta-alanine peaked at 428 uM, because serum carnosinase hydrolyses the dipeptide. So the food form works by liberating beta-alanine, and it does so at roughly half the peak concentration of an equal weight of free beta-alanine (833 uM at the same 40 mg/kg dose). Isomolar oral L-carnosine nonetheless raised muscle carnosine as much as 6.4 g/day of beta-alanine (65.8% versus 64.2%), so the dipeptide route is biologically equivalent and only the volume of food is impossible (Harris RC et al., Amino Acids 2006;30(3):279-89, PMID 16554972, DOI 10.1007/s00726-006-0299-9, every figure confirmed). Two further points: cooking significantly reduces meat carnosine, measured in lamb longissimus and semimembranosus after 90 min at 70 C (Purchas RW et al., Meat Sci 2004;66(3):629-37, PMID 22060873), and the paraesthesia that makes people split beta-alanine doses is a property of a large free-amino-acid bolus that food never produces.重大，而且是双向的。摄入的肌肽不会完整到达肌肉：以鸡汤形式给予组氨酸二肽、剂量相当于 40 mg/kg β-丙氨酸当量后，血浆中检测不到肌肽，血浆 β-丙氨酸峰值为 428 uM，原因是血清肌肽酶会水解该二肽。所以食物形式是通过释放 β-丙氨酸起作用，峰值浓度约为同等重量游离 β-丙氨酸的一半（同样 40 mg/kg 剂量下为 833 uM）。即便如此，等摩尔口服 L-肌肽提升肌肉肌肽的幅度与 6.4 g/天 β-丙氨酸相当（65.8% 对 64.2%），可见二肽途径在生物学上等效，无法实现的只是食物的体积（Harris RC et al., Amino Acids 2006;30(3):279-89, PMID 16554972, DOI 10.1007/s00726-006-0299-9，每一个数字都已核实）。另有两点：烹饪会显著降低肉中的肌肽，该结果测自羔羊背最长肌和半膜肌在 70 C 加热 90 min 之后（Purchas RW et al., Meat Sci 2004;66(3):629-37, PMID 22060873）；而促使人们把 β-丙氨酸分次服用的皮肤刺痛感，来自大剂量游离氨基酸的一次性冲击，食物从不会产生这种情况。

Absorption吸收 Quantified head to head. At 40 mg/kg body weight, plasma beta-alanine peaked at 833 uM from free beta-alanine and at 428 uM from an equivalent load of histidine dipeptides in chicken broth, with both returning to baseline by 2 h and urinary loss of beta-alanine under 5% (PMID 16554972). Muscle carnosine responses after 4 weeks: 42.1% at 3.2 g/day, 64.2% at 6.4 g/day, and 65.8% for isomolar L-carnosine. The food matrix costs about half the peak plasma concentration per gram and does not block the pathway; the binding constraint is that meat holds only 0.08-0.77% beta-alanine equivalent by weight. Content varies severalfold with muscle type and breed: carnosine across 21 beef muscles ranged 0.012-18.508 umol/g wet tissue, that is 0.27-418.7 mg/100 g (PMID 30811817), and glycolytic white muscle holds far more than red oxidative muscle, so 'chicken' is not one number.有直接的头对头定量数据。按体重 40 mg/kg 给药，游离 β-丙氨酸使血浆 β-丙氨酸峰值达 833 uM，鸡汤中等量组氨酸二肽为 428 uM，两者均在 2 h 内回到基线，β-丙氨酸的尿中损失低于 5%（PMID 16554972）。4 周后肌肉肌肽的反应：3.2 g/天为 42.1%，6.4 g/天为 64.2%，等摩尔 L-肌肽为 65.8%。食物基质的代价是每克损失约一半的血浆峰值浓度，通路本身没有被阻断；真正的约束是肉类按重量只含 0.08-0.77% 的 β-丙氨酸当量。含量随肌肉类型和品种相差数倍：21 块牛肌肉的肌肽为 0.012-18.508 umol/g 湿组织，即 0.27-418.7 mg/100 g（PMID 30811817），糖解型白肌远高于氧化型红肌，所以“鸡肉”并不对应单一数值。

Data note数据说明 for the values shown. Every dipeptide figure was checked against the full texts of Ali 2019, Khumpeerawat 2021, Mashima 2019 and Barido 2022, the 39.4%/37.1% mass fractions and the 346 mg conversion were re-derived, and all of Harris 2006 was confirmed figure for figure. One caveat on coverage rather than accuracy: pork loin, turkey breast, tuna and other pelagic fish and rabbit were never checked, so the claim that chicken breast is the richest ordinary source is untested所列数值为高。每个二肽数字都对照 Ali 2019、Khumpeerawat 2021、Mashima 2019 和 Barido 2022 的全文核对过，39.4%/37.1% 的质量分数和 346 mg 的换算重新推导，Harris 2006 的全部数字逐一确认。有一点属于覆盖面而非准确性的问题：猪里脊、火鸡胸、金枪鱼和其他中上层鱼类以及兔肉从未核查，所以“鸡胸肉是最丰富的普通食物来源”这一说法尚未验证。

References:文献： Saunders PMID 27797728; Trexler ISSN PMID 26175657; IOC PMID 29540367
CONSIDERDietary nitrate / beetroot膳食硝酸盐 / 甜菜根Grade C证据 C 级
Dose tested已验证剂量At least 6 mmol/d (372 mg) of nitrate, taken for more than 3 days, 2-3 hours before exercise. Read the label in mmol, not millilitres.硝酸盐至少 6 mmol/天（372 毫克），连续服用 3 天以上，运动前 2 至 3 小时。看标签要看 mmol，不是毫升。
Who it is for适用人群Recreationally active people rather than elite athletes, and separately anyone using it for blood pressure.休闲运动者而非精英运动员，此外还有把它用于降血压的人。

Pros优点

  • Time to exhaustion improves (SMD 0.33), as do total distance (0.42), muscular endurance (0.48) and peak power (0.25), across 180 primary studies and 2,672 participants.180 项原始研究、2672 名受试者的数据显示，力竭时间改善（SMD 0.33），总距离（0.42）、肌耐力（0.48）和峰值功率（0.25）同样改善。
  • The blood pressure effect is more consistent than the performance effect: systolic -3.55 mmHg (-4.55 to -2.54) across 22 controlled trials.降血压效应比成绩效应更一致：22 项对照试验中收缩压降低 3.55 mmHg（-4.55 至 -2.54）。
  • Non-athletes and recreationally active people benefit most, which is unusual and makes it accessible.非运动员和休闲运动者获益最大，这一点不寻常，也让它更适合普通人。

Cons缺点

  • Time trial performance, the one outcome that maps onto racing, is NULL. So is VO2max. The umbrella review is blunt about this.计时赛成绩，也就是唯一能对应到比赛的指标，是阴性的。最大摄氧量也是。伞式综述对此直言不讳。
  • Antibacterial mouthwash abolishes the effect entirely, because the pathway depends on commensal bacteria on the tongue.抗菌漱口水会完全消除这个效应，因为该通路依赖舌面上的共生细菌。
  • Ergogenic doses of 6-8 mmol exceed the EFSA and JECFA acceptable daily intake for nitrate of 3.7 mg/kg body weight per day in a single serving. That is a real regulatory tension, not a technicality.6 至 8 mmol 的增效剂量在单次服用中就超过了 EFSA 和 JECFA 对硝酸盐每日 3.7 毫克/公斤体重的可接受摄入量。这是实实在在的监管冲突，不是文字游戏。
  • Additive hypotension with organic nitrates such as glyceryl trinitrate and isosorbide mononitrate, and with PDE5 inhibitors such as sildenafil and tadalafil. Care with any antihypertensive.与硝酸甘油、单硝酸异山梨酯等有机硝酸酯，以及西地那非、他达拉非等 PDE5 抑制剂有叠加的降压作用。与任何降压药合用都需谨慎。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose reachable by eating靠吃可以达到剂量 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

Vegetables are the dietary source and several reach supplement-level concentrations. EFSA pooled 25,306 leafy vegetable samples: rocket had the highest median nitrate of any vegetable at 4,800 mg/kg, with rhubarb at 2,808, amaranth 2,660, lamb's lettuce 2,130, mixed lettuce 1,878, beet leaves 1,770, curled lettuce 1,628, oak-leaf lettuce 1,553, chard 1,510, Belgian endive 1,475, white radish 1,256, black radish 1,245, beetroot root 1,100 and cos lettuce 1,097, ahead of spinach at 785. This is the one entry on the list where a normal portion of a normal food matches the dose used in trials.蔬菜是膳食来源，其中几种达到了补充剂级别的浓度。EFSA 汇总了 25,306 份叶菜样品：芝麻菜的硝酸盐中位数在所有蔬菜中最高，为 4,800 mg/kg，其后是大黄 2,808、苋菜 2,660、野苣（lamb's lettuce）2,130、混合生菜 1,878、甜菜叶 1,770、皱叶生菜 1,628、橡叶生菜 1,553、瑞士甜菜 1,510、比利时菊苣 1,475、白萝卜 1,256、黑萝卜 1,245、甜菜根 1,100、罗马生菜 1,097，都高于菠菜的 785。这是全表唯一一项普通食物的普通份量就能对上试验剂量的成分。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 At 62 mg per mmol a 6 mmol target is 372 mg of nitrate. At EFSA median concentrations that is 78 g of rocket, 132 g of rhubarb, 140 g of amaranth or 175 g of lamb's lettuce, all portions a person would actually eat, or exactly 100 mL of concentrated beetroot shot, since 70 mL measured 4.2 mmol and 140 mL 8.4 mmol. Beetroot root itself takes 338 g, butterhead lettuce 188 g, iceberg 441 g, raw spinach 474 g and celery 537 g. Wylie's dose-response data put the useful target higher than 6 mmol: 4.2 mmol changed no exercise response, 8.4 mmol reduced steady-state oxygen uptake 1.7% and extended time to task failure 14%, and 16.8 mmol gave no further gain. An 8 mmol target is 496 mg of nitrate, which is about 103 g of rocket or 133 mL of concentrate.按每 mmol 折合 62 mg 计算，6 mmol 的目标是 372 mg 硝酸盐。按 EFSA 中位浓度，这相当于 78 g 芝麻菜、132 g 大黄、140 g 苋菜或 175 g 野苣，都是人真的会吃的份量；也正好等于 100 mL 浓缩甜菜根汁，因为实测 70 mL 为 4.2 mmol、140 mL 为 8.4 mmol。甜菜根本身需要 338 g，奶油生菜 188 g，冰山生菜 441 g，生菠菜 474 g，芹菜 537 g。Wylie 的剂量反应数据把有用的目标定在 6 mmol 以上：4.2 mmol 未改变任何运动反应，8.4 mmol 使稳态摄氧量下降 1.7%、力竭时间延长 14%，16.8 mmol 没有带来进一步收益。8 mmol 的目标是 496 mg 硝酸盐，约合 103 g 芝麻菜或 133 mL 浓缩汁。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 SUBSTANTIAL, mostly about dose uncertainty and a regulatory conflict. Vegetable nitrate varies enormously: rocket ran from 1,528 mg/kg at the 5th percentile to 7,340 at the 95th, and the highest single leafy sample EFSA saw was 19,925 mg/kg in an oak-leaf lettuce grown under cover in Norway. Beetroot's mean (1,379 mg/kg) is well above its median (1,100) because of a long tail, so a salad or a home-pressed juice cannot be dosed. The regulatory tension is concrete: EFSA calculated that eating more than 47 g of rocket at the median nitrate concentration would on its own exceed the acceptable daily intake for nitrate, and a rocket-heavy salad pattern pushed modelled intake to 330 mg/person/day. So the food route to 6 mmol means routinely exceeding the nitrate ADI, which EFSA judged acceptable in the context of overall vegetable benefits and which is still not nothing. Processing matters too: nitrate in red beet and kohlrabi was reduced by up to 50% by fermentation, and boiling leaches nitrate into the water, so pickled beetroot and boiled-and-drained spinach are weaker than the raw figures suggest. The pathway also depends on oral bacteria reducing nitrate to nitrite, so antibacterial mouthwash blunts the effect regardless of source. Spinach is the classic textbook nitrate answer and a mediocre one: its median is six times lower than rocket, and it is separately a bad iron recommendation because its oxalate binds the iron.相当可观，主要涉及剂量不确定性和一处监管冲突。蔬菜硝酸盐含量差异极大：芝麻菜从第 5 百分位的 1,528 mg/kg 到第 95 百分位的 7,340，EFSA 见过的单个叶菜最高值是挪威一份保护地栽培橡叶生菜的 19,925 mg/kg。甜菜根的均值（1,379 mg/kg）明显高于中位数（1,100），因为存在长尾，所以一份沙拉或自家榨的汁无法定量给药。监管上的张力很具体：EFSA 计算过，按中位硝酸盐浓度，单靠吃超过 47 g 芝麻菜就会超出硝酸盐的每日可接受摄入量，而以芝麻菜为主的沙拉模式把模型估计的摄入量推到 330 mg/人/天。所以，靠食物达到 6 mmol 就意味着经常性超过硝酸盐 ADI，EFSA 在蔬菜整体益处的背景下判定这可以接受，这件事本身仍然不容忽视。加工同样重要：红甜菜和苤蓝中的硝酸盐经发酵可减少多达 50%，水煮会把硝酸盐浸出到水里，所以醋渍甜菜根和煮后沥干的菠菜都弱于生品数值。该通路还依赖口腔细菌把硝酸盐还原为亚硝酸盐，因此抗菌漱口水会削弱效果，与来源无关。菠菜是教科书上经典的硝酸盐答案，实际表现平庸：它的中位数比芝麻菜低六倍，而且它作为补铁推荐同样不合适，因为其草酸会结合铁。

Absorption吸收 Nitrate from vegetables and from a juice concentrate behave the same because it is a small inorganic anion, absorbed essentially completely in the upper small intestine, then concentrated in saliva by the enterosalivary circulation and reduced to nitrite by oral bacteria before any nitric oxide is formed. Wylie's dose-response work showed plasma nitrite rising dose-dependently with peak change at 2-3 h after 4.2, 8.4 and 16.8 mmol, while the physiological response saturated: 8.4 and 16.8 mmol produced similar improvements, so more nitrate is not more effect. The practical differences are therefore in the food rather than the gut: concentration varies severalfold with species, season, greenhouse versus open-field growing and region (EFSA 2008), juice concentrates are standardised while salad is not, and cooking water discards nitrate. A whole-food route is entirely viable; it wants rocket, rhubarb or amaranth rather than beetroot to be efficient.来自蔬菜和来自浓缩果汁的硝酸盐表现相同，因为它是一个小的无机阴离子，在上段小肠几乎完全吸收，随后经肠涎循环在唾液中富集，由口腔细菌还原为亚硝酸盐，之后才生成一氧化氮。Wylie 的剂量反应研究显示，4.2、8.4 和 16.8 mmol 后血浆亚硝酸盐呈剂量依赖性升高，峰值变化出现在 2-3 h，而生理反应趋于饱和：8.4 与 16.8 mmol 带来的改善相近，硝酸盐加量并不等于效果加量。因此实际差别落在食物端，与肠道无关：浓度随物种、季节、温室或露地栽培以及地区相差数倍（EFSA 2008），浓缩汁经过标准化，沙拉没有，煮菜的水会把硝酸盐倒掉。整食路线完全可行；要做到高效，选芝麻菜、大黄或苋菜，甜菜根效率不高。

Data note数据说明 Roughly 25 EFSA statistics across Tables 7, 9 and 10 were queried against the document and matched exactly, as were five contextual claims verbatim and the whole Wylie dose-response set. All seven original per-portion conversions at 62 mg/mmol and all six whole-vegetable gram requirements were re-derived and held. The thirteen added vegetables come from the same EFSA tables as identified in the verification report; their medians were taken from that report and the individual table rows were not independently re-read here高。跨 Table 7、9、10 的约 25 项 EFSA 统计量已在原文档中查证并完全吻合，五条上下文陈述逐字核对，Wylie 的整套剂量反应数据同样确认。原有七项按 62 mg/mmol 的每份换算，以及六项整菜克数需求，全部重新推导并成立。新增的十三种蔬菜来自核查报告标明的同一批 EFSA 表格，其中位数取自该报告，本次未独立重读对应的表格行。

References:文献： Poon umbrella review PMID 40085422; Bahadoran PMID 29141968; Govoni PMID 18793740
CONSIDERSt John's wort圣约翰草Grade B证据 B 级
Dose tested已验证剂量900 mg/d of standardised extract, usually 300 mg three times daily. Trials ran 4-12 weeks.标准化提取物 900 毫克/天，通常 300 毫克每日三次。试验周期为 4 至 12 周。
Who it is for适用人群Adults with mild to moderate unipolar depression who take NO other medication whatsoever and no hormonal contraception.轻中度单相抑郁的成人，且完全不服用任何其他药物，也不使用激素类避孕。

Pros优点

  • It genuinely works for mild to moderate depression. Cochrane pooled 29 trials and 5,489 patients: response-rate ratio 1.28 (1.10-1.49) in the 9 larger trials.它对轻中度抑郁确实有效。Cochrane 汇总 29 项试验、5489 名患者：9 项较大试验中应答率比为 1.28（1.10-1.49）。
  • Side-effect burden is lower than standard antidepressants in the trials, which is the main reason patients seek it out.在试验中其副作用负担低于标准抗抑郁药，这是患者选择它的主要原因。
  • In the EU it is handled as a herbal medicinal product rather than a food supplement, so product quality is better controlled than for most botanicals.在欧盟它按草药药品而非食品补充剂管理，因此产品质量控制优于多数植物类产品。

Cons缺点

  • This has the most dangerous interaction profile in this entire document. Hyperforin is a potent pregnane X receptor ligand and therefore a strong inducer of CYP3A4, CYP2C9, CYP1A2 and P-glycoprotein.它是本文中相互作用最危险的一个。贯叶金丝桃素是强效孕烷 X 受体配体，因而是 CYP3A4、CYP2C9、CYP1A2 和 P-糖蛋白的强诱导剂。
  • Documented consequences: oral contraceptive failure with breakthrough bleeding and unintended pregnancy; loss of ciclosporin and tacrolimus levels leading to transplant rejection; antiretroviral failure with indinavir; reduced digoxin and warfarin effect; and serotonin syndrome when combined with SSRIs.已记录的后果包括：口服避孕药失效，出现突破性出血和意外妊娠；环孢素和他克莫司血药浓度下降导致移植排斥；与茚地那韦合用导致抗逆转录病毒治疗失败；地高辛和华法林效果减弱；与 SSRI 合用引发 5-羟色胺综合征。
  • The efficacy estimate is unstable. The response-rate ratio was 1.28 in the 9 larger trials but 1.87 in the 9 smaller ones, and there is a strong country-of-origin effect concentrated in German-speaking countries.有效性估计并不稳定。9 项较大试验中应答率比为 1.28，9 项较小试验中却是 1.87，而且存在集中于德语国家的明显来源国效应。
  • Photosensitivity, and it should be stopped before elective surgery.有光敏性，择期手术前应当停用。
  • Practically speaking this is suitable for almost nobody, because almost everyone is on something.实际上它几乎不适合任何人，因为几乎每个人都在吃点什么药。

Food sources食物来源

From a plant not eaten as food来自不作食物食用的植物 Dose NOT reachable by eating靠吃达不到剂量 Data confidence: Medium数据可信度：中

St John's wort is the dried flowering aerial parts of Hypericum perforatum, a European meadow plant with no culinary use anywhere. It is consumed only as a medicine: tea, tincture, oil macerate or standardised dry extract. The two constituents that define it, hypericin (a naphthodianthrone) and hyperforin (a prenylated phloroglucinol), are confined to Hypericum species and are absent from the food supply, so there is no food route at any dose. Pharmacopoeial and commercial standards specify 0.3% hypericin, and the well-studied extract WS 5570 is an 80% ethanolic extract at a drug-to-extract ratio of 3:1 to 7:1 containing 0.12-0.28% hypericin and 5-6% hyperforin. One point worth carrying across from the melatonin entry: Hypericum perforatum is itself among the richest melatonin-bearing botanicals on record at roughly 4,490 ng/g dry weight, which is a curiosity about the plant rather than a reason to eat it.圣约翰草是贯叶连翘（Hypericum perforatum）的干燥开花地上部分，这是一种欧洲草地植物，任何地方都没有烹饪用途。它只作为药物使用：茶、酊剂、油浸剂或标准化干提取物。定义它的两个成分，金丝桃素（hypericin，一种双蒽酮）和贯叶金丝桃素（hyperforin，一种异戊烯基间苯三酚类化合物），只存在于金丝桃属物种，食物供应链中没有，所以任何剂量下都不存在食物途径。药典和商业标准规定 0.3% 金丝桃素，研究充分的提取物 WS 5570 是 80% 乙醇提取物，药材与提取物比为 3:1 至 7:1，含 0.12-0.28% 金丝桃素和 5-6% 贯叶金丝桃素。有一点可以从褪黑素条目带过来：贯叶连翘本身是已记录含褪黑素最丰富的植物之一，约 4,490 ng/g 干重，这属于关于这种植物的趣闻，不构成吃它的理由。

No food rows: there is no ordinary food that supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有食物条目：没有任何普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 Standard antidepressant dosing is 300 mg of standardised extract three times daily, 900 mg/day, delivering roughly 1.1-2.5 mg of hypericin (900 mg x 0.12-0.28%) and 45-54 mg of hyperforin. At a 3:1 to 7:1 drug-to-extract ratio that corresponds to about 2.7-6.3 g of dried herb per day. There is no food equivalent to compute at any portion size, because hypericin and hyperforin do not occur in foods. This is a complete absence rather than a large multiplier.标准抗抑郁用量为标准化提取物 300 mg、每天三次，即 900 mg/天，提供约 1.1-2.5 mg 金丝桃素（900 mg x 0.12-0.28%）和 45-54 mg 贯叶金丝桃素。按 3:1 至 7:1 的药材提取物比，相当于每天约 2.7-6.3 g 干药材。任何份量都没有食物等效量可算，因为金丝桃素和贯叶金丝桃素不存在于食物中。这是完全的缺失，不是一个大倍数。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 The most consequential caveat in the whole set, and it runs opposite to the usual pattern: here the concentrated product is the dangerous one and there is no safe whole-food version to fall back on. Hyperforin is a potent activator of the pregnane X receptor and therefore a strong inducer of CYP3A4, CYP2C19 and P-glycoprotein. It lowers plasma levels of combined oral contraceptives (breakthrough bleeding and contraceptive failure are documented), ciclosporin and tacrolimus (with reported transplant rejection, including graft loss), warfarin, digoxin, HIV protease inhibitors and non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors, irinotecan and imatinib, and several anticonvulsants. Combined with SSRIs, SNRIs, triptans or tramadol it can precipitate serotonin syndrome. Hypericin causes dose-dependent photosensitisation. Preparation type changes the risk profile substantially: hyperforin is lipophilic and unstable, so a water infusion delivers far less of it than an ethanolic extract, and low-hyperforin extracts were developed specifically to reduce interactions. A tea, a tincture and a capsule labelled with the same herb weight are not interchangeable, and treating this plant as a gentle food-adjacent botanical is the central error.这是整组数据中后果最严重的一条警告，而且方向与常见情况相反：这里危险的是浓缩产品，也没有安全的全食物版本可以退守。贯叶金丝桃素是孕烷 X 受体的强效激动剂，因此是 CYP3A4、CYP2C19 和 P-糖蛋白的强诱导剂。它会降低复方口服避孕药（已有突破性出血和避孕失败的记录）、环孢素和他克莫司（有移植排斥报告，包括移植物失功）、华法林、地高辛、HIV 蛋白酶抑制剂和非核苷类逆转录酶抑制剂、伊立替康和伊马替尼，以及若干抗惊厥药的血药浓度。与 SSRI、SNRI、曲普坦类或曲马多合用时，可诱发血清素综合征。金丝桃素会引起剂量依赖性光敏反应。制备类型对风险谱影响很大：贯叶金丝桃素亲脂且不稳定，水浸提液提供的量远低于乙醇提取物，低贯叶金丝桃素提取物就是专为减少相互作用而开发的。标注同样药材克数的茶、酊剂和胶囊不能互换，而把这种植物当成温和、接近食物的植物制品，正是核心错误。

Absorption吸收 Hyperforin is well absorbed from oil-containing or ethanolic preparations, has a long elimination half-life on the order of nine hours and accumulates with three-times-daily dosing, which is why enzyme induction builds over one to two weeks and takes a similar period to wash out after stopping. Hypericin absorption is slow, low and variable, with a much longer half-life still. Both are lipophilic, so an aqueous tea extracts a small and inconsistent share, particularly of hyperforin, and hypericin is light-sensitive and degrades in poorly stored material. Since there is no food form, the practical absorption question is preparation rather than matrix, and the answer is that interaction risk tracks hyperforin exposure rather than the labelled hypericin percentage most products still advertise.贯叶金丝桃素在含油或乙醇制剂中吸收良好，消除半衰期约九小时，每天三次给药会累积，所以酶诱导在一到两周内逐步建立，停药后也需要相似时间才能消退。金丝桃素吸收缓慢、量低且波动大，半衰期更长得多。两者都亲脂，所以水煮的茶只提取出很小且不稳定的一部分，尤其是贯叶金丝桃素；金丝桃素对光敏感，在储存不当的材料中会降解。由于没有食物形式，实际的吸收问题是制备方式而非基质，答案是相互作用风险跟随贯叶金丝桃素暴露量，而不是跟随多数产品至今仍在宣传的金丝桃素百分比。

Data note数据说明 The NOT_FOOD classification was challenged and upheld, and the hyperforin dose (45-54 mg/day) and dried-herb equivalent (2.7-6.3 g/day) both recompute correctly. The hypericin figure had to be corrected by recomputation from the entry's own specification, and the only quantitative composition figure in the original entry carried no citation at all and has been withdrawn, so the entry now rests entirely on the extract specification rather than on any measured plant-material content中。NOT_FOOD 分类经质疑后维持，贯叶金丝桃素剂量（45-54 mg/天）和干药材等效量（2.7-6.3 g/天）重算均无误。金丝桃素数值需按本条目自身的规格重新计算才得到更正，而原条目中唯一的定量成分数据完全没有引文，已被撤回，所以本条目现在完全依赖提取物规格，不依赖任何实测的植物材料含量。

References:文献： Cochrane Linde PMID 18843608; Nicolussi PMID 31742659; Moore PNAS DOI 10.1073/pnas.130155097
CONSIDERLactase and pancreatic enzymes乳糖酶与胰酶Grade C证据 C 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Lactase 3,000-9,000 FCC units with the first bite of dairy. Pancrelipase is prescribed in lipase units per meal and titrated.乳糖酶：随第一口乳制品服 3000 至 9000 FCC 单位。胰酶按每餐脂肪酶单位处方，并逐步调整。
Who it is for适用人群Adults with hydrogen-breath-test-confirmed lactose maldigestion, and patients with objectively confirmed exocrine pancreatic insufficiency.经氢呼气试验确诊乳糖消化不良的成人，以及客观确诊外分泌胰腺功能不全的患者。

Pros优点

  • These are real enzymes replacing real deficiencies. Pancreatic enzyme replacement raises the coefficient of fat absorption from 63.1% to 83.7% in chronic pancreatitis, which is an objective physiological measurement rather than a symptom score.这是真正的酶在替代真正的缺乏。在慢性胰腺炎中，胰酶替代把脂肪吸收系数从 63.1% 提高到 83.7%，这是客观的生理测量，而不是症状评分。
  • Lactase lets people keep dairy in the diet rather than eliminating a whole food group.乳糖酶让人能继续吃乳制品，而不必整个食物类别都戒掉。
  • Pancrelipase is under-prescribed rather than over-sold, which is the opposite of the pattern in this document.胰酶是被开得太少而不是卖得太多，这与本文的普遍规律正好相反。

Cons缺点

  • Generic digestive enzyme complexes treat a condition that does not exist. There is no recognised syndrome of generalised enzyme insufficiency in healthy adults, and the pancreas has roughly 90% functional reserve before malabsorption appears.泛泛的“复合消化酶”治的是一个并不存在的病。健康成人不存在公认的“全面酶不足”综合征，而胰腺要损失约 90% 的功能才会出现吸收不良。
  • Using enzyme blends to self-treat undiagnosed persistent gut symptoms delays the diagnosis of coeliac disease, inflammatory bowel disease, pancreatic disease and colorectal cancer. That is the main harm.用复合酶自行处理未确诊的持续胃肠症状，会延误乳糜泻、炎症性肠病、胰腺疾病和结直肠癌的诊断。这才是主要危害。
  • Consumer enzyme products are dosed in non-comparable proprietary activity units by design, so cross-product comparison is impossible.消费级酶产品按互不可比的专有活性单位计量，这是设计如此，因此产品之间无法比较。
  • Pancrelipase is porcine-derived, which matters for observant Muslim and Jewish patients and for vegetarians, and cystic fibrosis patients must not exceed the weight-based ceiling because of fibrosing colonopathy risk.胰酶来源于猪，这对严格遵守教规的穆斯林和犹太患者以及素食者很重要；囊性纤维化患者不得超过按体重设定的上限，因为存在纤维化结肠病风险。

Food sources食物来源

No food source, manufactured无食物来源，人工合成 Dose NOT reachable by eating靠吃达不到剂量 Data confidence: Medium数据可信度：中

This item bundles two manufactured preparations with different answers, and the single SYNTHETIC code fits the products rather than the activities. Lactase: graded on the product it is SYNTHETIC, a microbial beta-galactosidase produced by fermentation of Aspergillus oryzae, A. niger or the yeast Kluyveromyces lactis and then purified, and the mammalian brush-border lactase it substitutes for is a membrane enzyme of the small intestinal epithelium present in no food; graded on the enzyme activity it is TRACE, because live yoghurt and kefir cultures carry microbial beta-galactosidase into the gut, which is why lactase-non-persistent people tolerate fermented dairy better than milk. Pancreatic enzyme replacement: NOT_FOOD. Pancreatin and pancrelipase are extracts of porcine pancreas glands, and the source review states that the preparations with demonstrated efficacy are porcine-derived (de la Iglesia et al., eClinicalMedicine 2026;94:103880, PMID 42011215). The nearest food is pancreas eaten as offal (sweetbread), which is not a realistic route.本条把两种人工制备的产品打包在一起，而它们的答案不同，单一的 SYNTHETIC 代码适用于产品，不适用于酶活性。乳糖酶：按产品评级为 SYNTHETIC，它是由 Aspergillus oryzae、A. niger 或酵母 Kluyveromyces lactis 发酵生产并纯化的微生物 β-半乳糖苷酶，而它所替代的哺乳动物刷状缘乳糖酶是小肠上皮的膜酶，任何食物中都不存在；按酶活性评级则为 TRACE，因为活性酸奶和开菲尔的菌种会把微生物 β-半乳糖苷酶带入肠道，这也是乳糖酶非持续型人群对发酵乳制品的耐受优于牛奶的原因。胰酶替代治疗：NOT_FOOD。胰酶（pancreatin）和胰脂肪酶制剂（pancrelipase）是猪胰腺的提取物，原综述指出，已证实有效的制剂均为猪源（de la Iglesia et al., eClinicalMedicine 2026;94:103880, PMID 42011215）。最接近的食物是作为内脏食用的胰腺（sweetbread），这不是现实可行的途径。

No food rows: there is no ordinary food that supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有食物条目：没有任何普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 Pancreatic enzymes: absolute. Recommended dosing is a minimum of 40,000-50,000 units of lipase with main meals and 20,000-25,000 with snacks, taken with every meal for life (PMID 42011215). No food supplies active lipase in those quantities. Raw pancreas is the only tissue that contains the enzymes at all, it is not eaten raw in any normal diet, cooking denatures them, the delivered activity would be unmeasurable and uncontrolled, and without enteric protection gastric acid would destroy most of what survived. Lactase: there is one genuine partial route, since live yoghurt and kefir carry microbial beta-galactosidase into the gut, but that only handles the lactose in the fermented product itself and does not give a dose-adjustable enzyme to take with an arbitrary lactose-containing meal, which is the point of a lactase capsule. No peer-reviewed per-100 g beta-galactosidase activity figure for retail yoghurt was retrieved here, so no number is given; that is a sourcing gap in this dataset rather than an absence in the literature.胰酶：差距是绝对的。推荐剂量为主餐至少 40,000-50,000 单位脂肪酶，加餐 20,000-25,000 单位，终身随每餐服用（PMID 42011215）。没有任何食物能提供这个量级的活性脂肪酶。生胰腺是唯一含有这些酶的组织，正常饮食中没有人生吃，加热会使其变性，实际送达的活性无法测量也无法控制，而且没有肠溶保护，胃酸会摧毁存活下来的大部分。乳糖酶：确实存在一条部分可行的途径，活性酸奶和开菲尔会把微生物 β-半乳糖苷酶带入肠道，但那只能处理发酵产品自身所含的乳糖，无法提供一种可按剂量调整、随任意含乳糖餐食服用的酶，而后者正是乳糖酶胶囊的用途。此处没有检索到零售酸奶每 100 g β-半乳糖苷酶活性的同行评议数据，因此不给出数字；这是本数据集的取证缺口，并不代表文献中不存在。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 For pancreatin the caveats are pharmaceutical rather than dietary. Dose must be titrated to steatorrhoea, meal fat content and disease severity; the enzymes must be enteric-coated to survive gastric acid; the capsules are taken during the meal rather than before or after; and the porcine origin is a real issue for vegetarian, vegan, Muslim and Jewish patients and should be disclosed. Nothing sold as a plant-based or vegan pancreatic enzyme has demonstrated equivalence for pancreatic exocrine insufficiency, and treating a diagnosed insufficiency with a supermarket digestive enzyme blend risks continued fat malabsorption, weight loss and fat-soluble vitamin deficiency. For lactase the honest framing is that this is a targeted, cheap, low-risk aid rather than a nutrient: the alternative food strategy of hard cheese, live yoghurt and small lactose doses spread through the day works for many people, and lactase capsules matter mainly when the meal is unavoidable and the lactose dose is large.对胰酶来说，注意点属于药学范畴，与膳食无关。剂量必须按脂肪泻程度、餐食脂肪含量和病情严重度滴定；酶必须做肠溶包衣才能在胃酸中存活；胶囊要在进餐过程中服用，不在餐前或餐后；猪源对素食者、纯素者、穆斯林和犹太患者是真实问题，应当披露。以植物基或纯素胰酶名义出售的产品，没有一种在胰腺外分泌不足上证明了等效性；用超市卖的消化酶复配产品去治疗已确诊的胰腺外分泌不足，可能导致脂肪吸收不良持续、体重下降和脂溶性维生素缺乏。对乳糖酶，诚实的定位是一种针对性强、便宜、低风险的辅助手段，它不构成营养素。替代的饮食策略（硬质奶酪、活性酸奶，把少量乳糖分散到一天里）对很多人有效，乳糖酶胶囊主要用在无法回避且乳糖负荷较大的那一餐。

Absorption吸收 Both are enzymes, so bioavailability means surviving intact and active to the site of action rather than being absorbed. Lactase works in the lumen of the upper small intestine and is itself digested, so timing relative to the lactose load determines the effect. Pancreatic lipase is irreversibly denatured below about pH 4, which is why uncoated pancreatin is largely wasted, why the field has moved to pH-sensitive enteric microspheres, and why an emerging approach adds bicarbonate to raise local pH around the pancreatin. Coadministered acid suppression is sometimes needed to make the enzymes work at all. None of this can be replicated by eating anything.两者都是酶，因此生物利用度指的是完整且有活性地到达作用部位，与被吸收无关。乳糖酶在上段小肠腔内起作用，本身也会被消化，所以相对于乳糖负荷的服用时机决定效果。胰脂肪酶在约 pH 4 以下不可逆变性，这就是无包衣胰酶大部分被浪费的原因，也是这一领域转向 pH 敏感肠溶微球的原因，还是近年出现的在胰酶周围加碳酸氢盐以提高局部 pH 这一思路的原因。有时还需要同时使用抑酸药，酶才能起作用。这些都无法靠吃任何东西复现。

Data note数据说明 The PERT dosing figures and the porcine origin were confirmed against the cited review (PMID 42011215), and the manufacturing routes for microbial lactase are standard and uncontested. The lactase side is weaker: the fermented-dairy beta-galactosidase route is well established qualitatively but no per-100 g activity figure for retail yoghurt was retrieved, so the partial food route cannot be quantified or compared against a capsule dose中。PERT 剂量数据和猪源已对照所引综述确认（PMID 42011215），微生物乳糖酶的生产路线是标准且无争议的。乳糖酶一侧较弱：发酵乳制品的 β-半乳糖苷酶途径在定性上确立良好，但没有检索到零售酸奶的每 100 g 活性数据，因此这条部分可行的食物途径无法定量，也无法与胶囊剂量比较。

References:文献： de la Iglesia-Garcia PMID 27941156; Gan PMID 29212278; de Vrese PMID 25042846; Munasinghe PMID 20204691

6  Skip it六、不必买

No good evidence of benefit for the marketed claim. Where a genuine narrow signal exists it is listed under Pros, so you can see exactly how thin it is.对其宣传的功效没有像样的证据。若确实存在一点狭窄的信号，会列在“优点”里，让你看清它有多薄。

SKIPMultivitamin / multimineral复合维生素与矿物质Grade A证据 A 级
Dose tested已验证剂量One tablet daily. There is no established effective dose because there is no established clinical effect in replete adults.每日一片。不存在“有效剂量”，因为在营养充足的成人中不存在已确立的临床效应。
Who it is for适用人群Genuine deficiency or high-probability deficiency: post-bariatric, malabsorption, strict vegans, long-term metformin users, heavy alcohol use, the housebound.确有缺乏或高度可能缺乏的人：减重手术后、吸收不良、严格纯素、长期二甲双胍使用者、大量饮酒者、久不出门者。

Pros优点

  • For someone with a genuine deficiency it is a cheap way to cover several nutrients at once, and that is a real use.对确实存在缺乏的人来说，这是一次覆盖多种营养素的便宜办法，这个用途是真实的。
  • Doses are usually at reference-intake level, so a plain multivitamin rarely pushes any single nutrient near its upper limit on its own.其剂量通常在参考摄入量水平，所以单独吃一片普通复合维生素很少会把某一种营养素推到接近上限。
  • COSMOS-Web and COSMOS-Mind reported a memory signal, which is the only positive finding in this entry and is weak.COSMOS-Web 和 COSMOS-Mind 报告了记忆方面的信号，这是本条目里唯一的阳性发现，而且很弱。

Cons缺点

  • It does not prevent cardiovascular disease, cancer or death. Physicians Health Study II (n=14,641, 11.2 years): major cardiovascular events HR 1.01 (0.91-1.10).它不能预防心血管病、癌症或死亡。医师健康研究 II（n=14641，11.2 年）：主要心血管事件 HR 1.01（0.91-1.10）。
  • The largest dataset points the wrong way. Pooled US cohorts (n=390,124, up to 27 years, 164,762 deaths): daily multivitamin users had HIGHER all-cause mortality, HR 1.04 (1.02-1.07). This is observational and probably reflects sick people starting supplements, but it is not the direction the marketing implies.最大的数据集指向相反方向。美国多队列合并分析（n=390124，随访最长 27 年，164762 例死亡）：每日服用者全因死亡更高，HR 1.04（1.02-1.07）。这是观察性数据，很可能反映的是生病的人开始吃补充剂，但方向与营销暗示的相反。
  • The USPSTF gives it an I statement, meaning the evidence is insufficient to weigh benefits against harms. The industry reports this as vindication, which it is not.USPSTF 给它的是 I 级声明，意思是证据不足以权衡利弊。行业把这当成背书来引用，而它并不是。
  • The nutrient-gap argument has never converted into a clinical outcome in a healthy replete adult, and this is a roughly 8 billion US dollar per year category resting on it.“营养缺口”这个论点从未在健康且营养充足的成人中转化为临床结局，而一个每年约 80 亿美元的品类就建立在它之上。
  • Vitamin K content antagonises warfarin, so switching brands or starting and stopping the product shifts INR. Treat it as a dosing variable.其中的维生素 K 会拮抗华法林，因此换品牌或开始与停用都会改变 INR。要把它当作一个剂量变量。
  • Risk comes from stacking. A multivitamin plus a separate high-dose single nutrient is how people cross an upper limit without noticing.风险来自叠加。一片复合维生素再加一种单独的大剂量营养素，人们就是这样在不知不觉中越过上限的。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose partly reachable靠吃只能部分达到 Data confidence: Medium数据可信度：中

This is a product category rather than a molecule, and almost every nutrient inside it is abundant in ordinary food, which is why the US Preventive Services Task Force concluded in 2022 that the evidence is insufficient to recommend multivitamins for preventing cardiovascular disease or cancer, and recommended against beta-carotene and vitamin E supplements outright. The nutrients are food-abundant while the pill itself is manufactured: folic acid is not a natural food form, and cyanocobalamin occurs in food only in traces, so the accurate statement is that neither is the predominant natural form, and both are present in fortified foods, which this entry treats as a legitimate route for B12. Shortfalls that are real in populations are a short list: the 2020-2025 Dietary Guidelines for Americans name calcium, potassium, vitamin D and dietary fibre as nutrients of public health concern, with iron and folate added in pregnancy, and UK survey data adds magnesium, selenium and iron in younger women, though the specific NDNS below-LRNI percentages carried in the original submission (magnesium 9% of men and 13% of women, selenium 25.8% of males and 50.3% of females, iron about a quarter of younger women) could not be traced to a named survey round, age band or table and are indicative and unconfirmed here.这是一个产品类别，谈不上是单一分子，而其中几乎每一种营养素在普通食物里都很丰富，这也是美国预防服务工作组（USPSTF）在 2022 年得出结论的原因：证据不足以推荐用复合维生素预防心血管疾病或癌症，同时明确不推荐 β-胡萝卜素和维生素 E 补充剂。营养素本身在食物中很丰富，药片则是制造出来的：叶酸（folic acid）不是食物中的天然形式，氰钴胺在食物里只有痕量，因此准确的说法是这两者都不是占主导的天然形式，两者也都存在于强化食品中，本条把强化食品视为获取 B12 的正当途径。人群中真实存在的摄入不足只是一个短名单：2020-2025 年美国膳食指南把钙、钾、维生素 D 和膳食纤维列为公共健康关注营养素，孕期再加铁和叶酸；英国调查数据在年轻女性中补上镁、硒和铁。不过原稿携带的具体 NDNS 低于 LRNI 比例（镁为男性 9%、女性 13%，硒为男性 25.8%、女性 50.3%，铁约为四分之一的年轻女性）无法追溯到具体的调查轮次、年龄组或表格，在此仅作参考，未经确认。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 There is no single food equivalent of a multivitamin, because a multivitamin is not a nutrient: one tablet supplies roughly 100% of the reference intake for 20 or more nutrients at once, and the only thing matching that profile is a varied diet, which by definition already supplies them. So the answer has to be given per nutrient, and it splits. For most of the tablet (vitamin C, vitamin A, thiamine, riboflavin, niacin, B6, vitamin E, vitamin K, zinc, selenium, copper, iodine) the food gap for anyone eating a normal mixed diet is zero. Vitamin D is reachable but rarely reached: the original claim that UV-treated mushrooms are the only food to hit 15 ug in one portion is arithmetically false, because 3 oz of canned sockeye salmon gives 17.9 ug (119% of the 15 ug RDA), 3 oz of farmed rainbow trout 16.2 ug (108%), a USDA half-fillet (155 g) of cooked sockeye 25.9 ug (173%), and a teaspoon of cod liver oil 11.3 ug (75%), alongside a cup of UV portabella at 24.4 ug. Reaching 15 ug/day from food needs about 90 g of cooked sockeye every day, or 1.15 litres of fortified milk, or 14 large eggs; the UK 10 ug RNI needs about 60 g of oily fish daily or 770 ml of fortified milk. So the vitamin D case for supplementing is behavioural (few people at temperate latitudes eat oily fish daily through winter) rather than compositional, and it argues for vitamin D alone rather than a 25-ingredient tablet. Periconceptional folic acid is a genuine exception: 400 ug/day is food-achievable in bulk (about 220 g of cooked lentils daily) but the trial evidence for preventing neural tube defects is for supplemental folic acid, and food folate is both less bioavailable and more variable, so food substitution is not supported. B12 on a vegan diet is the second real exception, since there is no reliable unfortified plant source, so a supplement or fortified food is mandatory. Two mismatches run the other way: the potassium in a multivitamin is capped at about 99 mg against a 3,500 mg reference intake, and the calcium is typically 100-200 mg, so the tablet cannot address either of the shortfalls the guidelines name, and fibre, the fourth named shortfall, is absent from every tablet. Iodised salt, the global public-health iodine vehicle, belongs in this list as well; verification named it as a complete omission but supplied no composition figure, so no row is given for it.复合维生素没有单一食物的等价物，因为它本身并不是一种营养素：一片药同时提供 20 种以上营养素各约 100% 的参考摄入量，唯一符合这一构成的东西是多样化的膳食，而多样化膳食按定义已经在提供这些营养素。所以答案必须按营养素分别给出，结论也随之分开。药片里的大部分成分（维生素 C、维生素 A、硫胺素、核黄素、烟酸、B6、维生素 E、维生素 K、锌、硒、铜、碘），对任何吃正常混合膳食的人来说食物缺口为零。维生素 D 可以达到，却很少有人达到：原稿称经紫外线处理的蘑菇是唯一能在一份内达到 15 ug 的食物，这在算术上不成立，因为 3 oz 罐装红鲑给出 17.9 ug（15 ug RDA 的 119%），3 oz 养殖虹鳟 16.2 ug（108%），USDA 的半片（155 g）熟红鲑 25.9 ug（173%），一茶匙鱼肝油 11.3 ug（75%），此外一杯紫外线处理的褐菇为 24.4 ug。要从食物做到 15 ug/天，需要每天约 90 g 熟红鲑，或 1.15 litres 强化牛奶，或 14 个大鸡蛋；英国的 10 ug RNI 需要每天约 60 g 多脂鱼或 770 ml 强化牛奶。所以维生素 D 需要补充的理由在行为层面（温带纬度很少有人整个冬天每天吃多脂鱼），与食物成分无关，据此该补的是单独的维生素 D，一片含 25 种成分的药并无必要。孕前和孕早期的叶酸是真正的例外：400 ug/天 靠食物在数量上做得到（每天约 220 g 熟扁豆），但预防神经管缺陷的试验证据针对的是补充剂形式的叶酸，食物叶酸生物利用度更低且变化更大，因此用食物替代得不到支持。素食者的 B12 是第二个真正的例外，植物性食物中没有可靠的未强化来源，所以补充剂或强化食品是必需的。有两处不匹配方向相反：复合维生素中的钾被限制在约 99 mg，而参考摄入量是 3,500 mg；钙通常只有 100-200 mg，因此药片解决不了指南列出的这两项不足，而纤维这第四项不足在任何药片里都不存在。碘盐作为全球公共卫生的碘载体也属于这个名单；核查指出它被完全遗漏，但没有给出成分数值，因此这里不为它单列一行。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 This category contains the clearest documented case of a whole food being safe while the isolated concentrate is harmful. Carotenoid-rich vegetables are consistently associated with lower lung cancer risk, while beta-carotene as a supplement increased lung cancer incidence in smokers and asbestos-exposed workers in the ATBC and CARET trials, and the USPSTF now recommends against it with moderate certainty that harms exceed benefits. Vitamin E supplements carry the same recommendation against. Preformed vitamin A as retinol in a tablet counts toward the 3,000 ug/day upper limit and is teratogenic at high intake, while beta-carotene in carrots does not convert quickly enough to reach toxicity. Two food rows on this list carry the same warning as the tablet: beef liver at 9,442 ug RAE/100 g and cod liver oil are both concentrated retinol sources, so neither is a free lunch. Folic acid in a tablet can partially mask the haematological signs of B12 deficiency while neurological damage continues, an effect food folate has not been shown to produce. Stacking is the underappreciated risk: a multivitamin alongside fortified breakfast cereal and a fortified plant drink can push folic acid, retinol, niacin and iron past their upper limits in someone who believes they are taking one tablet. Within the tablet itself, iron competes with zinc and copper for shared transporters and calcium interferes with iron uptake, so a combined product delivers less of each than the label states. And no tablet carries the fibre, the food-level potassium, or the polyphenols that account for much of the association between diet quality and outcomes, which is the structural reason a pill is not a diet.这个类别里有最清楚的记录：完整食物是安全的，分离出来的浓缩物有害。富含类胡萝卜素的蔬菜一贯与更低的肺癌风险相关，而 β-胡萝卜素作为补充剂在 ATBC 和 CARET 试验中增加了吸烟者和石棉暴露工人的肺癌发生率，USPSTF 现在不推荐使用它，并以中等确定性认为危害超过获益。维生素 E 补充剂同样被列为不推荐。药片中以视黄醇形式存在的预成型维生素 A 计入 3,000 ug/天 的上限，高摄入时具有致畸性；胡萝卜里的 β-胡萝卜素转化速度不足以达到中毒水平。本清单里有两行食物带着与药片相同的警告：牛肝为 9,442 ug RAE/100 g，鱼肝油同样是浓缩的视黄醇来源，两者都不是免费的午餐。药片里的叶酸可以部分掩盖 B12 缺乏的血液学表现，而神经损伤仍在继续，食物叶酸尚未显示有这种效应。叠加是被低估的风险：复合维生素加上强化早餐谷物再加强化植物饮料，可以把叶酸、视黄醇、烟酸和铁推过各自的上限，而当事人以为自己只吃了一片药。在药片内部，铁与锌和铜竞争同一批转运体，钙干扰铁的吸收，所以复合产品实际提供的每种成分都少于标签值。另外没有任何药片带来纤维、食物水平的钾或多酚，而这些占了膳食质量与结局之间关联的很大一部分，这是药片顶不上膳食的结构性原因。

Absorption吸收 Form differences run in both directions, so blanket claims fail here. Iron: haem iron from meat and fish absorbs at roughly 15-35% and is largely insensitive to the rest of the meal, while non-haem iron from plants and from the ferrous salts in tablets ranges from about 2% to 20% depending on phytate, polyphenols, calcium and vitamin C eaten at the same time. Spinach iron sits at the bottom of that range because oxalate binds it, so the textbook answer is the wrong answer. Folate: folic acid from a supplement taken with food is roughly 85% bioavailable against about 50% for naturally occurring food folate, so here the synthetic form genuinely outperforms the food. Vitamin B12: food B12 is protein-bound and needs gastric acid and pepsin to release it, so older adults with atrophic gastritis and long-term proton pump inhibitor or metformin users often absorb crystalline B12 from a tablet better than B12 from a chop. Vitamin D: the D2 in UV-treated mushrooms raises and sustains serum 25(OH)D less efficiently than the D3 in oily fish and most supplements, so 24.4 ug from a cup of portabella is not equivalent to 24.4 ug from salmon, and the mushroom rows should not be read as interchangeable with the fish rows despite ranking near them. Vitamin K: the K1 in leafy greens is poorly released from the plant matrix and cleared fast, while the long-chain MK-7 in natto reaches higher and far longer-lasting serum concentrations, so a portion of natto and a portion of kale are not interchangeable despite sharing the label term. All four fat-soluble vitamins need fat in the same meal, which is why a multivitamin swallowed with black coffee delivers less than the panel claims.形式差异在两个方向上都存在，因此一刀切的说法在这里都不成立。铁：来自肉和鱼的血红素铁吸收率约 15-35%，且基本不受同餐其他成分影响；来自植物以及片剂中亚铁盐的非血红素铁则在约 2% 到 20% 之间，取决于同餐的植酸、多酚、钙和维生素 C。菠菜的铁处在这个区间的底部，因为草酸把它结合住了，所以教科书答案是错误答案。叶酸：随餐服用的补充剂叶酸生物利用度约 85%，天然食物叶酸约 50%，在这里合成形式确实更胜一筹。维生素 B12：食物中的 B12 与蛋白结合，需要胃酸和胃蛋白酶才能释放，因此患萎缩性胃炎的老年人以及长期使用质子泵抑制剂或二甲双胍者，往往从药片里的结晶 B12 吸收得比从一块肉里更好。维生素 D：紫外线处理蘑菇中的 D2 在提升和维持血清 25(OH)D 上不如多脂鱼和多数补充剂中的 D3 有效，所以一杯褐菇的 24.4 ug 不等于来自三文鱼的 24.4 ug，蘑菇那几行虽然排名相近，也不应读作能与鱼类互换。维生素 K：叶菜中的 K1 从植物基质中释放较差且清除很快，纳豆里的长链 MK-7 则达到更高、持续时间长得多的血清浓度，所以一份纳豆和一份羽衣甘蓝虽然共用同一个标签名称，也不能互换。四种脂溶性维生素都需要同餐有脂肪，这也是复合维生素配黑咖啡吞下去时实际提供量少于成分表所示的原因。

Data note数据说明 The composition data is HIGH quality: verification traced every cited FDC ID and CoFID code to the source datasets with exact matches on descriptions, per-100 g values and portion weights. Two things pull the item down. The UK NDNS below-LRNI percentages that motivate the whole shortfall argument are UNVERIFIABLE as cited, with no survey round, age band or table given, and figures quoted to one decimal place with no year attached are not checkable. The EFSA 600 ug/day iodine upper level is consistent with the standard SCF 2002 figure but its source text could not be extracted during verification. Several added rows also carry conventional rather than dataset portion weights (haddock, crab brown meat, salted mackerel, UV crimini, fortified fat spread), and each is flagged in place中。组成数据质量为高：核查把每个引用的 FDC ID 和 CoFID 代码都追溯到源数据集，描述、每 100 g 数值和分量重量精确吻合。有两点把本条拉低。支撑整个摄入不足论证的英国 NDNS 低于 LRNI 比例按引用方式无法核实，没有给出调查轮次、年龄组或表格，而写到小数点后一位却不带年份的数字是没法核对的。EFSA 的 600 ug/天 碘上限与通行的 SCF 2002 数字一致，但核查期间无法提取其原文。另有若干新增行采用惯例分量而非数据集分量（黑线鳕、蟹褐肉、盐渍鲭鱼、紫外线处理的褐色小蘑菇、强化涂抹油脂），每一处都已就地标注。

Who it is for适用人群Nobody, on the best available analysis.按目前最好的分析，没有适用人群。

Pros优点

  • There is a weak, moderate-certainty signal for knee osteoarthritis pain: SMD -0.58 (-0.98 to -0.18) across 4 trials and 507 patients. All included trials had high risk of bias.在膝骨关节炎疼痛上有一个弱的、中等确定性的信号：4 项试验、507 名患者，SMD -0.58（-0.98 至 -0.18）。所有纳入试验偏倚风险都高。
  • Safety is benign. The problem with collagen is efficacy, not harm.安全性良好。胶原的问题在于有效性，不在于危害。

Cons缺点

  • This is the cleanest documented case of funding bias in the supplement literature. Myung and Park pooled 23 trials and 1,474 participants. Headline: collagen improved skin hydration, elasticity and wrinkles. Subgroup analysis: studies WITHOUT pharmaceutical-company funding showed no effect on any of the three, and high-quality studies showed no effect. The effect exists only in industry-funded, lower-quality trials.这是补充剂文献中资助偏倚被记录得最干净的案例。Myung 与 Park 汇总 23 项试验、1474 名受试者。头条结论：胶原改善皮肤含水量、弹性和皱纹。亚组分析：没有药企资助的研究，这三项全都没有效应；高质量研究同样没有效应。效应只存在于行业资助的低质量试验里。
  • Collagen is a poor-quality protein. It lacks tryptophan and is a poor source of essential amino acids, so it displaces better protein in the diet.胶原是低质量蛋白。它不含色氨酸，必需氨基酸来源也差，因此会挤占饮食中更好的蛋白。
  • Marine collagen in fish allergy; bovine sourcing matters for religious dietary restriction and BSE-region concerns.鱼类过敏者注意海洋胶原；牛源对宗教饮食限制和疯牛病疫区来源问题也很要紧。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose reachable by eating靠吃可以达到剂量 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

RICH was challenged and upheld, and this is the one entry whose trial dose is genuinely reachable by eating, because the supplement is simply hydrolysed collagen and several ordinary foods are almost pure collagen. Gelatine is thermally hydrolysed collagen at 85.6 g protein per 100 g with tryptophan recorded as 0.000 g. Plain pork crackling is 61.3 g protein per 100 g with an unmistakable collagen amino-acid signature (glycine 11.9 g, proline 7.3 g per 100 g). Trial doses are 2.5 to 15 g/day over 3 to 18 months (Paul, Leser & Oesser 2019, confirmed). Chicken skin, beef tendon, chicken feet and tinned fish eaten with skin and soft bones all add collagen; chicken feet and cartilage now have published GAG and collagen assays, but none of those sources yields a per-100 g collagen figure I can quote here, so they are named without numbers. Bone broth is the popular food answer and the unreliable one.RICH（丰富）曾被质疑，经复核维持。这是唯一一条试验剂量真能靠吃达到的条目，因为这种补剂就是水解胶原蛋白，而好几种普通食物几乎是纯胶原。明胶是热水解的胶原蛋白，每 100 g 含 85.6 g 蛋白，色氨酸记录为 0.000 g。原味猪皮脆（pork crackling）每 100 g 含 61.3 g 蛋白，氨基酸特征明确指向胶原（每 100 g 甘氨酸 11.9 g、脯氨酸 7.3 g）。试验剂量为 2.5 到 15 g/天，持续 3 到 18 个月（Paul, Leser & Oesser 2019，已确认）。鸡皮、牛筋、鸡爪，以及连皮带软骨一起吃的鱼罐头都能增加胶原摄入；鸡爪和软骨现在有已发表的 GAG 和胶原测定，但这些来源都没有可在此引用的每 100 g 胶原数值，所以只列名不给数字。骨汤是流行的食物答案，也是最不可靠的那个。

Scale it to whatever ratio you actually use

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 There is essentially no gap. One 7 g sachet of ordinary supermarket gelatine delivers about 6.0 g of collagen protein, which is 60 per cent of a 10 g dose and 240 per cent of the 2.5 g low-end trial dose; two sachets sit squarely inside the 2.5 to 15 g/day range used in the research. A 28 g bag of plain pork crackling delivers about 15 g of collagen-type protein, matching the top-end trial dose at a fraction of the price of branded peptides. Bone broth is the one route that fails: amino acid content of broths made to a standardised recipe was significantly lower than a 20 g reference collagen dose for hydroxyproline, glycine and proline, and non-standardised preparations varied enormously, with commercially available broths lower than self-prepared ones (Alcock, Shaw & Burke 2019). If you want a defined collagen dose from food, weigh out gelatine rather than simmering bones.基本没有差距。一小袋 7 g 的普通超市明胶提供约 6.0 g 胶原蛋白，是 10 g 剂量的 60%，是 2.5 g 低端试验剂量的 240%；两袋就稳稳落在研究所用的 2.5 到 15 g/天 区间内。一袋 28 g 的原味猪皮脆提供约 15 g 胶原类蛋白，达到试验剂量上限，价格只是品牌肽的一小部分。骨汤是唯一失败的路线：按标准化配方制作的骨汤，其羟脯氨酸、甘氨酸和脯氨酸含量显著低于 20 g 的参比胶原剂量，非标准化做法之间差异极大，市售骨汤低于自制骨汤（Alcock, Shaw & Burke 2019）。想从食物里得到确定的胶原剂量，称明胶比熬骨头可靠。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Moderate, and worth stating precisely. Collagen contains no tryptophan at all (USDA records gelatine tryptophan as 0.000 g/100 g) and is low in cysteine, methionine and histidine, so it is an incomplete protein with a PDCAAS effectively at zero and must not be counted as general protein intake; modelling suggests up to about 36 per cent of total daily protein can be collagen before indispensable amino acid balance suffers (Paul et al. 2019, PMID 31096622, confirmed). Hydrolysis is a real difference: collagen peptides are enzymatically cut to 2-5 kDa fragments that dissolve in cold liquid and are absorbed partly as di- and tripeptides, whereas gelatine gels and must be dissolved hot, and native collagen in skin and tendon must first be cooked and digested. On the food side, pork crackling brings a large load of saturated fat and salt with its collagen, which a sachet of gelatine does not, so swapping crackling for collagen powder is a trade-off rather than a free win.中等，值得说准确。胶原完全不含色氨酸（USDA 记录明胶色氨酸为 0.000 g/100 g），半胱氨酸、甲硫氨酸和组氨酸也低，所以它是一种不完全蛋白，PDCAAS 实际上为零，绝不能计入一般蛋白质摄入；建模提示每日总蛋白中最多约 36% 可以是胶原，再高必需氨基酸平衡就会受影响（Paul 等 2019, PMID 31096622，已确认）。水解是真实的差别：胶原蛋白肽经酶切成 2-5 kDa 片段，可溶于冷液体，部分以二肽和三肽形式吸收；明胶会凝胶，必须热溶；皮和筋里的天然胶原则要先煮熟再消化。食物一侧，猪皮脆连同胶原带来大量饱和脂肪和盐，一袋明胶不会，所以用猪皮脆换胶原粉是一种取舍。

Absorption吸收 Genuinely different by form, and here the supplement has a defensible argument. Hydrolysed collagen peptides are absorbed rapidly and hydroxyproline-containing dipeptides such as prolyl-hydroxyproline appear intact in plasma, which is the mechanistic basis of the collagen-peptide literature; plasma amino acid comparisons of dairy against collagen protein confirm the distinctive glycine, proline and hydroxyproline signature of collagen ingestion. Gelatine, already partly hydrolysed, behaves similarly, and a 7 g sachet delivers 6.0 g of that same protein. Native collagen in skin, tendon and bone requires prolonged moist cooking to become digestible at all, which is exactly why bone broth quantities are unpredictable and why standardised broths fell significantly short of a 20 g reference collagen dose. Vitamin C is required for the hydroxylation step in endogenous collagen synthesis, so collagen intake without adequate vitamin C is pointless, and eating hydroxyproline does not bypass that requirement.确实因形式而异，这里补剂有站得住的论点。水解胶原蛋白肽吸收快，含羟脯氨酸的二肽如脯氨酰-羟脯氨酸能以完整形式出现在血浆中，这是胶原肽文献的机制基础；把乳蛋白与胶原蛋白作血浆氨基酸对比，也确认了摄入胶原后甘氨酸、脯氨酸和羟脯氨酸的特征性升高。明胶本身已部分水解，表现类似，一小袋 7 g 就提供 6.0 g 同样的蛋白。皮、筋和骨中的天然胶原需要长时间湿热烹煮才谈得上可消化，这正是骨汤的量不可预测的原因，也是标准化骨汤显著低于 20 g 参比胶原剂量的原因。内源胶原合成的羟化步骤需要维生素 C，所以维生素 C 不足时补胶原没有意义，吃下羟脯氨酸也绕不过这个要求。

Pros优点

  • In the GAIT moderate-to-severe pain stratum the combination beat placebo, 79.2% versus 54.3% response (P=0.002). This was pre-specified but underpowered, and the authors themselves cautioned against over-reading it.在 GAIT 的中重度疼痛分层中，联用优于安慰剂，应答率 79.2% 对 54.3%（P=0.002）。该分层是预先设定的，但把握度不足，作者本人也提醒不要过度解读。
  • Cochrane found a short-term chondroitin benefit: 10% absolute pain improvement, NNT 5, at low to moderate quality.Cochrane 发现软骨素有短期获益：疼痛绝对改善 10%，NNT 5，质量为低至中等。
  • As safe as placebo in the trials.在试验中安全性与安慰剂相当。

Cons缺点

  • The definitive trial was null. GAIT was NIH-funded, n=1,583, 24 weeks, with a celecoxib active control, designed specifically to remove industry influence. Glucosamine +3.9 percentage points over placebo (P=0.30), chondroitin +5.3 (P=0.17), combination +6.5 (P=0.09). Celecoxib worked; the supplements did not.决定性试验是阴性的。GAIT 由 NIH 资助，n=1583，24 周，设塞来昔布阳性对照，专为排除行业影响而设计。氨基葡萄糖比安慰剂高 3.9 个百分点（P=0.30），软骨素高 5.3（P=0.17），联用高 6.5（P=0.09）。塞来昔布有效，补充剂无效。
  • Cochrane found glucosamine benefit ONLY for the Rotta-brand crystalline glucosamine sulfate preparation. Pooled non-Rotta preparations failed to show any pain benefit. Almost nothing sold in shops is the Rotta preparation.Cochrane 发现氨基葡萄糖的获益只出现在 Rotta 品牌的结晶型硫酸氨基葡萄糖制剂上。非 Rotta 制剂合并后在疼痛上没有任何获益。而商店里卖的几乎都不是 Rotta 制剂。
  • The industry sells cartilage regeneration. No trial has shown cartilage regeneration.行业卖的是“软骨再生”。没有任何试验显示过软骨再生。
  • This is the best-documented supplement-anticoagulant interaction in this document: 20 FDA MedWatch reports linking glucosamine plus chondroitin to raised INR, bruising and bleeding on warfarin, plus 21 WHO database reports of raised INR.这是本文中记录最充分的补充剂与抗凝药相互作用：FDA MedWatch 有 20 份报告将氨基葡萄糖加软骨素与华法林使用者的 INR 升高、瘀伤和出血联系起来，WHO 数据库另有 21 份 INR 升高报告。
  • Shellfish-derived glucosamine matters in shellfish allergy.甲壳类来源的氨基葡萄糖对甲壳类过敏者很要紧。

Food sources食物来源

SYNTHETIC (glucosamine) / RICH in cartilage-containing foods (chondroitin)SYNTHETIC (glucosamine) / RICH in cartilage-containing foods (chondroitin) Dose partly reachable靠吃只能部分达到 Data confidence: Low数据可信度：低

The two compounds have different answers and must not share one label. Glucosamine is SYNTHETIC: no ordinary food contains free glucosamine, and glucosamine hydrochloride is manufactured by hydrolysing chitin from crustacean shell or Aspergillus niger fermentation biomass with food-grade concentrated hydrochloric acid at 100 C, then filtering, crystallising, washing and flash-drying. Shell and fungal mycelium are neither digestible nor eaten, so the feedstock is not a food route. Chondroitin is a different case, and the submission's SYNTHETIC label was wrong for it by its own admission that chondroitin sulfate is extracted from cartilage. Chondroitin sulfate in edible chicken keel cartilage has been quantified at 189 +/- 33 mg per gram of cartilage, and GAG content has been quantified in chicken feet and in traditionally stewed pig trotters. Chicken cartilage (yakitori nankotsu), chicken feet, pig trotters and shark fin are ordinary foods in Chinese, Japanese and Korean cuisine, so for chondroitin the honest answer is rich in a small set of real but culturally specific foods.两种化合物答案不同，不能共用一个标签。氨基葡萄糖属于 SYNTHETIC（合成）：没有普通食物含有游离氨基葡萄糖，盐酸氨基葡萄糖的做法是用食品级浓盐酸在 100 C 下水解甲壳类外壳或黑曲霉（Aspergillus niger）发酵菌体中的甲壳素，再过滤、结晶、洗涤、闪蒸干燥。外壳和真菌菌丝既不可消化也没人吃，所以这种原料不构成食物途径。软骨素是另一种情况，原提交稿给它贴 SYNTHETIC 的标签是错的，它自己也承认硫酸软骨素是从软骨中提取的。可食用鸡龙骨软骨中的硫酸软骨素已被定量为每克软骨 189 ± 33 mg，鸡爪和传统炖制猪蹄的 GAG 含量也已定量。鸡软骨（日式烤串 nankotsu）、鸡爪、猪蹄和鱼翅在中式、日式和韩式饮食中都是普通食物，所以对软骨素而言，诚实的答案是它在一小类真实但带有文化特定性的食物中含量丰富。
