To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 Split by compound. Chondroitin: a 1,200 mg daily dose corresponds to roughly 5.4 to 7.7 g of chicken keel cartilage at 189 +/- 33 mg/g, about 6 g at the central value, so two yakitori nankotsu skewers already exceed it several times over. Even if that figure turns out to be per gram of dried cartilage, a 30 g fresh portion would still carry roughly 1.4 to 2.3 g, which is 117 to 194 per cent of the dose, so the conclusion holds on either moisture basis. Glucosamine: there is no food quantity at all, and the informative comparison is endogenous. Human endogenous glucosamine production is 4 to 20 g/day with a median around 14 g/day, so the standard GAIT-trial 1,500 mg adds about 10.7 per cent on top of the median, or 7.5 to 37.5 per cent across the range. Prawn and crab shells are the industrial feedstock but shell is indigestible and not eaten, so eating prawns delivers no useful glucosamine.按化合物分开说。软骨素：按每克 189 ± 33 mg 计，1,200 mg 的每日剂量相当于大约 5.4 到 7.7 g 鸡龙骨软骨，取中心值约 6 g，所以两串烤鸡软骨已经数倍于该剂量。即便这个数值实际是每克干软骨，30 g 鲜重的一份仍会含大约 1.4 到 2.3 g，也就是剂量的 117 到 194 个百分点，所以无论按哪种水分基准，结论都成立。氨基葡萄糖：食物层面根本没有量，有参考价值的比较是内源合成。人体内源氨基葡萄糖生成量为 4 到 20 g/天，中位数约 14 g/天，所以 GAIT 试验标准的 1,500 mg 只在中位数之上增加约 10.7%，按全区间算是 7.5 到 37.5%。虾壳和蟹壳是工业原料，但壳不可消化也没人吃，所以吃虾并不提供有用的氨基葡萄糖。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Several that matter, and they differ by compound. Chemical form is not interchangeable in the trial literature: the European positive trials used a specific patented crystalline glucosamine SULFATE while the large NIH GAIT trial used glucosamine HYDROCHLORIDE, and the results differ, so a shelf product labelled simply 'glucosamine' is not evidence-matched to any particular result. Vegetarian or shellfish-free glucosamine from Aspergillus niger fermentation is the same manufactured molecule from a different feedstock, not a food-derived alternative; EFSA's opinion on the fungal route states that the process is the same as the shellfish process except for the raw material. Shellfish-derived glucosamine is a purified sugar rather than shellfish protein, so it is not the classic tropomyosin allergen route, though labels warn and cautious avoidance is reasonable. Chondroitin product content notoriously deviates from label claim because it is an extracted polydisperse polysaccharide from a bovine or shark by-product, which raises quality-control and sourcing questions. On the food side, cartilage-containing dishes carry chondroitin in a cooked matrix at a concentration that varies with cut and preparation, so a nankotsu skewer is a real chondroitin source rather than a measured dose.有几点重要，而且因化合物而异。化学形式在试验文献中不可互换：欧洲的阳性试验用的是一种特定的专利结晶硫酸氨基葡萄糖，美国 NIH 的大型 GAIT 试验用的是盐酸氨基葡萄糖，结果不同，所以货架上只标“氨基葡萄糖”的产品与任何一项特定结果的证据并不对应。来自黑曲霉发酵的素食或无贝类氨基葡萄糖，是同一个人工制造的分子换了原料，构不成来自食物的替代品；EFSA 关于真菌路线的意见指出，除原料不同外工艺与贝类路线相同。来自贝类的氨基葡萄糖是提纯的糖类（而非贝类蛋白），因此不走经典的原肌球蛋白过敏原路径，不过标签仍会警示，谨慎回避也说得过去。软骨素产品的实际含量常与标签声称不符，因为它是从牛或鲨鱼副产品中提取的多分散多糖，这带来质量控制和来源方面的问题。食物一侧，含软骨的菜品把软骨素放在熟制基质中，浓度随部位和做法变化，所以一串鸡软骨算是真实的软骨素来源，谈不上一个测定过的剂量。

Absorption吸收 Poor and first-pass-limited for glucosamine: oral glucosamine is largely metabolised on first pass and plasma concentrations reach only low micromolar, far below the millimolar concentrations at which glucosamine affects chondrocytes in cell culture, which is the central pharmacological criticism of the category. Absorbed glucosamine enters cells through glucose transporters, a process facilitated by insulin, and is phosphorylated to glucosamine-6-phosphate, the same intermediate the body already makes at 4 to 20 g/day (median about 14 g/day, EFSA ANS Panel 2013 opinion on (6S)-5-methyltetrahydrofolic acid, glucosamine salt; the frequently quoted 230 mg/kg body weight per day is a back-calculation from that median for a 60 kg adult, 14,000/60 = 233, not an EFSA-quoted value). Chondroitin sulfate is a large sulfated polysaccharide of tens of kDa and is absorbed mainly after depolymerisation into smaller fragments and constituent sugars, so what reaches the circulation is not the intact molecule from the capsule. Food-borne chondroitin faces the same depolymerisation step plus the need to liberate the glycosaminoglycan from a cooked cartilage matrix, so a cartilage portion that exceeds the dose on paper is not equivalent to a measured dose in effect.氨基葡萄糖吸收差且受首过效应限制：口服氨基葡萄糖大部分在首过代谢中被处理掉，血药浓度只到低微摩尔级，远低于细胞培养中影响软骨细胞所需的毫摩尔浓度，这是对该类补剂的核心药理学批评。被吸收的氨基葡萄糖通过葡萄糖转运体进入细胞，胰岛素可促进这一过程，随后磷酸化为氨基葡萄糖-6-磷酸，与人体本来就以 4 到 20 g/天（中位数约 14 g/天）产生的中间体相同（EFSA ANS Panel 2013 关于 (6S)-5-甲基四氢叶酸氨基葡萄糖盐的意见；常被引用的每千克体重每天 230 mg 是按该中位数为 60 kg 成人反推的结果，14,000/60 = 233，并非 EFSA 给出的数值）。硫酸软骨素是几十 kDa 的大分子硫酸化多糖，主要在解聚为较小片段和组成糖之后才被吸收，所以进入循环的并非胶囊中的完整分子。食物中的软骨素同样要经过这一解聚步骤，还要先把糖胺聚糖从熟制的软骨基质中释放出来，所以纸面上超过剂量的一份软骨，在效果上不等于一个测定过的剂量。

Data note数据说明 The single numeric food row rests on one 2014 poultry-science paper reached through the verification review rather than read directly, and its moisture basis is unstated, which is why the per-portion figure is given on two readings. The chicken feet and pig trotter assays exist but are expressed per gram of total collagen and cannot be converted to a portion. Glucosamine has no food data at all, by nature rather than by omission. The endogenous 4-20 g/day figure is quoted verbatim in the literature but its primary EFSA opinion could not be opened this session低。唯一一条带数字的食物条目依赖 2014 年一篇家禽科学论文，且是通过核查综述转引而非直接阅读，其水分基准未说明，这也是每份数值给出两种读法的原因。鸡爪和猪蹄的测定确实存在，但以每克总胶原的量表示，无法换算成每份。氨基葡萄糖根本没有食物数据，这由其性质决定，与遗漏无关。内源 4-20 g/天 的数值在文献中被逐字引用，但本次会话无法打开其原始 EFSA 意见。

Dose tested已验证剂量250-2,000 mg/d in trials, most commonly 250 mg/d for 12 weeks. No dose has improved a clinical outcome.试验剂量 250 至 2000 毫克/天，最常见为 250 毫克/天持续 12 周。没有任何剂量改善过临床结局。
Who it is for适用人群Nobody demonstrably.没有可证实的适用人群。

Pros优点

  • It reliably raises blood NAD+ two to threefold, so the pill is absorbed and metabolised as claimed.它能稳定地把血中 NAD+ 提高 2 至 3 倍，说明药片确如所称被吸收和代谢了。
  • One 60-person trial in older adults with impaired physical function reported maintained walking speed and improved subjective sleep at 250 mg/d for 12 weeks. Single small trial.一项 60 人的试验在身体功能受损的老年人中报告，250 毫克/天持续 12 周可维持步速并改善主观睡眠。单项小试验。

Cons缺点

  • This is the purest biomarker-for-outcome substitution in the supplement market. Raising NAD+ is not a health outcome.这是补充剂市场上最纯粹的“用生物标志物冒充结局”的例子。把 NAD+ 提上去本身不是一个健康结局。
  • Two independent meta-analyses found nothing. Eight randomised trials in 342 people, and separately 12 studies in 513 people: no effect on fasting glucose, fasting insulin, HbA1c, HOMA-IR or any lipid fraction.两项独立 meta 分析什么也没发现。8 项随机试验、342 人，以及另外 12 项研究、513 人：对空腹血糖、空腹胰岛素、糖化血红蛋白、HOMA-IR 及各项血脂均无效应。
  • A systematic review of 10 trials in 437 people found grip strength 29.9 kg before and 30.5 kg after, with skeletal muscle mass index unchanged. Non-significant.一项纳入 10 项试验、437 人的系统综述显示握力从 29.9 公斤到 30.5 公斤，骨骼肌质量指数不变。不显著。
  • No contraindications are characterised because no adequately powered safety population exists. No upper limit has been set and EFSA has not authorised it as a novel food.没有明确的禁忌，因为不存在样本量足够的安全性人群。没有设定上限，EFSA 也未批准其为新型食品。
  • Avoid in pregnancy, lactation and active malignancy. NAD+ is a substrate for tumour metabolism and no oncology safety data exist.妊娠期、哺乳期和活动性恶性肿瘤者应避免。NAD+ 是肿瘤代谢的底物，且没有肿瘤学安全数据。

NMN really is present in ordinary plant and animal foods. Mills et al. 2016 Table 1, confirmed row by row against the primary source, puts every food it measured between 0 and 1.88 mg/100 g, and a 2025 HPLC-DAD/LC-MS-MS plant survey spans 40 to 13,000 ug/100 g, richest in broccoli and green beans. The submission's framing of 'sub-milligram-per-100 g levels, roughly 100 to 1,000 times below a single capsule' is withdrawn as self-contradicting: at the 2025 survey ceiling of 13 mg/100 g one 100 g portion sits about 19 times below a 250 mg capsule, and it is not sub-milligram. TRACE still holds against a 250 to 1,000 mg dose. Cow milk is not a meaningful NMN source, since its NAD+ precursor pool is dominated by nicotinamide and nicotinamide riboside (Trammell et al. 2016). Supplement NMN is manufactured by microbial fermentation or enzymatic/chemical synthesis and is never extracted from broccoli or edamame.NMN 确实存在于普通植物性和动物性食物中。Mills 等 2016 的 Table 1 经逐行对照原始文献核对，所测的每一种食物都落在 0 到 1.88 mg/100 g 之间；2025 年一项 HPLC-DAD/LC-MS-MS 植物调查跨度为 40 到 13,000 µg/100 g，以西兰花和四季豆含量最高。原提交稿“每 100 g 只有亚毫克水平，比一粒胶囊低约 100 到 1,000 倍”的表述自相矛盾，已撤回：按 2025 年调查的上限 13 mg/100 g，一份 100 g 大约只比 250 mg 胶囊低 19 倍，也谈不上亚毫克。对照 250 到 1,000 mg 的剂量，TRACE（痕量）这一判定依然成立。牛奶不算有意义的 NMN 来源，它的 NAD+ 前体池以烟酰胺和烟酰胺核苷为主（Trammell 等 2016）。补剂用 NMN 由微生物发酵或酶法/化学合成制得，从不从西兰花或毛豆中提取。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 A 250 mg dose is 13.3 kg of edamame a day at its richest measured value (1.88 mg/100 g) and 53 kg at the low end of the same food (0.47 mg/100 g); a 1,000 mg dose is 53 to 213 kg. Broccoli has to be quoted across both sources: at the 2025 plant survey's 13 mg/100 g ceiling a 250 mg dose is 1.9 kg, about 21 cups, while at Mills' 0.25 to 1.12 mg/100 g it is 22 to 100 kg. The honest span is therefore 1.9 to 100 kg, and the submission's flat '22 to 100 kg' overstated the gap by up to about elevenfold at the high-value end. Avocado: 104 to 463 whole avocados a day. Cucumber peel, the most quoted NMN food, is the least useful of all: 1,282 cucumbers pared, corrected from the 1,250 originally stated. No one eats any of this, and even the corrected best case rests on a survey ceiling that cannot be pinned to broccoli specifically.按毛豆实测最高值（1.88 mg/100 g）计算，250 mg 剂量相当于每天 13.3 kg 毛豆；按同一食物的低值（0.47 mg/100 g）则是 53 kg；1,000 mg 剂量为 53 到 213 kg。西兰花必须同时引用两个来源：按 2025 年植物调查的上限 13 mg/100 g，250 mg 剂量约 1.9 kg，大约 21 杯；按 Mills 的 0.25 到 1.12 mg/100 g，则是 22 到 100 kg。诚实的跨度因此是 1.9 到 100 kg，原提交稿一律写“22 到 100 kg”，在高值端把差距夸大了最多约 11 倍。牛油果：每天 104 到 463 整只。黄瓜皮是被引用最多的 NMN 食物，实际最没用：要削 1,282 根黄瓜的皮，原文写的 1,250 已更正。没人会这样吃，而且即便是更正后的最好情形，也建立在一个无法确切归到西兰花身上的调查上限之上。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Substantial. NMN is a phosphorylated nucleotide and is not absorbed intact in any large quantity: it is dephosphorylated in the gut to nicotinamide riboside and then to nicotinamide before or during absorption, so an oral NMN capsule is partly a nicotinamide delivery system. Food NMN arrives as a minor component of a mixed NAD+ vitamer pool (nicotinamide, nicotinic acid, NR, NAD+ itself) inside intact cells and is measured after extraction, which is not the same as being released by chewing and digestion. Supplement material is manufactured by fermentation or enzymatic synthesis, never extracted from broccoli or edamame despite the marketing imagery. Regulatory status differs too: the FDA has taken the position that NMN is precluded from being marketed as a US dietary supplement, while it is sold freely elsewhere, so 'food-derived' framing on a label carries no compositional meaning.很大。NMN 是磷酸化的核苷酸，不会有大量以完整形式被吸收：它在肠道内先去磷酸化为烟酰胺核苷，再转为烟酰胺，这一过程发生在吸收之前或吸收之中，所以口服 NMN 胶囊有一部分实际上是烟酰胺的递送系统。食物中的 NMN 是混合 NAD+ 维生素原池（烟酰胺、烟酸、NR、NAD+ 本身）里的次要成分，位于完整细胞内部，测定值是提取之后得到的，与咀嚼和消化能释放出来的量不是一回事。补剂原料由发酵或酶法合成制得，营销图片再怎么摆西兰花和毛豆，也从不从中提取。监管状态同样不同：FDA 已表态 NMN 不得作为美国膳食补充剂销售，而在其他地区可自由销售，因此标签上的“来自食物”并无成分层面的含义。

Absorption吸收 Food NMN quantities are too small for bioavailability to matter. For the supplement form, human and mouse tracer work shows the oral route delivers NAD+ precursors largely after conversion to nicotinamide riboside and nicotinamide rather than as intact NMN (Trammell et al. 2016, Nat Commun 7:12948, DOI 10.1038/ncomms12948, for the NR side of the same pathway). Ordinary diets already supply 15-20 mg/day of niacin equivalents feeding the same NAD+ pathway, thousands of times more molar precursor than the NMN in any vegetable portion, so the scarcity premise behind NMN supplementation is not a dietary-shortfall argument.食物中的 NMN 量太小，生物利用度无关紧要。就补剂形式而言，人体和小鼠示踪研究显示口服途径主要在转化为烟酰胺核苷和烟酰胺之后才把 NAD+ 前体送达，以完整 NMN 形式送达的比例很低（Trammell 等 2016, Nat Commun 7:12948, DOI 10.1038/ncomms12948，针对同一通路的 NR 一侧）。普通饮食本身每天已提供 15-20 mg 烟酸当量进入同一 NAD+ 通路，摩尔量比任何一份蔬菜里的 NMN 多出数千倍，所以 NMN 补充背后的稀缺前提并非膳食缺口论证。

Data note数据说明 Every Mills Table 1 value and per-portion conversion was confirmed against the primary table, and the PMID and DOI both resolve correctly. The upper end of the picture, and therefore the corrected best-case dose gap, rests on the Alegre & Pastore 2025 abstract alone, whose per-food values could not be retrieved (full text 403). The eight USDA FDC IDs used for food identity could not be checked because the FDC API rate-limited the session中。Mills Table 1 的每一个数值以及每份换算都已对照原表核实，PMID 与 DOI 均可正确解析。整体图景的上限，以及由此得出的更正后最好情形剂量差距，只依赖 Alegre & Pastore 2025 的摘要，其分食物数值无法获取（全文 403）。用于食物身份识别的八个 USDA FDC ID 无法核对，因为本次会话被 FDC API 限流。

Who it is for适用人群People with peripheral artery disease have the single best-supported claim, and it is thin.外周动脉疾病患者的证据是其中最好的，而这已经很薄了。

Pros优点

  • The NICE trial (n=90, 6 months) improved 6-minute walk distance by 17.6 m versus placebo, and by 31.0 m in those taking at least 75% of pills.NICE 试验（n=90，6 个月）使 6 分钟步行距离比安慰剂多 17.6 米，在服药依从性至少 75% 的人中多 31.0 米。

Cons缺点

  • More trials than NMN and a worse hit rate, which is informative. The pattern is consistent: NAD+ rises two to threefold, the clinical endpoint does not move.试验比 NMN 多，命中率反而更低，这本身很说明问题。规律是一致的：NAD+ 升高 2 至 3 倍，临床终点不动。
  • Long COVID (n=58, 2,000 mg/d, 20 weeks): NAD+ up 2.6 to 3.1-fold, no significant improvement in cognition, fatigue, sleep or mood.长新冠（n=58，2000 毫克/天，20 周）：NAD+ 升高 2.6 至 3.1 倍，认知、疲劳、睡眠、情绪均无显著改善。
  • Obese insulin-resistant men (n=40, 2,000 mg/d, 12 weeks): insulin sensitivity, endogenous glucose production, glucose disposal and oxidation were all unimproved, in the authors own words.肥胖胰岛素抵抗男性（n=40，2000 毫克/天，12 周）：用作者原话，胰岛素敏感性、内源性葡萄糖生成、葡萄糖处置与氧化全部未改善。
  • Mild cognitive impairment trials at 1,000 mg/d were null.1000 毫克/天治疗轻度认知障碍的试验为阴性。
  • EFSA caps pregnancy and lactation at 230 mg/d. Sum total nicotinamide exposure if also taking prescription niacin. As with NMN, no oncology safety data exist.EFSA 把妊娠期和哺乳期上限定在 230 毫克/天。若同时服用处方烟酸，需合计烟酰胺总暴露量。与 NMN 一样，没有肿瘤学安全数据。

Food sources食物来源

Trace amounts only仅有痕量 Dose NOT reachable by eating靠吃达不到剂量 Data confidence: Medium数据可信度：中

TRACE was challenged and upheld. NR is a real dietary vitamer, best characterised in cow milk, where Trammell et al. 2016 measured 4.3 +/- 2.6 umol/L across 18 raw samples (5.1 +/- 2.6 umol/L in the subset free of S. aureus, against nicotinamide at 7.3 +/- 1.5 umol/L). That is 1.1 to 1.3 mg per litre. Plant foods carry 62 to 1,600 ug per 100 g, with wild chicory, banana and orange named the highest (Alegre & Pastore 2025). Every one of these is three orders of magnitude below a 250 to 1,000 mg capsule. Commercial NR chloride is synthesised, not extracted from milk.TRACE（痕量）曾被质疑，经复核维持。NR 是真实的膳食维生素原形式，在牛奶中研究得最充分：Trammell 等 2016 在 18 个生奶样本中测得 4.3 ± 2.6 µmol/L（不含金黄色葡萄球菌（S. aureus）的子集为 5.1 ± 2.6 µmol/L，同批烟酰胺为 7.3 ± 1.5 µmol/L）。折合每升 1.1 到 1.3 mg。植物性食物含 62 到 1,600 µg/100 g，其中野生菊苣、香蕉和橙子被点名为最高（Alegre & Pastore 2025）。这些数值全部比 250 到 1,000 mg 的胶囊低三个数量级。商品化的 NR 氯化物为合成品，不从牛奶中提取。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 A 300 mg dose is 231 to 273 litres of milk a day, roughly 970 to 1,150 cups, and a 1,000 mg dose is 769 to 909 litres. One 250 mg capsule holds as much NR as 192 to 227 litres of milk. The submission quoted only the single lowest concentration (1.1 mg/L), which inflated each of these figures by 15 to 20 per cent; the range above spans Trammell's 4.3 umol/L mean and his bacteria-free 5.1 umol/L subset. From the richest plant value in the 2025 survey (1.6 mg/100 g) a 300 mg dose is about 19 kg a day. Milk is genuinely the best dietary source of NR and it is still useless as a route to a trial dose.300 mg 剂量对应每天 231 到 273 升牛奶，大约 970 到 1,150 杯；1,000 mg 剂量为 769 到 909 升。一粒 250 mg 胶囊所含 NR 相当于 192 到 227 升牛奶。原提交稿只引用了最低浓度（1.1 mg/L），把上述每个数字都抬高了 15 到 20 个百分点；这里的区间覆盖 Trammell 的 4.3 µmol/L 均值和他那个不含该细菌的 5.1 µmol/L 子集。按 2025 年调查中最高的植物值（1.6 mg/100 g），300 mg 剂量约为每天 19 kg。牛奶确实是 NR 最好的膳食来源，作为达到试验剂量的途径依然没用。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Important. Commercial NR is nicotinamide riboside chloride, a synthesised salt, while the NR in milk is a fragile glycosidic nucleoside that degrades on storage and is reduced in milk from mastitic (S. aureus positive) cows; Trammell also found conventional milk carried more NR than organic. The food number is a moving target for that reason. More significant, the whole diet already supplies plenty of the pathway's dominant precursor, nicotinamide, at 15-20 mg/day of niacin equivalents, so NR supplementation is not correcting a dietary gap in NAD+ precursors, it is a pharmacological attempt at a different pharmacokinetic profile. High-dose nicotinamide-family precursors also carry methyl-group and flushing or hepatic considerations at gram level that a glass of milk does not.重要。商品 NR 是烟酰胺核苷氯化物，一种合成的盐；牛奶中的 NR 是脆弱的糖苷核苷，储存过程中会降解，来自患乳腺炎（金黄色葡萄球菌阳性）奶牛的牛奶含量更低；Trammell 还发现常规牛奶的 NR 高于有机牛奶。食物数值因此是个移动的靶子。更实质的问题在于，整体饮食已经提供了充足的通路主导前体烟酰胺，每天 15-20 mg 烟酸当量，所以 NR 补充与 NAD+ 前体的膳食缺口无关，它是为了取得另一种药代动力学曲线所做的药理学尝试。克级的高剂量烟酰胺族前体还牵涉甲基供体消耗以及潮红或肝脏方面的考量，一杯牛奶不涉及这些。

Absorption吸收 NR is absorbed orally and raises blood NAD+ in humans, which was the point of the original demonstration (Trammell et al. 2016, Nat Commun 7:12948, DOI 10.1038/ncomms12948). Absorption is not the constraint; food quantities are microgram-scale, at 0.26-0.31 mg per cup of milk against a 250-1,000 mg capsule. There is a route difference too: much oral NR is cleaved to nicotinamide in the gut and liver, so a fraction of any dose acts as plain vitamin B3, which is abundant in food. The submission's claim that milk NR is 'free in solution and not bound to milk proteins' inverts the source and has been removed: Trammell's WaterLOGSY NMR gave positive signals from the four aromatic protons of the nicotinamide moiety consistent with association with a skim-milk protein fraction, with stronger binding in conventional than organic milk.NR 口服可吸收，并能提高人体血液 NAD+ 水平，这正是最初那项验证的要点（Trammell 等 2016, Nat Commun 7:12948, DOI 10.1038/ncomms12948）。吸收不是制约因素；食物中的量只有微克级，每杯牛奶 0.26-0.31 mg，对照 250-1,000 mg 的胶囊。途径上也有差别：口服 NR 有相当一部分在肠道和肝脏被裂解为烟酰胺，因此任何剂量都有一部分是以普通维生素 B3 起作用，而维生素 B3 在食物中很充足。原提交稿称牛奶中的 NR“游离于溶液中，不与乳蛋白结合”，把原始文献说反了，已删除：Trammell 的 WaterLOGSY 核磁共振从烟酰胺部分的四个芳香质子得到正信号，与其同脱脂乳蛋白组分相结合一致，且常规牛奶中的结合强于有机牛奶。

Data note数据说明 The milk figure is traceable to the primary full text and the micromolar-to-mg/L conversion was independently recomputed, but all three plant rows rest on a paywalled paper whose per-food values are not retrievable, so their content and their rank order are unconfirmed中。牛奶数值可追溯到原始全文，微摩尔到 mg/L 的换算也已独立重算，但三条植物条目全部依赖一篇付费墙论文，其分食物数值无法获取，因此它们的含量和排序都未经确认。

Dose tested已验证剂量Trials span 150 mg/d to gram doses. The EU caps synthetic trans-resveratrol at 150 mg/d in supplements, adults only.试验剂量从 150 毫克/天到克级。欧盟把合成反式白藜芦醇在补充剂中的上限定为 150 毫克/天，且仅限成人。
Who it is for适用人群Possibly people who already have type 2 diabetes. The healthy-ageing consumer is in the null subgroup.可能适用于已患 2 型糖尿病的人。以“健康抗老”为目的的消费者正处在无效的那个亚组里。

Pros优点

  • An 11-trial meta-analysis found significant improvement in glucose control and insulin sensitivity in people who already had diabetes, and explicitly no effect in non-diabetic people.一项 11 项试验的 meta 分析发现，在已患糖尿病的人中血糖控制和胰岛素敏感性显著改善，并明确指出在非糖尿病者中无效应。

Cons缺点

  • It is the cautionary tale the rest of this category has not learned from. Sirtris was acquired by GSK for 720 million US dollars and the development programme was discontinued.它是这个品类其余成员没有从中学到教训的警示故事。Sirtris 被 GSK 以 7.2 亿美元收购，随后开发项目终止。
  • The best-designed human trial was null: 150 mg/d for 6 months in overweight adults, no effect on insulin sensitivity (adjusted Matsuda index 5.18 versus 5.50 on placebo).设计最好的人体试验是阴性的：超重成人服用 150 毫克/天共 6 个月，对胰岛素敏感性无效（校正 Matsuda 指数 5.18，安慰剂 5.50）。
  • It can make exercise worse. In aged men undergoing training, resveratrol BLUNTED the training-induced cardiovascular improvements, the opposite of the marketed exercise-mimetic claim.它可能让运动效果变差。在接受训练的老年男性中，白藜芦醇削弱了训练带来的心血管改善，与其宣传的“运动模拟剂”正好相反。
  • Antiplatelet activity, so care with warfarin and antiplatelets. Oestrogen-sensitive conditions warrant caution. Gram doses cause gastrointestinal intolerance, and the oncology programme saw renal adverse events.有抗血小板活性，与华法林和抗血小板药合用需谨慎。雌激素敏感性疾病也需谨慎。克级剂量引起胃肠不耐受，肿瘤学项目中还出现过肾脏不良事件。

Food sources食物来源

Trace amounts only仅有痕量 Dose NOT reachable by eating靠吃达不到剂量 Data confidence: Medium数据可信度：中

Resveratrol occurs in red wine, grapes, peanuts and some berries, at concentrations three to five orders of magnitude below trial doses; red wine averages 1.9 mg trans-resveratrol per litre, so a whole litre holds less than one capsule. Supplement resveratrol is not grape-derived: it is made synthetically or extracted from Japanese knotweed root (Polygonum cuspidatum). Knotweed is not entirely inedible, since young itadori shoots are eaten as a spring vegetable in Japan and foraged in the UK and North America and itadori tea is made from the plant, so the accurate statement is that it is not a food in Western diets, has no composition-table entry, and the root used for extraction is not the part anyone eats. Three sources that belong in the food picture carry no verified figure here and so get no row: peanut skins (the redskin testa, the richest stilbene fraction of the peanut, which is why the roasted-kernel value is explicitly for peanuts without seed coats), red and purple grape juice (the non-alcoholic route the ethanol argument implies), and the wider stilbene foods (muscadine grapes, bilberries, blueberries, cranberries, pistachios, cocoa), so the roughly 5 mg/day dietary ceiling rests on population intake studies rather than on rows built here.白藜芦醇存在于红葡萄酒、葡萄、花生和部分浆果中，浓度比试验剂量低三到五个数量级；红葡萄酒的反式白藜芦醇平均为每升 1.9 mg，整整一升所含的量还不到一粒胶囊。补充剂中的白藜芦醇与葡萄无关：它由化学合成，或从虎杖根（Polygonum cuspidatum）中提取。虎杖并非完全不可食用，日本会把嫩芽（itadori，虎杖嫩茎）当作春季蔬菜食用，英国和北美也有人采集，还有用该植物制成的虎杖茶（itadori tea）。因此准确的说法是：它在西方饮食中不是食物，没有成分表条目，用于提取的根部也不是任何人会吃的部位。另有三类本应进入食物图景的来源，此处没有经核实的数值，故不单列：花生红衣（种皮，花生中芪类含量最高的部分，这也是烤花生数值明确标注为去种皮花生的原因）、红葡萄汁和紫葡萄汁（乙醇论点所隐含的无醇路径），以及范围更广的芪类食物（马斯卡丁葡萄、越橘、蓝莓、蔓越莓、开心果、可可）。每天约 5 mg 的膳食上限因此来自人群摄入量研究，此处建立的数据行并未提供支撑。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 A 150 mg resveratrol dose equals 79 litres of average red wine (150 divided by 1.9 mg/L), about 105 standard 750 mL bottles or roughly 450 glasses, every day. Even at the top of the corroborated sample spread of 0.361 to 1.972 mg/L it is still 76 litres a day. From grapes it is 30 kg daily; from boiled peanuts 29 kg, and from roasted peanuts 2.7 tonnes. Trials commonly use 150 to 1,000 mg/day and the SRT501 cancer studies used up to 5 g/day, all of it manufactured. Measured population intakes sit far lower again (a Spanish study found a median of 100 ug/day and a mean of 933 ug/day for resveratrol plus piceid, and French wine consumption yields about 0.2 mg/day), and no plausible diet gets past about 5 mg/day.150 mg 白藜芦醇的剂量相当于每天 79 升平均含量的红葡萄酒（150 除以 1.9 mg/L），约 105 瓶 750 mL 标准装，或大约 450 杯。即便取已获旁证的样本区间 0.361 至 1.972 mg/L 的上限，也仍需每天 76 升。换成葡萄是每天 30 kg；水煮花生 29 kg；烤花生 2.7 吨。试验常用剂量为每天 150 至 1,000 mg，SRT501 的肿瘤研究用到每天 5 g，全部为人工制造。实测的人群摄入量远低于此（西班牙一项研究得出白藜芦醇加虎杖苷（piceid）的中位数为每天 100 ug、均值为每天 933 ug；法国的葡萄酒消费约折合每天 0.2 mg），任何合理的饮食都超不过每天约 5 mg。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Three separate mismatches. First, the supplement is not a food extract: commercial resveratrol is synthetic or comes from Polygonum cuspidatum root, which is not a Western food and not a composition-table food, so the grape imagery on the label is marketing rather than sourcing. Second, wine's stilbenes are mostly the glucoside trans-piceid, at about three times the aglycone concentration, arriving inside a large mixed polyphenol and ethanol matrix, so wine does not behave as a dilute resveratrol capsule. Third, and decisive: recommending wine as a resveratrol source is a bad recommendation regardless of dose, because ethanol is a Group 1 carcinogen and the alcohol harm arrives at one glass while the resveratrol dose would require a hundred bottles. Separately, high-dose resveratrol (2.5 to 5 g/day) causes diarrhoea and nausea and inhibits CYP3A4, CYP2C9 and sulfotransferases, giving it real interaction potential (warfarin, for example) that a glass of wine does not have.三处彼此独立的错配。第一，这种补充剂并非食物提取物：市售白藜芦醇为合成品，或来自虎杖根，后者在西方不是食物，也没有成分表条目，所以标签上的葡萄形象属于营销手法，与原料来源无关。第二，葡萄酒中的芪类以糖苷形式的反式虎杖苷为主，浓度约为苷元的三倍，且处在成分复杂的多酚与乙醇基质之中，葡萄酒的表现与一粒稀释版白藜芦醇胶囊完全不同。第三点最关键：把葡萄酒当作白藜芦醇来源来推荐，无论剂量如何都是糟糕的建议，因为乙醇是 1 类致癌物，酒精的危害从第一杯就开始，而要达到白藜芦醇的剂量需要上百瓶。另外，高剂量白藜芦醇（每天 2.5 至 5 g）会引起腹泻和恶心，并抑制 CYP3A4、CYP2C9 和硫酸转移酶，具有实际的相互作用风险（例如华法林），一杯葡萄酒不具备这种风险。

Absorption吸收 Oral resveratrol is well absorbed (about 70% of the dose crosses the enterocyte) but systemic bioavailability of the unchanged aglycone is under 1 to 2% because of near-immediate intestinal and hepatic glucuronidation and sulfation; plasma peaks from dietary quantities sit in the low nanomolar range, while in vitro activity is generally demonstrated at micromolar concentrations. Piceid, the form dominant in grapes and much of wine, must be deglycosylated before absorption, adding another step. Gram doses are needed to reach micromolar plasma levels, which is precisely why the food route is closed.口服白藜芦醇吸收良好（约 70% 的剂量可通过肠上皮细胞），但由于肠道和肝脏几乎即刻发生葡萄糖苷酸化与硫酸化，未变化苷元的全身生物利用度低于 1 至 2%；膳食量所产生的血浆峰值处于低纳摩尔级，而体外活性通常要在微摩尔浓度下才能显现。葡萄和大部分葡萄酒中占主导的虎杖苷必须先脱糖才能吸收，又多一道步骤。要让血浆达到微摩尔水平需要克级剂量，食物路径正因此被彻底堵死。

Data note数据说明 The wine mean (1.9 +/- 1.7 mg/L), the Napoleon grape figures, the roasted-peanut corroborating range and the roughly 5 mg/day dietary ceiling were all verified or independently corroborated, and about a dozen unit conversions recompute correctly. The boiled peanut and peanut butter values sit behind a paywall and are indicative, and the wine maximum of 14.3 mg/L had to be removed as untraceable中。葡萄酒均值（1.9 +/- 1.7 mg/L）、Napoleon 葡萄的数值、烤花生的旁证区间以及每天约 5 mg 的膳食上限均已核实或获得独立旁证，约十余项单位换算重算无误。水煮花生和花生酱的数值处于付费墙之后，属参考性数据；葡萄酒 14.3 mg/L 的最高值因无法追溯而删除。

Dose tested已验证剂量0.9 mg/d was the dose in the definitive trial. Commercial products supply roughly 1-6 mg/d.决定性试验用的是 0.9 毫克/天。市售产品约提供 1 至 6 毫克/天。
Who it is for适用人群Nobody demonstrably.没有可证实的适用人群。

Pros优点

  • The autophagy mechanism is genuine in yeast, flies, worms and mice, and lifespan is extended in those organisms.自噬机制在酵母、果蝇、线虫和小鼠中是真实的，这些生物的寿命确实被延长了。

Cons缺点

  • The one well-conducted human test failed in exactly the target population. SmartAge was 12 months, double-masked, placebo-controlled, in 100 adults aged 60-90 with subjective cognitive decline. Primary outcome difference -0.03 (95% CI -0.11 to 0.05), P=0.47, against a pre-registered primary endpoint.唯一一项做得规范的人体试验，在完全对口的目标人群中失败了。SmartAge 为 12 个月、双盲、安慰剂对照，纳入 100 名 60 至 90 岁有主观认知下降的成人。针对预先注册的主要终点，组间差异为 -0.03（95% CI -0.11 至 0.05），P=0.47。
  • The observational case rests on dietary intake epidemiology, and spermidine-rich foods are wheat germ, legumes, mushrooms and aged cheese. That is a dietary pattern, not a molecule.观察性依据来自膳食摄入流行病学，而富含亚精胺的食物是麦胚、豆类、蘑菇和陈年奶酪。那是一种饮食模式，不是一个分子。
  • Dietary intake from food is typically several-fold higher than most supplements provide, which by itself undermines the supplement premise.从食物中摄入的量通常比多数补充剂提供的高出数倍，这一点本身就削弱了补充剂存在的前提。
  • Wheat-germ-derived products are unsuitable in coeliac disease and wheat allergy. Polyamines are growth-supporting and elevated in many tumours, and polyamine depletion is an active oncology strategy, so avoid during active malignancy.麦胚来源的产品不适合乳糜泻和小麦过敏者。多胺具有促生长作用，在许多肿瘤中升高，而多胺耗竭正是当前肿瘤治疗的一种策略，因此活动性恶性肿瘤期间应避免。

RICH was challenged and upheld. This is the one entry where ordinary food beats the supplement outright: wheat germ, dried soybeans, mushrooms, green peas, fermented soy and some aged cheeses all carry milligram-per-portion quantities. Measured intakes tabulated by Munoz-Esparza et al. 2019 run from 33.1 umol/day in Turkey to 103.1 umol/day in Spain, with Western populations at 54.7 to 103.1 umol/day, which is 7.9 to 15.0 mg/day. Trial capsules delivered 0.9 mg/day in the 12-month SmartAge trial. The diet supplies roughly ten times the capsule. Atiya Ali et al. 2011 also names chicken liver, corn and shellfish among its high-spermidine foods, and chicken liver in particular would be a useful non-wheat source, but no per-food figure for them could be sourced here, so they are not given rows.RICH（丰富）曾被质疑，经复核维持。这是唯一一条普通食物完全胜过补剂的条目：小麦胚芽、干黄豆、蘑菇、青豌豆、发酵豆制品和部分陈年干酪，每份都能提供毫克级的量。Munoz-Esparza 等 2019 汇总的实测摄入量从土耳其的 33.1 µmol/天 到西班牙的 103.1 µmol/天，西方人群处于 54.7 到 103.1 µmol/天，也就是 7.9 到 15.0 mg/天。为期 12 个月的 SmartAge 试验中，胶囊每天提供 0.9 mg。饮食供给量大约是胶囊的十倍。Atiya Ali 等 2011 还把鸡肝、玉米和贝类列入高亚精胺食物，其中鸡肝会是有用的非小麦来源，但这里查不到它们的分食物数值，所以未单列条目。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 The gap runs backwards. Two tablespoons of wheat germ (14 g) supply 3.1 to 5.0 mg, three to five times the 0.9 mg/day dose used in the SmartAge trial. A cup of cooked green peas supplies about 8.7 mg and a cup of sliced mushrooms 6.2 to 7.6 mg, each close to an entire ordinary day's intake. Against habitual intakes of 7.9 to 15.0 mg/day, a typical 1 mg capsule adds 6.7 to 12.7 per cent on top of what the person already eats, which is inside the day-to-day variation of a normal diet, and matching a day's dietary spermidine from capsules would take 8 to 15 of them. Anyone who wants more spermidine should buy wheat germ, which costs a fraction of the capsules and delivers several times the dose.差距是反向的。两大勺小麦胚芽（14 g）提供 3.1 到 5.0 mg，是 SmartAge 试验所用 0.9 mg/天 剂量的三到五倍。一杯煮熟的青豌豆提供约 8.7 mg，一杯切片蘑菇 6.2 到 7.6 mg，各自都接近普通人一整天的摄入量。对照 7.9 到 15.0 mg/天 的习惯摄入量，一粒常见的 1 mg 胶囊只在既有饮食之上增加 6.7 到 12.7 个百分点，落在正常饮食的日常波动范围内；要用胶囊凑够一天的膳食亚精胺，需要 8 到 15 粒。想多摄入亚精胺的人应该去买小麦胚芽，价格只是胶囊的一小部分，提供的量却是数倍。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Real, in both directions. Most 'spermidine' products are wheat germ extracts standardised to about 1 mg rather than purified spermidine, so the label compound is the same molecule as in the food and there is no extraction advantage. Against that, aged cheese and natto carry biogenic amines (histamine, tyramine, putrescine) that matter for people on MAO inhibitors or with histamine intolerance, so the richest fermented sources are not risk-free foods even though they are ordinary ones. Polyamines are proliferative signalling molecules and concentrated long-term supplementation lacks the observational safety record that food-level intake has. The Bruneck cohort (Kiechl et al. 2018, Am J Clin Nutr 108(2):371-380, PMID 29955838) supports dietary intake, reporting mortality by intake thirds of 40.5, 23.7 and 15.1 deaths per 1,000 person-years; the 9 to 11.5 mg/day figures the submission attributed to it are not retrievable from the paper and have been dropped. Wheat germ also goes rancid quickly, so buy small and refrigerate.真实存在，而且两个方向都有。多数“亚精胺”产品其实是标准化到约 1 mg 的小麦胚芽提取物（而非纯化亚精胺），标签上的化合物与食物中的是同一个分子，提取并不带来优势。另一面，陈年干酪和纳豆携带生物胺（组胺、酪胺、腐胺），对服用单胺氧化酶抑制剂或有组胺不耐受的人有影响，因此最富含的发酵来源虽然都是普通食物，却算不上没有风险。多胺是促增殖的信号分子，长期高浓度补充缺少食物水平摄入所具备的观察性安全记录。Bruneck 队列（Kiechl 等 2018, Am J Clin Nutr 108(2):371-380, PMID 29955838）支持膳食摄入，按摄入量三分位报告的死亡率为每 1,000 人年 40.5、23.7 和 15.1 例；原提交稿归到该研究名下的 9 至 11.5 mg/天 数值在论文中查不到，已删除。小麦胚芽也很快酸败，少量购买并冷藏。

Absorption吸收 Dietary polyamines are absorbed readily in the upper small intestine, gut bacteria synthesise more, and circulating levels are homeostatically buffered, so intake is not the only input. A triple-blind randomised placebo-controlled crossover trial gave 12 healthy volunteers 15 mg/day of spermidine in two 5-day phases, about 15 times a typical capsule and 1.0 to 1.9 times a rich day's diet; plasma spermine rose significantly while spermidine and putrescine did not change, which the authors read as presystemic conversion of spermidine to spermine (Senekowitsch et al. 2023, Nutrients, PMID 37111071). Either way, dosing well above dietary levels did not raise circulating spermidine. Processing of the food matters more than any supplement choice: commercially germinated wheat grain measured 19.22-24.25 mg/kg spermidine against 220.65-337.2 mg/kg for industrially separated wheat germ. Those ranges imply an 89 to 94 per cent drop, about 92 per cent mean to mean, and the paper's own headline figure of 85.52 per cent is inconsistent with its own data.膳食多胺在小肠上段吸收良好，肠道细菌还会额外合成，循环水平受体内稳态缓冲，所以摄入量并非唯一输入。一项三盲随机安慰剂对照交叉试验给 12 名健康志愿者每天 15 mg 亚精胺，分两个 5 天阶段，约为典型胶囊的 15 倍、富含亚精胺一天饮食的 1.0 到 1.9 倍；血浆精胺显著升高，亚精胺和腐胺没有变化，作者解读为亚精胺在进入体循环前转化成了精胺（Senekowitsch 等 2023, Nutrients, PMID 37111071）。无论如何，剂量远高于膳食水平也没有提高循环中的亚精胺。食物的加工方式比选哪种补剂更要紧：商业发芽小麦粒实测亚精胺 19.22-24.25 mg/kg，工业分离的小麦胚芽为 220.65-337.2 mg/kg。这两个区间意味着 89 到 94 个百分点的下降，均值对均值约 92%，论文自己给出的 85.52% 与其自身数据不符。

Data note数据说明 The wheat germ, green pea, natto and cheddar figures were all confirmed against their primary sources, including the nmol/g conversions and the cross-checks. Two rows are less settled because two cited sources disagree by 3-6x (soybeans) or because the submission's fresh-weight figure exceeded the source's own ceiling (mushrooms), and both are now presented as ranges. Two claims were dropped as unverifiable: the Bruneck mg/day intakes and a supposed 3.3 mg/day follow-up trial dose中。小麦胚芽、青豌豆、纳豆和切达干酪的数值全部对照原始来源核实，包括 nmol/g 换算和交叉核对。两条条目仍不确定：黄豆的两个引用来源相差 3-6 倍，蘑菇则是原提交稿的鲜重值超过了来源自身的上限，两者现在都以区间给出。两项主张因无法验证被删除：Bruneck 的 mg/天 摄入量，以及所谓 3.3 mg/天 的后续试验剂量。

Pros优点

  • A Bayesian network meta-analysis of 23 studies and 2,175 knee osteoarthritis patients found pain on a visual analogue scale -1.63 (-2.91 to -0.45) and total WOMAC -18.85.一项贝叶斯网络 meta 分析纳入 23 项研究、2175 名膝骨关节炎患者，视觉模拟疼痛评分为 -1.63（-2.91 至 -0.45），WOMAC 总分为 -18.85。

  • It was classified in the Journal of Medicinal Chemistry as both a PAINS (pan-assay interference compound) and an invalid metabolic panacea: an unstable, reactive, nonbioavailable compound and therefore a highly improbable lead. That is a formal medicinal-chemistry verdict, not an opinion.《药物化学杂志》把它同时归类为 PAINS（泛测定干扰化合物）和“无效的代谢万灵药”：一个不稳定、易反应、生物利用度极低的化合物，因此几乎不可能成为先导物。这是药物化学领域的正式判定，不是个人看法。
  • The dose on the label is disconnected from systemic exposure. Unconjugated plasma curcumin stays below 2 nM even at high dose with piperine, against the 1-100 micromolar concentrations used in the in-vitro work that generated the claims. Adding piperine does not raise unconjugated plasma curcumin.标签上的剂量与体内暴露量脱钩。即便高剂量并加胡椒碱，血浆游离姜黄素仍低于 2 nM，而产生这些说法的体外实验用的是 1 至 100 微摩尔。加胡椒碱并不能提高血浆游离姜黄素。
  • The osteoarthritis trials are mostly industry-funded with high heterogeneity.骨关节炎试验多为行业资助，异质性高。
  • Turmeric is the most commonly used of the six botanicals linked to liver injury in US survey data (236 of 9,685 respondents), and 10 DILIN cases published in 2023 included five hospitalisations and one death from acute liver failure. Seven of ten carried HLA-B*35:01.在美国调查数据中，姜黄是六种与肝损伤相关的植物里使用最多的一种（9685 名受访者中有 236 人），2023 年发表的 10 例 DILIN 病例中有 5 例住院、1 例死于急性肝衰竭。10 人中有 7 人携带 HLA-B*35:01。
  • Antiplatelet activity raises bleeding risk with warfarin and antiplatelets. Piperine inhibits CYP3A4 broadly, so herb-drug interaction risk with cytotoxics and targeted agents is real.抗血小板活性会增加与华法林和抗血小板药合用时的出血风险。胡椒碱广泛抑制 CYP3A4，因此与细胞毒药物和靶向药之间的相互作用风险是真实的。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose NOT reachable by eating靠吃达不到剂量 Data confidence: Medium数据可信度：中

Turmeric is an ordinary culinary spice, the dried ground rhizome of Curcuma longa, and it carries curcumin at 3.14% by weight, so one level teaspoon delivers 94 mg. Measured against the JECFA/EFSA acceptable daily intake for curcumin of 3 mg/kg body weight (210 mg for a 70 kg adult), a single teaspoon supplies 45% of the ADI, which is a rich dietary source on any normal reading; the earlier TRACE label came from scoring food against a 1,000 mg capsule, which is the dose question and is answered separately below. Turmeric is effectively the only meaningful food source, and commercial curry powder is much weaker. Fresh turmeric rhizome is the same food in unprocessed form and is increasingly sold in UK and US supermarkets, but no verified composition figure for it is available here, so it gets no row.姜黄就是普通的厨房香料，即 Curcuma longa 干燥根茎磨成的粉，其姜黄素含量按重量计为 3.14%，因此一平茶匙可提供 94 mg。以 JECFA/EFSA 为姜黄素设定的每日允许摄入量 3 mg/kg 体重（70 kg 成人为 210 mg）衡量，一茶匙即达到 ADI 的 45%，按任何常规标准都算得上富含来源；此前标为 TRACE，是因为拿食物去对标 1,000 mg 的胶囊剂量，那属于剂量问题，下文单独回答。姜黄实际上是唯一有意义的食物来源，市售咖喱粉的含量要低得多。新鲜姜黄根茎是同一种食物的未加工形态，在英美超市越来越常见，但此处没有经核实的成分数据，故不单列一行。

Rows tagged unconfirmed carry a figure the verification pass could not trace back to its cited source. The number is reported as found; hover the tag for the reason.标记为未核实的行，其数值在核查环节无法追溯到所引来源。数字按原样列出；把鼠标移到标记上可看具体原因。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 A 1,000 mg curcuminoid capsule equals about 21 to 32 g of turmeric powder every day: 32 g counting curcumin only at 3.14% w/w, about 21 g counting all three curcuminoids at roughly 4.7% (a conventional ratio the cited source does not establish). That is 7 to 11 level teaspoons, close to a third of a supermarket spice jar per day, and nobody eats that. A generous curry portion carries 1 to 2 g of turmeric, or 30 to 60 mg of curcumin, and a heavy South Asian intake of 2 to 2.5 g turmeric per day yields 63 to 79 mg of curcumin, so the capsule is about 13 to 16 times a heavy dietary intake on a curcumin basis, and about 8.5 to 11 times if the comparison is made on total curcuminoids. There is no eating route to the dose.一粒 1,000 mg 姜黄素类化合物胶囊相当于每天约 21 至 32 g 姜黄粉：只按 3.14% w/w 的姜黄素计算是 32 g，按三种姜黄素类化合物合计约 4.7% 计算约为 21 g（这个换算比例属惯用值，所引来源并未确立）。折合 7 至 11 平茶匙，接近每天吃掉三分之一瓶超市香料罐，没有人会这么吃。一份量足的咖喱含 1 至 2 g 姜黄，即 30 至 60 mg 姜黄素；南亚地区偏高的摄入量为每天 2 至 2.5 g 姜黄，可得 63 至 79 mg 姜黄素。按姜黄素计，胶囊约为高膳食摄入量的 13 至 16 倍；若按总姜黄素类化合物比较，约为 8.5 至 11 倍。靠吃东西达不到这个剂量。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 This is the single most important form gap in the whole list. Culinary turmeric has no liver-injury signal; 95% curcuminoid extracts, especially those boosted with piperine or reformulated as phytosomes, micelles or nanoparticles, are now a leading identified botanical cause of drug-induced liver injury in US and Australian case series, with a reported HLA-B*35:01 association. The EFSA/JECFA acceptable daily intake for curcumin (E 100) is 3 mg/kg body weight per day, 210 mg for a 70 kg adult: one teaspoon of turmeric in food (94 mg curcumin) sits at 45% of it, while a single 1,000 mg curcuminoid capsule is about five times over it. Concentrated extracts also inhibit CYP3A4 and UGT enzymes and interact with anticoagulants, which food-level turmeric does not. Second caveat cutting the other way: scaling up culinary turmeric is not a safe workaround either, because turmeric powder in some supply chains has been adulterated with lead chromate for colour (well documented in Bangladeshi turmeric), and gram-level daily dosing of spice-grade powder magnifies that exposure.这是整份清单中最重要的形态差异。食用姜黄没有肝损伤信号；95% 姜黄素类提取物，尤其是加胡椒碱增效或改造为植物体（phytosome）、胶束、纳米颗粒的产品，如今在美国和澳大利亚的病例系列中已成为药物性肝损伤的首要已确认植物性病因，并报告与 HLA-B*35:01 相关。EFSA/JECFA 为姜黄素（E 100）设定的每日允许摄入量是每天 3 mg/kg 体重，70 kg 成人为 210 mg：食物中一茶匙姜黄（94 mg 姜黄素）占其 45%，而单粒 1,000 mg 姜黄素类化合物胶囊约为该限值的五倍。浓缩提取物还会抑制 CYP3A4 和 UGT 酶，并与抗凝药发生相互作用，食物剂量的姜黄没有这些问题。反向的第二条提示：把食用姜黄的量放大同样不是安全的替代做法，因为部分供应链的姜黄粉曾被掺入铬酸铅以增色（孟加拉国姜黄有充分记录），每天以克为单位服用香料级粉末会放大这类暴露。

Absorption吸收 Curcumin is close to a worst case for oral absorption: poor solubility, extensive intestinal and hepatic glucuronidation and sulfation, and rapid biliary excretion leave systemic exposure at or below detection limits after dietary amounts. Co-administered piperine 20 mg raised curcumin bioavailability roughly 20-fold in humans (Shoba et al. 1998, PMID 9619120, verified as a 2000% increase), and modern phytosome, micellar and nanoparticle formulations claim 10 to 185-fold increases over unformulated powder. The practical consequence is that milligram equivalence between spice and supplement misleads in both directions: a formulated 500 mg extract can deliver more systemic curcumin than 30 g of raw powder, and the traditional practice of blooming turmeric in hot oil with black pepper is a crude version of the same trick.姜黄素在口服吸收上接近最差情形：溶解度低，在肠道和肝脏大量发生葡萄糖苷酸化与硫酸化，胆汁排泄迅速，摄入膳食量后全身暴露处于或低于检测限。人体试验中同服 20 mg 胡椒碱可使姜黄素生物利用度提高约 20 倍（Shoba 等 1998，PMID 9619120，核实为提高 2000%）；现代植物体、胶束和纳米颗粒制剂声称比未制剂化的粉末高出 10 至 185 倍。实际后果是，香料与补充剂之间按毫克对等的比较在两个方向上都会误导：一份制剂化的 500 mg 提取物进入体循环的姜黄素可能多于 30 g 生粉，而传统上把姜黄与黑胡椒一起在热油中炝香，其实是同一套技巧的粗糙版本。

Data note数据说明 The headline 3.14% curcumin figure, the two USDA portion weights, the per-teaspoon and per-tablespoon arithmetic, the 210 mg ADI and Shoba's 20-fold piperine effect all verified exactly. The curry powder range, the curcumin-to-total-curcuminoid ratio and the FDC ID could not be traced to their cited sources中。核心的 3.14% 姜黄素数值、两个 USDA 分量重量、每茶匙和每汤匙的换算、210 mg ADI 以及 Shoba 的胡椒碱 20 倍效应，全部逐项核实无误。咖喱粉的含量区间、姜黄素与总姜黄素类化合物的比例以及 FDC ID 无法追溯到所引来源。

SKIPMSM (methylsulfonylmethane)MSM（二甲基砜）Grade D证据 D 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Trials used 2 g/d (the 2023 trial) up to 6 g/d (the 2006 pilot). No effective dose is established.试验用量从 2 克/天（2023 年试验）到 6 克/天（2006 年预试验）。没有确立的有效剂量。
Who it is for适用人群No population has a defensible claim.没有任何人群有站得住的理由。

Pros优点

  • A single 88-person trial reported a significant between-group difference in a knee quality-of-life composite score at 12 weeks.一项 88 人的试验报告，12 周时膝关节生活质量综合评分的组间差异显著。
  • Very low toxicity signal at the doses used.在所用剂量下毒性信号极低。

Cons缺点

  • The meta-analysis found 3 randomised trials and 326 patients, of which only ONE studied MSM at all. The other two studied DMSO. Reported pain reduction was a non-significant 6.34 mm on a visual analogue scale.meta 分析共找到 3 项随机试验、326 名患者，其中只有一项真正研究了 MSM，另外两项研究的是 DMSO。报告的疼痛下降为视觉模拟评分 6.34 毫米，不显著。
  • The 2008 systematic review covering 6 studies and 681 osteoarthritis patients found only 52 had ever received MSM in a controlled trial. That is the entire human evidence base.2008 年那篇系统综述涵盖 6 项研究、681 名骨关节炎患者，其中只有 52 人曾在对照试验中接受过 MSM。这就是全部的人体证据基础。
  • It is present in a large share of joint supplements, which inflates the price of combination products for no measured benefit.它出现在相当大比例的关节类产品中，抬高了复方产品的价格，却没有可测量的收益。
  • No characterised drug interactions, largely because almost nobody has looked. No pregnancy or lactation data.没有明确的药物相互作用，主要是因为几乎没有人研究过。没有妊娠和哺乳期数据。

Food sources食物来源

Trace amounts only仅有痕量 Dose NOT reachable by eating靠吃达不到剂量 Data confidence: Low数据可信度：低

TRACE survives as a label, since nobody claims food delivers grams of MSM, but the evidence behind it is void and the entry's food table has been withdrawn in full. Every number in the widely circulated MSM food table (cow's milk 3.30 mg/kg, coffee 1.60, tomato 0.86, alfalfa 0.77, tea 0.30, beer 0.18, Swiss chard 0.18, corn 0.11) comes from Pearson, Dawson & Lackey 1981, which is titled 'Naturally occurring levels of dimethyl sulfoxide in selected fruits, vegetables, grains, and beverages'. It measured DMSO, a different compound; a 2026 review reproduced those eight values under an MSM heading, and the mislabelling has propagated from there. The accurate statement is that the MSM content of ordinary foods is essentially unquantified in the accessible literature. Bulk supplement MSM is manufactured by oxidising DMSO with hydrogen peroxide or nitrogen dioxide and purifying by distillation or crystallisation, so this is functionally a synthetic bulk chemical with an unmeasured natural presence.TRACE（痕量）作为标签仍然成立，没人主张食物能提供克级的 MSM，但支撑它的证据已归零，本条目的食物表整体撤回。广为流传的 MSM 食物表里每一个数字（牛奶 3.30 mg/kg、咖啡 1.60、番茄 0.86、紫花苜蓿 0.77、茶 0.30、啤酒 0.18、瑞士甜菜 0.18、玉米 0.11）都来自 Pearson, Dawson & Lackey 1981，那篇论文的标题是“Naturally occurring levels of dimethyl sulfoxide in selected fruits, vegetables, grains, and beverages”。它测的是 DMSO，一种不同的化合物；2026 年一篇综述把那八个数值搬到了 MSM 的标题下，错误从此扩散。准确的说法是：在可获取的文献中，普通食物的 MSM 含量基本未经定量。散装补剂 MSM 由过氧化氢或二氧化氮氧化 DMSO 制得，再经蒸馏或结晶提纯，所以这实质上是一种散装合成化学品，其天然存在量未被测定。

No food rows: there is no ordinary food that supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有食物条目：没有任何普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 The gap cannot be computed, and the submission's figures (909 kg of milk for a 3 g dose, 1,875 litres of coffee, 450 kg of milk for the 1.5 g low end) are withdrawn because every one of them was built on DMSO measurements. Qualitatively the answer is still no: supplement doses are 1.5 to 6 g/day, no food has been shown to contain MSM at anything approaching that, and no MSM deficiency has ever been described. Anyone quoting a per-cup or per-kilogram MSM figure is quoting a mislabelled DMSO table.差距无法计算，原提交稿的数字（3 g 剂量需 909 kg 牛奶、1,875 升咖啡，1.5 g 低端需 450 kg 牛奶）全部撤回，因为它们都建立在 DMSO 的测定值上。定性的答案依然是否：补剂剂量为 1.5 到 6 g/天，没有任何食物被证明含有接近这一水平的 MSM，也从未有人描述过 MSM 缺乏。凡是引用每杯或每公斤 MSM 数字的人，引用的都是一张贴错标签的 DMSO 表。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Yes, and it is mostly about honesty in marketing. Commercial MSM is made by oxidising DMSO, so it is chemically identical to whatever trace natural molecule exists but industrially produced; purity grades differ (distilled versus crystallised) and residual DMSO or solvent is a real quality variable between brands. The common marketing move of pointing at garlic, onions and brassicas as natural MSM foods is wrong: those foods are rich in allicin, thiosulfinates and glucosinolates, which are different sulfur chemistries, and eating them does not deliver MSM. Dietary sulfur adequacy comes from methionine and cysteine in protein, a separate question entirely. No whole food substitutes for an MSM capsule, and equally there is no evidence anyone is MSM-deficient.有，而且主要关乎营销是否诚实。商品 MSM 由氧化 DMSO 制得，与任何微量天然分子在化学上完全相同，只是工业生产的；纯度等级有差别（蒸馏与结晶），残留 DMSO 或溶剂是品牌之间真实存在的质量变量。常见的营销做法是指着大蒜、洋葱和十字花科蔬菜说它们是天然 MSM 食物，这是错的：那些食物富含大蒜素、硫代亚磺酸酯和硫代葡萄糖苷，属于不同的硫化学，吃它们并不带来 MSM。膳食硫的充足性来自蛋白质中的甲硫氨酸和半胱氨酸，那是另一个问题。没有哪种完整食物能替代一粒 MSM 胶囊，同样也没有证据表明有人缺乏 MSM。

Absorption吸收 Absorption is not the limiting factor. MSM is a small (94 Da), highly water-soluble, uncharged molecule, absorbed close to completely after oral dosing and distributed widely including across the blood-brain barrier, which is why it is detectable in cerebrospinal fluid. Circulating MSM in people who take no supplements comes partly from diet and partly from bacterial and endogenous metabolism of other sulfur compounds. Because uptake is near-complete either way, the food-versus-supplement comparison reduces entirely to dose, and the dose cannot currently be stated for food: the ratios the submission gave (about 1:3,700 per cup of milk, which it rounded to 1:4,000) rest on a DMSO measurement and are withdrawn.吸收不是限制因素。MSM 是小分子（94 Da），水溶性极强且不带电，口服后接近完全吸收并广泛分布，包括跨过血脑屏障，所以在脑脊液中可检出。不服用补剂的人循环中的 MSM，一部分来自饮食，一部分来自细菌和内源对其他硫化合物的代谢。由于两条途径的吸收都接近完全，食物与补剂的比较完全归结为剂量，而食物的剂量目前无法给出：原提交稿给的比例（每杯牛奶约 1:3,700，它四舍五入成 1:4,000）依赖的是 DMSO 的测定值，已撤回。

Data note数据说明 The entire food dataset for this entry was traced to a paper that measured dimethyl sulfoxide rather than dimethyl sulfone, so all seven food rows, all per-portion figures, all percentages of dose and both dose-gap calculations have been removed rather than corrected. The secondary review that relabelled the table is real and correctly cited (PMC13071705), which is precisely how the error travels. No verified quantification of MSM in any ordinary food is available to put in its place低。本条目的整个食物数据集被追溯到一篇测定二甲基亚砜而非二甲基砜的论文，因此七条食物条目、所有每份数值、所有占剂量百分比以及两项剂量差距计算全部删除而非更正。把该表重新贴标的二次综述真实存在且引用正确（PMC13071705），错误恰恰就是这样传播的。目前没有任何经核实的普通食物 MSM 定量数据可以补上。

Dose tested已验证剂量4-12 mg/d in skin trials. EFSA acceptable daily intake is 0.2 mg/kg body weight, so 14 mg/d for a 70 kg adult.皮肤类试验为 4 至 12 毫克/天。EFSA 的每日允许摄入量为 0.2 毫克/公斤体重，70 公斤成人即 14 毫克/天。
Who it is for适用人群Nobody with a demonstrated clinical outcome.没有任何人群有已证实的临床结局获益。

Pros优点

  • Small improvements in skin moisture (ES 0.53) and elasticity (ES 0.77) across 9 oral randomised trials.9 项口服随机试验显示皮肤含水量（ES 0.53）和弹性（ES 0.77）有小幅改善。
  • One oxidative-stress marker, advanced oxidation protein products, fell significantly after exercise.一个氧化应激指标，即晚期氧化蛋白产物，在运动后显著下降。

Cons缺点

  • The core selling point is a test-tube potency ratio, often quoted as 1,000 times coenzyme Q10 at quenching singlet oxygen. That is an in-vitro number with no demonstrated clinical consequence, and it is exactly the kind of assay-derived claim the PAINS critique warns about.它的核心卖点是一个试管里的效力倍数，常被引用为“淬灭单线态氧的能力是辅酶 Q10 的 1000 倍”。那是一个体外数字，没有证明出任何临床后果，而这正是 PAINS 批评所警告的那类由测定衍生出来的说法。
  • Wrinkle depth, the outcome consumers actually buy it for, was NOT significant (-0.26, 95% CI -0.58 to 0.06).皱纹深度，也就是消费者真正为之买单的指标，并不显著（-0.26，95% CI -0.58 至 0.06）。
  • In exercise trials MDA, TBARS, superoxide dismutase, sulfhydryls, creatine kinase and IL-6 were all non-significant, directly contradicting the antioxidant marketing.在运动试验中，MDA、TBARS、超氧化物歧化酶、巯基、肌酸激酶和 IL-6 全部不显著，与其抗氧化营销直接冲突。
  • EFSA noted that children exceed the acceptable daily intake with 8 mg/d supplements, so the common commercial 12 mg dose exceeds the safe intake for a 40 kg adolescent.EFSA 指出，8 毫克/天的补充剂就会让儿童超过每日允许摄入量，因此常见的 12 毫克商业剂量已超过 40 公斤青少年的安全摄入水平。
  • Krill-derived astaxanthin in shellfish allergy. Reported 5-alpha-reductase inhibition is poorly characterised and matters in hormone-sensitive conditions.甲壳类过敏者注意磷虾来源的虾青素。有报告称其抑制 5α-还原酶，特性不明，对激素敏感性疾病有影响。

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose partly reachable靠吃只能部分达到 Data confidence: Medium数据可信度：中

Astaxanthin is genuinely present at milligram levels in ordinary seafood, so this is the strongest food case in the set. Wild sockeye salmon carries 26 to 38 mg per kg of flesh, meaning one 140 g fillet supplies 3.6 to 5.3 mg, the same order of magnitude as a capsule. Several standard sources in the same literature carry no verified figure here and so get no row: salmon roe (ikura and sujiko), wild chinook, pink and chum salmon, Arctic char, red sea bream, and the shell-on preparations (crayfish, small crab, head-on prawns) where the pigment actually concentrates.虾青素确实以毫克级存在于常见海产中，这是本组里食物依据最强的一项。野生红鲑（sockeye）鱼肉含 26 至 38 mg/kg，一片 140 g 的鱼柳可提供 3.6 至 5.3 mg，与一粒胶囊同一数量级。同一批文献中还有若干标准来源此处没有经核实的数值，故不单列：鲑鱼卵（ikura 咸鲑鱼子和 sujiko 筋子）、野生大鳞大麻哈鱼（chinook）、粉鲑（pink salmon）和大麻哈鱼（chum salmon）、北极红点鲑（Arctic char）、真鲷，以及色素实际富集其中的带壳做法（小龙虾、小蟹、带头虾）。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 A 12 mg daily dose, the commonest in the clinical literature, equals 315 to 460 g of wild sockeye salmon every day at 26 to 38 mg/kg, or about 550 g using the cited review's own dietary anchor of 3.6 mg per 165 g portion. From farmed Atlantic salmon it is 1.5 to 2.0 kg per day, from peeled shrimp meat about 1.4 kg, and from whole wet krill 1.2 to 1.5 kg. A single 140 g sockeye fillet already covers 30 to 44% of the dose, which no other entry here manages, so a meaningful fraction is reachable by eating while the full dose is not: sustaining 350 to 500 g of oily fish daily would push past standard advice on methylmercury and persistent organic pollutants.临床文献中最常见的每天 12 mg 剂量，按 26 至 38 mg/kg 计相当于每天吃 315 至 460 g 野生红鲑，若按所引综述自身的膳食参照（每 165 g 一份含 3.6 mg）计算则约为 550 g。换成养殖大西洋鲑是每天 1.5 至 2.0 kg，去壳虾肉约 1.4 kg，整只湿重磷虾 1.2 至 1.5 kg。单是一片 140 g 的红鲑鱼柳就已覆盖该剂量的 30 至 44%，这是此处其他条目都做不到的，所以靠吃可以拿到相当一部分，全量则不行：每天持续吃 350 至 500 g 多脂鱼会突破关于甲基汞和持久性有机污染物的常规建议。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Chemical form differs by source. Salmon astaxanthin is largely free or protein-bound; krill and Haematococcus astaxanthin is esterified with fatty acids; and much supplement and feed astaxanthin is synthetic astaxanthin dimethyldisuccinate, a different stereoisomer mixture from the natural 3S,3'S form. This matters for the safety arithmetic: EFSA's acceptable daily intake of 0.2 mg/kg body weight per day (14 mg for a 70 kg adult, established by the FEEDAP Panel in 2019 and replacing the earlier 0.034 mg/kg) was derived from a rat carcinogenicity study on the synthetic material and then applied to the algal form. On that ADI, a 12 mg capsule is 86% of the limit and sits just under it, doses of about 14 mg and above exceed it, and a 24 mg capsule is roughly 1.7 times over, while a salmon fillet stays well below. A safety review of 87 human studies, including 35 at 12 mg/day or more, found no safety concerns with natural astaxanthin and argues the synthetic-derived ADI should not govern it (Brendler & Williamson, Phytother Res 2019;33(12):3090-3111, PMID 31788888, DOI 10.1002/ptr.6514). One honest twist: the astaxanthin in farmed salmon is itself an added feed pigment, so eating farmed salmon for astaxanthin means eating a supplemented animal.化学形态因来源而异。鲑鱼中的虾青素以游离型或与蛋白结合的形式为主；磷虾和雨生红球藻（Haematococcus）的虾青素与脂肪酸成酯；补充剂和饲料中大量使用的是合成虾青素二甲基二琥珀酸酯，其立体异构体组成与天然的 3S,3'S 型不同。这影响安全性的算法：EFSA 的每日允许摄入量为每天 0.2 mg/kg 体重（70 kg 成人为 14 mg，由 FEEDAP 专家组于 2019 年确定，取代此前的 0.034 mg/kg），该值源自对合成品的大鼠致癌性研究，随后被套用到藻源形态上。按此 ADI，12 mg 胶囊占限值的 86%，略低于限值；约 14 mg 及以上的剂量超出限值；24 mg 胶囊约为限值的 1.7 倍；一片鲑鱼柳则远低于限值。一项覆盖 87 项人体研究（其中 35 项剂量为每天 12 mg 及以上）的安全性综述未发现天然虾青素存在安全性问题，并认为由合成品推导出的 ADI 不应适用于它（Brendler & Williamson, Phytother Res 2019;33(12):3090-3111, PMID 31788888, DOI 10.1002/ptr.6514）。还有一处需要如实指出：养殖鲑鱼里的虾青素本身就是饲料中添加的色素，为了虾青素而吃养殖鲑鱼，等于吃一条已经补充过的动物。

Absorption吸收 Astaxanthin is a lipophilic xanthophyll and absorption depends on fat and micelle formation: uptake from a lipid-based formulation or a fatty meal is severalfold higher than from a dry powder taken fasted, and esterified forms must first be hydrolysed by pancreatic lipase. Overall human bioavailability is low and highly variable (single-digit percentages), which cuts in favour of the food: salmon arrives pre-packaged with its own lipid and a food matrix, so the plasma difference between a 4 mg fillet and a 12 mg dry capsule is smaller than the milligram gap implies.虾青素是亲脂性的叶黄素类色素，吸收依赖脂肪和胶束形成：脂质基质制剂或高脂餐条件下的吸收比空腹服用干粉高数倍，成酯形态还须先由胰脂肪酶水解。人体总体生物利用度低且个体差异很大（个位数百分比），这一点对食物有利：鲑鱼自带脂质和食物基质，所以一片含 4 mg 的鱼柳与一粒 12 mg 干粉胶囊之间的血浆差距，小于毫克数所暗示的差距。

Data note数据说明 Every salmonid figure verified exactly against its source (sockeye 26 to 38 mg/kg, Atlantic 6 to 8, trout 6 and 25, the 165 g / 3.6 mg anchor, retail sockeye 14.2 and coho 7.0 mg/kg), as did the EFSA ADI and the Brendler review. The salmonid values still rest on a compiled review figure, the shrimp span is paywalled and indicative, and the krill row is a wet-weight reconstruction rather than a measured food value中。所有鲑科鱼类的数值都已逐项对照来源核实（红鲑 26 至 38 mg/kg，大西洋鲑 6 至 8，虹鳟 6 和 25，165 g / 3.6 mg 参照，零售红鲑 14.2、银鲑 7.0 mg/kg），EFSA 的 ADI 和 Brendler 综述同样核实无误。鲑科数值仍建立在一份汇编综述的图表数据上，虾的区间在付费墙之后属参考性数据，磷虾那一行是按湿重推算的重建值，并非实测的食物数值。

Pros优点

  • An umbrella review of 11 studies and 41 datasets found small but significant pooled effects on muscle mass (ES 0.21), muscle strength index (0.27) and fat-free mass (0.22).一项涵盖 11 项研究、41 个数据集的伞式综述发现，肌肉质量（ES 0.21）、肌力指数（0.27）和去脂体重（0.22）有小但显著的合并效应。

Cons缺点

  • In trained and competitive athletes it is a flat null across every endpoint. Six randomised trials, n=193: bench press effect size 0.00, leg press 0.09, body mass -0.01, fat-free mass 0.16, fat mass -0.20, all non-significant and described by the authors as trivial. Results were unchanged by dose, duration, training level or dietary co-intervention.在训练有素和竞技运动员中，所有终点上都是彻底的阴性。6 项随机试验，n=193：卧推效应量 0.00，腿举 0.09，体重 -0.01，去脂体重 0.16，脂肪量 -0.20，全部不显著，作者形容为微不足道。剂量、时长、训练水平或饮食联合干预都不改变结果。

Food sources食物来源

No food source, manufactured无食物来源，人工合成 Dose NOT reachable by eating靠吃达不到剂量 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

HMB (beta-hydroxy-beta-methylbutyrate) is manufactured, by halogenation of diacetone alcohol with sodium hypobromite or by esterification routes from diacetone alcohol and acetic acid derivatives, at plant scales around 1.5 tonnes per month, with microbial routes emerging (Galactomyces reessii 29.0 g/L, engineered E. coli 17.7 g/L). No food composition database carries an HMB value, and the frequently repeated claim that it occurs in catfish, grapefruit and alfalfa has no quantified composition analysis behind it; an independent literature query returned five papers, none with a food figure. Endogenous production of 0.3-0.4 g/day in healthy adults is metabolism rather than a dietary source, so the earlier TRACE label overstated the dietary presence.HMB（β-羟基-β-甲基丁酸）是工业合成的，路线包括用次溴酸钠对双丙酮醇进行卤化，或由双丙酮醇与乙酸衍生物经酯化制得，工厂规模约每月 1.5 吨，微生物路线正在兴起（Galactomyces reessii 29.0 g/L，工程化 E. coli 17.7 g/L）。没有任何食物成分数据库收录 HMB 数值，而反复流传的“存在于鲶鱼、葡萄柚和紫花苜蓿中”的说法背后没有定量成分分析；一次独立的文献检索返回五篇论文，均无食物数值。健康成年人每天 0.3-0.4 g 的内源生成属于代谢过程，算不上膳食来源，所以此前的 TRACE（微量）标签高估了它在膳食中的存在。

No food rows: there is no ordinary food that supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有食物条目：没有任何普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 There is no food HMB figure to work from, so the gap has to be argued through the precursor. About 80% of leucine is directed to protein synthesis, and approximately 5-10% of alpha-ketoisocaproate, the leucine transamination product, is converted to HMB; treating that 5-10% as a leucine-to-HMB yield is generous, so the arithmetic below is a ceiling. Even on that generous reading, 3 g of HMB implies about 60 g of leucine per day, which is 2.6 kg of cooked chicken breast at 2.33 g leucine per 100 g, carrying roughly 800 g of protein. At the optimistic 10% figure it is 30 g of leucine, about 1.3 kg of cooked breast and 400 g of protein. Measured endogenous output in healthy adults is only 0.3-0.4 g/day, 8 to 20 times below the 3-6 g/day used in trials, and eating more protein or leucine does not move it, because the bottleneck is the branched-chain pathway rather than the intake.没有食物 HMB 数值可用，只能通过前体来论证这个差距。约 80% 的亮氨酸被导向蛋白质合成，亮氨酸转氨产物 α-酮异己酸中大约 5-10% 转化为 HMB；把这 5-10% 当作亮氨酸到 HMB 的产率已经很宽松，所以下面的算术是一个上限。即便按这种宽松读法，3 g HMB 也意味着每天约 60 g 亮氨酸，按熟鸡胸每 100 g 含 2.33 g 亮氨酸计算是 2.6 kg 熟鸡胸，随之带来约 800 g 蛋白质。按乐观的 10% 计算是 30 g 亮氨酸，约 1.3 kg 熟鸡胸和 400 g 蛋白质。健康成年人实测的内源产量只有 0.3-0.4 g/天，比试验所用的 3-6 g/天低 8 到 20 倍，多吃蛋白质或亮氨酸也无法提高，因为瓶颈是支链氨基酸通路的容量，摄入量本身并不构成限制。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 The supplement is a manufactured molecule and not a food extract, so there is no whole-food-versus-extract comparison to make and no reason to describe HMB as something a diet can supply. Regulatory reviews treat 3-6 g/day as generally safe while noting that no international consensus on an optimal dose exists. The one form question that matters commercially is calcium HMB monohydrate versus free-acid HMB, which differ in absorption kinetics rather than in origin. Primary source for the manufacturing, endogenous production and conversion figures: Zhou S, Liu G, Wang Z, Lei Z, Chen W, Wang C, Foods 2025;14(8):1294, PMID 40282696, DOI 10.3390/foods14081294.这种补充剂是工业合成的分子，并非食物提取物，因此没有整食与提取物的比较可做，也没有理由把 HMB 描述成饮食能够提供的东西。监管评审把 3-6 g/天视为总体安全，同时指出最佳剂量尚无国际共识。商业上唯一有意义的形式问题是一水 HMB 钙与游离酸型 HMB 之别，两者的差异在吸收动力学上，来源相同。制造工艺、内源生成和转化率数据的原始来源：Zhou S, Liu G, Wang Z, Lei Z, Chen W, Wang C, Foods 2025;14(8):1294, PMID 40282696, DOI 10.3390/foods14081294。

Absorption吸收 There is no food form whose absorption can be compared, so the only meaningful statement is about the pathway. Dietary leucine is not a usable precursor at supplement scale: about 80% of leucine goes to protein synthesis, and roughly 5-10% of alpha-ketoisocaproate, the leucine transamination product, is converted to HMB, which is why raising protein or leucine intake lifts endogenous HMB only marginally and total endogenous output stays at 0.3-0.4 g/day (DOI 10.3390/foods14081294). Between the two supplement forms, free-acid HMB is reported to reach peak plasma concentration faster and higher than calcium HMB monohydrate, which is the main practical bioavailability distinction; both bypass the leucine pathway entirely, which is precisely why the supplement exists.不存在可供比较吸收的食物形式，所以唯一有意义的说法关于通路本身。在补充剂的量级上，膳食亮氨酸不是可用的前体：约 80% 的亮氨酸走向蛋白质合成，亮氨酸转氨产物 α-酮异己酸中约 5-10% 转化为 HMB，这就是提高蛋白质或亮氨酸摄入只能让内源 HMB 略有上升、内源总产量始终停在 0.3-0.4 g/天的原因（DOI 10.3390/foods14081294）。两种补充剂形式之间，据报告游离酸型 HMB 比一水 HMB 钙达峰更快、峰值更高，这是实际中主要的生物利用度区别；两者都完全绕开亮氨酸通路，这正是这类补充剂存在的理由。

The item has no food rows because no defensible food figure exists高。五项制造与内源生成数据全部对照 Foods 2025;14(8):1294 逐字确认，亮氨酸路线的算术重新推导并成立，而“没有数据库收录 HMB 数值”以及“鲶鱼、葡萄柚、紫花苜蓿的说法缺乏定量依据”这两条否定性论断经过独立的对抗式检验仍然站得住。本项没有食物行，因为不存在站得住脚的食物数值。

  • It is the strongest example in this document of a product that survived its own definitive trials. GEM randomised 3,069 older adults to 240 mg/d for a median 6.1 years: all-cause dementia HR 1.12 (0.94-1.33), Alzheimer disease HR 1.16 (0.97-1.39). The point estimates are above 1.它是本文中“在自己的决定性试验之后依然活着”的最强例子。GEM 把 3069 名老年人随机到 240 毫克/天，中位随访 6.1 年：全因痴呆 HR 1.12（0.94-1.33），阿尔茨海默病 HR 1.16（0.97-1.39）。点估计值都在 1 以上。

A meta-analysis of 18 trials in 1,985 adults found no significant effect on platelet aggregation or coagulation parameters, but case reports of bleeding exist and stopping before elective surgery is prudent.出血的问题确实存在争议，而非已有定论。一项 18 项试验、1985 名成人的 meta 分析未发现对血小板聚集或凝血指标有显著影响，但出血的个案报告确实存在，择期手术前停用是稳妥做法。

Food sources食物来源

From a plant not eaten as food来自不作食物食用的植物 Dose NOT reachable by eating靠吃达不到剂量 Data confidence: Medium数据可信度：中

The supplement is a concentrated leaf extract, and ginkgo leaf is not a food: it is processed with acetone-water into a standardised extract, of which EGb 761 is the reference, at a drug-to-extract ratio of 35-67:1 containing 22-27% flavone glycosides and 5-7% terpene lactones (2.8-3.4% ginkgolides A, B and C plus 2.6-3.2% bilobalide) with ginkgolic acids held below 5 ppm. The same species does have a real food form, and this is what a flat NOT_FOOD label conceals: ginkgo NUTS are eaten in Japanese chawanmushi, Chinese congee and Korean dishes, and they are chemically a different proposition from the leaf. Seeds carry ginkgotoxin (4'-O-methylpyridoxine and its 5'-glucoside), a vitamin B6 antagonist, at total mature-stage contents of 249-296 ug/g measured across three Chinese samples (249.30, 295.62 and 267.85 ug/g; Gong H et al., J Agric Food Chem 2018;66(30):7916-7922, PMID 29975518). Seeds do contain flavonoids and terpene trilactones occur in several tissues, but nothing in the seed approaches the 24%/6% standardised profile of a 50:1 leaf extract, so the edible organ does not supply the medicinal one.补充剂是浓缩的叶提取物，而银杏叶不是食物：它用丙酮-水体系加工成标准化提取物，EGb 761 是其参照品，药材与提取物比为 35-67:1，含 22-27% 黄酮苷和 5-7% 萜类内酯（2.8-3.4% 银杏内酯 A、B、C 加 2.6-3.2% 白果内酯），银杏酸控制在 5 ppm 以下。同一物种确实有真实的食物形式，这也是笼统的 NOT_FOOD 标签会掩盖的事情：白果（银杏种子）出现在日本茶碗蒸、中国粥品和韩国菜里，它在化学上与叶完全是另一回事。种子含银杏毒素（ginkgotoxin，即 4'-O-甲基吡哆醇及其 5'-葡萄糖苷），一种维生素 B6 拮抗剂，三份中国样品在成熟期测得的总含量为 249-296 µg/g（249.30、295.62 和 267.85 µg/g；Gong H 等，J Agric Food Chem 2018;66(30):7916-7922, PMID 29975518）。种子确实含黄酮类，萜类三内酯也存在于多个组织中，但种子里没有任何成分接近 50:1 叶提取物 24%/6% 的标准化谱型，所以可食的器官无法提供药用的那个器官。

No food rows: there is no ordinary food that supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有食物条目：没有任何普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 Clinical dosing is 120-240 mg/day of EGb 761. At a 35-67:1 drug-to-extract ratio that corresponds to 4.2-16 g of dried ginkgo leaf per day, and dried leaf is not something people eat; a leaf tea extracts only part of the terpene lactones and none of the concentration. Via the edible nut the gap cannot be closed at all, because the nut does not carry the leaf profile, and attempting it would be dangerous rather than merely futile: acute poisoning has been reported after 10-50 cooked seeds at one sitting, Hong Kong's Centre for Food Safety advises no more than 10 kernels a day for adults and three for children, and cooking does not destroy ginkgotoxin because it is heat-stable. Adult intoxication with seizures is documented (PMC7007935).临床用量为 EGb 761 120-240 mg/天。按 35-67:1 的药材提取物比，相当于每天 4.2-16 g 干银杏叶，而干叶不是人们会吃的东西；叶茶只能提取出一部分萜类内酯，也完全没有浓缩效果。走可食用的白果这条路，差距根本无法弥补，因为白果不含叶的成分谱，而且尝试这么做是危险的，并非只是徒劳：一次吃 10-50 颗熟白果已有急性中毒报告，香港食物安全中心建议成人每天不超过 10 颗、儿童不超过 3 颗，而烹煮不能破坏银杏毒素，因为它耐热。成人中毒伴惊厥已有记录（PMC7007935）。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Two separate caveats, and both cut against food substitution. First, the safe food (the nut) and the studied medicine (the leaf extract) share no active profile; a bowl of ginkgo-nut congee is not a low dose of EGb 761. Second, the food itself has a hard ceiling: ginkgotoxin blocks pyridoxal-5'-phosphate-dependent enzymes including glutamate decarboxylase, so excess intake causes vomiting, irritability and convulsions, with children at much higher risk. Ginkgotoxin is present in leaf tissue as well, at far lower levels than in seed, and in a typical standardised leaf extract it sits below a 9 ppm limit of detection (Planta Med 2009, PMID 19288402; Toxicon 2021, PMID 34425140; J Nat Prod 2014, PMID 24432981); that 9 ppm figure supports the manufacturing argument better than the false absence claim it replaces. On the extract side, the concentration step is what makes standardisation possible and also what concentrates the hazards manufacturers must strip out: ginkgolic acids are strongly allergenic and are capped at 5 ppm, and unstandardised or adulterated ginkgo products (rutin or quercetin spiking to hit a flavonoid assay) are a recurring market problem. Ginkgo extract also inhibits platelet aggregation and interacts with anticoagulants, and lowers efavirenz and some other drug levels through CYP induction.这里有两条独立的警告，都不利于用食物替代。第一，安全的食物（白果）和被研究的药物（叶提取物）没有共同的活性谱；一碗白果粥不是小剂量的 EGb 761。第二，这个食物本身有硬性上限：银杏毒素会阻断依赖 5'-磷酸吡哆醛的酶，包括谷氨酸脱羧酶，因此摄入过量会引起呕吐、易激惹和抽搐，儿童风险高得多。银杏毒素在叶组织中同样存在，水平远低于种子，在典型的标准化叶提取物中低于 9 ppm 的检出限（Planta Med 2009, PMID 19288402；Toxicon 2021, PMID 34425140；J Nat Prod 2014, PMID 24432981）；这个 9 ppm 的数字比它所取代的“叶中不含”的错误说法更能支持工艺层面的论证。提取物一侧，浓缩这一步既让标准化成为可能，也把厂家必须去除的危害一起浓缩了：银杏酸致敏性强，限量为 5 ppm，而未标准化或掺假的银杏产品（用芦丁或槲皮素掺入以凑够黄酮测定值）是市场上反复出现的问题。银杏提取物还抑制血小板聚集，与抗凝药有相互作用，并通过诱导 CYP 降低依非韦伦等一些药物的血药浓度。

Absorption吸收 The two marker classes behave completely differently. Terpene lactones (ginkgolides A and B, bilobalide) are small, reasonably lipophilic and well absorbed after oral dosing of the standardised extract. The flavonol glycosides are not absorbed intact: gut microbiota hydrolyse them to quercetin, kaempferol and isorhamnetin aglycones, which are then heavily glucuronidated and sulfated, so plasma concentrations of the labelled compounds are very low and highly variable between people. This is the practical reason a leaf infusion is not a weak extract: hot water recovers a modest and inconsistent share of the terpene lactones, and the flavonoid fraction ends up as conjugated metabolites regardless. For the nut, the compound with real oral kinetics is ginkgotoxin, which is absorbed efficiently and has been measured in the serum of poisoning patients.两类标志物的行为完全不同。萜类内酯（银杏内酯 A 和 B、白果内酯）分子小、亲脂性适中，口服标准化提取物后吸收良好。黄酮醇糖苷不会以原形吸收：肠道菌群把它们水解为槲皮素、山奈酚和异鼠李素苷元，随后大量葡萄糖醛酸化和硫酸化，所以标签成分的血浆浓度很低且个体间差异很大。这正是叶泡水不能算作弱提取物的实际原因：热水只回收出一部分萜类内酯，比例还不稳定，而黄酮组分无论如何最终都变成结合型代谢物。对白果来说，真正有口服动力学意义的化合物是银杏毒素，它吸收效率高，并已在中毒患者血清中被测出。

Data note数据说明 The EGb 761 specification and the derived 4.2-16 g/day dried-leaf equivalent were verified, as was the ginkgotoxin poisoning literature. Two of the entry's original factual claims failed verification and were corrected: the seed ginkgotoxin lower bound and the assertion that ginkgotoxin is absent from the leaf. A separate seed range of 170-404 ug/g could not be traced to the cited source and has been dropped rather than restated中。EGb 761 的规格及由此推出的 4.2-16 g/天干叶等效量均已核实，银杏毒素中毒文献同样核实。本条目原有的两项事实性说法未通过核查并已更正：种子银杏毒素的下限，以及银杏毒素不存在于叶中的断言。另一个 170-404 µg/g 的种子范围无法追溯到所引来源，已删除而未重述。

References:文献： GEM DeKosky PMID 19017911; GuidAge Vellas PMID 22959217; Cochrane Wieland PMID 41641880
SKIPValerian缬草Grade D证据 D 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Roughly 300-600 mg of extract 30-120 minutes before bed. No effective dose is established.睡前 30 至 120 分钟服提取物约 300 至 600 毫克。没有确立的有效剂量。
Who it is for适用人群On present evidence, nobody reliably.按现有证据，没有可靠的适用人群。

Pros优点

  • The umbrella review characterises it as having a good safety profile, which is the strongest positive statement the evidence supports.伞式综述认为它安全性良好，这是现有证据能支持的最积极的说法。
  • The 2006 review found a statistically significant benefit on a dichotomous improved-sleep outcome, relative risk 1.8 (1.2-2.9).2006 年那篇综述在“睡眠改善”这个二分类结局上发现统计学显著获益，相对风险 1.8（1.2-2.9）。

Cons缺点

  • The 2006 authors reported publication bias, considerable heterogeneity and variable preparations in the same paper that produced the positive number. The positive number does not survive its own caveats.2006 年的作者在得出那个阳性数字的同一篇论文里，报告了发表偏倚、相当大的异质性和制剂不一致。那个阳性数字扛不住它自己的限定条件。
  • The 2024 umbrella review of 8 systematic reviews concluded there is NO evidence of efficacy for the treatment of insomnia, with subjective improvements not corroborated by objective measures.2024 年那篇涵盖 8 篇系统综述的伞式综述结论是：没有证据表明它对失眠有效，主观改善没有被客观指标印证。
  • The AASM guideline suggests clinicians NOT use valerian for sleep-onset or sleep-maintenance insomnia.美国睡眠医学会指南建议临床不要用缬草治疗入睡困难或睡眠维持障碍。
  • Additive sedation with benzodiazepines, Z-drugs, barbiturates, opioids, antihistamines and alcohol. Case reports of hepatotoxicity exist, mostly with multi-herb combination products.与苯二氮类、Z 类药物、巴比妥类、阿片类、抗组胺药和酒精有叠加的镇静作用。有肝毒性个案报告，多见于多草药复方产品。

Food sources食物来源

From a plant not eaten as food来自不作食物食用的植物 Dose NOT reachable by eating靠吃达不到剂量 Data confidence: Medium数据可信度：中

Valerian is the root and rhizome of Valeriana officinalis, a European perennial. It is not a food in any cuisine; it is a bitter, strongly odorous drug taken as a tea, tincture or dried-extract capsule. The constituents credited with the sedative effect, valerenic acid and its relatives plus the flavonoids 6-methylapigenin, hesperidin and linarin, are found in Valeriana species and nowhere in the food supply. Valerian root has been used at low levels as a flavouring in some beverages, which puts trace amounts into a few products, and those are flavour levels, orders of magnitude below anything sedative. Nothing you would call a food supplies valerenic acid.缬草是欧洲多年生植物 Valeriana officinalis 的根和根茎。它在任何菜系里都不是食物；它是一种味苦、气味强烈的药材，以茶、酊剂或干提取物胶囊的形式服用。被认为产生镇静作用的成分，缬草酸（valerenic acid）及其同系物，加上黄酮类 6-methylapigenin、橙皮苷（hesperidin）和 linarin，只见于缬草属植物，在食物供应链中没有。缬草根曾以低水平用作某些饮料的香味成分，这让少数产品中含有微量，那属于香料级用量，比任何有镇静作用的量低几个数量级。称得上食物的东西没有一种能提供缬草酸。

No food rows: there is no ordinary food that supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有食物条目：没有任何普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 Typical use is 400-900 mg of dried root extract before bed, or 2-3 g of dried root as an infusion. A quality target of at least 3 mg/g valerenic acid in the dried root has been recommended for commercial material and marketed extracts are sold around 0.8% valerenic acid, so a night's dose is roughly 3-8 mg of valerenic acid. No food at any portion size supplies measurable valerenic acid, so there is no achievable eating quantity to compute. The gap is total rather than large.典型用法是睡前 400-900 mg 干根提取物，或 2-3 g 干根泡饮。商业原料的质量目标建议干根中缬草酸不低于 3 mg/g，市售提取物按约 0.8% 缬草酸销售，所以一晚的剂量大致相当于 3-8 mg 缬草酸。任何份量的食物都不能提供可测量的缬草酸，所以没有可以计算的进食量。这里的差距是彻底的缺失，不是一个大倍数。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Valerian is the textbook example of a herb where the preparation determines the chemistry. Valerenic acid concentrations fall significantly during storage, with the greatest loss at 30 C in low humidity (Food Chemistry 2009, changes in valerenic acid content of valerian root during long-term storage), so an old capsule and a fresh one are different products. Valepotriates present in some preparations are unstable and degrade to baldrinals, and aqueous versus ethanolic extraction recovers quite different fractions, which is one reason valerian trials are so inconsistent. Practical cautions: additive sedation with alcohol, benzodiazepines and antihistamines; occasional paradoxical stimulation; rare hepatotoxicity reports, usually in multi-herb products. A valerian tea and a standardised extract capsule are not interchangeable at the same nominal gram amount.缬草是“制备方式决定化学成分”的教科书式例子。缬草酸浓度在储存期间明显下降，在 30 C 低湿条件下损失最大（Food Chemistry 2009, changes in valerenic acid content of valerian root during long-term storage），所以一瓶放久的胶囊和一瓶新的是不同的产品。某些制剂中的缬草素（valepotriates）不稳定，会降解为 baldrinals；水提和乙醇提取回收的组分差别很大，这也是缬草临床试验结果如此不一致的原因之一。实用注意事项：与酒精、苯二氮类和抗组胺药有叠加镇静作用；偶见反常性兴奋；有罕见的肝毒性报告，通常出现在多草药复方产品中。同样标注克数的缬草茶和标准化提取物胶囊并不能互换。

Absorption吸收 Human data are limited. Valerenic acid is detectable in plasma after oral dosing with a short half-life of roughly one to two hours, which fits its use as a bedtime agent rather than a daytime one, and the flavonoid constituents undergo extensive glucuronidation. Because there is no food form there is no food-matrix comparison; the meaningful variable is extraction, since valerenic acid is lipophilic and is recovered far better by ethanol than by a water infusion, so a tea delivers a small and poorly characterised fraction of what a labelled milligram amount of extract implies.人体数据有限。口服后血浆中可检出缬草酸，半衰期约一到两小时，这符合它作为睡前用药而非日间用药的定位；黄酮类成分会经历大量葡萄糖醛酸化。由于没有食物形式，也就没有食物基质的比较可做；有意义的变量是提取方式，缬草酸亲脂，乙醇的回收率远高于水浸，所以一杯茶提供的量只是标注毫克数的提取物所暗示量的一小部分，而且难以表征。

Data note数据说明 The NOT_FOOD classification was challenged and upheld and the valerenic-acid dose arithmetic (3-8 mg per night) was verified as correct. The 3 mg/g quality target and the 0.8% extract figure each rest on a single secondary citation, and the storage-stability claim was not individually verified in the numeric pass中。NOT_FOOD 分类经质疑后维持，缬草酸剂量的算术（每晚 3-8 mg）核实无误。3 mg/g 的质量目标和 0.8% 的提取物含量各自只有一条二手引用支撑，储存稳定性的说法在数值核查中未逐项验证。

Who it is for适用人群Possibly people with subjective mental fatigue, on evidence too weak to justify confidence.可能适用于有主观精神疲劳的人，但证据弱到不足以让人有信心。

Cons缺点

  • The systematic review screened 206 articles, included 11 trials, and found that ALL of them exhibit either a high risk of bias or reporting flaws that hinder assessment of their true effect. No two studies reported the same outcome, so meta-analysis was impossible.那篇系统综述筛查了 206 篇文章，纳入 11 项试验，发现全部试验都存在高偏倚风险，或存在妨碍评估其真实效应的报告缺陷。没有任何两项研究报告了相同的结局，因此无法做 meta 分析。
  • Only 2 of 6 physical-fatigue trials were positive.六项体力疲劳试验中只有两项阳性。
  • The premium adaptogen positioning has essentially no regulatory-grade support. EFSA has authorised no health claim.高价的“适应原”定位基本没有监管级别的支持。EFSA 没有批准任何健康声称。
  • No upper limit can be stated because dose-ranging and toxicity data do not exist. Theoretical additive serotonergic effects with SSRIs, SNRIs and MAOIs, and activation risk in bipolar disorder.无法给出上限，因为剂量探索和毒性数据都不存在。理论上与 SSRI、SNRI 和 MAOI 有叠加的 5-羟色胺效应，双相障碍者有躁狂激活风险。

Food sources食物来源

From a plant not eaten as food来自不作食物食用的植物 Dose NOT reachable by eating靠吃达不到剂量 Data confidence: Medium数据可信度：中

The supplement is the rhizome and root of Rhodiola rosea (roseroot), an arctic-alpine succulent in the Crassulaceae, standardised on rosavins (rosavin, rosin, rosarin) and salidroside. The rhizome is a folk-medicine drug of Scandinavia and Russia and is not eaten as food. The plant is not entirely outside the food record: young leaves and shoots have been eaten raw or cooked like spinach and stems cooked like asparagus in Greenland, Alaska and northern North America, and Inuit use mixed leaves and buds with marine fat. That food use involves the aerial parts while rosavins are rhizome constituents, and composition data for the edible shoots are sparse, so the culinary history does not translate into a dietary source of the marker compounds. Rosavins are also close to unique to R. rosea, which is why species substitution is such a persistent problem.补充剂用的是红景天（Rhodiola rosea，roseroot）的根茎和根，它是景天科的一种北极高山肉质植物，以 rosavins（rosavin、rosin、rosarin）和红景天苷（salidroside）为标准化指标。这个根茎是斯堪的纳维亚和俄罗斯的民间药材，不作为食物食用。这种植物并非完全不见于食物记录：在格陵兰、阿拉斯加和北美北部，嫩叶和嫩芽被生食或像菠菜一样煮食，茎则像芦笋一样烹煮，因纽特人会把叶和芽混着海生动物脂肪一起吃。那种食用涉及的是地上部分，而 rosavins 是根茎成分，加上可食嫩芽的成分数据很少，所以这段饮食史无法转化为标志物成分的膳食来源。rosavins 还几乎只见于 R. rosea，这正是物种替代问题长期存在的原因。

No food rows: there is no ordinary food that supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有食物条目：没有任何普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 Typical dosing is 200-600 mg/day of extract standardised to 3% rosavins and 1% salidroside (the SHR-5 pattern), roughly 6-18 mg rosavins and 2-6 mg salidroside per day. The dried-rhizome equivalent depends entirely on the content assumed, and the 0.01-3.08% rosavin / 0.07-2.91% salidroside range cited here is COMMERCIAL PRODUCT content rather than measured rhizome, so raw-material content is not established from that source. Stating the assumption explicitly: at 1-3% rosavins, 0.2-1.8 g of dried rhizome carries a daily dose; at 0.1-0.5%, 1.2-18 g; at the 0.01% floor of the cited range, 60-180 g. The submission's flat 0.5-2 g figure silently assumed the top of the range and is optimistic by up to two orders of magnitude. On any assumption this is a herbal dose of a root and no food supplies it, and the edible young shoots cannot be costed at all because the composition work is on rhizome material.典型用量为 200-600 mg/天的提取物，标准化到 3% rosavins 和 1% salidroside（SHR-5 模式），约合每天 6-18 mg rosavins 和 2-6 mg salidroside。干根茎的等效量完全取决于假定的含量，而这里引用的 0.01-3.08% rosavin 与 0.07-2.91% salidroside 范围是市售成品的含量，不是实测的根茎含量，因此原料含量无法由该来源确定。把假定明确写出来：按 1-3% rosavins 计，0.2-1.8 g 干根茎含一日剂量；按 0.1-0.5% 计为 1.2-18 g；按所引范围的下限 0.01% 计为 60-180 g。原稿一律给 0.5-2 g，暗中采用了范围上限，乐观程度最多达两个数量级。无论采用哪个假定，这都是一种根类草药的剂量，没有食物能提供；可食的嫩芽则根本无法折算，因为成分研究做的是根茎材料。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Rhodiola has an unusually bad identity record. An analysis of US-market Rhodiola supplements found rosavin and salidroside contents ranging from 0.01% to 3.08% and 0.07% to 2.91% respectively, with substantial departures from label claims, alongside heavy metal and pesticide residue screening (The quality and safety of Rhodiola rosea supplements on the U.S. market, PLoS One 2026, PMC12810810, verified). Those are finished-product figures, not raw-material figures, a distinction the submission blurred. Rhodiola crenulata is a common substitute; it contains salidroside but little or no rosavin, so a product standardised only on salidroside can be a different species. Wild R. rosea is under harvesting pressure and CITES-listed in Appendix II. Field material varies enormously by clone and site, with inter-clonal variation of 92.8% reported for salidroside in Norwegian collections, so growing region and harvest season change the product more than the label does.红景天的品种真实性记录尤其糟糕。一项对美国市场红景天补充剂的分析发现，rosavin 含量在 0.01% 到 3.08% 之间，salidroside 在 0.07% 到 2.91% 之间，与标签声称有很大偏差，同时还做了重金属和农药残留筛查（The quality and safety of Rhodiola rosea supplements on the U.S. market, PLoS One 2026, PMC12810810，已核实）。这些是成品数据，不是原料数据，原稿把这一区别模糊掉了。Rhodiola crenulata（大花红景天）是常见的替代品，它含 salidroside 但几乎不含 rosavin，所以只按 salidroside 标准化的产品可能是另一个物种。野生 R. rosea 面临采挖压力，已列入 CITES 附录二。田间材料随克隆株和产地差异极大，挪威采集材料中 salidroside 的克隆间变异达到 92.8%，因此产地和采收季节对产品的影响比标签更大。

Absorption吸收 Salidroside is absorbed rapidly and hydrolysed to tyrosol, and rosavins are cinnamyl glycosides subject to gut microbial deglycosylation, so plasma exposure reflects metabolites rather than the labelled markers; controlled human pharmacokinetic data are limited and no reliable percentage figure can be given. Because there is no food form, the practical absorption question is the extraction solvent: hydroalcoholic extracts recover both rosavins and salidroside, while water infusions of the root recover the glycosides preferentially. Chewing raw shoots, the only genuinely food-like route, has never been characterised.salidroside 吸收迅速并水解为酪醇（tyrosol），rosavins 属肉桂醇糖苷，会被肠道菌群脱糖基，所以血浆暴露反映的是代谢产物，而不是标签上的标志物；受控的人体药代动力学数据有限，无法给出可靠的百分比数值。由于没有食物形式，实际的吸收问题变成了提取溶剂：水醇提取物能同时回收 rosavins 和 salidroside，而根的水浸提液优先回收糖苷。咀嚼生嫩芽是唯一真正接近食物的途径，它从未被表征过。

Data note数据说明 The NOT_FOOD classification was challenged and upheld and the cited biomarker ranges were verified as real and on-topic, but those ranges are commercial-product contents that the submission reused as raw-material contents, so the dried-rhizome dose equivalent is now given as a wide assumption-dependent range rather than a figure. No composition data exist for the edible aerial shoots, so that route cannot be quantified at all中。NOT_FOOD 分类经质疑后维持，所引的标志物含量范围也核实为真实且切题，但那些范围是市售成品的含量，原稿把它们当成了原料含量，因此干根茎的剂量等效量现在给出的是一个依赖假定的宽区间，不再是一个确定数字。可食用的地上嫩芽没有成分数据，这条途径完全无法量化。

SKIPLion's mane (Hericium erinaceus)猴头菇Grade C证据 C 级
Dose tested已验证剂量3,000 mg/d of dried fruiting body for 16 weeks in the pivotal trial. Fruiting body and mycelium contain different compounds and are not interchangeable.关键试验为干燥子实体 3000 毫克/天、持续 16 周。子实体与菌丝体所含成分不同，不可互换。
