Pros优点

  • It is a food mushroom with a long history of dietary use, so the baseline safety expectation is reasonable.它是一种食用菌，有长期的食用历史，因此对其基础安全性的预期是合理的。
  • In the pivotal trial, dementia screening scores improved at weeks 8, 12 and 16.在关键试验中，痴呆筛查评分在第 8、12 和 16 周有所改善。

Cons缺点

  • The pivotal trial randomised 30 Japanese adults, 15 per arm, to a dementia SCREENING scale. Scores then fell significantly 4 weeks after stopping. There is no meta-analysis and no trial with a hard endpoint.关键试验把 30 名日本成人随机分为每组 15 人，用的是痴呆筛查量表。停药 4 周后评分显著回落。没有 meta 分析，也没有任何硬终点试验。
  • The only other cited trial is explicitly self-described as a pilot.另一项被引用的试验，作者自己明确称之为预试验。
  • This is one of the largest gaps between marketing volume and evidence volume in the entire document. The neurogenesis claim rests on in-vitro nerve growth factor stimulation.这是全文中营销声量与证据体量差距最大的条目之一。所谓“促进神经再生”建立在体外刺激神经生长因子的基础上。
  • Most retail products do not disclose whether they contain fruiting body or mycelium, so you cannot match the product to the trial.多数零售产品不披露所用是子实体还是菌丝体，因此你无法把手上的产品对应到试验里。

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose reachable by eating靠吃可以达到剂量 Data confidence: Low数据可信度：低

This is the one entry whose supplement organism is an ordinary culinary food. Hericium erinaceus is sold fresh in Asian markets and increasingly in Western ones, cooked like scallops or shredded into stir-fries, and it is the same organism used to make the fruiting-body supplement. The best-known human trial used no exotic extract: Mori and colleagues gave 3 g/day of dried Hericium powder, four 250 mg tablets containing 96% dry powder three times daily, to older adults with mild cognitive impairment (Phytother Res 2009;23(3):367-372, PMID 18844328, verified). RICH describes this one species in its several presentations (fresh, dried powder, dried slices), which are one food rather than several independent sources. The important limit is by tissue: the newer and more mechanistically interesting trials use erinacine-A-enriched MYCELIUM, and no amount of the edible fruiting body supplies erinacines. Other edible Hericium species exist, notably H. coralloides and H. americanum, which matters here because the composition paper the submission cited was about H. coralloides rather than H. erinaceus.这是唯一一条补充剂原生物本身就是普通食用食材的条目。Hericium erinaceus（猴头菇）在亚洲市场有鲜品出售，西方市场也越来越多，做法像干贝一样烹调或撕成丝炒菜，它与制作子实体补充剂用的是同一种生物。最著名的人体试验没有用什么特殊提取物：Mori 等人给轻度认知障碍的老年人每天 3 g 猴头菇干粉，即每次四片 250 mg（含 96% 干粉）、每天三次（Phytother Res 2009;23(3):367-372, PMID 18844328，已核实）。RICH 描述的是这一个物种的几种形态（鲜品、干粉、干片），它们属于同一种食物，并非几个独立来源。重要的限制按组织划分：更新、机制上更有意思的那些试验用的是富含 erinacine A 的菌丝体，而供食用的子实体无论吃多少都不含 erinacines。还存在其他可食的猴头菌属物种，尤其是 H. coralloides 和 H. americanum，这一点在此很重要，因为原稿引用的成分论文研究的是 H. coralloides，并非 H. erinaceus。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 For the fruiting-body dose there is essentially no gap. At 8-11% dry matter, the 3 g/day of dried powder used in the Mori trial is about 27-38 g of fresh lion's mane, a small side portion, or 3 g of dried slices, or a rounded half-tablespoon of powder. A 100 g fresh portion supplies 8-11 g of dry matter, roughly 270-370% of that dose. The gap reappears with a concentrated extract: 3 g/day of a nominal 8:1 hot-water extract corresponds to about 24 g of dried mushroom, roughly 218-300 g of fresh mushroom a day, which is a lot of mushroom and still not absurd. For erinacine-A products the answer is NO at any portion size, because erinacines are mycelial and the fruiting body sold for cooking does not contain them at meaningful levels.就子实体剂量而言基本没有差距。按 8-11% 干物质计，Mori 试验用的 3 g/天干粉相当于约 27-38 g 鲜猴头菇，一小份配菜的量，或 3 g 干片，或略满的半汤匙干粉。100 g 鲜品提供 8-11 g 干物质，约为该剂量的 270-370%。换成浓缩提取物，差距就回来了：标称 8:1 的热水提取物 3 g/天相当于约 24 g 干菇，即每天约 218-300 g 鲜菇，量不小但仍不算荒唐。对于 erinacine A 类产品，答案在任何份量下都是 NO，因为 erinacines 存在于菌丝体，供烹调出售的子实体不含有意义量的 erinacines。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 The compound classes split cleanly by tissue and by solvent, and this is where most consumer confusion lives. Hericenones C-H occur in the fruiting body; erinacines A-I occur in the mycelium, with erinacine biosynthesis genes consistently downregulated in fruiting-body tissue and no detectable erinacine production there (Fungal Biol Biotechnol 2025, PMC11969743, verified). The Taiwanese trials in early Alzheimer's disease and in depression used erinacine-A-enriched mycelium capsules at around 5 mg/g erinacine A, three 350 mg capsules a day giving 1,050 mg mycelia and about 5.25 mg erinacine A over 49 weeks (PMC7283924, verified), so their results cannot be transferred to eating the mushroom, and equally the Mori fruiting-body result cannot be transferred to a mycelium product. Solvent matters as much as tissue: hericenones are lipophilic and are recovered by ethanol while hot-water extraction recovers polysaccharides, so a dual extract and a hot-water extract deliver different chemistry at the same milligram figure. The specific polysaccharide numbers the submission used to make that point (4.85-5.68% of dry weight for the fruiting body and 3.62% beta-glucan for a hot-water extract) are withdrawn here, because neither is present in the paper cited for them. Many cheap US supplements are mycelium grown on grain and sold with the substrate included, so a large fraction of the capsule weight is starch; a starch assay or a low beta-glucan number relative to labelled polysaccharide is the tell. Safety is good for a food, with occasional contact dermatitis and respiratory allergy reports, and scattered case reports of skin reactions with supplement use.化合物类别按组织和溶剂清晰分开，消费者的困惑大多出在这里。Hericenones C-H 存在于子实体；erinacines A-I 存在于菌丝体，erinacine 生物合成基因在子实体组织中一致下调，该组织中检测不到 erinacine 生成（Fungal Biol Biotechnol 2025, PMC11969743，已核实）。台湾在早期阿尔茨海默病和抑郁症中的试验用的是富含 erinacine A 的菌丝体胶囊，erinacine A 约 5 mg/g，每天三粒 350 mg 胶囊，即 1,050 mg 菌丝体、约 5.25 mg erinacine A，持续 49 周（PMC7283924，已核实），所以它们的结果不能转用到吃这种菇上；同样，Mori 的子实体结果也不能转用到菌丝体产品上。溶剂和组织同等重要：hericenones 亲脂，靠乙醇回收，而热水提取回收的是多糖，所以在相同毫克数下，双提取物和热水提取物提供的化学成分不同。原稿用来支持这一点的具体多糖数值（子实体干重的 4.85-5.68%，以及热水提取物 3.62% 的 β-葡聚糖）在此撤回，因为所引论文中没有这两个数据。美国许多便宜补充剂是在谷物上培养的菌丝体，连培养基一起出售，所以胶囊重量里有很大一部分是淀粉；淀粉检测，或 β-葡聚糖数值相对标注多糖含量偏低，都是识别线索。作为食物，它的安全性良好，偶有接触性皮炎和呼吸道过敏报告，服用补充剂后也有零星皮肤反应的个案报告。

Absorption吸收 The fungal beta-glucans are not absorbed intact; a water-soluble 1-3/1-6 beta-glucan of about 13.3 kDa has been characterised from the fruiting body, and such polymers act on gut and gut-associated immune receptors rather than entering circulation, so how much reaches the blood is the wrong question for the polysaccharide fraction. The small molecules are the ones with systemic potential: erinacine A is lipophilic, crosses the blood-brain barrier in rodents and is the compound behind the neurotrophic claims, while hericenones are also lipophilic and their human absorption is poorly characterised. Practically, fat in the pan helps the hericenone fraction, a water-based soup extracts the polysaccharides, and the raw mushroom is not the right comparator for either since chitinous cell walls need heat to break down. The relevant food-versus-supplement difference here is which molecules are present at all rather than absorption efficiency.真菌 β-葡聚糖不会以原形吸收；已从子实体中表征出一种约 13.3 kDa 的水溶性 1-3/1-6 β-葡聚糖，这类聚合物作用于肠道及肠道相关免疫受体，并不进入循环，所以对多糖组分来说，“有多少进入血液”是个提错的问题。有全身作用潜力的是小分子：erinacine A 亲脂，在啮齿类中可穿过血脑屏障，是神经营养相关说法背后的化合物；hericenones 也亲脂，其人体吸收情况表征很差。实际操作上，锅里的油脂有助于 hericenone 组分，水基汤品提取的是多糖，而生菇对两者都不是合适的参照，因为几丁质细胞壁需要加热才能破坏。这里食物与补充剂的真正差别是哪些分子存在，吸收效率是次要问题。

Data note数据说明 Every composition figure in this entry traces to one paper that turned out to be about a different species: J Fungi 2025;11(11):785 analysed only Hericium coralloides, and the submission truncated its title to Hericium. The 91.68% moisture that generated every dose-gap number was an H. coralloides measurement, the H. erinaceus proximate values appear in that paper only as an untraced quotation from its reference [29], and the 4.85-5.68% polysaccharide range is absent from the paper altogether. The replacement moisture figure used here is the published 89-92% band rather than a specific re-traced H. erinaceus measurement. What is solid is the dose side: the Mori 3 g/day protocol, the 4 x 250 mg x 3 arithmetic, the 5 mg/g erinacine A figure and the tissue-partition claim were all verified低。本条目的每个成分数值都追溯到同一篇论文，而那篇论文研究的是另一个物种：J Fungi 2025;11(11):785 只分析了 Hericium coralloides，原稿把它的标题截短成了 Hericium。生成全部剂量差距数字的 91.68% 水分是 H. coralloides 的测定值；H. erinaceus 的常规成分值在该论文中只是引自其参考文献 [29] 的未追溯引用；4.85-5.68% 的多糖范围在该论文中完全不存在。这里采用的替代水分数值是已发表的 89-92% 区间，并非重新追溯的某个 H. erinaceus 具体测定值。可靠的是剂量一侧：Mori 的 3 g/天方案、4 x 250 mg x 3 的算术、5 mg/g erinacine A 的数据以及组织分布的说法均已核实。

References:文献： Mori PMID 18844328; Li PMID 32581767
SKIPBacopa monnieri假马齿苋（婆罗米）Grade C证据 C 级
Dose tested已验证剂量300-320 mg/d of extract standardised to 50-55% bacosides, for at least 12 weeks. It is not an acute agent.标准化至 50 至 55% 假马齿苋皂苷的提取物 300 至 320 毫克/天，至少 12 周。它不是急性起效的东西。
Who it is for适用人群Healthy adults willing to take it daily for 12 weeks for a modest change in processing speed.愿意连续服用 12 周、以换取加工速度小幅变化的健康成人。

Pros优点

  • The meta-analysis restricted inclusion to chronic dosing of 12 weeks or more, which is methodologically sound, and found two statistically significant results.meta 分析把纳入范围限定为 12 周以上的长期给药，方法上是站得住的，并得到两个统计学显著的结果。

Cons缺点

  • Read the actual endpoints. The two significant results across 9 trials and 437 analysable subjects were a Trail Making Test B change of -17.9 MILLISECONDS and a choice reaction time change of about 10 ms. Millisecond-scale processing speed is being sold as memory and learning.要看真正的终点。9 项试验、437 名可分析受试者中，两个显著结果分别是连线测验 B 型缩短 17.9 毫秒，以及选择反应时缩短约 10 毫秒。毫秒级的加工速度变化，被当作记忆力和学习能力在卖。
  • The meta-analysis authors explicitly said larger comparative trials are needed before any recommendation.meta 分析作者明确表示，在提出任何建议之前需要更大规模的对照试验。
  • Nothing supports a memory or dementia effect.没有任何证据支持它对记忆或痴呆有作用。
  • Gastrointestinal adverse effects (nausea, cramping, increased stool frequency) are the commonest problem. Cholinergic activity means caution with donepezil, rivastigmine and galantamine, and with anticholinergics. Animal work suggests thyroid hormone effects, so care with levothyroxine.胃肠道不良反应（恶心、腹部绞痛、排便次数增多）是最常见的问题。它具胆碱能活性，与多奈哌齐、利伐斯的明、加兰他敏以及抗胆碱药合用需谨慎。动物研究提示其影响甲状腺激素，因此与左甲状腺素合用需注意。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose partly reachable靠吃只能部分达到 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

Bacopa monnieri (brahmi, water hyssop) is a real leafy vegetable in parts of India, which makes it the exception among the herbal entries here. Ethnobotanical surveys in West Bengal's Terai-Dooars, Maharashtra, Assam and northeast India record it among wild edible greens gathered and cooked, with tender shoots and leaves eaten fresh, cooked as a green, or made into chutneys and raita, so bacosides genuinely enter the food supply in a way withanolides and valerenic acid do not. RICH here describes concentration, since a culinary serving reaches a fifth to a half of the clinical dose, and it is worth being explicit that this is one regional green rather than several ordinary foods: the availability is narrow and geographically limited, which is a different axis from concentration and is where the submission's TRACE label went wrong. Note the naming trap: in parts of India brahmi refers to Centella asiatica, a different plant with different actives (asiaticosides), and market material is frequently mixed.Bacopa monnieri（brahmi，假马齿苋）在印度部分地区是真正的叶菜，这让它成为本组草药条目中的例外。西孟加拉 Terai-Dooars 地区、马哈拉施特拉、阿萨姆和印度东北部的民族植物学调查记录它属于采集后烹食的野生食用绿叶菜，嫩梢和叶被鲜食、当青菜炒煮，或做成酸辣酱（chutney）和 raita，所以假马齿苋皂苷（bacosides）确实以睡茄内酯和缬草酸做不到的方式进入了食物供应。这里的 RICH 描述的是浓度，因为一份普通菜量就能达到临床剂量的五分之一到一半；有必要明确的是，这只是一种地方性绿叶菜，而非若干常见食物：可获得性狭窄且地域受限，那是与浓度不同的另一个维度，也正是原稿 TRACE 标签出错的地方。注意名称陷阱：在印度部分地区，brahmi 指的是积雪草（Centella asiatica），那是另一种植物，活性成分不同（积雪草苷类，asiaticosides），市场上的原料经常混用。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 Trials use 300 mg/day of extract standardised to 50-55% bacosides, roughly 150-165 mg of bacosides. At the measured 6.54 mg/g for the two quantified bacoside constituents, that is about 23 g of dried brahmi herb per day, roughly eleven teaspoons of churna, which nobody eats in a day. A 2 g teaspoon of dried powder supplies 13.1 mg, about 9% of the dose. Converting to fresh greens requires a fresh-to-dry ratio the cited sources do not give, so only the dried figure is quoted: a realistic culinary serving of the fresh green, the quantity that goes into a thoran or a chutney, corresponds to single-digit grams of dry matter and therefore to a few tens of milligrams of bacosides, a fifth to a half of the trial dose. Eating brahmi as a vegetable is on the same scale as supplementing it without matching it, which is not true of anything else in this list except lion's mane. Total bacoside A also includes bacopasaponin C and a jujubogenin isomer that the cited analysis does not quantify, so the real herb content is somewhat higher than 6.54 mg/g and the gap correspondingly smaller.试验用量为 300 mg/天、标准化到 50-55% bacosides 的提取物，约合 150-165 mg bacosides。按实测的两种 bacoside 成分合计 6.54 mg/g 计算，相当于每天约 23 g 干 brahmi 药材，约合十一茶匙 churna 药粉，没有人一天吃这么多。一茶匙 2 g 干粉提供 13.1 mg，约为剂量的 9%。换算成新鲜绿叶需要所引来源没有给出的鲜干比，所以这里只列干重数据：一份现实的鲜菜量，也就是做 thoran 或 chutney 会用的分量，对应个位数克的干物质，因而是几十毫克的 bacosides，即试验剂量的五分之一到一半。把 brahmi 当菜吃，量级上与吃补充剂接近，只是达不到同等水平，这在本列表中除猴头菇外没有别的例子。此外，bacoside A 总量还包括所引分析未定量的 bacopasaponin C 和一个 jujubogenin 异构体，所以药材的真实含量比 6.54 mg/g 更高一些，差距也相应更小。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Bacoside content in the herb varies several-fold with accession, season and harvest, which is exactly why breeding programmes select elite lines such as DBM-4, so a wild-gathered green is an unpredictable dose. Extraction matters too: bacosides are saponins recovered by hydroalcoholic extraction, and boiling a green in water for a curry leaches an unknown fraction into cooking liquid that may be discarded. The best-studied products (CDRI-08, BacoMind) are specific standardised extracts and their cognitive trial results should not be read across to eating the plant. Bacopa also has real dose-dependent gastrointestinal effects, cramping, nausea and loose stools, more prominent with the concentrated extract than with the vegetable, and it has cholinergic activity that could matter alongside cholinesterase inhibitors. Watch for Centella asiatica sold as brahmi, and for heavy metal accumulation, since Bacopa is a wetland plant with documented capacity to take up metals from sediment.药材中的 bacoside 含量随种质、季节和采收期变化数倍，这正是育种项目要选育 DBM-4 这类优良品系的原因，所以野采的绿叶菜是一个不可预测的剂量。提取方式同样重要：bacosides 是皂苷，靠水醇提取回收，而把青菜在水里煮成菜肴时，会有不确定比例浸入可能被倒掉的汤汁。研究最充分的产品（CDRI-08、BacoMind）是特定的标准化提取物，其认知功能试验结果不应照搬到吃这种植物上。假马齿苋还有明确的剂量依赖性胃肠道反应，绞痛、恶心和稀便，浓缩提取物比蔬菜更明显；它具有胆碱能活性，与胆碱酯酶抑制剂同用时可能需要注意。要留意积雪草被当作 brahmi 出售，也要留意重金属蓄积，因为假马齿苋是湿地植物，有从底泥中吸收金属的明确能力。

Absorption吸收 Bacosides are large triterpenoid saponin glycosides with poor membrane permeability and low oral bioavailability; the pharmacologically relevant species are thought to be the deglycosylated sapogenins (jujubogenin and pseudojujubogenin derivatives) generated by gut hydrolysis, which is why supplement makers push phospholipid-complex and nanoparticle formulations. Eating the whole green delivers the same glycosides embedded in a fibrous matrix with fat from the cooking medium, and it has never been compared head to head with an extract in humans, so the fresh-vegetable route is plausible and uncharacterised. The saponins themselves also have surfactant behaviour in the gut, which is part of why higher doses cause GI upset.bacosides 是大分子三萜皂苷糖苷，膜通透性差，口服生物利用度低；一般认为具药理意义的形式是肠道水解生成的脱糖基皂苷元（jujubogenin 和 pseudojujubogenin 衍生物），这也是补充剂厂家推磷脂复合物和纳米制剂的原因。整棵菜吃下去，提供的是同样的糖苷，只是嵌在纤维基质中并伴随烹调油脂，而它从未在人体上与提取物做过头对头比较，所以鲜菜途径可行但未被表征。皂苷本身在肠道内还有表面活性行为，这也是高剂量引起胃肠不适的部分原因。

Data note数据说明 The ICAR DBM-4 bacoside figures were verified exactly against the cited release note, including the variety designation, and every derived step recomputed correctly (654 mg per 100 g, 13.1 mg per 2 g teaspoon, about 9% of dose, 23 g and about eleven teaspoons for 150 mg). The one soft spot is that no fresh-to-dry ratio is available in the cited sources, so the fresh-green serving is described qualitatively rather than given a number高。ICAR 的 DBM-4 bacoside 数据已逐项对照所引品种发布说明核实，包括品种名称，各步推导也重算无误（每 100 g 654 mg、每 2 g 茶匙 13.1 mg、约为剂量的 9%、150 mg 需 23 g 和约十一茶匙）。唯一的薄弱处是所引来源没有鲜干比，所以鲜菜份量只作定性描述，没有给出数字。

The 1989 outbreak was linked to contaminated L-tryptophan and Cochrane flagged that the possibility of a similar contaminant in 5-HTP products has not been excluded.嗜酸性粒细胞增多-肌痛综合征的问题至今未解决。1989 年的疫情与污染的 L-色氨酸有关，Cochrane 指出，5-HTP 产品中存在类似污染物的可能性尚未被排除。

This is a direct serotonin precursor, so the risk is mechanistic rather than theoretical.与 SSRI、SNRI、包括不可逆型在内的 MAOI、三环类、曲马多、曲普坦类、利奈唑胺、锂盐和右美沙芬合用有 5-羟色胺综合征风险。它是直接的 5-羟色胺前体，所以这个风险是机制性的，不是理论上的。

Food sources食物来源

No food source, manufactured无食物来源，人工合成 Dose NOT reachable by eating靠吃达不到剂量 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

5-hydroxytryptophan is not a dietary constituent. In living tissue it exists only as a transient intracellular intermediate between tryptophan and serotonin, immediately decarboxylated by aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase, so it does not accumulate in any food at measurable levels. The commercial article is a purified single molecule, either extracted from the seeds of Griffonia simplicifolia, a West African climbing shrub whose seeds are an unusual botanical accumulator at 156 mg/g dry weight (about 16%) in a chemically characterised reference sample against literature concentrations of 10-20%, or, increasingly, produced by microbial or enzymatic biosynthesis. Griffonia seed is a pharmaceutical raw material rather than a food, which is why SYNTHETIC fits better than the NOT_FOOD label used for botanical drugs such as valerian or ashwagandha. The foods listed below are tryptophan sources, a different molecule one step upstream, scored against the WHO/FAO/UNU 2007 adult requirement of 4 mg tryptophan per kg per day (280 mg/day for a 70 kg adult) rather than against any 5-HTP dose.5-羟基色氨酸不是膳食成分。在活体组织中，它只作为色氨酸到血清素之间的瞬时细胞内中间体存在，会被芳香族 L-氨基酸脱羧酶立即脱羧，因此不会在任何食物中蓄积到可测量的水平。市售产品是纯化的单一分子，或从 Griffonia simplicifolia（西非一种攀缘灌木）的种子中提取，该种子是不寻常的植物蓄积体，一份经化学表征的参照样品达 156 mg/g 干重（约 16%），文献浓度为 10-20%；或者越来越多地由微生物或酶法生物合成得到。Griffonia 种子是药用原料，不是食物，这就是 SYNTHETIC 比用于缬草、南非醉茄这类植物药的 NOT_FOOD 标签更贴合的原因。下面列出的食物是色氨酸来源，那是上游一步的另一个分子，评分依据是 WHO/FAO/UNU 2007 年成人需要量每公斤体重每天 4 mg 色氨酸（70 kg 成人 280 mg/天），而非任何 5-HTP 剂量。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 For 5-HTP itself the gap is absolute: no food contains it in measurable quantity, so no eating quantity reproduces the 50-300 mg/day used in trials. From the manufacturing raw material, 100 mg of 5-HTP sits in about 0.64 g of Griffonia seed at 156 mg/g, a striking number and irrelevant to eating, since Griffonia seed is not a food and carries other constituents. Via the dietary precursor the arithmetic runs deceptively the other way. An ordinary mixed diet supplies roughly 900-1000 mg of tryptophan a day, three to twenty times a 5-HTP dose by mass, and a single chicken breast supplies 434 mg, yet that intake does not act like 5-HTP for three reasons. Over 95% of tryptophan is degraded down the kynurenine pathway by TDO and IDO, with only about 1-2% passing through tryptophan hydroxylase to serotonin (PMC5398323; PMC9292703). Tryptophan competes with the other large neutral amino acids, leucine, isoleucine, valine, phenylalanine and tyrosine, for the LAT1 transporter at the blood-brain barrier, and every protein food raises tryptophan and its competitors together, so a high-protein meal can leave the brain tryptophan ratio flat or lower. And tryptophan hydroxylase is the regulated rate-limiting step, so raising substrate does little. 5-HTP sidesteps all three: it is past the rate-limiting hydroxylation and is decarboxylated by ubiquitous AADC. Adding 300 mg of tryptophan to a meal is therefore not equivalent to 300 mg of 5-HTP, and no realistic quantity of food makes it so.就 5-HTP 本身而言，差距是绝对的：没有食物含有可测量的量，所以没有任何进食量能重现试验所用的 50-300 mg/天。从生产原料看，按 156 mg/g 计算，100 mg 5-HTP 存在于约 0.64 g Griffonia 种子中，这个数字很惊人，与吃东西无关，因为 Griffonia 种子不是食物，还含有其他成分。走膳食前体这条路，算术的方向反而具有欺骗性。普通混合膳食每天提供约 900-1000 mg 色氨酸，按质量计是 5-HTP 剂量的三到二十倍，单块鸡胸肉就提供 434 mg，但这种摄入不会像 5-HTP 那样起作用，原因有三。超过 95% 的色氨酸经 TDO 和 IDO 沿犬尿氨酸通路降解，只有约 1-2% 经色氨酸羟化酶转向血清素（PMC5398323；PMC9292703）。色氨酸要与其他大分子中性氨基酸（亮氨酸、异亮氨酸、缬氨酸、苯丙氨酸和酪氨酸）竞争血脑屏障上的 LAT1 转运体，而每种蛋白质食物都会同时提高色氨酸和它的竞争者，所以一顿高蛋白餐可能让脑内色氨酸比值持平甚至下降。而色氨酸羟化酶是受调控的限速步骤，提高底物作用很小。5-HTP 绕开了这三点：它已越过限速的羟化步骤，并由普遍存在的 AADC 脱羧。因此在一餐中加 300 mg 色氨酸并不等于 300 mg 5-HTP，任何现实的食物量都做不到这一点。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Bypassing the pathway's regulation is what makes 5-HTP a drug rather than a nutrient. AADC is present throughout peripheral tissues, so much of an oral 5-HTP dose is converted to serotonin outside the central nervous system, which produces the characteristic nausea and is why clinical protocols historically paired 5-HTP with a peripheral decarboxylase inhibitor such as carbidopa. Combined with SSRIs, SNRIs, MAOIs, tramadol, triptans or linezolid, 5-HTP carries a genuine serotonin syndrome risk that no amount of dietary tryptophan does. There is also a contamination history worth naming: the 1989 eosinophilia-myalgia syndrome epidemic was traced to a contaminant in bacterially produced L-tryptophan, and a related peak X impurity has been detected in some 5-HTP preparations, so purity of a purified plant extract or fermentation product is not a given. Note also that commercial 98% 5-HTP claims are computed on identified compounds rather than on seed weight, and one commercial extract labelled 95% assayed at about 65%. Griffonia seed should not be eaten as a food substitute; the whole seed carries other constituents and is not characterised for dietary safety. Nothing about the tryptophan-rich foods above raises comparable concerns; they are food, and the warm-milk folklore is folklore. Separately, the food table here is narrower than it should be: it contains no legume, no plant-protein concentrate and no cheese richer than cheddar, and dried spirulina, soybeans and soy protein isolate, Parmesan, sesame seeds, turkey, tuna, oats and peanuts are all absent. No figures for them could be verified in this pass, so they are named rather than tabulated, but their absence makes the requirement look harder to meet than it is.绕过该通路的调控，正是 5-HTP 成为药物而非营养素的原因。AADC 遍布外周组织，所以口服 5-HTP 的很大一部分在中枢神经系统之外被转化为血清素，这产生了典型的恶心反应，也是临床方案历来把 5-HTP 与卡比多巴等外周脱羧酶抑制剂配伍使用的原因。与 SSRI、SNRI、MAOI、曲马多、曲普坦类或利奈唑胺合用时，5-HTP 有真实的血清素综合征风险，而膳食色氨酸无论多少都没有这种风险。还有一段值得点明的污染史：1989 年嗜酸性粒细胞增多-肌痛综合征的暴发被追溯到细菌法生产的 L-色氨酸中的一种污染物，某些 5-HTP 制剂中也检出过相关的 peak X 杂质，所以纯化植物提取物或发酵产品的纯度并非理所当然。另外，市售 98% 5-HTP 的说法是按已鉴定化合物计算的，不按种子重量计算；一份标称 95% 的市售提取物实测约 65%。Griffonia 种子不应当作食物替代品食用；整粒种子含有其他成分，膳食安全性未经表征。上面那些富含色氨酸的食物没有类似问题，它们就是食物，而睡前热牛奶的说法只是民间说法。还有一点：这里的食物表比应有的范围窄，其中没有豆类、没有植物蛋白浓缩物，也没有比切达更高的奶酪，干螺旋藻、大豆和大豆分离蛋白、帕玛森奶酪、芝麻、火鸡肉、金枪鱼、燕麦和花生全部缺失。本轮无法核实它们的数据，因此只点名不入表，但它们的缺席让需要量看起来比实际更难达到。

Absorption吸收 The whole point of 5-HTP is that its absorption route differs from its precursor's. 5-HTP is absorbed from the small intestine and crosses the blood-brain barrier without competing significantly for the LAT1 large-neutral-amino-acid carrier, so plasma and brain 5-HTP rise roughly in proportion to dose, unlike tryptophan whose brain entry depends on the tryptophan-to-LNAA ratio rather than on absolute intake. Dietary tryptophan absorption from protein foods is efficient at the gut level, over 90%, and the losses that matter are metabolic rather than absorptive: hepatic TDO is induced by cortisol and by tryptophan itself, and IDO is induced by inflammation, so illness, stress and high-protein intake all divert precursor toward kynurenine. This is why the classic dietary manoeuvre for raising brain tryptophan is a carbohydrate load with little protein, using an insulin-driven fall in circulating branched-chain amino acids to improve the ratio, an effect measured in single-digit percentage changes and nothing like a 100 mg 5-HTP capsule.5-HTP 的关键在于它的吸收路径与前体不同。5-HTP 在小肠吸收，穿过血脑屏障时不与 LAT1 大分子中性氨基酸载体发生显著竞争，所以血浆和脑内 5-HTP 大致随剂量成比例上升；色氨酸进入脑内则取决于色氨酸与其他大分子中性氨基酸的比值，与绝对摄入量无关。蛋白质食物中的膳食色氨酸在肠道层面吸收效率高，超过 90%，真正重要的损失是代谢性的：肝脏 TDO 受皮质醇和色氨酸自身诱导，IDO 受炎症诱导，所以疾病、应激和高蛋白摄入都会把前体转向犬尿氨酸。这就是提高脑内色氨酸的经典膳食手段是低蛋白的高碳水负荷的原因，它借助胰岛素引起的循环支链氨基酸下降来改善比值，效应量以个位数百分比计，与一粒 100 mg 5-HTP 胶囊完全不在同一量级。

Data note数据说明 for what remains. All six USDA tryptophan values were confirmed against SR Legacy with no errors, all six per-portion and percent-of-requirement figures recompute correctly against the verified WHO/FAO/UNU denominator of 280 mg/day, and the Griffonia 156 mg/g figure and the 0.64 g per 100 mg calculation were verified against full text. Two Griffonia figures that could not be found in their cited source have been withdrawn rather than restated, and the cheddar value carries the verifier's caveat that the USDA number is probably an imputation artefact就保留下来的内容而言为高。六项 USDA 色氨酸数值全部对照 SR Legacy 确认无误，六个每份含量和占需要量百分比的数字按核实过的 WHO/FAO/UNU 分母 280 mg/天重算均正确，Griffonia 的 156 mg/g 数据和 100 mg 对应 0.64 g 的计算已对照全文核实。两个在所引来源中找不到的 Griffonia 数据已撤回而未重述，切达奶酪数值带有核查者的提示，即该 USDA 数字很可能是插补产物。

Pros优点

  • The carboxylation mechanism is real: MK-7 does carboxylate osteocalcin and matrix Gla protein, and the biomarkers move.羧化机制是真实的：MK-7 确实会羧化骨钙素和基质 Gla 蛋白，生物标志物也确实变化。

Surrogate endpoint, and not at the total hip.Knapen 2013（244 名健康绝经后女性，180 微克/天服 3 年）显著减缓了腰椎和股骨颈骨矿含量与骨密度的随龄下降。这是替代终点，且全髋部位没有效果。

Cons缺点

  • The core sales pitch, that D3 without K2 calcifies your arteries, is a marketing construct. No randomised trial has ever shown that vitamin D supplementation causes vascular calcification which K2 then prevents.核心卖点，也就是“只补 D3 不补 K2 会让血管钙化”，是一个营销构造。没有任何随机试验显示过维生素 D 补充会导致血管钙化、而 K2 能加以阻止。
  • The calcification claim has been tested and failed twice. AVADEC: 720 µg MK-7 plus vitamin D for 24 months in 365 men with aortic valve calcification, progression 275 versus 292 AU, no difference. VitaK-CAC: 360 µg MK-7 for 2 years in 167 coronary patients, coronary calcium rose from 135 to 184 AU on MK-7 anyway.钙化方面的说法已被检验两次并失败。AVADEC：365 名主动脉瓣钙化男性服用 720 微克 MK-7 加维生素 D 共 24 个月，进展为 275 对 292 AU，无差异。VitaK-CAC：167 名冠心病患者服用 360 微克 MK-7 共 2 年，MK-7 组冠脉钙化照样从 135 升到 184 AU。
  • MK-4 is worse. The impressive vertebral-fracture odds ratios in K2 marketing trace to small Japanese menatetrenone trials, and when the hypothesis was tested properly the OF study (n=4,378, 45 mg/d, 36-48 months) was NULL on new vertebral fractures. One frequently cited supporting paper has been RETRACTED for research misconduct.MK-4 更糟。K2 营销中那些漂亮的椎体骨折比值比源自小型日本甲基萘醌试验，而当这个假说被正规检验时，OF 研究（n=4378，45 毫克/天，36 至 48 个月）在新发椎体骨折上是阴性的。一篇常被引用的支持性论文已因科研不端被撤稿。
  • MK-4 has essentially no oral bioavailability at supplement doses. A single 420 µg dose of MK-4 was not detectable in the serum of any subject at any time point, while the same dose of MK-7 peaked at 6 hours and stayed detectable for 48 hours.在补充剂剂量下 MK-4 基本没有口服生物利用度。单次 420 微克 MK-4 在任何受试者的任何时间点都检测不到，而同剂量的 MK-7 在 6 小时达峰并可检测 48 小时。
  • Absolute practical contraindication with warfarin and other vitamin K antagonists. MK-7 has a long half-life, so even modest doses destabilise INR for days to weeks.与华法林及其他维生素 K 拮抗剂在实际使用中属绝对禁忌。MK-7 半衰期长，即便中等剂量也会让 INR 在数天到数周内不稳定。

Food sources食物来源

RICH (MK-7) / TRACE (MK-4)RICH (MK-7) / TRACE (MK-4) Dose partly reachable靠吃只能部分达到 Data confidence: Low数据可信度：低

The two menaquinones need separate answers, because one merged label buries the whole point. MK-7 is genuinely rich in food, at 939 µg/100 g in natto, and that richness rests on exactly one food that most of the target population never eats; every other measured MK-7 source is trace, with cheddar at 2.7 and butter at 4.2 µg/100 g. MK-4 is trace in food across the board, at roughly 1 to 22 µg/100 g in chicken, egg yolk, full-fat dairy and meat, with goose liver paste as the one outlier at about 369 µg/100 g, while the 45 mg clinical dose is synthetic-only, since MK-4 supplements are manufactured from menadione because no food is or could be concentrated to 45 mg per dose.两种甲基萘醌需要分开作答，合成一个标签会把要点全部埋掉。MK-7 在食物中确实丰富，纳豆达 939 µg/100 g，但这份丰富只落在唯一一种食物上，而目标人群多数人从不吃它；其他所有实测的 MK-7 来源都只是痕量，切达奶酪 2.7 µg/100 g，黄油 4.2 µg/100 g。MK-4 在各类食物中普遍只是痕量，鸡肉、蛋黄、全脂乳制品和肉类大致为 1 至 22 µg/100 g，唯一的异常值是鹅肝酱约 369 µg/100 g；而 45 mg 的临床剂量只能来自合成，MK-4 补充剂由甲萘醌制造，因为没有任何食物浓缩到、也不可能浓缩到每剂 45 mg。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 MK-7 and MK-4 give opposite answers. MK-7 at supplement and trial doses of 90 to 180 µg/day is fully covered by food: one 50 g pack of natto carries 470 µg, so a pack every second or third day matches a 180 µg capsule. Nothing else comes close, since 180 µg/day from cheddar at 2.7 µg MK-7 per 100 g would take 6.7 kg of cheese daily and from butter about 4.3 kg. MK-4 is the reverse. The Japanese clinical dose, menatetrenone for osteoporosis, is 45 mg/day (45,000 µg), usually 15 mg three times daily. At the richest food value in the composition literature, goose liver paste at about 369 µg/100 g, that is 12.2 kg per day, and at barbecue chicken's 22.1 µg/100 g it is about 204 kg. Even a modest 1.5 mg consumer MK-4 pill needs 407 g of goose liver paste, 6.8 kg of chicken, or 150 kg of whole milk. Measured whole-diet MK-4 intake sits around 17 µg/day (7.3% of a mean total vitamin K intake of about 230 µg/day in Japanese women, Kamao 2007), roughly one 2,600th of the pharmacological dose. MK-4 at supplement strength is unreachable by eating.MK-7 和 MK-4 给出相反的答案。MK-7 在 90 至 180 µg/天 的补充剂和试验剂量上完全能由食物覆盖：一盒 50 g 纳豆含 470 µg，每两三天吃一盒就相当于一粒 180 µg 胶囊。别的食物都远远不及，按切达奶酪 2.7 µg MK-7/100 g 计算，每天 180 µg 需要 6.7 kg 奶酪，用黄油则约 4.3 kg。MK-4 的情况相反。日本用于骨质疏松的临床剂量，四烯甲萘醌，为 45 mg/天（45,000 µg），通常一日三次、每次 15 mg。按成分文献中最高的食物数值，鹅肝酱约 369 µg/100 g，这相当于每天 12.2 kg；按烧烤鸡肉 22.1 µg/100 g 计算约为 204 kg。哪怕是一粒普通消费级 1.5 mg 的 MK-4 药片，也需要 407 g 鹅肝酱、6.8 kg 鸡肉，或 150 kg 全脂牛奶。实测整膳食 MK-4 摄入量约为 17 µg/天（日本女性维生素 K 总摄入量约 230 µg/天，MK-4 占 7.3%，Kamao 2007），大约是药理剂量的 1/2,600。补充剂强度的 MK-4 靠吃达不到。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 MK-7 supplements are made by Bacillus subtilis natto fermentation, the same organism that makes natto, or synthesised; the active species is all-trans MK-7, and cis-isomer contamination is a documented quality problem in commercial products that the fermented food does not have. MK-4 supplements are wholly synthetic, derived from menadione, because no food is or could be concentrated to 45 mg per dose. That said, one framing in the original entry was wrong and has to go: goose liver paste at about 369 µg/100 g puts 100 g of food within roughly 2.1 orders of magnitude of the 45 mg dose (1/122 of it), so the claim that no food comes within three orders of magnitude fails, even though the dose stays unreachable at 12.2 kg/day. Natto also brings the fermentation matrix, fibre and nattokinase, and circulating K2 after eating natto is around ten times circulating K1 after eating spinach, a comparison made with 200 g of natto against 400 g of spinach rather than gram for gram (Schurgers LJ, Vermeer C, Haemostasis 2000;30:298-307, PMID 11356998). The 'cheese is a K2 food' claim needs unpicking: cheese total vitamin K is genuinely high, at 282 ± 5.0 µg/100 g for hard cheese, 289 ± 38 for semi-soft, 440 ± 41 for blue and 506 ± 63 for soft, but roughly 90% of it is MK-9, MK-10 and MK-11 from starter bacteria (Fu et al. 2017, PMID 29955705), forms no clinical trial has tested, while the MK-7 fraction is a few µg/100 g. Cheddar is the weak exemplar for that argument, and the long-ripened Dutch and Norwegian cheeses (Gouda, Edam, Jarlsberg) are the canonical MK-9-rich ones that would test it properly; curd cheese and quark appear as K2 sources in the Schurgers and Vermeer paper itself, and tempeh, fermented soy pastes, Korean cheonggukjang, sauerkraut and fermented salami would show whether natto is uniquely high or simply the best measured. None of those could be tabulated for want of a figure. Animal MK-4 also tracks the animal's feed, since menadione is a routine poultry feed additive and Elder et al. attribute poultry MK-4 to alkylation of it, so brand, country and production system shift the numbers, and the chicken hot dog and chicken broth samples in the same study contained no detectable MK-4 at all.MK-7 补充剂由纳豆枯草杆菌（Bacillus subtilis natto）发酵制得，与做纳豆的是同一种菌，也有化学合成的；活性种类是全反式 MK-7，顺式异构体污染是商业产品中有记录的质量问题，发酵食物没有这个问题。MK-4 补充剂完全是合成的，来自甲萘醌，因为没有任何食物浓缩到、也不可能浓缩到每剂 45 mg。不过原条目里有一个说法是错的，必须去掉：鹅肝酱约 369 µg/100 g，使 100 g 食物与 45 mg 剂量之间只差约 2.1 个数量级（为其 1/122），所以“没有食物能进入三个数量级之内”这一断言不成立，尽管 12.2 kg/天 这个剂量依然达不到。纳豆还带来发酵基质、纤维和纳豆激酶，吃纳豆后循环中的 K2 约为吃菠菜后循环中 K1 的十倍，这一比较用的是 200 g 纳豆对 400 g 菠菜，并非等重比较（Schurgers LJ，Vermeer C，Haemostasis 2000;30:298-307，PMID 11356998）。“奶酪是 K2 食物”这个说法需要拆开看：奶酪的维生素 K 总量确实高，硬质奶酪 282 ± 5.0 µg/100 g，半软质 289 ± 38，蓝纹 440 ± 41，软质 506 ± 63，但其中约 90% 是发酵剂细菌产生的 MK-9、MK-10 和 MK-11（Fu 等 2017，PMID 29955705），这些形式没有任何临床试验测试过，而 MK-7 部分只有每 100 g 几 µg。切达奶酪是支撑该论点的弱例子，长期成熟的荷兰和挪威奶酪（高达 Gouda、埃丹 Edam、亚尔斯堡 Jarlsberg）才是典型的富含 MK-9 品种，用它们才能真正检验；凝乳奶酪和夸克（quark）本身就出现在 Schurgers 与 Vermeer 的论文里，被列为 K2 来源；天贝、发酵豆酱、韩国清麴酱（cheonggukjang）、德式酸菜和发酵萨拉米则可以显示纳豆究竟是独一无二地高，还是仅仅测得最充分的一个。这些都因缺少数据而无法列表。动物性 MK-4 还随动物饲料变化，甲萘醌是家禽饲料的常规添加剂，Elder 等把家禽 MK-4 归因于它的烷基化，所以品牌、国家和生产体系都会改变数字；同一研究中的鸡肉热狗和鸡汤样品完全检不出 MK-4。

Absorption吸收 MK-4 and MK-7 behave so differently that microgram-for-microgram comparison is meaningless. A single 420 µg dose of MK-7 was well absorbed, peaked at 6 hours and remained detectable in serum for 48 hours, while the identical 420 µg dose of MK-4 was undetectable in the serum of all subjects at every time point, and seven consecutive days at 60 µg/day raised only MK-7 (Sato T et al., Nutr J 2012;11:93, PMID 23140417, DOI 10.1186/1475-2891-11-93, every element confirmed). MK-7's long half-life comes from its extended isoprenoid side chain and tight lipoprotein binding. That is the mechanistic reason MK-4 is dosed in milligrams while MK-7 works in micrograms, and it means the 1 to 22 µg/100 g of MK-4 in butter, egg yolk, cheese and chicken contributes almost nothing to circulating vitamin K2 even though it is real and measurable. All menaquinones need dietary fat for absorption, which is why they sit in and are absorbed from the fat phase of dairy and eggs, and the reduced-fat versions lose most of it, with reduced-fat cheddar at 1.8 µg MK-4 per 100 g against 9.5 µg for full fat (PMID 29955705, whose fat-dependence finding was confirmed).MK-4 和 MK-7 的表现差别之大，按微克对微克比较毫无意义。单次 420 µg 的 MK-7 吸收良好，6 小时达峰，血清中 48 小时仍可检出；同样 420 µg 的 MK-4 在所有受试者的各个时间点血清中都检不出，连续七天每天 60 µg 也只升高 MK-7（Sato T 等，Nutr J 2012;11:93，PMID 23140417，DOI 10.1186/1475-2891-11-93，各项要素均已确认）。MK-7 半衰期长，来自它较长的类异戊二烯侧链和与脂蛋白的紧密结合。这正是 MK-4 以毫克计量而 MK-7 以微克起效的机理原因，也意味着黄油、蛋黄、奶酪和鸡肉中那 1 至 22 µg/100 g 的 MK-4 虽然真实可测，对循环维生素 K2 的贡献几乎为零。所有甲基萘醌的吸收都需要膳食脂肪，因此它们存在于乳制品和鸡蛋的脂肪相中并从那里被吸收，减脂版本会失去其中大部分：减脂切达奶酪每 100 g 含 1.8 µg MK-4，全脂为 9.5 µg（PMID 29955705，其脂肪依赖性发现已确认）。

Data note数据说明 The literature layer is strong and fully verified: Kamao 2007 (natto 939 µg/100 g, 230 µg/day total K, MK-4 at 7.3%), Fu 2017 (cheese totals and fat dependence), Sato 2012 (420 µg MK-4 undetectable) and Schurgers 2000 all confirmed exactly against PubMed, so the MK-7 side of the item rests on a confirmed number. The food-composition layer does not. Six MK-4 food values come from Elder et al. Table 1 and 2, which is a confirmed citation with paywalled tables that could not be opened, the butter and cheddar MK-7 values come from a paper whose DOI does not resolve and whose calibration the submission itself questions at about 27x the US values, and the goose liver paste figure that now anchors the MK-4 dose gap is a widely cited table value that could not be confirmed from its source低。文献层面很扎实且全部经过核验：Kamao 2007（纳豆 939 µg/100 g，维生素 K 总摄入 230 µg/天，MK-4 占 7.3%）、Fu 2017（奶酪总量和脂肪依赖性）、Sato 2012（420 µg MK-4 检不出）和 Schurgers 2000 都与 PubMed 逐项精确核对无误，所以本条目 MK-7 一侧建立在一个已确认的数字上。食物成分层面则不然。六个 MK-4 食物数值出自 Elder 等的表 1 和表 2，引文本身已确认，但表格在付费墙后无法打开；黄油和切达奶酪的 MK-7 数值来自一篇 DOI 无法解析的论文，提交材料自己也质疑其校准，约为美国数值的 27 倍；而现在支撑 MK-4 剂量缺口的鹅肝酱数字，是一个被广泛引用的表格值，无法从其源头确认。

References:文献： AVADEC Diederichsen PMID 35465686; VitaK-CAC JAMA Cardiol 2026; Knapen PMID 23525894; OF study Inoue PMID 19082528; Sato PK PMID 23140417; retracted PMID 21778673
SKIPGeneric multi-strain probiotic blends泛泛的复合菌株益生菌Grade B证据 B 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Marketed as 50 billion CFU and similar. The dose threshold that matters is at least 5 billion CFU/d, but only for the two specific indications.常以“500 亿 CFU”之类标示。真正有意义的剂量门槛是至少 50 亿 CFU/天，但只对那两个特定适应证有效。
Who it is for适用人群See the strain-specific entry in the Consider tier. A blend with no strain designators has nothing behind it.见“可以考虑”一档中的菌株特异性条目。不标菌株编号的复方产品背后没有任何依据。

Pros优点

  • If a blend happens to contain a strain with evidence at an adequate dose, it will work for that indication. The problem is you cannot tell from the label.如果某款复方恰好含有一种有证据的菌株且剂量足够，它对那个适应证会有效。问题是你从标签上看不出来。

Cons缺点

  • The category claim is unfalsifiable marketing. Probiotic describes a delivery concept, not an active ingredient. NCCIH states the point plainly: if one Lactobacillus helps prevent an illness, that does not necessarily mean another kind of Lactobacillus will.品类式声称是无法证伪的营销话术。“益生菌”描述的是一种投递概念，不是一种活性成分。NCCIH 说得很直白：如果某种乳杆菌有助于预防某种疾病，这并不必然意味着另一种乳杆菌也能。
  • Disaggregate 82 randomised trials and 10,332 irritable bowel syndrome patients by strain, and GRADE certainty collapses to low or very low almost everywhere. Only 24 of the 82 trials were at low risk of bias.把 82 项随机试验、10332 名肠易激患者按菌株拆开，GRADE 确定性几乎处处塌到低或极低。82 项试验中只有 24 项属低偏倚风险。
  • Raw CFU counts are close to meaningless divorced from strain. The infant colic strain works at 100 million CFU/d, which is 100 to 1,000 times LOWER than the counts marketed on adult tubs.脱离菌株，单看 CFU 数字几近毫无意义。婴儿肠绞痛那个菌株在 1 亿 CFU/天下有效，比成人罐装上标的数字低 100 至 1000 倍。
  • The same contraindications apply as for any live organism: central venous catheter, neutropenia, severe immunocompromise, critical illness, preterm infants.与任何活菌一样的禁忌同样适用：中心静脉置管、中性粒细胞减少、重度免疫抑制、危重症、早产儿。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose reachable by eating靠吃可以达到剂量 Data confidence: Medium数据可信度：中

RICH applies to one endpoint only, and it is a redefined one: live lactic acid bacteria of common genera. On that endpoint several ordinary fermented foods match or exceed supplement label doses, with yoghurt surveyed at up to 10^9 CFU/g, kefir at 2.5x10^8 CFU/mL, unpasteurised sauerkraut at about 2x10^8 CFU/g, kimchi at 10^7.14 to 10^9.23 CFU/g and natto reported at roughly 10^8-10^9 CFU/g. On the endpoint that matters for a product claim, a defined blend of characterised strains at a stated dose, no food supplies it and the honest grade would be a flat no. A reader scanning this field should not read RICH as 'food replaces this product'. The named-strain entry in this same group states that a CFU comparison is meaningless for a strain-specific claim, and that remains true here.RICH 只针对一个终点，而且是被重新定义过的终点：常见属的活乳酸菌。在这个终点上，若干普通发酵食品达到或超过补充剂的标签剂量，调查中酸奶最高达 10^9 CFU/g，开菲尔 2.5x10^8 CFU/mL，未经巴氏杀菌的德式酸菜约 2x10^8 CFU/g，韩式泡菜 10^7.14 至 10^9.23 CFU/g，纳豆据报约 10^8-10^9 CFU/g。而对产品主张真正重要的终点，即以确定剂量提供一组已表征菌株的确定配方，没有任何食物能提供，诚实的评级应当是明确的否。浏览本字段的读者不应把 RICH 读成食物可以替代这个产品。同一组中的指名菌株条目已指出，CFU 比较对菌株特异性主张毫无意义，这一点在此同样成立。

Rows tagged unconfirmed carry a figure the verification pass could not trace back to its cited source. The number is reported as found; hover the tag for the reason.标记为未核实的行，其数值在核查环节无法追溯到所引来源。数字按原样列出；把鼠标移到标记上可看具体原因。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 For total live cells there is no gap. The source review calculates that about 10^10 cells is the intake likely needed to affect the microbiota and that this is met by 100 g of a food carrying 10^8 cells/g (PMID 30197628). One cup of kefir, one cup of yoghurt, about 120 g of raw sauerkraut, a cup of kimchi or a cup of natto each clear that bar, and kimchi at the top of its measured range delivers more live organisms in one serving than most 50-billion-CFU capsules. The gap is qualitative: identity, characterisation and consistency. Fermented food counts vary across four to six orders of magnitude between products and batches (yoghurt below 10^4 to 10^9 CFU/g), the organisms are usually not identified to strain, and none of them are the strains on the label of the blend.就活菌总数而言不存在差距。原综述估算，可能影响菌群所需的摄入量约为 10^10 个菌体，而 100 g 含 10^8 菌体/g 的食物即可达到（PMID 30197628）。一杯开菲尔、一杯酸奶、约 120 g 生德式酸菜、一杯韩式泡菜或一杯纳豆都能越过这条线，处于实测区间上端的韩式泡菜一份提供的活菌数超过大多数标称 50 billion CFU 的胶囊。差距是定性的：身份、表征和一致性。发酵食品的菌数在不同产品和批次之间跨越四到六个数量级（酸奶从低于 10^4 到 10^9 CFU/g），其中的微生物通常没有鉴定到菌株层面，而且没有一个是复配产品标签上的菌株。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Fermented food is a reasonable dietary habit and a different proposition from a named strain at a defined dose. Even a generic blend tells you which species you are getting and roughly how many; a jar of sauerkraut tells you neither, and a pasteurised jar contains no live cells. The practical points that decide whether a food delivers anything: it must be labelled raw, unpasteurised or 'live cultures' and kept refrigerated; heat destroys the organisms, so miso added to boiling soup, cooked kimchi and baked tempeh contribute essentially nothing; and long-aged cheeses can be several orders of magnitude lower than young ones. Water kefir, kombucha, brine-fermented unpasteurised pickles, kvass, skyr, traditional buttermilk and young raw-milk cheeses belong on the same list, though no confirmed counts for them were available here. Conversely, a supplement claim of 50 billion CFU means little if the strains are unnamed, because probiotic effects are demonstrated strain by strain, and CFU counts on labels refer to manufacture rather than end of shelf life.吃发酵食品是合理的饮食习惯，与按确定剂量服用指名菌株是两个不同的命题。即便是通用复配产品，也会告诉你拿到的是哪些菌种、大致多少数量；一罐德式酸菜两者都不告诉你，而经巴氏杀菌的罐装品根本没有活菌。决定一种食物是否真能提供活菌的实用要点：标签必须写生、未经巴氏杀菌或含活性菌种，并且全程冷藏；加热会破坏这些微生物，因此加进沸汤的味噌、炒熟的韩式泡菜和烤过的天贝基本没有贡献；长期陈化的奶酪可能比年轻奶酪低几个数量级。水开菲尔、康普茶、盐水发酵未杀菌腌菜、kvass 酸面包饮、skyr 酸奶、传统白脱牛奶和年轻生乳奶酪属于同一清单，但此处没有它们的可确认菌数。反过来说，如果菌株没有具名，补充剂标称 50 billion CFU 也说明不了什么，因为益生菌效应是逐一菌株验证的，而标签上的 CFU 数指的是出厂时而非保质期末。

Absorption吸收 Gastric and bile survival is strain-dependent and matrix-dependent. Fermented dairy foods buffer stomach acid and their fat content improves transit survival, a genuine advantage of the food route over an uncoated capsule; supplements compensate with enteric coating or microencapsulation. Almost none of these organisms colonise permanently, so the effect is dose-dependent and ceases when intake stops, which applies equally to food and to capsules. The source review notes that many fermentation microbes are closely related to probiotic organisms and can share mechanisms, which is the honest basis for recommending fermented food, but relatedness is not equivalence and it does not license transferring a strain-specific trial result onto a jar of kimchi.在胃酸和胆汁中的存活既取决于菌株，也取决于基质。发酵乳制品能缓冲胃酸，其脂肪含量提高通过消化道的存活率，这是食物途径相对无包衣胶囊的真实优势；补充剂则用肠溶包衣或微囊化来弥补。这些微生物几乎都不会长期定植，所以效应是剂量依赖的，停止摄入即终止，这一点对食物和胶囊同样适用。原综述指出，许多发酵微生物与益生菌生物在亲缘上很近，可能共享作用机制，这是推荐发酵食品的诚实依据，但亲缘接近并不等于等效，也不允许把菌株特异的试验结果搬到一罐韩式泡菜上。

Data note数据说明 The Rezac counts for kimchi, sauerkraut, yoghurt, miso and tempeh were verified against Tables 5 and 6, as were the kefir counts and the 10^10-cells threshold. Two soft spots remain: the tempeh 9 log ceiling could not be sourced and has been removed, and the natto count is a literature range supplied by the verification report without a retrievable citation中。Rezac 关于韩式泡菜、德式酸菜、酸奶、味噌和天贝的菌数已对照表 5 和表 6 核实，开菲尔菌数和 10^10 菌体阈值同样已核实。仍有两处软点：天贝 9 log 的上限找不到来源，已删除；纳豆菌数是核查报告给出的文献范围，没有可调取的引文。

References:文献： Goodoory & Ford PMID 37541528; NCCIH; Cochrane CD006095.pub5 PMID 40931979
SKIPB. infantis 35624 (single strain)B. infantis 35624（单一菌株）Grade D证据 D 级
Dose tested已验证剂量1 billion CFU/d, one capsule, assessed at 4 weeks. This is the trialled dose, not a dose shown to work.10 亿 CFU/天，每日一粒，4 周后评估。这是试验用的剂量，不是被证明有效的剂量。
Who it is for适用人群On current evidence, no clearly identifiable group.按现有证据，没有可清楚界定的适用人群。

Pros优点

  • Composite probiotic products containing B. infantis showed small effects on abdominal pain (SMD 0.22) and bloating (SMD 0.30). Those effects belong to the composite, not to this strain.含 B. infantis 的复方益生菌产品对腹痛（SMD 0.22）和腹胀（SMD 0.30）有小幅效应。那些效应属于复方，不属于这个菌株。

Cons缺点

  • This is the clearest case of the strain-specificity argument cutting AGAINST the industry. It is the product that taught consumers to look for a strain number, and the dedicated meta-analysis of 5 studies found the SINGLE strain had no effect on abdominal pain, bloating or bowel habit satisfaction.这是“菌株特异性”这个论点反过来对行业不利的最清楚案例。正是这个产品教会消费者去看菌株编号，而一项针对 5 项研究的专门 meta 分析发现，单一菌株对腹痛、腹胀和排便满意度都没有效应。
  • The whole reputation rests on one 2006 trial plus an anti-inflammatory mechanism story about the IL-10 to IL-12 ratio.它的全部声誉建立在 2006 年的一项试验，加上一个关于 IL-10 与 IL-12 比值的抗炎机制叙事之上。
  • The AGA recommends against probiotics for irritable bowel syndrome outside clinical trials, which is this product primary market.美国胃肠病学会建议在临床试验之外不要用益生菌治疗肠易激，而那正是这个产品的主要市场。
  • Bifidobacterium species specifically have caused whole-genome-sequencing-confirmed bacteraemia in preterm infants.双歧杆菌属确实在早产儿中造成过经全基因组测序确认的菌血症。

Food sources食物来源

No food source, manufactured无食物来源，人工合成 Dose NOT reachable by eating靠吃达不到剂量 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

SYNTHETIC here means no dietary source, not an artificial molecule. The strain is a live organism isolated from the ileal mucosa of a healthy human donor and has since been reclassified from Bifidobacterium longum subsp. infantis to B. longum subsp. longum 35624 (PLOS One 2016;11:e0162983, PMC5033381). It is propagated industrially from a proprietary strain bank and freeze-dried. It is present in no food, no fermented food and no other supplement brand. Comparative genome analysis identified a 35624-specific gene cluster encoding biosynthesis of its exopolysaccharide EPS624, the kind of strain-level distinction that makes substitution unsound.此处 SYNTHETIC 的含义是没有膳食来源，它并非人工合成的分子。该菌株是活的生物体，分离自一名健康人类供体的回肠黏膜，此后已从 Bifidobacterium longum subsp. infantis 重新归类为 B. longum subsp. longum 35624（PLOS One 2016;11:e0162983, PMC5033381）。它从专有菌种库出发进行工业扩繁并冻干。任何食物、任何发酵食品、任何其他品牌的补充剂中都不存在它。比较基因组分析发现了一个 35624 特有的基因簇，编码其胞外多糖 EPS624 的生物合成，这类菌株层面的差异使替换缺乏依据。

No food rows: there is no ordinary food that supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有食物条目：没有任何普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 No quantity of any food supplies this strain. The trial dose is small in absolute terms, 1x10^8 CFU, which is roughly the number of live bacteria in half a gram of unpasteurised sauerkraut at 8.3 log CFU/g, so the dose is not the obstacle and the identity is. Fermented foods can supply a thousand times more live cells than the effective dose of 35624 while supplying none of it. Note that the source trial expressed its doses as CFU/mL rather than CFU/day.任何食物的任何摄入量都无法提供这个菌株。试验剂量在绝对值上很小，1x10^8 CFU，大致相当于 8.3 log CFU/g 的未杀菌德式酸菜半克中的活菌数，所以障碍与剂量无关，障碍在于身份。发酵食品能提供比 35624 有效剂量多一千倍的活菌，却一个 35624 都提供不了。请注意，原始试验把剂量表述为 CFU/mL 而非 CFU/day。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 The dose-response data make the point better than any argument about food. In the 362-patient dose-ranging trial, 1x10^8 of B. infantis 35624 was significantly superior to placebo for abdominal pain, the composite score, bloating, bowel dysfunction and incomplete evacuation, while 1x10^6 and 1x10^10 were not, the paper attributing the highest dose's failure to significant formulation problems (Whorwell et al., Am J Gastroenterol 2006;101:1581-1590, PMID 16863564). The trial enrolled women only, which limits generalisation and which the submission did not state. If a tenfold change in dose of the same strain in the same capsule abolishes the effect, swapping the strain for a different Bifidobacterium in a yoghurt cannot be assumed to preserve it. Anyone advised to take 35624 should be told plainly that no diet reproduces it and that a generic bifidobacterium supplement is a different product.剂量反应数据比任何关于食物的论证都更能说明问题。在那项 362 例的剂量探索试验中，1x10^8 的 B. infantis 35624 在腹痛、复合评分、腹胀、排便功能障碍和排便不尽感上显著优于安慰剂，1x10^6 和 1x10^10 则没有，论文把最高剂量失效归因于明显的配方问题（Whorwell et al., Am J Gastroenterol 2006;101:1581-1590, PMID 16863564）。试验只纳入女性，这限制了外推，原稿没有说明。既然同一胶囊中同一菌株的剂量变动十倍就能让效应消失，那么把菌株换成酸奶里的另一种双歧杆菌，就不能假定效应还在。凡被建议服用 35624 的人都应被明确告知：没有任何饮食能复制它，通用双歧杆菌补充剂是另一种产品。

Absorption吸收 The strain was selected partly for surviving gastrointestinal transit, and its documented actions are immunoregulatory and barrier-related rather than nutritional: enhanced gut barrier function, accelerated intestinal transit and reduced visceral hypersensitivity. It does not permanently colonise, so the effect depends on continued daily intake. Formulation dominates delivery: the failure of the 1x10^10 arm was a formulation problem rather than evidence against high cell numbers, and it illustrates that CFU on a label is not the active variable on its own. The specific gelling mechanism the submission gave for that failure is not in the source and has been removed.选择该菌株的部分理由是它能在胃肠道转运中存活，其有记录的作用属于免疫调节和屏障相关，与营养无关：增强肠道屏障功能、加快肠道转运、降低内脏高敏感性。它不会长期定植，所以效应依赖每天持续摄入。配方主导递送：1x10^10 组的失败是配方问题，并不构成反对高菌数的证据，它说明标签上的 CFU 单独并不是起作用的变量。原稿给出的那个具体成胶机制在来源文献中没有，已删除。

Data note数据说明 The strain's origin, reclassification, exopolysaccharide gene cluster and the dose-ranging trial results were all confirmed. The only failed detail was the gelling mechanism, now replaced with the paper's own wording, and the only additions are the women-only enrolment and the CFU/mL unit高。菌株来源、重新归类、胞外多糖基因簇和剂量探索试验结果均已确认。唯一未通过核实的细节是成胶机制，现已改用论文自身的表述；唯一的新增内容是只纳入女性这一点和 CFU/mL 单位。

References:文献： Yuan PMID 28166427; Goodoory & Ford PMID 37541528; AGA PMID 32531291
SKIPKrill oil磷虾油Grade C证据 C 级
Dose tested已验证剂量2 g/d for 24 weeks in the knee osteoarthritis trial. Bioavailability trials used about 1.1 g/d of actual omega-3.膝骨关节炎试验为 2 克/天、持续 24 周。生物利用度试验用的是实际 omega-3 约 1.1 克/天。
Who it is for适用人群At most, people wanting a given rise in omega-3 index from a smaller dose. That is a biomarker advantage.最多适用于希望用更小剂量把 omega-3 指数提上去的人。那是生物标志物层面的优势。

Pros优点

  • The absorption argument has support. A 72-person trial at matched 1.1 g/d found krill oil produced about 1.5-fold higher increments in plasma EPA and DHA than fish oil.吸收方面的论点有支持。一项 72 人的试验在同为 1.1 克/天的条件下发现，磷虾油使血浆 EPA 和 DHA 的升幅比鱼油高约 1.5 倍。
  • Contains astaxanthin, which is why it does not oxidise as readily as bulk fish oil.含虾青素，这也是它不像散装鱼油那样容易氧化的原因。

Cons缺点

  • The joint claim collapsed under proper testing. The largest randomised trial (JAMA, n=262 with knee osteoarthritis and effusion-synovitis, 2 g/d for 24 weeks) found mean pain change -19.9 with krill oil versus -20.2 with placebo. A trial-sequential-analysis review across 5 trials and 700 patients found no significant improvement in knee pain, stiffness or lipid profile.关节方面的说法在正规检验下崩塌。规模最大的随机试验（JAMA，262 名膝骨关节炎伴积液滑膜炎患者，2 克/天服 24 周）显示磷虾油组疼痛平均变化 -19.9，安慰剂组 -20.2。一项含试验序贯分析、涵盖 5 项试验 700 名患者的综述发现，膝痛、僵硬和血脂均无显著改善。
  • It is priced as a premium product on the strength of a biomarker advantage, and delivers far less EPA and DHA per capsule than a concentrate.它凭一个生物标志物优势按高端产品定价，而每粒提供的 EPA 和 DHA 远少于浓缩型产品。
  • Crustacean and shellfish allergy is a genuine and under-warned contraindication.甲壳类和贝类过敏是真实存在却警示不足的禁忌。
  • Same anticoagulant, antiplatelet and atrial fibrillation cautions as any omega-3 source once dose rises.一旦剂量上升，与任何 omega-3 来源一样，需注意抗凝、抗血小板和房颤方面的问题。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose reachable by eating靠吃可以达到剂量 Data confidence: Medium数据可信度：中

The molecules krill oil delivers, EPA and DHA, are abundant in ordinary oily fish, and a 1-2 g/day krill oil dose is smaller than what a single tin of sardines provides. The phospholipid delivery form is also obtainable from food, which the earlier draft got wrong: fish roe and caviar are membrane-lipid tissues in which a large share of the EPA and DHA is phospholipid-bound, and in lean white fish such as cod most of the (small) EPA+DHA pool sits in phospholipid rather than triglyceride. The triglyceride generalisation holds for fatty fish flesh only. One tablespoon of caviar (16 g, 1,046 mg EPA+DHA) beats a 2 g krill oil dose on both quantity and form. Krill itself is close to a non-food: Antarctic krill (Euphausia superba) is eaten as okiami in Japan and to a small extent in Russia and the Philippines, but the global catch is largely rendered into meal and oil, and the shell carries a heavy fluoride load that has to be stripped before human consumption. Nobody reaches a krill oil dose by eating krill; they reach it by eating fish or roe, or by taking capsules.磷虾油提供的分子（EPA 和 DHA）在普通多脂鱼中很丰富，1-2 g/day 的磷虾油剂量还不及一罐沙丁鱼提供的量。磷虾油的磷脂递送形式同样可以从食物中获得，这一点早前的草稿弄错了：鱼卵和鱼子酱属于膜脂组织，其中很大一部分 EPA 和 DHA 以磷脂形式结合；在鳕鱼这类少脂白肉鱼中，本就不多的 EPA+DHA 大部分存在于磷脂中，甘油三酯里很少。甘油三酯的通则只适用于多脂鱼的肌肉。一汤匙鱼子酱（16 g，1,046 mg EPA+DHA）在数量和形式上都胜过 2 g 磷虾油剂量。磷虾本身几乎算不上食物：南极磷虾（Euphausia superba）在日本作为 okiami 食用，在俄罗斯和菲律宾也有少量食用，但全球渔获大多被加工成粉和油，虾壳带有很重的氟负荷，供人食用前必须去除。没有人靠吃磷虾达到磷虾油的剂量；达到该剂量靠的是吃鱼或鱼卵，或者服用胶囊。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 There is effectively no gap, which is the useful finding. Measured EPA plus DHA in 20 commercial krill oils from the Korean market spanned 14.2-34.8% of total fatty acids (Lee 2024, PMID 39233519, DOI 10.4014/jmb.2406.06026, range confirmed; the sampling is one national market). Converting that percentage to capsule mass overstates the content, because total fatty acids are less than capsule mass once phospholipid head groups, free sterols, astaxanthin and excipients are counted, so every figure that follows is a ceiling rather than a point estimate. A 1 g capsule carries at most roughly 140-350 mg EPA+DHA. Two capsules (2 g) deliver at most about 280-700 mg, which is matched or beaten by one 92 g tin of sardines (903 mg), one 45 g tin of anchovies (924 mg), one mackerel fillet (1,059 mg) or one tablespoon of caviar (1,046 mg). At the top of the trial range, 4 g/day of krill oil supplies at most roughly 570-1,400 mg, equal to at most 0.6-1.5 tins of sardines. Because these are ceilings, the real gap runs further in favour of fish than the raw numbers suggest. Going the other way, matching a krill oil dose by eating krill is not a real option: the catch is not sold as food outside a small Japanese and Russian market, and the shell must be removed for fluoride reasons.实际上不存在差距，这本身就是有用的结论。对韩国市场 20 种商品磷虾油的实测显示，EPA 加 DHA 占总脂肪酸的 14.2-34.8%（Lee 2024, PMID 39233519, DOI 10.4014/jmb.2406.06026，区间已确认；取样限于一个国家的市场）。把这个百分比直接换算成胶囊质量会高估含量，因为计入磷脂头基、游离甾醇、虾青素和辅料后，总脂肪酸低于胶囊质量，所以下面每个数字都是上限，不能当作点估计。一粒 1 g 胶囊最多含约 140-350 mg EPA+DHA。两粒（2 g）最多提供约 280-700 mg，一罐 92 g 沙丁鱼（903 mg）、一罐 45 g 凤尾鱼（924 mg）、一片鲭鱼柳（1,059 mg）或一汤匙鱼子酱（1,046 mg）都能与之相当或超过。取试验剂量范围的上端，4 g/day 磷虾油最多提供约 570-1,400 mg，最多相当于 0.6-1.5 罐沙丁鱼。由于这些都是上限，真实差距比原始数字显示的更偏向鱼类。反过来看，靠吃磷虾来匹配磷虾油剂量并不现实：除了日本和俄罗斯的小规模市场，渔获并不作为食品销售，而且出于氟的原因必须去壳。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Two things were previously claimed to separate krill oil from food, and both claims are weaker than stated. The phospholipid form is the product claim, and fish roe and caviar supply phospholipid-bound EPA and DHA in ordinary food, so the honest version is that krill oil offers a high phospholipid share conveniently, not uniquely. Krill oil is reported at roughly 39-81% phospholipid (Xie 2019, DOI 10.1111/1541-4337.12427); the citation is real and topically correct, but the range could not be traced to a page or table in the review, so treat it as indicative and unconfirmed, and do not read the original two-decimal precision as measured. Astaxanthin is the second claim, and 'no oily fish portion supplies it in comparable concentration' should not stand: wild sockeye and other red-fleshed Pacific salmon carry astaxanthin in flesh at roughly 25-40 mg/kg, so a 130 g portion supplies about 3-5 mg against the 0.1-1.5 mg per gram of oil typical of krill capsules. That concentration could not be re-verified, so it is a challenge to the claim rather than a settled figure, but the flat denial is gone. Neither the phospholipid form nor the astaxanthin has been shown to produce a clinical outcome that fish or fish oil does not. Against that, krill oil is the most expensive way to buy EPA and DHA per milligram, capsule doses are small enough that many products deliver less omega-3 than one tin of fish, it is a crustacean allergen, and whole krill or poorly processed krill meal carries the fluoride load of the exoskeleton. The fluoride figures usually quoted are about 4,260 mg F/kg fat-free dry matter in the carapace against 570 mg/kg in raw muscle; neither full text was retrievable, so both values are unconfirmed and should be attributed to whichever paper actually reports them (Soevik & Braekkan, Journal of the Fisheries Research Board of Canada 1979;36(11):1414-1416, DOI 10.1139/f79-204, which was not yet called the Canadian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences in 1979; and Tou 2007, PMID 17345959). Sustainability is a genuine consideration given that Antarctic krill is the base of the Southern Ocean food web.此前有两点被说成是磷虾油区别于食物之处，两种说法都比原本的表述要弱。磷脂形式是产品主张，而鱼卵和鱼子酱在普通食物中就能提供以磷脂结合的 EPA 和 DHA，因此诚实的说法是：磷虾油方便地提供了较高的磷脂比例，这种能力并非它独有。磷虾油的磷脂含量据报道约为 39-81%（Xie 2019, DOI 10.1111/1541-4337.12427）；该引文真实且主题相符，但这个区间无法追溯到该综述中的具体页面或表格，因此应视为参考性且未经确认，原文两位小数的精度也不能当成实测值来读。第二点是虾青素，“没有任何多脂鱼份量能提供可比浓度”这一说法站不住：野生红鲑及其他红肉太平洋鲑的鱼肉中虾青素约为 25-40 mg/kg，一份 130 g 大约提供 3-5 mg，而磷虾胶囊的典型水平是每克油 0.1-1.5 mg。该浓度未能重新核实，所以它目前只是对原说法的质疑，尚未成为定论，但那种一概否认已经不成立。无论磷脂形式还是虾青素，都没有被证明能带来鱼类或鱼油所不能带来的临床结果。与此相对，按每毫克 EPA 和 DHA 计，磷虾油是最贵的购买方式；胶囊剂量之小，使许多产品提供的欧米伽-3 少于一罐鱼；它属于甲壳类过敏原；整只磷虾或加工不当的磷虾粉还带有外壳的氟负荷。常被引用的氟数值是甲壳中约 4,260 mg F/kg 脱脂干物质，对应生肌肉 570 mg/kg；两篇全文都无法获取，因此两个数值均未确认，应归属于真正报告它们的论文（Soevik & Braekkan, Journal of the Fisheries Research Board of Canada 1979;36(11):1414-1416, DOI 10.1139/f79-204，该刊在 1979 年还不叫 Canadian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences；以及 Tou 2007, PMID 17345959）。考虑到南极磷虾是南大洋食物网的基础，可持续性是一个实实在在的考量。

Absorption吸收 The phospholipid form does appear to be absorbed at least as well as triglyceride and better than ethyl ester. In a crossover trial in 12 healthy men at a matched 1,680 mg EPA+DHA dose, incorporation into plasma phospholipids by area under the curve over 0-72 h was 80.03 +/- 34.71 %*h for krill oil, 59.78 +/- 36.75 %*h for re-esterified triglyceride fish oil and 47.53 +/- 38.42 %*h for ethyl ester fish oil, with no statistically significant difference (EPA p = 0.057, DHA p = 0.246, EPA+DHA p = 0.119) (Schuchardt 2011, Lipids Health Dis, PMC3168413, all figures confirmed). Attributing that result to the phospholipid form is not the only reading: the same paper notes that 22% of the krill oil's EPA and 21% of its DHA were present as free fatty acids, which absorb readily and offer a plausible alternative explanation. The practical implication is modest either way, since a krill capsule contains so much less EPA and DHA than a portion of fish that absorption efficiency does not close the gap.磷脂形式的吸收看来至少与甘油三酯相当，并优于乙酯。在 12 名健康男性的交叉试验中，以匹配的 1,680 mg EPA+DHA 剂量给药，按 0-72 h 曲线下面积计的血浆磷脂掺入量为：磷虾油 80.03 +/- 34.71 %*h，重新酯化甘油三酯型鱼油 59.78 +/- 36.75 %*h，乙酯型鱼油 47.53 +/- 38.42 %*h，差异无统计学意义（EPA p = 0.057，DHA p = 0.246，EPA+DHA p = 0.119）（Schuchardt 2011, Lipids Health Dis, PMC3168413，所有数字均已确认）。把这一结果归因于磷脂形式并非唯一解读：同一篇论文指出磷虾油中 22% 的 EPA 和 21% 的 DHA 以游离脂肪酸形式存在，这类形式容易吸收，提供了另一个合理解释。无论采用哪种解读，实际意义都有限，因为一粒磷虾胶囊所含的 EPA 和 DHA 远少于一份鱼，吸收效率无法弥补这一差距。

Data note数据说明 The comparator fish and roe composition is all traced to USDA records and the two human trials (Lee 2024, Schuchardt 2011) checked out exactly. The krill-specific claims are the weak part: the phospholipid percentage range, both fluoride values and the sockeye astaxanthin concentration are all unverified, and two of the three factual claims that justified the original classification turned out to be false中。作为对照的鱼类和鱼卵成分全部可追溯到 USDA 记录，两项人体试验（Lee 2024、Schuchardt 2011）核对完全一致。薄弱之处在磷虾自身的相关说法：磷脂百分比区间、两个氟数值和红鲑虾青素浓度都未经核实，而支撑原有分类的三项事实性说法中有两项被证明是错的。

Dose tested已验证剂量No established effective dose for any endpoint. The binding constraint is retinol, not omega-3.对任何终点都没有确立的有效剂量。真正的限制因素是视黄醇，不是 omega-3。
Who it is for适用人群Arguably nobody, given modern alternatives.考虑到现代替代品，可以说没有适用人群。

Pros优点

  • Historically it was an effective vitamin D and vitamin A vehicle in populations with little sun and poor diets, and that history is real.在缺少日照、饮食贫乏的人群中，它历史上确实是有效的维生素 D 和维生素 A 载体，这段历史是真实的。
  • Natural triglyceride oils absorb well.天然甘油三酯型油脂吸收良好。

Cons缺点

  • You cannot increase the omega-3 dose without simultaneously increasing preformed vitamin A, which has a real toxicity ceiling of 3,000 µg/d and is teratogenic. That is a dose-limiting design flaw, not a feature.你无法在不同时增加预成型维生素 A 的情况下提高 omega-3 剂量，而前者有 3000 微克/天的真实毒性上限，并且致畸。这是限制剂量的设计缺陷，不是特色。
  • As an omega-3 source it is dilute, so reaching a therapeutic dose requires a large volume of oil and therefore a large retinol load.作为 omega-3 来源它很稀，要达到治疗剂量需要很大体积的油，也就意味着很大的视黄醇负荷。
  • Standard obstetric advice in several countries is to avoid liver and liver-oil supplements in pregnancy.若干国家的标准产科建议是妊娠期避免肝脏和肝油类补充剂。
  • Typically sold as a bulk, often flavoured liquid, which is the format that performed worst in oxidation surveys. Fermented cod liver oil has no quality advantage.通常以散装、常带调味的液体形式出售，而这正是在氧化调查中表现最差的形式。“发酵鱼肝油”没有质量优势。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose reachable by eating靠吃可以达到剂量 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

Everything cod liver oil supplies is available from ordinary food: EPA and DHA from oily fish and roe, vitamin D from oily fish, vitamin A from any liver. Cod liver oil is itself a traditional food-grade oil with its own USDA composition entry, which is why it appears in the list below, and it is included as the reference product rather than as an alternative to itself. What makes it distinctive is concentration: one teaspoon (4.5 g) carries 806 mg EPA+DHA, 1,350 ug RAE of preformed vitamin A (4,500 IU) and 11.2 ug of vitamin D (450 IU). Two genuine food alternatives are named without figures because no authoritative per-portion composition value could be obtained in this pass: tinned cod liver, eaten in Nordic, Baltic and Russian cuisine, and liver as a vitamin A source. Rather than estimate them, no row is given.鳕鱼肝油提供的每一种成分都能从普通食物中获得：EPA 和 DHA 来自多脂鱼和鱼卵，维生素 D 来自多脂鱼，维生素 A 来自任何动物肝脏。鳕鱼肝油本身就是一种传统食用级油脂，在 USDA 有自己的成分条目，这也是它出现在下表中的原因，它在表中的身份是参照产品，并不充当自身的替代品。它的特点在于浓度：一茶匙（4.5 g）含 806 mg EPA+DHA、1,350 ug RAE 的预形成维生素 A（4,500 IU）和 11.2 ug 维生素 D（450 IU）。有两种真正的食物替代只点名而不给数值，因为本轮无法获得权威的每份成分值：北欧、波罗的海和俄罗斯饮食中食用的罐装鳕鱼肝，以及作为维生素 A 来源的肝脏。与其估算，这里干脆不列出对应行。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 For the EPA and DHA at a traditional teaspoon dose there is no gap, and food matches it easily: 806 mg per teaspoon is a little under one 92 g tin of sardines (903 mg) and about a quarter of a herring fillet (2,873 mg). Cod liver oil is also efficient in the other direction: 250-500 mg/day of EPA+DHA needs only 1.4-2.8 g of oil, a third to two thirds of a teaspoon, carrying 419-838 ug RAE of vitamin A, comfortably inside the 3,000 ug/day UL. The gap that opens at pharmacological doses is a toxicity gap rather than a volume one. Reaching 4 g/day of EPA+DHA takes 22.3 g of cod liver oil, about 1.6 tablespoons, delivering 6,704 ug RAE of preformed vitamin A every day, 2.2 times the EFSA adult UL. Traditional cod liver oil therefore cannot be dose-escalated to the level used in triglyceride-lowering trials, and food cannot reach 4 g/day either (see the Omega-3 entry). That is what plain fish oil and purified concentrates exist for.在传统的一茶匙剂量上，EPA 和 DHA 不存在差距，食物很容易匹配：每茶匙 806 mg，略低于一罐 92 g 沙丁鱼（903 mg），约为一片鲱鱼柳（2,873 mg）的四分之一。反过来看鳕鱼肝油也很高效：250-500 mg/day 的 EPA+DHA 只需 1.4-2.8 g 油，即三分之一到三分之二茶匙，随之摄入 419-838 ug RAE 维生素 A，稳稳低于 3,000 ug/day 的 UL。药理剂量下出现的差距是毒性上的差距，与吃得下多少无关。达到 4 g/day 的 EPA+DHA 需要 22.3 g 鳕鱼肝油，约 1.6 汤匙，每天随之摄入 6,704 ug RAE 预形成维生素 A，为 EFSA 成人 UL 的 2.2 倍。因此传统鳕鱼肝油无法加量到降甘油三酯试验所用的水平，食物同样达不到 4 g/day（见欧米伽-3 条目）。这正是普通鱼油和纯化浓缩物存在的理由。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 This is the clearest case in this group where the concentrated product is hazardous in a way the food behaviour does not suggest. The vitamin A is preformed retinol, so it accumulates and is teratogenic. Anyone already taking a multivitamin, or pregnant, can exceed the 3,000 ug RAE/day UL on one tablespoon alone (4,080 ug). Doubling up cod liver oil with a separate vitamin D supplement is the other common stacking error. Many modern products labelled cod liver oil are refined with the vitamin A and D partly stripped and re-standardised, so the USDA generic entry above describes traditional oil and not necessarily what is in a given bottle: the label governs. Contaminants concentrate in liver, which is why the EU sets a separate limit for fish liver and derived products (20.0 pg WHO-TEQ/g wet weight) alongside the 1.75 pg/g fat dioxin and 6.0 pg/g fat dioxin plus dioxin-like PCB limits for marine oils under Regulation (EU) 2023/915. Those limit values were not re-verified in this pass. Commercial cod liver oil is refined to meet them; home-rendered or artisanal liver oil is not.这是本组中最清楚的一例：浓缩产品的危害方式，从食物本身的表现里看不出来。其中的维生素 A 是预形成的视黄醇，会蓄积并有致畸性。已经在服用复合维生素的人，或孕妇，仅一汤匙（4,080 ug）就可能超过 3,000 ug RAE/day 的 UL。另一个常见的叠加错误是鳕鱼肝油再加单独的维生素 D 补充剂。许多现代标称鳕鱼肝油的产品经过精炼，维生素 A 和 D 被部分去除并重新标准化，所以上面 USDA 的通用条目描述的是传统油品，未必等于某一瓶里的东西，以标签为准。污染物在肝脏中富集，这也是欧盟在 Regulation (EU) 2023/915 中除了对海洋油脂设定二噁英 1.75 pg/g 脂肪、二噁英加类二噁英 PCB 6.0 pg/g 脂肪的限值之外，另为鱼肝及其衍生产品设定单独限值（20.0 pg WHO-TEQ/g 湿重）的原因。这些限值在本轮未重新核实。商品化鳕鱼肝油经过精炼以符合限值；自家熬制或手作肝油不符合。

Absorption吸收 Cod liver oil is a natural triglyceride and was one of the natural-triglyceride comparators assigned the 100% reference index in the Dyerberg comparison, against 124% for re-esterified triglyceride and 73% for ethyl ester (PMID 20638827, both comparator values confirmed). Its fat-soluble vitamins come dissolved in the oil, which is the ideal vehicle, and that is precisely why the vitamin A is so efficiently absorbed and why overdose is easy. There is no absorption advantage over eating oily fish for the EPA and DHA.鳕鱼肝油是天然甘油三酯，在 Dyerberg 的比较中属于被赋予 100% 参照指数的天然甘油三酯对照之一，相对的重新酯化甘油三酯为 124%，乙酯为 73%（PMID 20638827，两个对照数值均已确认）。它的脂溶性维生素溶解在油中，这是理想的载体，也正因如此维生素 A 吸收极其高效，过量也容易发生。就 EPA 和 DHA 而言，它相对于吃多脂鱼没有吸收优势。

Data note数据说明 The USDA cod liver oil record matched on every value including both household measures and both vitamin unit conversions, and the whole arithmetic block recomputed exactly (806 mg and 2,434 mg per portion, 322% of the AI, 45% and 136% of the vitamin A UL, 1.4-2.8 g for 250-500 mg carrying 419-838 ug RAE, 22.3 g for 4 g/day carrying 6,704 ug RAE). The EFSA vitamin A and D ULs and the EU 2023/915 limits are widely cited but were not confirmed in this pass, and they are load-bearing for the toxicity conclusion高。USDA 鳕鱼肝油记录在每一个数值上都吻合，包括两种家庭常用量和两项维生素单位换算，整个算术部分复算完全一致（每份 806 mg 和 2,434 mg，AI 的 322%，维生素 A UL 的 45% 和 136%，250-500 mg 需 1.4-2.8 g 并随之摄入 419-838 ug RAE，4 g/day 需 22.3 g 并随之摄入 6,704 ug RAE）。EFSA 的维生素 A 和 D UL 以及 EU 2023/915 限值被广泛引用，但本轮未予确认，而它们对毒性结论起支撑作用。

References:文献： Dyerberg PMID 20638827; Jackowski PMID 26688721; Heller PMID 30626234
SKIPALA from flaxseed, chia or walnut oil亚麻籽、奇亚籽或核桃油中的 ALAGrade C证据 C 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Adequate intake 1.6 g/d for men and 1.1 g/d for women. No upper limit; the practical constraint is calories from oil.适宜摄入量：男性 1.6 克/天，女性 1.1 克/天。没有上限；实际限制是油带来的热量。
Who it is for适用人群People who eat no marine products at all and will not take algal oil. It at least maintains essential fatty acid status.完全不吃海产、也不愿吃藻油的人。它至少能维持必需脂肪酸的状态。

Pros优点

  • It is a genuinely essential fatty acid, so adequate intake matters.它确实是必需脂肪酸，所以摄入足量是有意义的。
  • The Cochrane review found a signal for arrhythmia reduction, RR 0.73 (0.55-0.97) at moderate certainty. Note that rests on just 2 trials, 4,912 participants and 173 events.Cochrane 综述发现心律失常减少的信号，RR 0.73（0.55-0.97），确定性中等。注意这只建立在 2 项试验、4912 名受试者和 173 个事件之上。

Cons缺点

  • The plant-based omega-3, same benefits claim is the core deception. Conversion of ALA to EPA is a few percent and to DHA is well under one percent in adults, and it is further suppressed by high dietary linoleic acid. A flaxseed capsule does not deliver what a fish oil or algal oil capsule delivers.“植物来源的 omega-3，同样的好处”是核心误导。成人体内 ALA 转化为 EPA 只有百分之几，转化为 DHA 远低于百分之一，而且会被膳食中较高的亚油酸进一步压制。一粒亚麻籽胶囊提供不了鱼油或藻油胶囊提供的东西。
  • Cochrane found increased ALA probably makes little or no difference to all-cause mortality, RR 1.01 (0.84-1.20).Cochrane 发现增加 ALA 对全因死亡可能几乎没有影响，RR 1.01（0.84-1.20）。
  • Anyone relying on it to achieve DHA status is making a mistake, and that includes pregnant women and vegans wanting fetal DHA supply. Algal DHA is the correct product there.任何指望靠它达到 DHA 水平的人都做错了，这包括希望为胎儿提供 DHA 的孕妇和纯素者。那种情况下正确的产品是藻油 DHA。
  • Note the arrhythmia finding for ALA points the opposite way to the atrial fibrillation excess seen with marine omega-3 (HR 1.25), so the two should not be treated as interchangeable in either direction.注意 ALA 的心律失常结果与海洋 omega-3 观察到的房颤增多（HR 1.25）方向相反，因此两者在任何方向上都不应被当作可以互换。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose reachable by eating靠吃可以达到剂量 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

ALA is one of the easiest nutrients in this reference to obtain from food. EFSA sets the Adequate Intake at 0.5% of energy, about 1.1-1.4 g/day for a 2,000-2,500 kcal diet (EFSA Journal 2010;8(3):1461, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2010.1461; the 0.5%-of-energy conversion checks arithmetically at 10 kcal/9 = 1.11 g and 12.5/9 = 1.39 g). A single tablespoon of ground flaxseed exceeds it. The supplement-shaped foods are not even the main dietary route in the UK and Northern Europe, where rapeseed oil supplies more ALA than flaxseed, chia and walnuts combined, and perilla oil is a higher-ALA culinary oil than flaxseed oil. The real question is not whether you can eat ALA but whether ALA becomes EPA and DHA in the body, and for DHA the answer is largely no.ALA 是本参考资料中最容易从食物获得的营养素之一。EFSA 将适宜摄入量定为能量的 0.5%，对 2,000-2,500 kcal 的膳食约为 1.1-1.4 g/day（EFSA Journal 2010;8(3):1461, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2010.1461；能量 0.5% 的换算在算术上核对无误：10 kcal/9 = 1.11 g，12.5/9 = 1.39 g）。一汤匙亚麻籽粉就超过了这个量。在英国和北欧，这些被做成补充剂形态的食物甚至不是主要的膳食途径：菜籽油提供的 ALA 超过亚麻籽、奇亚籽和核桃之和，而紫苏油的 ALA 含量还高于亚麻籽油。真正要问的是 ALA 在体内能否变成 EPA 和 DHA；吃够 ALA 本身毫无难度，而就 DHA 而言，答案基本是否定的。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 For ALA itself there is zero gap: one tablespoon of ground flaxseed (1.60 g), one ounce of walnuts (2.57 g), one ounce of hulled hemp seed (2.46 g), one tablespoon of walnut oil (1.41 g) or one tablespoon of rapeseed oil (about 1.2 g) each meet or exceed the 1.1-1.4 g/day AI, and one tablespoon of flaxseed oil supplies 7.26 g. The gap appears only when ALA is sold as a substitute for EPA and DHA, and the two substances need separate answers. For EPA, substitution is plausible at modest intakes: Burdge and Wootton 2002 measured 21% net fractional conversion of labelled ALA to EPA in young women (PMID 12323090, DOI 10.1079/BJN2002689), so a 250 mg/day EPA target needs 1.19 g ALA/day, which is about 0.7 tablespoons of ground flaxseed. For DHA, substitution fails at any realistic intake. The same paper gives 9% conversion to DHA and 6% to DPA in women, while in young men roughly 33% of the dose was oxidised within 24 hours, EPA and DPA were the only meaningful products, and no labelled DHA was detectable in plasma at any point over 21 days (PMID 12323085, DOI 10.1079/bjn2002662). Whole-body estimates are lower still, commonly 0.1-0.5% for DHA. At 0.5% you need 50 g ALA/day, which is 219 g of flaxseed or roughly 100 mL of flaxseed oil daily; at 0.1% you need 250 g ALA/day, over a kilogram of seed. No one eats that. Feeding trials agree, with plasma DHA unchanged after a month of flaxseed in any form (Austria 2008, PMID 18689552). State it plainly: flaxseed, chia and walnut oil can substitute for EPA at modest intakes and cannot supply DHA at any realistic intake. Express any of these requirements in milled seed rather than whole, since whole flaxseed produced no significant plasma ALA rise in that trial.就 ALA 本身而言差距为零：一汤匙亚麻籽粉（1.60 g）、一盎司核桃（2.57 g）、一盎司去壳大麻籽（2.46 g）、一汤匙核桃油（1.41 g）或一汤匙菜籽油（约 1.2 g），都达到或超过 1.1-1.4 g/day 的 AI，而一汤匙亚麻籽油提供 7.26 g。差距只在把 ALA 当作 EPA 和 DHA 的替代品出售时才出现，这两种物质需要分开回答。对 EPA，在中等摄入量下替代是可行的：Burdge 与 Wootton 2002 在年轻女性中测得标记 ALA 转化为 EPA 的净分数转化率为 21%（PMID 12323090, DOI 10.1079/BJN2002689），因此 250 mg/day 的 EPA 目标需要 1.19 g ALA/day，约合 0.7 汤匙亚麻籽粉。对 DHA，在任何现实摄入量下替代都行不通。同一篇论文给出女性向 DHA 的转化率为 9%、向 DPA 为 6%；而在年轻男性中，约 33% 的剂量在 24 小时内被氧化，EPA 和 DPA 是唯一有意义的产物，21 天内任何时间点血浆中都检测不到标记 DHA（PMID 12323085, DOI 10.1079/bjn2002662）。全身水平的估计更低，DHA 常见为 0.1-0.5%。按 0.5% 计需要 50 g ALA/day，即每天 219 g 亚麻籽或约 100 mL 亚麻籽油；按 0.1% 计需要 250 g ALA/day，超过一公斤籽。没有人这么吃。喂养试验的结果一致：食用任何形式的亚麻籽一个月后血浆 DHA 均无变化（Austria 2008, PMID 18689552）。直说结论：亚麻籽、奇亚籽和核桃油在中等摄入量下可以替代 EPA，在任何现实摄入量下都无法提供 DHA。上述需求量都应以研磨后的籽来表述，整粒籽不适用，因为该试验中整粒亚麻籽未使血浆 ALA 显著升高。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Form determines whether the ALA is absorbed at all, which is unusual among plant supplements. Over one month at matched ALA doses, flaxseed oil and milled flaxseed both raised plasma ALA significantly (oil higher than milled, P=0.004), while whole flaxseed produced no significant rise, and no group raised EPA or DHA (Austria 2008, PMID 18689552, DOI 10.1080/07315724.2008.10719693). Sprinkling whole seeds on food is close to decorative. Practical consequences: grind flaxseed, store it cold and use it quickly, because ALA at 53% of an oil is highly oxidisable and rancid flax oil is a pro-oxidant load rather than a benefit; flaxseed oil supplies ALA with none of the fibre or lignans of the seed; and conversion to EPA is suppressed by high dietary linoleic acid, so an ALA supplement taken alongside a diet heavy in sunflower or corn oil performs worse than the tracer figures suggest. Milled seed was also the best-tolerated form, with the oil and whole seed both causing gastrointestinal discomfort in that trial.形式决定 ALA 究竟能否被吸收，这在植物类补充剂中并不常见。在为期一个月的匹配 ALA 剂量试验中，亚麻籽油和研磨亚麻籽都显著提高了血浆 ALA（油高于研磨，P=0.004），整粒亚麻籽未带来显著升高，而没有任何一组提高了 EPA 或 DHA（Austria 2008, PMID 18689552, DOI 10.1080/07315724.2008.10719693）。把整粒籽撒在食物上，作用接近装饰。实际含义有几点：亚麻籽要现磨、冷藏并尽快用完，因为占油脂 53% 的 ALA 极易氧化，酸败的亚麻油带来的是促氧化负荷，谈不上益处；亚麻籽油只提供 ALA，不含籽中的膳食纤维和木酚素；膳食中亚油酸过高会抑制向 EPA 的转化，因此在大量食用葵花籽油或玉米油的膳食下服用 ALA 补充剂，效果比示踪剂数字所显示的更差。研磨籽也是耐受性最好的形式，该试验中油和整粒籽都引起了胃肠不适。

Absorption吸收 Two sequential losses. First, absorption and delivery: oil beats milled seed beats whole seed, with whole seed showing no measurable plasma ALA response (Austria 2008). Second, metabolic conversion, where the same enzyme chain (delta-6 desaturase, elongase, delta-5 desaturase, then peroxisomal beta-oxidation for DHA) is shared with linoleic acid and is the real bottleneck. Conversion rates differ by product and must not be interchanged: EPA 21% and DPA 6% in the tracer study in women, DHA 9% at best in the same study and undetectable in men over 21 days, with whole-body estimates commonly 0.1-0.5% for DHA. Women convert better than men, which is thought to reflect the demands of pregnancy and lactation. A third of an oral ALA dose is simply burned for energy within 24 hours.有两道先后损失。第一道是吸收和递送：油优于研磨籽，研磨籽优于整粒籽，整粒籽没有可测的血浆 ALA 反应（Austria 2008）。第二道是代谢转化，同一条酶链（delta-6 去饱和酶、延长酶、delta-5 去饱和酶，生成 DHA 还需过氧化物酶体 beta-氧化）与亚油酸共用，这才是真正的瓶颈。不同产物的转化率不同，不可互换使用：女性示踪研究中 EPA 为 21%、DPA 为 6%；同一研究中 DHA 最高 9%，而男性在 21 天内检测不到；全身水平的估计对 DHA 常见为 0.1-0.5%。女性的转化优于男性，一般认为这反映了妊娠和哺乳的需求。口服 ALA 剂量的三分之一在 24 小时内直接被燃烧供能。

Pros优点

  • It is the correct product for vegans, who cannot obtain preformed EPA and DHA any other way, and for whom ALA conversion is inadequate.对纯素者而言这是正确的产品，他们无法通过其他途径获得预成型的 EPA 和 DHA，而 ALA 转化又不足。
  • Statistically non-inferior to fish oil for plasma phospholipid DHA and EPA in a 74-person trial over 6 to 14 weeks.在一项 74 人、持续 6 至 14 周的试验中，血浆磷脂 DHA 和 EPA 在统计学上不劣于鱼油。
  • Avoids methylmercury, dioxins and PCBs, which is a legitimate reason to choose it in pregnancy.可避开甲基汞、二噁英和多氯联苯，这是妊娠期选择它的正当理由。

Cons缺点

  • There is no clinical outcome trial of algal oil for any endpoint. The only evidence is a 74-person biomarker study, and the credibility it borrows comes from the fish oil outcome trials, which were largely null.藻油在任何终点上都没有临床结局试验。唯一的证据是一项 74 人的生物标志物研究，而它借来的可信度出自鱼油的结局试验，那些试验大体上是阴性的。
  • Non-inferiority on a biomarker is not superiority, and marketing implying algal DHA is cleaner therefore better conflates contaminant avoidance with efficacy.在生物标志物上不劣于并不等于优于，而暗示“藻油 DHA 更干净所以更好”的营销，把避开污染物和有效性混为一谈。
  • Cost per milligram of DHA is usually higher than fish oil.每毫克 DHA 的成本通常高于鱼油。
  • Products are DHA-dominant, and DHA raises LDL more than EPA does (+6.9% versus +2.2% in a head-to-head crossover), which matters if LDL is your limiting problem.这类产品以 DHA 为主，而 DHA 升高低密度脂蛋白的幅度大于 EPA（头对头交叉试验中为 +6.9% 对 +2.2%），如果低密度脂蛋白是你的主要问题，这一点很要紧。

Food sources食物来源

Trace amounts only仅有痕量 Dose NOT reachable by eating靠吃达不到剂量 Data confidence: Medium数据可信度：中

The classification depends entirely on who is eating, so it has to be stated by population. For an omnivore EPA and DHA are RICH in food: one herring fillet supplies 2,873 mg, one tablespoon of caviar 1,046 mg (see the Omega-3 entry). For a strict vegan the answer is TRACE, and that is the population this product exists for: raw laver (nori) has 80 mg EPA per 100 g and zero DHA, which is 2 mg of EPA per standard sheet, and dried spirulina, routinely marketed as a vegan omega-3 food, contains 0.000 g of both EPA and DHA (it does carry 823 mg/100 g of ALA, 58 mg per 7 g tablespoon, which is not the same nutrient). For a lacto-ovo vegetarian the honest answer sits between the two, because eggs supply preformed DHA at 58 mg/100 g, about 29 mg per large 50 g egg, and DHA-enriched eggs several times that. The earlier draft elided vegan and vegetarian and so overstated the case. The production organism is not a food either: Schizochytrium sp. is a single-cell marine microalga cultured in fermenters and authorised in the EU as a novel food.这个分类完全取决于食用者是谁，因此必须按人群分别陈述。对杂食者来说，食物中的 EPA 和 DHA 属于 RICH（丰富）：一片鲱鱼柳提供 2,873 mg，一汤匙鱼子酱 1,046 mg（见欧米伽-3 条目）。对严格素食者（vegan）来说答案是 TRACE（微量），而这类产品正是为这一人群而存在的：生紫菜（nori）每 100 g 含 80 mg EPA，DHA 为零，折合每标准张 2 mg EPA；常被当作纯素欧米伽-3 食品营销的干螺旋藻，EPA 和 DHA 含量均为 0.000 g（它确实含 823 mg/100 g 的 ALA，每 7 g 汤匙 58 mg，这是另一种营养素）。对蛋奶素食者来说，诚实的答案介于两者之间，因为鸡蛋提供预形成的 DHA，含量为 58 mg/100 g，一枚 50 g 大鸡蛋约 29 mg，而 DHA 强化蛋是这个量的数倍。早前的草稿把纯素和素食混为一谈，因而夸大了结论。生产藻种本身也不是食物：Schizochytrium sp. 是在发酵罐中培养的单细胞海洋微藻，在欧盟按新型食品获得批准。
