To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 For a strict vegan the gap is unbridgeable for DHA and absurd for EPA. Typical algal oil products sit at 250 mg/day of DHA for general adult use and 450 mg/day for pregnancy and lactation. Matching 250 mg of EPA from nori would take 312 g of raw laver, about 120 sheets a day. Matching any amount of DHA from nori is impossible, since the USDA value is 0.000 g, and spirulina supplies zero of both. No seaweed portion, no fermented food and no oilseed closes this gap, which is why algal oil is one of the few supplements in this reference with a real and unavoidable role. For a lacto-ovo vegetarian eggs get partway and no further: 250 mg of DHA is about nine large eggs a day, so two eggs (58 mg) cover 23% of the target and one covers 12%. DHA-enriched eggs shorten that considerably. For an omnivore the same 250 mg of DHA is one 45 g tin of anchovies (580 mg DHA) or half a tin of sardines.对严格素食者来说，DHA 的差距无法弥合，EPA 的差距则荒谬。典型藻油产品对一般成人为 250 mg/day DHA，孕期和哺乳期为 450 mg/day。用紫菜凑足 250 mg EPA 需要 312 g 生紫菜，约每天 120 张。用紫菜凑任何数量的 DHA 都不可能，因为 USDA 数值为 0.000 g，而螺旋藻两者都是零。没有任何一份海藻、任何发酵食品或任何油料籽能填上这个缺口，这也是藻油成为本参考资料中少数具有真实且不可回避作用的补充剂的原因。对蛋奶素食者，鸡蛋只能补上一段：250 mg DHA 约相当于每天九枚大鸡蛋，因此两枚（58 mg）覆盖目标的 23%，一枚覆盖 12%。DHA 强化蛋能把这个数字大幅缩短。对杂食者，同样的 250 mg DHA 等于一罐 45 g 凤尾鱼（580 mg DHA）或半罐沙丁鱼。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 The strain determines what you get, and the earlier generalisation was too broad. EFSA's assessment of strain WZU477 specifies DHA at 32.0% of total fatty acids or above, with batches measured at 40.5-46.3%, and EPA at a single value of about 0.56% (EFSA Journal 2020;18(10):6242, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2020.6242). That is one strain, and the same opinion explicitly contrasts it with other authorised Schizochytrium strains carrying 1.3-6% EPA. So a DHA-dominant oil from this strain is not an EPA supplement, but 'a product labelled vegan omega-3 may supply almost no EPA' does not follow for the category: check the strain and the declared EPA content. On the positive side, this is one case where the concentrated product is cleaner than the food, because the algae are grown in closed fermenters rather than harvested from the sea, so algal oil avoids the methylmercury of predatory fish and the dioxin and PCB burden that makes fatty fish a leading dietary contributor to European dioxin exposure (EFSA Journal 2018;16(11):5333, document confirmed). The usual oxidation caveat applies, since a highly unsaturated oil in a clear bottle or an old capsule degrades, and a fishy aftertaste is the tell. Do not substitute algae biomass powders (spirulina, chlorella) for algal oil; they are different organisms with no DHA.藻株决定你得到什么，早前的概括过于笼统。EFSA 对 WZU477 藻株的评估规定 DHA 占总脂肪酸 32.0% 及以上，实测批次为 40.5-46.3%，EPA 为约 0.56% 的单一数值（EFSA Journal 2020;18(10):6242, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2020.6242）。这只是一个藻株，同一份意见还明确将其与其他获批的 Schizochytrium 藻株（EPA 为 1.3-6%）作了对比。因此，来自该藻株的 DHA 主导型油不能当作 EPA 补充剂，但“标称纯素欧米伽-3 的产品可能几乎不含 EPA”这一推论对整个类别并不成立：请核对藻株和声称的 EPA 含量。从积极面看，这是浓缩产品比食物更洁净的一个例子，因为藻类是在封闭发酵罐中培养的，没有从海里捕捞，所以藻油避开了掠食性鱼类的甲基汞，也避开了使多脂鱼成为欧洲膳食二噁英暴露主要来源的二噁英和 PCB 负荷（EFSA Journal 2018;16(11):5333，文件已确认）。通常的氧化提醒同样适用：高度不饱和的油放在透明瓶中，或存放过久的胶囊，都会降解，鱼腥的余味就是信号。不要用藻类生物量粉（螺旋藻、小球藻）替代藻油，它们是不同的生物，不含 DHA。

Absorption吸收 Algal oil DHA is nutritionally equivalent to DHA from fish. A randomised trial comparing algal-oil capsules with cooked salmon found the two equivalent as DHA sources by blood incorporation (Arterburn 2008, PMID 18589030, DOI 10.1016/j.jada.2008.04.020). Absorption follows the same rules as other marine oils, so triglyceride forms behave like natural fish oil and take-with-a-meal advice applies. Some DHA retroconverts to EPA in the body, which partly offsets the low EPA content of DHA-dominant algal oils, though not reliably enough to treat a DHA-only product as an EPA source.藻油 DHA 在营养上与鱼类来源的 DHA 等效。一项将藻油胶囊与熟三文鱼作比较的随机试验发现，按血液掺入衡量，两者作为 DHA 来源等效（Arterburn 2008, PMID 18589030, DOI 10.1016/j.jada.2008.04.020）。吸收遵循与其他海洋油脂相同的规律，甘油三酯形式的表现与天然鱼油一致，随餐服用的建议同样适用。体内有部分 DHA 会逆转化为 EPA，这在一定程度上弥补了 DHA 主导型藻油 EPA 含量低的问题，但可靠性不足以把只含 DHA 的产品当作 EPA 来源。

Data note数据说明 The three composition rows are all traced to USDA records and confirmed, including the two zero values that carry the debunking point, and the nori arithmetic (2 mg per sheet, 0.8% of a 250 mg dose, 312 g or about 120 sheets) recomputes exactly. The dose figures are the weak part: the 250 mg/day and 450 mg/day conditions were attributed to an EFSA opinion that contains neither, and the correct source, the Union list of novel foods under Regulation (EU) 2017/2470, was not verified in this pass. The population framing also had to be rebuilt, since the original TRACE label was applied to vegans and vegetarians together中。三行成分数据全部可追溯到 USDA 记录并已确认，包括承载纠错要点的两个零值；紫菜的算术（每张 2 mg，占 250 mg 剂量的 0.8%，312 g 约 120 张）复算完全一致。薄弱之处是剂量数字：250 mg/day 和 450 mg/day 的使用条件被归到一份并不含这两个数值的 EFSA 意见上，而正确来源即 Regulation (EU) 2017/2470 下的新型食品联盟清单，本轮未予核实。人群框架也必须重建，因为原来的 TRACE 标签把纯素者和素食者一并套用了。

Pros优点

  • It is the clearest case in this document of a refuted product still sold into the exact indication where it failed. Soluble fibre by contrast gave 0.83 (0.73-0.94), NNT 7.这是本文中最清楚的一个例子：一个已被推翻的产品，仍然被卖进它恰恰失败的那个适应证。合并的麦麸试验：肠易激症状持续的相对风险 0.90（0.79-1.03），阴性。相比之下可溶性纤维为 0.83（0.73-0.94），NNT 7。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose reachable by eating靠吃可以达到剂量 Data confidence: Medium数据可信度：中

Wheat bran is a food, sold as a plain milled cereal fraction, and at 42.8 g total dietary fibre per 100 g (USDA FDC 169722) it is one of the most fibre-dense ordinary cereal fractions. The submission's claim that it is among the most fibre-dense foods in any composition table is false and has been removed: corn bran at 79 g/100 g ranks first among roughly 4,000 USDA foods, nearly double wheat bran, and psyllium husk is about 78 g/100 g. RICH is demonstrated for the cereal-bran supplements specifically, which is where food comparators exist: wheat bran, corn bran, rice bran. The other common insoluble-fibre supplement base, powdered or microcrystalline cellulose and methylcellulose, is a manufactured material with no dietary equivalent, so the RICH grade does not extend to it. Availability is not the problem with this product category; the indication is.小麦麸是食物，作为普通研磨谷物分层出售，每 100 g 含总膳食纤维 42.8 g（USDA FDC 169722），属于纤维密度最高的普通谷物分层之一。原稿称它是任何成分表中纤维最密集的食物之一，这一说法不成立，已删除：玉米麸 79 g/100 g 在约 4,000 种 USDA 食物中排第一，接近小麦麸的两倍，洋车前子壳约为 78 g/100 g。RICH 的判定专门适用于谷物麸皮类补充剂，因为只有这一类存在食物对照：小麦麸、玉米麸、米糠。另一类常见的不可溶性纤维补充剂基料，即粉状或微晶纤维素与甲基纤维素，属于人造材料，没有膳食对应物，RICH 等级不延伸到它们。这一产品类别的问题与可得性无关，问题出在适应证上。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 The 10 g/day of bran tested against psyllium and placebo in IBS (PMID 19713235) is about 3 heaped tablespoons of plain wheat bran, which carries 4.28 g of dietary fibre. Matched on fibre, that is about 1 serving of bran flakes, not the 2 the submission claimed: one 29 g serving supplies 4.90 g, so two servings deliver more than double the fibre in the trial dose. A single cup of crude bran (58 g) is 5.8x the trial dose by mass. No supplement is needed to reach it. What the trial found is that reaching it does not help: bran was no better than placebo in months one and two, its month-three advantage did not survive worst-case analysis, and early dropout was highest in the bran arm because IBS symptoms worsened. A review of the wheat bran literature reaches the same conclusion and quotes official guidance that wheat bran should not be recommended to people with IBS (DOI 10.3109/09637486.2012.687366).在 IBS 中与洋车前子和安慰剂对照的 10 g/day 麸皮（PMID 19713235）大约是 3 满汤匙普通小麦麸，含 4.28 g 膳食纤维。按纤维匹配，这相当于约 1 份麸皮薄片，原稿说的 2 份是错的：一份 29 g 提供 4.90 g，两份的纤维量超过试验剂量的两倍。一杯粗麸皮（58 g）按质量计是试验剂量的 5.8 倍。达到这个量不需要任何补充剂。试验的发现是达到了也没用：第一、二个月麸皮不优于安慰剂，第三个月的优势在最差情况分析下不成立，而且麸皮组的早期退出率最高，原因是 IBS 症状加重。一篇小麦麸文献综述得出同样结论，并引用官方指南指出不应向 IBS 患者推荐小麦麸（DOI 10.3109/09637486.2012.687366）。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 The food is safe and useful; the supplement indication is the problem. Wheat bran is a genuinely effective faecal bulking agent, increasing stool by roughly 5 g per 1 g of bran consumed, at the top of the accepted 3-5.4 g range (DOI 10.3109/09637486.2012.687366), and it is a reasonable food for ordinary constipation and general fibre intake. In IBS it commonly worsens bloating, distension and pain, and it was the arm patients dropped out of. A less obvious caveat: wheat bran carries fructan (white wheat flour measures 0.75 g fructan/100 g, DOI 10.3389/fnut.2024.1446771), so bran-loading also raises FODMAP intake in exactly the patients least able to tolerate it. Insoluble-fibre supplements sold as 'IBS fibre' are marketing the wrong fibre class; the evidence in IBS favours the viscous, poorly fermented kind.食物本身安全且有用，问题在于补充剂的适应证。小麦麸确实是有效的粪便增容剂，每摄入 1 g 麸皮可使粪便增加约 5 g，处于公认 3-5.4 g 区间的上端（DOI 10.3109/09637486.2012.687366），对普通便秘和整体纤维摄入是合理的食物。在 IBS 中它常加重胀气、腹胀和疼痛，患者退出最多的正是这一组。一个不太明显的注意点：小麦麸带有果聚糖（白小麦面粉测得 0.75 g 果聚糖/100 g，DOI 10.3389/fnut.2024.1446771），所以加大麸皮摄入也会在最难耐受的那部分患者身上提高 FODMAP 摄入量。以“IBS 纤维”名义出售的不可溶性纤维补充剂推销的是错误的纤维类别，IBS 的证据支持的是黏性、难发酵的那一类。

Absorption吸收 Not absorbed. The mechanism is mechanical bulking plus water-holding by arabinoxylan and cellulose, and the non-starch polysaccharide of the bran is 70% arabinoxylan, 24% cellulose and 6% beta-glucan (Stevenson et al., PMID 22716911, quotation verified). Bran accelerates small bowel transit and increases faecal weight dose-dependently. Particle size matters more than gram total, because coarse bran bulks and irritates while finely milled bran loses much of the effect, so two products with the same fibre label are not interchangeable. Only 1.5-4.0 g per 100 g is soluble, so bran contributes almost nothing to the viscous-gel effects on cholesterol, glycaemia and stool consistency that people often assume fibre delivers.不被吸收。机制是机械增容加上阿拉伯木聚糖与纤维素的持水作用，麸皮的非淀粉多糖组成为 70% 阿拉伯木聚糖、24% 纤维素和 6% β-葡聚糖（beta-glucan）（Stevenson et al., PMID 22716911，引文已核实）。麸皮加快小肠通过速度，并以剂量依赖方式增加粪便重量。颗粒大小比总克数更重要，粗麸皮既增容也造成刺激，细磨麸皮则丧失大部分效果，所以纤维标签相同的两种产品并不能互换。每 100 g 中只有 1.5-4.0 g 是可溶的，所以人们常以为纤维能带来的降胆固醇、控血糖和改善粪便质地的黏胶效应，麸皮几乎没有贡献。

Data note数据说明 The core wheat values were confirmed against USDA legacy records (wheat bran 42.8, whole-wheat bread 6.0, whole-grain flour 10.7), as were the Stevenson NSP split and the Bijkerk trial narrative. Weaknesses: the bran flakes FDC ID could not be resolved, the whole-wheat bread slice weight is unconfirmed, and the corn bran, rice bran and all-bran figures come from the verification report's compiled values with conventional rather than sourced portion weights中。小麦相关的核心数值已对照 USDA legacy 记录确认（小麦麸 42.8，全麦面包 6.0，全麦面粉 10.7），Stevenson 的 NSP 组成拆分和 Bijkerk 试验叙述同样已确认。薄弱处：麸皮薄片的 FDC ID 无法确定，全麦面包的每片重量未获确认，玉米麸、米糠和全麸谷物的数字来自核查报告汇编的数值，份量重量为常规值而非取自来源记录。

SKIPOver-the-counter digestive enzyme blends非处方复合消化酶Grade D证据 D 级
Dose tested已验证剂量No evidence-derived dose exists. Products are dosed in non-comparable proprietary activity units by design.不存在源自证据的剂量。这类产品按互不可比的专有活性单位计量，且这是设计如此。
Who it is for适用人群No identified group. Use a matched single enzyme for a diagnosed deficiency instead.没有确定的适用人群。确诊缺乏某种酶时，应使用对应的单一酶。

Pros优点

  • One 120-participant double-blind placebo-controlled trial of a fungal multi-enzyme blend reported improvement in functional dyspepsia symptom and quality-of-life scores. Single centre, proprietary product, symptom-scale endpoints.一项 120 人的双盲安慰剂对照试验，用真菌来源的复合酶，报告功能性消化不良症状和生活质量评分改善。单中心、专有产品、症状量表终点。

Cons缺点

  • The category is built on a fabricated disease. There is no recognised syndrome of generalised digestive enzyme insufficiency in healthy adults, and clinically meaningful malabsorption does not appear until roughly 90% of exocrine pancreatic function is lost.这个品类建立在一个被制造出来的疾病之上。健康成人不存在公认的“全面消化酶不足”综合征，而要出现有临床意义的吸收不良，需要外分泌胰腺功能损失约 90%。
  • It borrows credibility from prescription pancreatic enzyme replacement, which treats a real, objectively diagnosable condition.它从处方胰酶替代治疗那里借来了可信度，而后者治疗的是一种真实、可客观诊断的疾病。
  • The main harm is diagnostic delay. Self-treating undiagnosed persistent gut symptoms delays diagnosis of coeliac disease, inflammatory bowel disease, pancreatic disease and colorectal cancer.主要危害是延误诊断。自行处理未确诊的持续胃肠症状，会延误乳糜泻、炎症性肠病、胰腺疾病和结直肠癌的诊断。
  • A properly controlled trial in autism (43 children, double-blind crossover) found no clinically significant improvement, in a population where these products were heavily promoted.一项在孤独症人群中设计规范的试验（43 名儿童，双盲交叉）未发现有临床意义的改善，而这些产品曾在该人群中被大力推销。

Food sources食物来源

Trace amounts only仅有痕量 Dose NOT reachable by eating靠吃达不到剂量 Data confidence: Low数据可信度：低

Reclassified from NOT_FOOD, which was too strong and was contradicted by this entry's own form caveat. The plant proteases do occur in ordinary food: fruit bromelain is present in edible pineapple flesh and juice with real proteolytic activity, which is exactly why fresh pineapple stops gelatin setting and canned does not; papain occurs in unripe papaya flesh as well as in the latex that is the commercial source; and actinidin, a cysteine protease, is present in ordinary edible ripe green kiwifruit, with human data comparing green (actinidin-containing) against gold (actinidin-free) kiwifruit for gastric protein digestion. Ginger (zingibain), fig latex (ficin), malted barley (diastatic amylase) and raw honey (diastase) are further real dietary enzyme sources. What remains genuinely NOT_FOOD is the other half of these blends: the amylase, protease, lipase and lactase components are Aspergillus or yeast fermentation products with no dietary presence. TRACE rather than PARTIAL because the activity in edible flesh is present without any confirmed quantification, and the parts carrying the measured activity are not eaten.原为 NOT_FOOD，判定过重，且与本条自己的剂型注意点自相矛盾，故重新分级。植物蛋白酶确实存在于普通食物中：果实菠萝蛋白酶存在于可食的菠萝果肉和果汁中，具有真实的蛋白水解活性，这正是新鲜菠萝会让明胶无法凝固而罐装菠萝不会的原因；木瓜蛋白酶除存在于作为商业来源的乳汁中，也存在于未熟木瓜的果肉里；猕猴桃蛋白酶（actinidin）是一种半胱氨酸蛋白酶，存在于普通可食的成熟绿肉猕猴桃中，并有人体数据用绿肉（含 actinidin）与金果（不含 actinidin）猕猴桃比较胃内蛋白消化。姜（zingibain）、无花果乳汁（ficin）、麦芽大麦（麦芽淀粉酶）和生蜂蜜（diastase）是另外几种真实的膳食酶来源。真正仍属 NOT_FOOD 的是这些复配产品的另一半：其中的淀粉酶、蛋白酶、脂肪酶和乳糖酶组分是 Aspergillus 或酵母发酵产物，在膳食中不存在。评为 TRACE 而未评 PARTIAL，原因是可食果肉中的活性虽然存在却没有任何经确认的定量，而携带已测活性的部位并不被食用。

This is the clearest food route for a swallowed protease and it is why the NOT_FOOD grade was withdrawn.
Pineapple, raw flesh菠萝，生果肉 contains fruit bromelain (pI 4.6, distinct from stem bromelain at pI 9.5); no proteolytic activity value for the eaten flesh was retrieved in this pass 1 cup chunks (about 165 g), conventional portion1 杯块状（约 165 g），常规份量 proteolytic activity present but unquantified here not expressible; the measured GDU/g values in the literature belong to basal stem, peel and core rather than to flesh无法表达；文献中实测的 GDU/g 数值属于茎基部、果皮和果心，不属于果肉 USDA FDC 169124 records the edible fruit but carries no enzyme activity value. To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 Bromelain supplements are dosed by activity, typically 500-2,000 mg of a preparation standardised to around 2,400 GDU/g, giving roughly 1,200-4,800 GDU per dose. On the activities reported for pineapple by-products, that is equivalent to about 0.41-1.65 g of basal stem or about 1.0-4.1 g of peel, and neither the basal stem nor the peel is eaten (those per-gram activity values are from a genuine, on-topic paper whose individual figures could not be retrieved, so treat them as unconfirmed). Expressed against food you would actually put in your mouth, the dose cannot be matched: the crown has no detectable activity, the core is usually discarded, and no sourced activity figure exists for the ripe flesh. Fresh pineapple and green kiwifruit do deliver active protease into the stomach, so the effect is not zero, but with no confirmed activity value for edible flesh there is no way to express a food equivalent of a GDU dose. For papain the source material is the latex of the unripe fruit, which is irritant and is not food. For the fungal amylase, protease and lipase components there is no food source at all.菠萝蛋白酶补充剂按活性给药，典型为 500-2,000 mg 标准化到约 2,400 GDU/g 的制剂，每次剂量约 1,200-4,800 GDU。按菠萝副产物报告的活性折算，这相当于约 0.41-1.65 g 茎基部或约 1.0-4.1 g 果皮，而茎基部和果皮都不会被吃掉（这些每克活性值出自一篇真实且切题的论文，其中的单项数字无法调取，应视为未确认）。若换成真正会放进嘴里的食物来表达，这个剂量无法匹配：冠芽检测不到活性，果心通常被丢弃，成熟果肉则没有有据可查的活性数据。新鲜菠萝和绿肉猕猴桃确实会把有活性的蛋白酶送进胃里，所以效果不为零，但在缺少可食果肉活性确认值的情况下，没有办法把 GDU 剂量换算成食物当量。木瓜蛋白酶的原料是未熟果实的乳汁，有刺激性，不属于食物。至于真菌来源的淀粉酶、蛋白酶和脂肪酶组分，根本没有食物来源。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 The whole food is safe and the concentrate is not always. Fresh pineapple and papaya are ordinary fruit; concentrated bromelain has anticoagulant and antiplatelet activity and interacts with warfarin and antiplatelet drugs, and papain and chymopapain are recognised respiratory and contact allergens, which EFSA flags in its allergenicity assessments of the food enzyme (the specific identifier cited in the submission, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2026.9950, could not be confirmed; EFSA does publish opinions on papain from papaya latex, so the substance of the point stands while that reference does not). The matrix also destroys the premise: these are proteins, so heat and gastric acid inactivate them. Canned and cooked pineapple has no meaningful proteolytic activity left, which is why canned pineapple does not stop gelatin setting while fresh pineapple does, and any orally swallowed enzyme without enteric protection meets pepsin and pH 2 before reaching the small intestine. The most important caveat is scope: these blends are not equivalent to pancreatic enzyme replacement and must not be substituted for it in diagnosed pancreatic exocrine insufficiency, where the requirement is 40,000-50,000 lipase units per meal in an enteric-coated porcine preparation (PMID 42011215). Nor is the plant-derived lactase in a blend interchangeable with a dose-standardised lactase product.整食是安全的，浓缩物未必。新鲜菠萝和木瓜是普通水果；浓缩菠萝蛋白酶有抗凝和抗血小板活性，与华法林及抗血小板药物存在相互作用，木瓜蛋白酶和木瓜凝乳蛋白酶（chymopapain）是公认的呼吸道和接触性致敏物，EFSA 在对该食品酶的致敏性评估中已提示这一点（原稿引用的具体标识 DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2026.9950 无法确认；EFSA 确实发布过关于木瓜乳汁来源木瓜蛋白酶的意见，因此论点本身成立，那个引用不成立）。基质本身也推翻了前提：这些是蛋白质，加热和胃酸会使其失活。罐装和加热过的菠萝已没有有意义的蛋白水解活性，这正是罐装菠萝不会阻止明胶凝固而新鲜菠萝会的原因；任何口服吞下且无肠溶保护的酶，在到达小肠之前都会遇到胃蛋白酶和 pH 2。最重要的注意点是适用范围：这些复配产品不等同于胰酶替代治疗，在已确诊的胰腺外分泌不足中绝不能用来替代，那里的要求是每餐 40,000-50,000 单位脂肪酶的肠溶包衣猪源制剂（PMID 42011215）。复配产品中植物来源的乳糖酶也不能与剂量标准化的乳糖酶产品互换。

Absorption吸收 Enzymes are not absorbed and do not need to be; they act in the lumen, so what matters is surviving to the right pH and place. Stem bromelain and fruit bromelain differ even in isoelectric point (pI 9.5 against 4.6), which is why extraction pH determines which enzyme you actually get and why 'bromelain' on a label does not identify a single molecule. Activity rather than milligrams is the meaningful unit, and GDU, CDU, FIP and USP units are not interconvertible, so a milligram figure on a bottle says almost nothing about what it will do. Both bromelain and papain are irreversibly denatured by cooking and largely by gastric acid unless enterically protected, so an uncoated capsule and a bowl of fresh pineapple share the same delivery problem.酶不被吸收，也不需要被吸收；它们在肠腔内起作用，所以关键是能否在合适的 pH 和部位存活下来。茎菠萝蛋白酶与果实菠萝蛋白酶连等电点都不同（pI 9.5 对 4.6），这就是提取 pH 决定你实际拿到哪种酶的原因，也是标签上写菠萝蛋白酶并不指向单一分子的原因。有意义的单位是活性。GDU、CDU、FIP 和 USP 单位之间无法互换，所以瓶子上的毫克数几乎说明不了它能做什么。菠萝蛋白酶和木瓜蛋白酶都会因加热而不可逆变性，若无肠溶保护也大多被胃酸破坏，所以无包衣胶囊和一碗新鲜菠萝面对的是同一个递送问题。

Data note数据说明 The quantitative core of this entry could not be verified. The pineapple by-product activities (2,909 GDU/g basal stem, 1,179 GDU/g peel, 694 GDU/g core, crown below detection) come from a genuine and on-topic paper (PMID 38397568) whose individual values were not retrieved, and every dose equivalence derives from them. The EFSA papain identifier could not be confirmed. The two food rows are qualitative because no activity figure for edible pineapple flesh or kiwifruit was retrieved. Only the supplement-side arithmetic (1,200-4,800 GDU per dose) and the bromelain isoform biochemistry check out低。本条的定量核心无法核实。菠萝副产物活性（茎基部 2,909 GDU/g，果皮 1,179 GDU/g，果心 694 GDU/g，冠芽低于检出限）出自一篇真实且切题的论文（PMID 38397568），但其中的单项数值未被调取，而所有剂量当量都由它们推导而来。EFSA 木瓜蛋白酶的标识无法确认。两个食物行只能定性，因为没有检索到可食菠萝果肉或猕猴桃的活性数据。只有补充剂一侧的算术（每次剂量 1,200-4,800 GDU）和菠萝蛋白酶同工型的生化特性经得起核对。

References:文献： Ullah PMID 37976892; Munasinghe PMID 20204691; de la Iglesia-Garcia PMID 27941156
SKIPL-glutamine for gut repairL-谷氨酰胺用于修复肠道Grade C证据 C 级
Dose tested已验证剂量15 g/d as 5 g three times daily for 8 weeks in the only supportive gut trial.唯一一项支持性肠道试验为 15 克/天，即 5 克每日三次、持续 8 周。
Who it is for适用人群Narrowly, post-infectious diarrhoea-predominant IBS with objectively documented increased intestinal permeability.严格来说，仅限感染后腹泻型肠易激且已客观证实肠道通透性增加者。

Pros优点

  • The one supportive trial is genuinely striking: 106 patients, 79.6% versus 5.8% achieved a 50-point reduction in IBS severity score over 8 weeks, with normalisation of intestinal permeability.唯一那项支持性试验的结果确实惊人：106 名患者，8 周内肠易激严重度评分下降 50 分的比例为 79.6% 对 5.8%，且肠道通透性恢复正常。
  • It has a licensed pharmaceutical use in sickle cell disease, where a phase 3 trial reduced median pain crises from 4.0 to 3.0.它在镰状细胞病中有获批的药用，一项三期试验把疼痛危机中位数从 4.0 降到 3.0。

Cons缺点

  • A 14-fold difference in response rate is an effect size almost never seen in functional gastrointestinal disease, and the 5.8% placebo response is far below the 30 to 40% typical of IBS trials. That combination demands scepticism, not enthusiasm. It is a single-centre, unreplicated result.应答率相差 14 倍，这种效应量在功能性胃肠病中几乎从未出现，而 5.8% 的安慰剂应答率远低于肠易激试验典型的 30 至 40%。这两点合在一起要求的是怀疑，不是兴奋。它是一项单中心、未被重复的结果。
  • There is a mortality signal in the critically ill. In the REDOXS trial, high-dose glutamine given to 1,223 critically ill adults with multi-organ failure raised 28-day mortality to 32.4% versus 27.2%, adjusted OR 1.28.在危重患者中存在死亡信号。REDOXS 试验中，对 1223 名多器官功能衰竭的危重成人给予高剂量谷氨酰胺，28 天死亡率升至 32.4%，对照为 27.2%，校正 OR 1.28。
  • Contraindicated in hepatic impairment, cirrhosis and any history of hepatic encephalopathy, because glutamine is metabolised to glutamate and ammonia.肝功能不全、肝硬化和有肝性脑病史者禁用，因为谷氨酰胺会代谢为谷氨酸和氨。
  • It is the chemical anchor of the entire leaky gut supplement economy, and the gap between that market and the evidence is enormous.它是整个“肠漏”补充剂经济的化学支点，而那个市场与证据之间的差距极大。

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose partly reachable靠吃只能部分达到 Data confidence: Medium数据可信度：中

Glutamine is one of the most abundant amino acids in ordinary dietary protein, so any protein-containing meal supplies it. One caveat governs every number below: USDA composition tables report 'glutamic acid', which after the acid hydrolysis used in amino acid analysis is the sum of glutamate and glutamine, because glutamine is converted to glutamate during hydrolysis. The figures are therefore the combined Glu plus Gln pool, and the glutamine share of that pool is roughly half in most animal proteins. Treat the values as an upper bound on glutamine content.谷氨酰胺是普通膳食蛋白中含量最高的氨基酸之一，任何含蛋白的一餐都能提供。下面每一个数字都受一条限定条件约束：USDA 成分表报告的是“谷氨酸”，在氨基酸分析所用的酸水解之后，这个值是谷氨酸与谷氨酰胺之和，因为谷氨酰胺在水解过程中被转化为谷氨酸。因此这些数字是 Glu 加 Gln 的合并池，在多数动物蛋白中谷氨酰胺约占该池的一半。请把这些数值当作谷氨酰胺含量的上限。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 The trial dose is 5 g three times daily, 15 g/day for 8 weeks, in post-infectious diarrhoea-predominant IBS with increased intestinal permeability (Zhou et al., Gut 2019;68:996-1002, PMID 30108163). On the combined Glu plus Gln figures, 15 g comes from about 50-60 g of vital wheat gluten, about 79-88 g of soy protein isolate, about 183 g of parmesan, about 323 g of cooked chicken breast, about 440 g of cod (about 2.5 fillets), about 450 g of natto (corrected from the submission's 865 g, which was wrong by 1.9x) or roughly 1.1 kg of cooked lentils. Correcting for the fact that only about half that pool is glutamine, matching 15 g of glutamine specifically needs roughly double: about 100-120 g of vital wheat gluten a day, or 600-700 g of cooked chicken breast. The baseline matters more than the ceiling. Glutamine is roughly 4-8% of food protein, so a diet supplying 80-100 g of protein delivers about 4-7 g/day, consistent with the conventional 3-6 g/day estimate. A 15 g/day supplement is therefore a three- to four-fold increase over habitual intake, not the doubling the submission claimed, which makes this a moderate gap rather than a small one. It is still nothing like creatine or NMN, where food cannot get close.试验剂量为每次 5 g、每天三次，即 15 g/day，持续 8 周，用于伴肠道通透性升高的感染后腹泻型 IBS（Zhou et al., Gut 2019;68:996-1002, PMID 30108163）。按 Glu 加 Gln 合并值计算，15 g 来自约 50-60 g 谷朊粉（活性小麦面筋）、约 79-88 g 大豆分离蛋白、约 183 g 帕玛森奶酪、约 323 g 熟鸡胸肉、约 440 g 鳕鱼（约 2.5 片鱼柳）、约 450 g 纳豆（原稿写 865 g，偏差 1.9 倍，已更正），或约 1.1 kg 熟扁豆。考虑到该池中只有约一半是谷氨酰胺，要专门凑够 15 g 谷氨酰胺需要大约翻倍：每天约 100-120 g 谷朊粉，或 600-700 g 熟鸡胸肉。基线比上限更值得关注。谷氨酰胺约占食物蛋白的 4-8%，因此提供 80-100 g 蛋白的饮食可提供约 4-7 g/day，与常规估计的 3-6 g/day 一致。这样看，15 g/day 的补充剂相当于把习惯摄入量提高三到四倍，原稿说的翻倍并不成立，本条的差距因此从很小改判为中等。它仍然完全不同于肌酸或 NMN，那两者靠食物根本接近不了。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 The difference is in the delivery rather than the amount. The trial gave 5 g of free crystalline L-glutamine three times a day on an empty-stomach schedule, producing a sharp luminal and plasma bolus; dietary glutamine arrives protein-bound, released slowly by digestion, and a large fraction is consumed by the enterocytes themselves on first pass. Whether the clinical effect depends on that bolus pattern has not been tested against a food-protein comparator, so 'just eat more protein' remains plausible and unproven. Two practical points: free glutamine is heat-labile and degrades in aqueous solution, so cooking and storage reduce free glutamine in food while leaving protein-bound glutamine intact; and glutamine supplementation is not risk-free in everyone, since it is a nitrogen donor and high doses warrant caution in hepatic or renal impairment, whereas the same amount arriving as ordinary food protein raises no comparable concern.差别出在递送方式上，与总量无关。试验按空腹方案每天三次给予 5 g 游离结晶 L-谷氨酰胺，在肠腔和血浆中形成陡峭的冲击峰；膳食谷氨酰胺以蛋白结合形式进入，经消化缓慢释放，其中很大一部分在首过时就被肠上皮细胞自身消耗。临床效应是否依赖这种冲击式模式，尚未用食物蛋白作对照来检验，所以“多吃点蛋白就行”这种说法仍然只是合理推测，未被证实。两个实用要点：游离谷氨酰胺不耐热，在水溶液中会降解，因此烹调和储藏会减少食物中的游离谷氨酰胺，蛋白结合的谷氨酰胺不受影响；谷氨酰胺补充并非对所有人都没有风险，它是氮供体，肝功能或肾功能受损者用高剂量需谨慎，而同样的量以普通食物蛋白形式摄入则不引起可比的担忧。

Absorption吸收 Absorbed as free amino acid and as di- and tripeptides, then extensively extracted by the small intestinal mucosa on first pass, which is the mechanistic argument for a gut-directed effect and also the reason plasma appearance underestimates delivery to the target tissue. Because USDA reports Glu and Gln as one pooled value, no composition table can give the true glutamine content of a food, and any per-food glutamine figure quoted to two decimal places should be treated with suspicion. In the trial, the measured mechanism was normalisation of an elevated urinary lactulose/mannitol ratio, so the endpoint was permeability rather than amino acid status; a food equivalent would have to reproduce the permeability effect, which has not been shown.以游离氨基酸以及二肽和三肽形式被吸收，随后在首过时被小肠黏膜大量摄取，这既是肠道定向效应的机制论据，也是血浆出现量低估靶组织递送量的原因。由于 USDA 把 Glu 和 Gln 报告为一个合并值，没有任何成分表能给出食物真实的谷氨酰胺含量，凡是精确到小数点后两位的单食物谷氨酰胺数字都应存疑。在该试验中，实测的机制是尿乳果糖/甘露醇比值升高后恢复正常，所以终点是通透性，与氨基酸营养状态无关；食物等效方案必须复现这个通透性效应，而这一点尚未被证明。

Data note数据说明 Every USDA per-100 g glutamic acid value and every per-portion calculation in the original list was re-verified and stands. The weaknesses are structural and additive: the Glu plus Gln pooling means no table reports glutamine itself, the two densest rows (vital wheat gluten, soy protein isolate) are calculations from protein content and a literature glutamate fraction rather than direct composition records, and the corrected habitual baseline of 4-7 g/day rests on the conventional 3-6 g/day estimate rather than a measured survey中。原清单中每一个 USDA 每 100 g 谷氨酸值和每一项每份计算都已重新核实并成立。薄弱之处是结构性和新增性的：Glu 加 Gln 合并意味着没有任何表格报告谷氨酰胺本身；密度最高的两行（谷朊粉、大豆分离蛋白）是由蛋白含量与文献谷氨酸占比推算的，并非直接的成分记录；更正后的习惯摄入基线 4-7 g/day 依据的是常规估计 3-6 g/day，而非实测调查。

Who it is for适用人群Adults with chronic constipation and habitually low fibre intake who tolerate fermentation.慢性便秘、平时纤维摄入偏低、且能耐受发酵的成人。

Pros优点

  • Inulin does something measurable for constipation: stool frequency SMD 0.69 and Bristol stool consistency SMD 1.07 across 5 trials and 252 subjects.菊粉对便秘确有可测量的作用：5 项试验、252 名受试者中，排便频率 SMD 0.69，Bristol 大便性状 SMD 1.07。
  • It reliably increases faecal bifidobacteria, and it is cheap.它能稳定增加粪便中的双歧杆菌，而且便宜。
  • EFSA has an authorised claim for native chicory inulin at 12 g/d for maintenance of normal defecation, which is more regulatory support than most items here have.EFSA 批准了天然菊苣菊粉在 12 克/天下“维持正常排便”的健康声称，这比本文多数条目获得的监管支持都多。

Cons缺点

  • Feed your good bacteria is the current premium reframing of what used to be sold as roughage, at roughly ten times the price per gram of fibre.“喂养你的好细菌”是把过去当作粗纤维卖的东西重新包装成高端品，而每克纤维的价格约为过去的十倍。
  • The endpoint switch is the specific dishonesty: marketing leans on the reliable rise in faecal bifidobacteria, which is a microbiological measurement, and lets the consumer infer a clinical benefit.具体的不诚实之处在于偷换终点：营销依赖的是粪便双歧杆菌可靠上升这个微生物学指标，却让消费者自行推断出临床获益。
  • The inulin meta-analysis states explicitly that pain and bloating do NOT improve. The largest systematic review of prebiotics in IBS found the data sparse and insufficient to establish efficacy.菊粉的 meta 分析明确写道，疼痛和腹胀并未改善。关于益生元治疗肠易激的最大系统综述认为数据稀少，不足以确立有效性。
  • Self-defeating for IBS patients on or considering a low-FODMAP diet, because inulin, FOS and GOS ARE the fermentable oligosaccharides that diet removes. Anyone whose dominant symptom is bloating or flatulence should not take these.对正在或考虑低 FODMAP 饮食的肠易激患者来说，这么做是自相矛盾的，因为菊粉、FOS 和 GOS 正是那种饮食要去掉的可发酵低聚糖。任何以腹胀或排气为主要症状的人都不应服用。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose partly reachable靠吃只能部分达到 Data confidence: Medium数据可信度：中

This item bundles three substances with two different answers. Inulin and fructo-oligosaccharide (FOS) are RICH: chicory root at 15-20 g per 100 g fresh weight, Jerusalem artichoke at roughly 8-22 g, garlic at about 9-16 g, onion at about 2 g, with smaller amounts in globe artichoke, shallot, salsify, leek, asparagus, banana, wheat and rye. Beta-galacto-oligosaccharide (GOS) is SYNTHETIC and should not be carried under the same heading: the beta-GOS used in trials is manufactured enzymatically by transgalactosylation of lactose and has no meaningful presence in ordinary food. The galacto-oligosaccharides that do occur in legumes are alpha-galactosides (raffinose, stachyose, verbascose), a chemically different family with different bacterial targets. Habitual dietary intake of the fructan class is low: mean 1.6-1.7 g/day in a Slovenian survey (DOI 10.3389/fnut.2024.1446771) and median inulin 1.3 g/day in UK schoolchildren (PMID 40808333).本条把三种物质打包在一起，而答案有两种。菊粉和低聚果糖（FOS）为 RICH：菊苣根按鲜重 15-20 g/100 g，洋姜约 8-22 g，蒜约 9-16 g，洋葱约 2 g，朝鲜蓟、红葱头、婆罗门参（salsify）、韭葱、芦笋、香蕉、小麦和黑麦中含量较少。β-低聚半乳糖（GOS）属于 SYNTHETIC，不应归在同一标题下：试验所用的 beta-GOS 由乳糖经酶法转半乳糖苷化制造，在普通食物中没有实质存在。豆类中确实存在的半乳寡糖是 α-半乳糖苷（棉子糖、水苏糖、毛蕊花糖），化学上属于另一族，作用的细菌靶标也不同。果聚糖这一类的习惯膳食摄入量偏低：斯洛文尼亚一项调查的均值为 1.6-1.7 g/day（DOI 10.3389/fnut.2024.1446771），英国学龄儿童菊粉摄入中位数为 1.3 g/day（PMID 40808333）。

Rows tagged unconfirmed carry a figure the verification pass could not trace back to its cited source. The number is reported as found; hover the tag for the reason.标记为未核实的行，其数值在核查环节无法追溯到所引来源。数字按原样列出；把鼠标移到标记上可看具体原因。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 For inulin and FOS the answer depends on which food. A 5 g/day dose is reachable from about 250 g of raw onion (two to three medium onions), about 10-19 cloves of garlic on the corrected 9-16 g/100 g range (the submission's 30 cloves was wrong by roughly 3x and contradicted its own food row), about 23-63 g of Jerusalem artichoke, or about 30 g of salsify on an unconfirmed figure. It is out of reach from banana (about 4.5 kg), leek (about 2.1 kg) and asparagus (roughly 1-5 kg, the range reflecting a fivefold uncertainty in the fresh-weight figure; the submission's flat 5 kg used the low end only). The tolerance ceiling is the more useful number than the dose: up to 10 g/day of native inulin and up to 5 g/day of oligofructose were well tolerated in a randomised crossover trial, while 10 g of oligofructose substantially increased symptoms, chiefly flatulence then bloating (Bonnema et al., PMID 20497775). One 150 g cup of Jerusalem artichoke delivers roughly 12-33 g of inulin, so between one and three times the tolerated daily ceiling in a single sitting. For GOS the answer is a flat no: the beta-GOS doses used in trials are made industrially and no ordinary food supplies them.对菊粉和 FOS 来说，答案取决于选哪种食物。5 g/day 的剂量可以由约 250 g 生洋葱（两到三个中等大小洋葱）、按更正后的 9-16 g/100 g 范围计约 10-19 瓣蒜（原稿的 30 瓣偏差约 3 倍，并与其自己的食物行自相矛盾）、约 23-63 g 洋姜，或按一个未确认数值计约 30 g 婆罗门参达到。靠香蕉（约 4.5 kg）、韭葱（约 2.1 kg）和芦笋（约 1-5 kg，区间反映鲜重数值存在五倍不确定性；原稿写死 5 kg，只用了低端值）则达不到。比剂量更有用的数字是耐受上限：一项随机交叉试验中，天然菊粉每天最多 10 g、低聚果糖每天最多 5 g 耐受良好，而 10 g 低聚果糖显著加重症状，主要是排气，其次是腹胀（Bonnema et al., PMID 20497775）。一杯 150 g 洋姜提供约 12-33 g 菊粉，一顿就相当于每日耐受上限的一到三倍。对 GOS 的答案是明确的否：试验所用的 beta-GOS 剂量由工业制造，没有任何普通食物能提供。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Chicory root is the classic textbook answer and a poor recommendation: it is the industrial source of inulin and is roasted as a coffee substitute rather than eaten as a vegetable, so its 15-20 g/100 g headline is not a dietary route. Dandelion greens, which are eaten as a vegetable, and burdock root and yacon are recognised high-inulin foods that answer that objection, though no confirmed figures for them were available here. Chicory also illustrates why fibre tables and fructan assays disagree, since USDA lists chicory root at only 1.5 g total dietary fibre per 100 g (FDC 169993). Purified inulin and oligofructose are safe as food ingredients, and concentration is what causes symptoms: the same molecule that is unremarkable spread across a day's vegetables provokes flatulence and bloating as a single 10 g bolus (PMID 20497775). Briet et al. (PMID 7588500) reported a symptom ladder for FOS (excess flatus above 30 g/day, borborygmi and bloating above 40 g, cramps and diarrhoea at 50 g, with no tolerance developing on chronic dosing); the citation is correct and on topic, but those specific thresholds could not be retrieved from the full text and are unconfirmed. The reverse caveat matters clinically: the 'eat more prebiotic vegetables' list (onion, garlic, leek, globe artichoke, Jerusalem artichoke, wheat, rye) is precisely the list a low-FODMAP diet removes, so in IBS the food route and the supplement route can both make things worse. Finally, do not treat legume alpha-GOS as a food form of supplemental beta-GOS; the reported contents in Phaseolus vulgaris (raffinose 0.8-7.4 mg/g, stachyose 20.0-30.9 mg/g, verbascose 0.3-1.3 mg/g, DOI 10.3390/foods15020391) come from a genuine and on-topic paper whose individual values could not be confirmed, and they are different molecules with a flatulence profile of their own.菊苣根是教科书式的经典答案，也是个糟糕的推荐：它是菊粉的工业来源，通常烘烤后当咖啡替代品，并不作蔬菜食用，因此 15-20 g/100 g 这个亮眼数字不构成膳食途径。作为蔬菜食用的蒲公英叶，以及牛蒡根和雪莲果，是公认的高菊粉食物，可以回应这一质疑，但此处没有它们的可确认数据。菊苣还说明了纤维表与果聚糖测定为何会互相矛盾：USDA 把菊苣根列为每 100 g 仅 1.5 g 总膳食纤维（FDC 169993）。纯化菊粉和低聚果糖作为食品配料是安全的，引起症状的是浓度：同一种分子分散在一天的蔬菜里毫不起眼，一次性 10 g 冲击剂量却会引发排气和腹胀（PMID 20497775）。Briet et al.（PMID 7588500）报告了 FOS 的症状阶梯（每天超过 30 g 出现排气过多，超过 40 g 出现肠鸣和腹胀，50 g 时出现痉挛和腹泻，长期给药不产生耐受）；该引文本身正确且切题，但这些具体阈值无法从全文中调取，属未确认。反向的注意点具有临床意义：多吃益生元蔬菜的清单（洋葱、蒜、韭葱、朝鲜蓟、洋姜、小麦、黑麦）正是低 FODMAP 饮食要剔除的清单，所以在 IBS 中，食物途径和补充剂途径都有可能让情况变糟。最后，不要把豆类的 α-GOS 当作补充剂 beta-GOS 的食物形式；已报道的 Phaseolus vulgaris 含量（棉子糖 0.8-7.4 mg/g，水苏糖 20.0-30.9 mg/g，毛蕊花糖 0.3-1.3 mg/g，DOI 10.3390/foods15020391）出自一篇真实且切题的论文，但其中的单项数值无法确认，而且它们是不同的分子，有自己的产气特征。

Absorption吸收 Fructans are not absorbed at all, so the variable is where and how fast they ferment, and chain length decides that. Oligofructose (DP 2-8) ferments proximally and quickly, which is why its tolerated dose was half that of long-chain native inulin in the same trial, 5 g against 10 g (PMID 20497775). Assay and plant part also drive the numbers: onion measured 1.97 g/100 g and leek 0.24 g/100 g by AOAC 999.03 in one national survey (DOI 10.3389/fnut.2024.1446771), while an Australian survey using the Megazyme assay reported 1.2-17.4 g/100 g across high-fructan alliums including leek bulb (PMID 17625872). Storage matters too, since fructan is depolymerised during onion storage. Single figures should be read as indicative rather than exact. GOS is fermented similarly but is a distinct substrate: beta-GOS and legume alpha-galactosides are not interchangeable.果聚糖完全不被吸收，因此变量是在哪里发酵、发酵有多快，而这由链长决定。低聚果糖（DP 2-8）在近端快速发酵，这是它在同一试验中耐受剂量只有长链天然菊粉一半的原因，5 g 对 10 g（PMID 20497775）。测定方法和植物部位同样左右数字：某国家级调查用 AOAC 999.03 测得洋葱 1.97 g/100 g、韭葱 0.24 g/100 g（DOI 10.3389/fnut.2024.1446771），而澳大利亚一项使用 Megazyme 测定法的调查报告，包括韭葱鳞茎在内的高果聚糖葱属食物为 1.2-17.4 g/100 g（PMID 17625872）。储藏也有影响，洋葱储藏期间果聚糖会解聚。单一数字应当读作指示性数值，而非精确值。GOS 的发酵方式类似，但它是另一种底物：beta-GOS 与豆类 α-半乳糖苷不能互换。

Data note数据说明 The Ferjancic fructan values (onion, leek, banana, bread, flour) and the Bonnema tolerance thresholds were verified verbatim, and the chicory contrast between 15-20 g inulin and a 1.5 g USDA fibre record holds. Against that: the garlic figure was a source misreading now corrected to a wide 9-16 g/100 g range, Jerusalem artichoke spans 8-22 g/100 g, the asparagus fresh-weight value is uncertain by fivefold, the Briet symptom ladder and the Phaseolus oligosaccharide values could not be confirmed, and the three added foods (salsify, globe artichoke, shallot) rest on group-level ranges rather than food-specific measurements中。Ferjancic 的果聚糖数值（洋葱、韭葱、香蕉、面包、面粉）和 Bonnema 的耐受阈值已逐字核实，菊苣 15-20 g 菊粉与 USDA 1.5 g 纤维记录之间的反差也成立。另一面：蒜的数字原为来源误读，现更正为较宽的 9-16 g/100 g 范围；洋姜跨 8-22 g/100 g；芦笋鲜重值存在五倍不确定性；Briet 的症状阶梯和 Phaseolus 寡糖数值无法确认；新增的三种食物（婆罗门参、朝鲜蓟、红葱头）依据的是类别层面的范围，而非单一食物的实测值。

References:文献： Ford PMID 30294792; Collado Yurrita PMID 25208775; Reynolds Lancet 2019 PMID 30638909
SKIPSaffron, SAMe and other mood botanicals藏红花、SAMe 及其他情绪类植物制剂Grade C证据 C 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Saffron 30 mg/d of standardised extract. SAMe 1,600-3,200 mg/d as an adjunct.藏红花：标准化提取物 30 毫克/天。SAMe：1600 至 3200 毫克/天作为辅助用药。
Who it is for适用人群At most, adults with mild to moderate depression taking no serotonergic medication, and only with a clinician involved.最多适用于轻中度抑郁、未服用任何 5-羟色胺能药物的成人，且必须有临床医生参与。

Pros优点

  • Saffron: 21 randomised trials found Beck Depression Inventory -4.86 (-6.58 to -3.14) and Beck Anxiety Inventory -5.29.藏红花：21 项随机试验显示 Beck 抑郁量表 -4.86（-6.58 至 -3.14），Beck 焦虑量表 -5.29。
  • SAMe: one 2024 meta-analysis of 23 trials and 2,183 participants found monotherapy better than placebo, SMD -0.58 (-0.93 to -0.23), at moderate certainty.SAMe：2024 年一项纳入 23 项试验、2183 名受试者的 meta 分析发现单药优于安慰剂，SMD -0.58（-0.93 至 -0.23），确定性中等。

Cons缺点

  • Saffron effect sizes are implausibly large for the trial size. One meta-analysis reported SMD -1.22 versus placebo, which is better than licensed antidepressants achieve. Effect sizes that large in small short trials usually indicate small-study effects and a narrow research base, so treat it as a red flag rather than a selling point.藏红花的效应量相对试验规模大得不合常理。一项 meta 分析报告相对安慰剂 SMD 为 -1.22，好过获批抗抑郁药能达到的水平。小样本短周期试验出现这么大的效应量，通常说明存在小研究效应和研究基础狭窄，因此应视为警示信号而非卖点。
  • Self-report instruments move while clinician-rated instruments do not, which is the classic pattern of an unblinded expectancy effect.自评量表在动，而临床医生评定的量表不动，这正是未盲化预期效应的典型形态。
  • SAMe has directly conflicting meta-analyses published in the same year. A second 2024 analysis of 14 trials and 1,522 participants found NO significant difference versus placebo, versus imipramine or versus escitalopram. Report both.SAMe 在同一年有两篇结论直接冲突的 meta 分析。2024 年另一项涵盖 14 项试验、1522 名受试者的分析发现，相对安慰剂、丙咪嗪和艾司西酞普兰均无显著差异。两篇都要报告。
  • SAMe is associated with switching into mania or hypomania in bipolar disorder, and homocysteine can rise on it. Both saffron and SAMe carry serotonin syndrome risk with serotonergic medication. Saffron should be avoided in pregnancy on the basis of traditional emmenagogue use.SAMe 在双相障碍中与转为躁狂或轻躁狂有关，服用期间同型半胱氨酸可能升高。藏红花和 SAMe 与 5-羟色胺能药物合用都有 5-羟色胺综合征风险。基于传统上的通经用途，藏红花在妊娠期应当避免。
  • Depression is a condition where delaying effective treatment carries real risk. Neither of these should displace a clinical assessment.抑郁是一种延误有效治疗会带来真实风险的疾病。这两样都不应取代临床评估。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose reachable by eating靠吃可以达到剂量 Data confidence: Medium数据可信度：中

This item bundles three different answers, so each gets its own sentence. Saffron is RICH: it is a supermarket spice with USDA composition and portion entries, its clinical dose is a cooking quantity, and it is listed under foods below, which is why the previous NOT_FOOD label on the group was the clearest error in the submission. SAMe has no dietary source: there is no meaningful preformed SAMe in food and no composition-table entry, the body synthesises it continuously from methionine and ATP by methionine adenosyltransferase, and the commercial material is made by Saccharomyces cerevisiae fermentation and stabilised as the tosylate disulfate or 1,4-butanedisulfonate salt, so it is biosynthetic in origin and the SYNTHETIC label holds in the sense of 'no dietary source' rather than 'chemically synthesised'. St John's wort aerial parts, rhodiola root, ashwagandha root and Griffonia simplicifolia seed (the source of 5-HTP) are NOT_FOOD: nobody eats them in any normal diet, they have no composition-table entry, and they have no portion size.这一条打包了三个不同的答案，各自单独说明。藏红花属于 RICH：它是超市里的香料，有 USDA 成分和分量条目，其临床剂量就是一个烹饪用量，并已列入下方的食物行，这也是原提交把整组标为 NOT_FOOD 成为最明显错误的原因。SAMe 没有膳食来源：食物中没有有意义的预成型 SAMe，也没有成分表条目，人体通过甲硫氨酸腺苷转移酶由甲硫氨酸和 ATP 持续合成，商品原料由酿酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）发酵制成，并以对甲苯磺酸二硫酸盐或 1,4-丁二磺酸盐形式稳定，所以它在来源上属于生物合成，SYNTHETIC 这个标签成立的含义是没有膳食来源，它并不表示化学合成。贯叶连翘地上部分、红景天根、南非醉茄（ashwagandha）根和 Griffonia simplicifolia 种子（5-HTP 的来源）属于 NOT_FOOD：正常饮食中没有人吃它们，它们没有成分表条目，也没有分量大小。

Food食物 Per 100 g每 100 克 Portion一份 Per portion每份 Share占比 Source来源
Saffron, dried stigmas (Crocus sativus)藏红花干柱头（Crocus sativus） 100 g of saffron is 3,333 clinical doses of 30 mg. No apocarotenoid percentage is stated here: the previously cited '8% of dry weight' for crocins, picrocrocin, safranal and crocetin combined and the 'roughly 3.4 mg of crocins per 30 mg dose' could not be confirmed against any source reached, and they contradict each other, since 3.4 mg in 30 mg is 11.3% crocins alone, above the claimed 8% ceiling for all apocarotenoids 1 teaspoon (0.7 g)1 茶匙（0.7 g） 700 mg of saffron, 23 times the 30 mg dose used in depression RCTs 2,300% of a 30 mg trial dose相当于 30 mg 试验剂量的 2,300% USDA portion weights for Spices, saffron (1 tbsp = 2.1 g, so 1 tsp = 0.7 g) independently confirmed; the FDC ID 170934 previously cited could not be confirmed against a live lookup. Trial dose: Akhondzadeh S, Tahmacebi-Pour N, Noorbala AA et al., Crocus sativus L. in the treatment of mild to moderate depression: a double-blind, randomized and placebo-controlled trial, Phytother Res 2005;19(2):148-51, PMID 15852492 (30 mg/day given as 15 mg twice daily for 6 weeks, 40 outpatients with DSM-IV major depression and baseline HAM-D of 18 or more, against PLACEBO). The fluoxetine comparison belongs to a separate trial (Noorbala AA et al., J Ethnopharmacol 2005)
Saffron, culinary pinch as used to season a dish藏红花，烹饪中为一道菜调味用的一小撮 as above a generous pinch, about 0.1 g, seasoning a dish for four (roughly 50 threads at published thread weights near 2 mg; the commonly quoted 20 to 30 threads per 0.1 g would imply a heavier 3 to 5 mg thread). For reference the FDA reference amount customarily consumed for saffron is 0.125 g满满一小撮，约 0.1 g，为四人份的一道菜调味（按已发表的每根约 2 mg 计约 50 根；常被引用的每 0.1 g 有 20 至 30 根则意味着每根更重，为 3 至 5 mg）。作为参照，FDA 为藏红花设定的习惯消费参考量为 0.125 g about 25 mg of saffron per person from a dish for four; 125 mg for a single 0.125 g reference serving 83% of the 30 mg trial dose per serving of the dish; over 400% for one 0.125 g reference serving该菜每份相当于 30 mg 试验剂量的 83%；按 0.125 g 一份参考量计则超过 400% USDA portion and reference-serving figures for Spices, saffron (portion weights confirmed, FDC ID unconfirmed); trial dose PMID 15852492 (placebo-controlled)

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 For saffron the gap is zero or negative, which is the most useful finding in the set: the 30 mg/day used in the depression RCTs is about 15 threads at published thread weights near 2 mg, or about 6 to 9 threads if a thread weighs the 3 to 5 mg implied by the commonly quoted 20 to 30 threads per 0.1 g, which is under a generous culinary pinch, and one teaspoon of saffron in a paella is over twenty doses. The barrier is cost rather than physiology. For SAMe there is nothing to compute, because there is no food source: trials use 400 to 1,600 mg/day of a manufactured molecule, while the body's own SAMe turnover (on the order of grams per day) is fed by roughly 1 g/day of dietary methionine from protein foods, which is a different intervention from swallowing SAMe. For the remaining botanicals (St John's wort typically 300 mg three times daily of a 0.3% hypericin extract, rhodiola 200 to 600 mg, ashwagandha 300 to 600 mg root extract, 5-HTP 100 to 300 mg) the food gap is undefined because the source plants are not foods at any quantity.藏红花的差距为零甚至为负，这是本组中最有用的发现：抑郁症 RCT 使用的每天 30 mg，按已发表的每根柱头约 2 mg 计约为 15 根；若按常被引用的每 0.1 g 有 20 至 30 根（即每根 3 至 5 mg）推算，则约为 6 至 9 根，都不到烹饪中一小撮的量，而西班牙海鲜饭里放一茶匙藏红花就超过二十个剂量。障碍在于成本，与生理无关。SAMe 无从计算，因为它没有食物来源：试验使用每天 400 至 1,600 mg 的人工制造分子，而人体自身的 SAMe 周转（每天以克计）靠蛋白质食物提供的每天约 1 g 膳食甲硫氨酸来支撑，这与直接口服 SAMe 属于两种不同的干预。至于其余植物制剂（贯叶连翘通常为 0.3% 金丝桃素提取物每次 300 mg、每天三次，红景天 200 至 600 mg，南非醉茄根提取物 300 至 600 mg，5-HTP 100 至 300 mg），食物差距无从界定，因为这些原植物在任何用量下都不是食物。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Saffron is the mildest food-versus-extract case in this whole set, since trials use either powdered stigma or a hydroalcoholic extract standardised to crocins and safranal, so kitchen saffron is close to the trial material. The caveat is at the top end: saffron is toxic at gram doses, with roughly 5 g reported as a toxic dose and 12 to 20 g as potentially lethal, and it is a traditional abortifacient, so scaling from a pinch to a spoonful is genuinely hazardous. Standardised extracts also concentrate crocins, so milligram for milligram an extract is not the spice. For the rest of the group the form gap is total: St John's wort is a potent CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein inducer that has caused transplant rejection, contraceptive failure and serotonin syndrome with SSRIs; ashwagandha root extracts have accumulated a documented cluster of hepatotoxicity case reports, including in regulatory reviews, while traditional use was of small amounts of root powder in milk as medicine and never as a food; purified 5-HTP bypasses the rate-limiting tryptophan hydroxylase step that normally regulates serotonin synthesis, which is exactly why it carries serotonin syndrome risk with serotonergic drugs and why no food behaves like it.藏红花是整组中食物与提取物差别最小的一例，试验使用的是柱头粉末，或按藏红花素（crocins）和藏红花醛（safranal）标准化的醇水提取物，因此厨房里的藏红花与试验材料很接近。需要提示的是高端剂量：藏红花在克级剂量下有毒性，报告约 5 g 为中毒剂量，12 至 20 g 可能致死，它还是传统的堕胎药，所以从一小撮放大到一勺确实危险。标准化提取物还会富集藏红花素，按毫克对等来看，提取物与香料并不等同。这一组其余成分的形态差距是彻底的：贯叶连翘是强效的 CYP3A4 和 P-糖蛋白诱导剂，曾导致移植排斥、避孕失败以及与 SSRI 合用时的血清素综合征；南非醉茄根提取物已积累一批有记录的肝毒性病例报告，包括监管审评中的病例，而传统用法是把少量根粉加进牛奶作药用，从未当作食物；纯化 5-HTP 绕过了正常调控血清素合成的限速步骤色氨酸羟化酶，这正是它与血清素能药物合用会带来血清素综合征风险的原因，也是没有任何食物具有类似作用的原因。

Absorption吸收 Saffron's crocins are poorly absorbed intact and are hydrolysed in the gut to crocetin, which is what appears in plasma; safranal is volatile and is partly lost in long simmering, so a slow-cooked dish delivers a different apocarotenoid profile than a capsule taken cold, and blooming saffron in warm liquid before adding it is the culinary analogue of extraction. SAMe is chemically unstable and is degraded in gastric acid unless enterically coated, and oral bioavailability is only about 1% because of extensive first-pass metabolism, which is why oral doses are 400 to 1,600 mg while parenteral doses are far smaller. The classic bad recommendation in this space is 'eat turkey or eggs for 5-HTP': food supplies tryptophan, and dietary tryptophan competes with the other large neutral amino acids in the same protein meal for LAT1 transport across the blood-brain barrier, so a high-protein meal can lower rather than raise brain tryptophan availability. Food is a poor delivery route for this entire group.藏红花中的藏红花素以完整形式吸收很差，在肠道内水解为藏红花酸（crocetin），进入血浆的是后者；藏红花醛易挥发，长时间炖煮会部分损失，因此慢炖菜品提供的脱降类胡萝卜素谱与冷服胶囊不同，而下锅前先用温液体把藏红花泡开，相当于烹饪版的提取。SAMe 化学性质不稳定，未做肠溶包衣就会在胃酸中降解，由于首过代谢强，口服生物利用度仅约 1%，这也是口服剂量为 400 至 1,600 mg 而注射剂量小得多的原因。这一领域的经典错误建议是为了 5-HTP 去吃火鸡或鸡蛋：食物提供的是色氨酸，而同一顿蛋白质餐中的膳食色氨酸要与其他大分子中性氨基酸争夺 LAT1 转运体穿过血脑屏障，因此高蛋白餐可能反而降低脑内色氨酸的可得量。对整组成分而言，食物都是很差的给药途径。

Data note数据说明 The saffron portion weights, the 3,333-doses arithmetic and the trial's 30 mg/day for 6 weeks all verified exactly, and the trial's design has been corrected against the abstract. The apocarotenoid content figures could not be confirmed anywhere and have been removed, the thread-weight basis remains unsettled between two mutually inconsistent conventions, and the FDC ID is unconfirmed中。藏红花的分量重量、3,333 个剂量的换算以及试验的每天 30 mg 持续 6 周均已逐项核实无误，试验设计也已对照摘要更正。脱降类胡萝卜素含量数值在任何地方都无法确认，已删除；每根柱头重量的基准在两套互相矛盾的惯例之间仍未定论；FDC ID 未获确认。

References:文献： Yang PMID 29849461; Ghaderi PMID 31987241; Limveeraprajak PMID 38423354; Peng PMID 38199136
SKIPQuercetin and taurine槲皮素与牛磺酸Grade C证据 C 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Quercetin at least 500 mg/d for the blood pressure effect. Taurine 0.5-6 g/d.槲皮素：要产生降压效应需至少 500 毫克/天。牛磺酸：0.5 至 6 克/天。
Who it is for适用人群At most, people with elevated blood pressure or components of metabolic syndrome, for a small surrogate effect.最多适用于血压偏高或有代谢综合征组分的人，且只是一个小的替代终点效应。

Pros优点

  • Taurine has the strongest human surrogate data of any longevity compound here: 25 trials, 1,024 participants, systolic -4.0 mmHg (-7.29 to -0.71), diastolic -1.51 mmHg, fasting glucose -5.9 mg/dL, all dose-dependent.在本文所有抗衰老类化合物中，牛磺酸的人体替代终点数据最强：25 项试验、1024 名受试者，收缩压 -4.0 mmHg（-7.29 至 -0.71），舒张压 -1.51 mmHg，空腹血糖 -5.9 mg/dL，均呈剂量依赖。
  • Quercetin at 500 mg/d or more gave systolic -4.45 mmHg and diastolic -2.98 mmHg in the dose-stratified analysis.在按剂量分层的分析中，槲皮素 500 毫克/天及以上使收缩压降低 4.45 mmHg，舒张压降低 2.98 mmHg。

Cons缺点

  • The taurine longevity story was directly refuted in humans in 2025. The 2023 Science paper showed taurine declines with age in mice, monkeys and humans and extends lifespan in mice. A 2025 Aging Cell paper found circulating taurine is NOT associated with age, muscle mass, strength, physical performance or mitochondrial function in humans.牛磺酸与长寿的故事在 2025 年已被人体研究直接推翻。2023 年《科学》那篇论文显示牛磺酸在小鼠、猴和人体内随年龄下降，并延长小鼠寿命。2025 年《Aging Cell》一篇论文发现，在人体中循环牛磺酸与年龄、肌肉质量、力量、体能表现或线粒体功能都无关联。
  • Quercetin effect sizes are shrinking as the evidence matures. The 2016 meta-analysis gave systolic -3.04 mmHg; the 2023 umbrella review of meta-analyses found only -1.9 mmHg with heterogeneity of 88%, and nothing else significant, at very low certainty.随着证据成熟，槲皮素的效应量在缩小。2016 年的 meta 分析给出收缩压 -3.04 mmHg；2023 年针对 meta 分析的伞式综述只得到 -1.9 mmHg，异质性 88%，其余指标均不显著，确定性极低。
  • A 2 to 4 mmHg systolic reduction is small next to any antihypertensive drug or to sodium reduction.收缩压降低 2 至 4 mmHg，相比任何降压药或减少钠摄入都很小。
  • Quercetin inhibits CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein, so treat it as an interaction risk with ciclosporin, tacrolimus, CYP3A4-metabolised statins, warfarin and many chemotherapeutics. It is also a topoisomerase inhibitor in vitro, which is a specific reason not to combine it with chemotherapy.槲皮素抑制 CYP3A4 和 P-糖蛋白，因此与环孢素、他克莫司、经 CYP3A4 代谢的他汀、华法林以及许多化疗药合用都应视为相互作用风险。它在体外还是拓扑异构酶抑制剂，这是不要与化疗联用的具体理由。
  • Taurine effects are additive with antihypertensives, insulin and sulfonylureas.牛磺酸的效应与降压药、胰岛素和磺脲类叠加。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose NOT reachable by eating靠吃达不到剂量 Data confidence: Medium数据可信度：中

Quercetin is present across ordinary plant food: raw capers 233.84 mg/100 g, lovage leaves 170.00, dock (Rumex) 86.20, radish leaves 70.37, wild rocket 66.19, fresh dill 55.15, coriander leaves 52.90, yellow wax hot peppers 50.63, fennel leaves 48.80 and red onion 39.21, against habitual intakes of tens of milligrams a day, so naming capers as the only rich source overstated how narrow the food route is. Taurine is present in animal food only, richest in shellfish, with beef muscle at 61.1 mg/100 g wet weight and chicken thigh at 47.34 mg/100 g; it was undetectable in all 48 plant foods Laidlaw analysed, so a vegan diet supplies none, while quercetin intake is unaffected by avoiding animal food. The two compounds are RICH for opposite populations, which is why they are described separately throughout this entry.槲皮素广泛存在于普通植物性食物中：生刺山柑（capers）233.84 mg/100 g、圆叶当归叶 170.00、酸模（Rumex）86.20、萝卜叶 70.37、野生芝麻菜 66.19、新鲜莳萝 55.15、香菜叶 52.90、黄蜡质辣椒 50.63、茴香叶 48.80、红洋葱 39.21，而习惯摄入量只有每天几十毫克，因此把刺山柑说成唯一的丰富来源，夸大了食物路线的狭窄程度。牛磺酸只存在于动物性食物中，贝类最丰富，牛肌肉按湿重为 61.1 mg/100 g，鸡腿肉为 47.34 mg/100 g；Laidlaw 分析的 48 种植物性食物中全部检测不到，所以纯素饮食提供不了牛磺酸，而槲皮素的摄入不受回避动物性食物的影响。这两种化合物的“丰富”针对的是相反的人群，本条目因此始终把它们分开描述。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 QUERCETIN: trials use 500-1,000 mg/day. From raw capers at 233.84 mg/100 g that is 214-428 g per day, 14 to 29 tablespoons of a salt-cured condiment and a salt load nobody should take; from dock leaves at 86.20 mg/100 g it is 580 g to 1.16 kg; from wild rocket at 66.19 mg/100 g it is 756 g to 1.51 kg; from raw red onion at 39.21 mg/100 g it is 1.28-2.55 kg; from apples with skin at 4.01 mg/100 g it is 12.5-25 kg, about 70 to 140 apples. A 500 mg capsule is roughly 25 to 50 times what a diet delivers. TAURINE: trials use 1-6 g/day, commonly 3 g. From beef at 61.1 mg/100 g that is 4.9 kg of raw steak per day, from chicken thigh at 47.34 mg/100 g it is 6.3 kg, and from clam meat at roughly 450 mg/100 g as eaten it is about 670 g of clam meat daily, the only route within an order of magnitude of feasible and still nothing a person eats. Neither dose is reachable by eating normally.槲皮素：试验剂量为 500-1,000 mg/天。按生刺山柑 233.84 mg/100 g 计算，每天要 214-428 g，也就是 14 到 29 汤匙盐渍调味小菜，那样的钠负荷谁都不该承受；按酸模叶 86.20 mg/100 g 计算是 580 g 到 1.16 kg；按野生芝麻菜 66.19 mg/100 g 计算是 756 g 到 1.51 kg；按生红洋葱 39.21 mg/100 g 计算是 1.28-2.55 kg；按带皮苹果 4.01 mg/100 g 计算是 12.5-25 kg，约 70 到 140 个苹果。一粒 500 mg 胶囊大致相当于膳食供给量的 25 到 50 倍。牛磺酸：试验剂量为 1-6 g/天，常用 3 g。按牛肉 61.1 mg/100 g 计算，每天要 4.9 kg 生牛排；按鸡腿肉 47.34 mg/100 g 计算是 6.3 kg；按可食状态下蛤肉约 450 mg/100 g 计算，每天约 670 g 蛤肉，这是唯一在可行性一个数量级之内的路径，仍然不是人的日常吃法。两种剂量都无法靠正常饮食达到。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 QUERCETIN, MAJOR. Supplements are almost always the aglycone, extracted from Sophora japonica flower buds or Dimorphandra mollis pods, which are not foods anyone eats; food quercetin is glycosides (glucosides in onions, rutin in tea and apples). The forms are not interchangeable in the gut, and a 500-1,000 mg aglycone dose is a pharmacological exposure that inhibits drug-metabolising enzymes and transporters, whereas 10-30 mg/day from onions and apples never approaches it. Capers are the richest source per 100 g and the worst practical recommendation, since the value is for a salt-cured condiment eaten a tablespoon at a time and the canned figure ranges 45.05-519.85 mg/100 g across 20 samples, an elevenfold spread; fresh herbs, dock, radish leaves and wild rocket at 48-86 mg/100 g are the more usable everyday sources. Apples with skin are the classic textbook answer and are roughly 60 times too dilute; peeling drops them from 4.01 to 1.05 mg/100 g. TAURINE, MODERATE. The supplement is synthetic and chemically identical to food taurine, so there is no extract-versus-food problem here. The two real caveats are analytical and culinary. Shellfish taurine numbers in circulation are often dry-weight figures presented as if they were per 100 g of food, which inflates them four- to sixfold; the three bivalve rows above are dry-weight values from an umami study, converted with an assumed 80-83% moisture that is labelled as an assumption in each row. And taurine is a free amino acid rather than protein-bound, so it leaches: taurine and creatine were the compounds most reduced by cooking beef, partly into the cooking juices (Purchas RW, Rutherfurd SM, Pearce PD, Vather R, Wilkinson BHP, Meat Sci 2004;68(2):201-7, PMID 22062229; the companion 90 min at 70 C result is from lamb muscle, Purchas RW et al., Meat Sci 2004;66(3):629-37, PMID 22060873). A stew keeps its taurine in the broth; a grilled steak with the juices discarded does not.槲皮素：重大。补充剂几乎都是苷元，从槐（Sophora japonica）花蕾或 Dimorphandra mollis 豆荚中提取，这两种都不是人吃的食物；食物中的槲皮素是糖苷（洋葱中是葡糖苷，茶和苹果中是芦丁）。这些形式在肠道中不可互换，500-1,000 mg 苷元剂量属于药理学暴露，会抑制药物代谢酶和转运体，而洋葱和苹果提供的 10-30 mg/天永远达不到这个水平。刺山柑每 100 g 含量最高，同时是最糟糕的实用建议，因为这个数值属于一次只吃一汤匙的盐渍调味小菜，罐装样品 20 份的范围是 45.05-519.85 mg/100 g，相差十一倍；48-86 mg/100 g 的新鲜香草、酸模、萝卜叶和野生芝麻菜才是日常更可用的来源。带皮苹果是教科书上的经典答案，浓度大约稀了 60 倍；削皮后从 4.01 降到 1.05 mg/100 g。牛磺酸：中等。补充剂是合成的，与食物中的牛磺酸化学上完全相同，所以这里没有提取物与食物之争。真正的两点提醒在分析层面和烹饪层面。流传的贝类牛磺酸数字往往是干重值，却被当作每 100 g 食物来引用，从而虚高四到六倍；上面三行贝类数据是取自一项鲜味研究的干重值，按假定的 80-83% 水分换算，每一行都已标明这属于假设。另外，牛磺酸是游离氨基酸，并未结合在蛋白质中，因此容易流失：牛肉烹饪中减少最多的化合物就是牛磺酸和肌酸，一部分进了肉汁（Purchas RW, Rutherfurd SM, Pearce PD, Vather R, Wilkinson BHP, Meat Sci 2004;68(2):201-7, PMID 22062229；配套的 70 C 加热 90 min 结果来自羔羊肌肉，Purchas RW et al., Meat Sci 2004;66(3):629-37, PMID 22060873）。炖菜的牛磺酸留在汤里，把肉汁丢掉的烤牛排留不住。

Absorption吸收 QUERCETIN, quantified and decisive. In healthy ileostomy volunteers absorption was 52 plus or minus 15% for quercetin glucosides from fried onions, 17 plus or minus 15% for quercetin rutinoside (the main form in tea and apples) and 24 plus or minus 9% for pure quercetin aglycone, the form used in supplements; conjugation with glucose enhances absorption (Hollman PC, de Vries JH, van Leeuwen SD, Mengelers MJ, Katan MB, Am J Clin Nutr 1995;62(6):1276-82, PMID 7491892, citation and values confirmed). So per milligram, onion quercetin is roughly twice as absorbable as the capsule and three times as absorbable as tea or apple rutin, which narrows the effective gap a little and nowhere near enough to close it, since urinary recovery was only 0.5% of the amount absorbed. TAURINE. It is present in food as the free amino acid rather than bound in protein, absorbed by the TauT transporter with high oral bioavailability, and the supplement form is identical, so absorption is not where food loses. Food loses on concentration and on cooking: the content of a portion depends heavily on whether the cooking liquid is consumed, and reported values vary severalfold with muscle type (beef taurine ranged 0.552 to 23.861 umol/g across 21 muscles, PMID 30811817) and with breed in poultry (39.29-47.34 mg/100 g, PMID 36230082). Reading dry-weight shellfish values as wet-weight is the single commonest error in this literature, and it is the weak point of the shellfish rows here.槲皮素：有定量数据，结论明确。在健康的回肠造口志愿者中，来自油煎洋葱的槲皮素葡糖苷吸收率为 52 加减 15%，槲皮素芦丁苷（茶和苹果中的主要形式）为 17 加减 15%，补充剂所用的纯槲皮素苷元为 24 加减 9%；与葡萄糖结合可提高吸收（Hollman PC, de Vries JH, van Leeuwen SD, Mengelers MJ, Katan MB, Am J Clin Nutr 1995;62(6):1276-82, PMID 7491892，引文和数值均已确认）。因此按毫克计，洋葱槲皮素的可吸收程度约为胶囊的两倍、茶或苹果芦丁的三倍，这让实际差距缩小了一点，远不足以抹平，因为尿中回收量只占已吸收量的 0.5%。牛磺酸：它在食物中以游离氨基酸形式存在，未结合在蛋白质里，由 TauT 转运体吸收，口服生物利用度高，补充剂形式完全相同，吸收环节没有差距。食物的劣势在浓度和烹饪上：一份的含量很大程度取决于烹饪汤汁是否一起吃掉，而报告值随肌肉类型相差数倍（21 块牛肌肉的牛磺酸为 0.552 至 23.861 umol/g，PMID 30811817），禽类还随品种变化（39.29-47.34 mg/100 g，PMID 36230082）。把贝类的干重值当作湿重来读，是这一文献中最常见的单一错误，也是这里贝类各行的薄弱之处。

Data note数据说明 overall, and the two halves differ. The quercetin block is the most thoroughly verified material in the submission: all eight original values, their sample counts, min-max ranges and NDB numbers matched Flavonoid Release 3.3 exactly, and Hollman 1995 and the 74% peeling loss were confirmed. The taurine rows are weaker. The three bivalve figures are dry-weight values from an umami and taste-compound study, located in Figure 1B rather than the cited Table 3, converted to as-eaten values with a self-supplied 80-83% moisture assumption, and one of them (Kumamoto oyster) was wrong at source by about 11%. Laidlaw 1990, which analysed 29 meats on an as-eaten basis, was cited only for the negative plant finding, so no wet-weight primary source backs any shellfish row总体为中，两个部分情况不同。槲皮素部分是本次提交材料中核实得最彻底的：原有八个数值及其样本数、最小最大范围和 NDB 编号全部与 Flavonoid Release 3.3 完全吻合，Hollman 1995 和 74% 的削皮损失也已确认。牛磺酸各行较弱。三个双壳贝数值来自一项鲜味与风味物质研究的干重值，位于 Figure 1B 而非所引的 Table 3，用自行设定的 80-83% 水分假设换算为可食状态值，其中熊本牡蛎一项在原始来源处就错了约 11%。Laidlaw 1990 按可食状态分析了 29 种肉类，本数据集只引用了它关于植物的阴性发现，因此没有任何湿重原始来源支持贝类各行。

References:文献： Tzang PMID 38755142; Singh Science 2023; Marcangeli Aging Cell 2025 PMC12507425; Serban PMID 27405810; Arabi PMID 37654199

Skip does not mean dangerous. Everything in this section is a money problem rather than a safety problem, with three exceptions where a Cons entry says otherwise: curcumin and green tea extract appear on liver-injury registries, and L-glutamine carries a mortality signal in the critically ill.“不必买”不等于“危险”。本节内容基本是花钱的问题，不是安全的问题，但有三个例外，其“缺点”栏已写明：姜黄素和绿茶提取物出现在肝损伤登记中，L-谷氨酰胺在危重患者中带有死亡信号。

7  Avoid it七、不要吃

Published evidence of harm from randomised trials, prospective registries or national surveillance. Where a legitimate narrow medical indication exists it is stated, because the harm applies to the consumer use, not to the supervised one.来自随机试验、前瞻性登记或全国性监测的公开致害证据。若存在正当而狭窄的医疗适应证，文中会写明，因为危害针对的是消费者的自行使用，不是医疗监督下的使用。

Dose tested已验证剂量No effective dose exists. The doses tested and found harmful were 20 mg/d and 30 mg/d combined with retinyl palmitate.不存在有效剂量。经检验并被发现有害的剂量是 20 毫克/天，以及 30 毫克/天与棕榈酸视黄酯联用。

Pros优点

  • Dietary carotenoids from vegetables are not implicated in any of the harm below. Eating carrots is fine.来自蔬菜的膳食类胡萝卜素与下面所有危害都无关。吃胡萝卜没问题。

Cons缺点

  • ATBC (n=29,133 male smokers, Finland, 5-8 years): 20 mg/d increased lung cancer incidence by 18% (95% CI 3 to 36%) and total mortality by 8% (1 to 16%).ATBC（29133 名男性吸烟者，芬兰，5 至 8 年）：20 毫克/天使肺癌发病率增加 18%（95% CI 3 至 36%），总死亡增加 8%（1 至 16%）。
  • CARET (n=18,314 smokers, former smokers and asbestos-exposed workers): lung cancer RR 1.28 (1.04-1.57), all-cause death RR 1.17 (1.03-1.33), lung cancer death RR 1.46 (1.07-2.00). Stopped early.CARET（18314 名吸烟者、曾吸烟者和石棉接触工人）：肺癌 RR 1.28（1.04-1.57），全因死亡 RR 1.17（1.03-1.33），肺癌死亡 RR 1.46（1.07-2.00）。提前终止。
  • Cochrane, 78 randomised trials and 296,707 participants: beta-carotene increased mortality, RR 1.05 (1.01-1.09).Cochrane 纳入 78 项随机试验、296707 名受试者：β-胡萝卜素增加死亡，RR 1.05（1.01-1.09）。
  • This is the canonical case where the industry own logic failed in public. The observational data were strong, the mechanism was plausible, the trials were large and well conducted, and the answer was that the pill killed people.这是行业自身逻辑在公开场合失效的经典案例。观察性数据很强，机制看起来合理，试验规模大、执行规范，而答案是这药片让人死得更多。
  • Absolute avoidance in current smokers, former smokers and anyone with asbestos exposure. USPSTF grade D recommendation.现吸烟者、曾吸烟者和任何有石棉接触史者绝对避免。USPSTF 为 D 级推荐。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose partly reachable靠吃只能部分达到 Data confidence: Medium数据可信度：中

Carrots, carrot juice, sweet potato, squash and dark leafy greens are dense, ordinary sources: baked sweet potato flesh carries 11,509 µg beta-carotene per 100 g, carrot juice about 9,300 and raw carrot 8,285. Red palm oil is denser again at roughly 20,000 to 40,000 µg total carotenes per 100 g. By mass the 20 to 30 mg doses used in the intervention trials sit within reach of a few large portions, which makes this the one case where food and supplement look superficially comparable and behave completely differently.胡萝卜、胡萝卜汁、红薯、南瓜类和深色叶菜都是含量高的普通来源：烤红薯果肉每 100 g 含 11,509 µg β-胡萝卜素，胡萝卜汁约 9,300，生胡萝卜 8,285。红棕油浓度更高，每 100 g 总类胡萝卜素约 20,000 至 40,000 µg。按质量算，干预试验所用的 20 至 30 mg 剂量，几大份食物就够得着，这使本条成为食物与补充剂表面看来可比、实际行为完全不同的唯一一例。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 By label mass the trial doses are reachable: 20 mg/day is about 241 g of raw carrot (four medium carrots), 174 g of baked sweet potato, or 215 g of carrot juice, and 30 mg/day is about 362 g of raw carrot. Carrot juice is the case that really tests this, because it is the one form anyone actually consumes in the volume required. By absorbed dose the answer flips. The Dietary Reference Intake conversion factors treat 12 µg of food beta-carotene as equivalent to 1 µg retinol activity against 2 µg for supplemental beta-carotene in oil, implying the supplement form is about six times more available (Institute of Medicine, DRIs for Vitamin A and related micronutrients, 2001, DOI 10.17226/10026). Matching the absorbed exposure of a 20 mg capsule therefore takes on the order of 120 mg of food beta-carotene, roughly 1.45 kg of raw carrots daily, which nobody eats and the gut would not absorb anyway. Food matches the label number and does not match the plasma exposure that produced the trial results.按标签质量算，试验剂量是够得着的：20 mg/天 约等于 241 g 生胡萝卜（四根中等大小），或 174 g 烤红薯，或 215 g 胡萝卜汁；30 mg/天 约为 362 g 生胡萝卜。真正检验这一点的是胡萝卜汁，因为它是唯一一种人们确实会按所需体积喝下去的形式。按吸收剂量算，答案就翻转了。膳食参考摄入量的换算系数把 12 µg 食物来源 β-胡萝卜素算作 1 µg 视黄醇活性当量，油溶补充剂形式的 β-胡萝卜素则是 2 µg，意味着补充剂形式的可利用度约高六倍（Institute of Medicine，DRIs for Vitamin A and related micronutrients，2001，DOI 10.17226/10026）。因此要在吸收暴露上匹配一粒 20 mg 胶囊，需要约 120 mg 食物来源 β-胡萝卜素，大致相当于每天 1.45 kg 生胡萝卜，没有人这么吃，肠道也吸收不了。食物能对上标签上的数字，对不上产生试验结果的那个血浆暴露水平。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 This is the clearest food-versus-extract case in the set. Supplement beta-carotene is synthetic all-trans-beta-carotene or algal/fungal beta-carotene, formulated in oil or water-dispersible beadlets specifically to defeat the poor bioavailability of the food form, so it is engineered to do what a carrot cannot. Food never delivers beta-carotene alone: the same carrot supplies 3,477 µg/100 g of alpha-carotene, red palm oil is roughly a third alpha-carotene, and dark greens supply lutein with less beta-carotene. Dietary carotenoids carry none of the supplement harm for three reasons. First, uptake and cleavage are feedback-regulated, since absorbed beta-carotene raises intracellular retinoic acid, which induces ISX, which represses SR-B1 and BCO1 in the enterocyte, so absorption falls as vitamin A status rises (Reboul E, Nutrients 2019;11(4):838, PMID 31013870; the ISX loop itself traces to Lobo et al. and Widjaja-Adhi et al.). A capsule of purified beta-carotene in oil pushes plasma concentrations well past anything food produces, and the IOM 2:1 factor strictly applies to purified beta-carotene in oil, so applying it to beadlet formulations is an approximation. Second, the harm signals came from isolated high doses in high-risk groups: 20 mg/day raised lung cancer incidence by 18% in male smokers (ATBC, N Engl J Med 1994;330:1029-35, PMID 8127329) and 30 mg/day plus 25,000 IU retinyl palmitate produced about 28% more lung cancers, weighted incidence RR 1.36 (95% CI 1.07 to 1.73, P = .01) with mortality RR 1.59, in smokers and asbestos-exposed workers (CARET, Omenn et al., J Natl Cancer Inst 1996;88:1550-9, PMID 8901853). CARET cannot be attributed to beta-carotene alone, since it co-administered a large preformed retinol dose. Third, overloading on carrots produces carotenodermia, a harmless orange discolouration, rather than hypervitaminosis A, because the conversion step is regulated. Eating carrots and taking 20 mg of beta-carotene are two different interventions. Several everyday sources are absent from the table only because no figure was available to tabulate: dried parsley, basil and coriander, paprika, fresh apricots, persimmon, papaya, sweet red pepper, spring greens and collards, watercress, Swiss chard and romaine lettuce, all of which outrank the baby spinach originally chosen as the green exemplar.这是全组中食物与提取物对比最清楚的一例。补充剂里的 β-胡萝卜素是合成的全反式 β-胡萝卜素，或藻类、真菌来源的 β-胡萝卜素，配制成油溶剂型或水分散微丸，目的正是绕过食物形式吸收差的问题，它被设计出来做胡萝卜做不到的事。食物从不单独提供 β-胡萝卜素：同一根胡萝卜还提供 3,477 µg/100 g 的 α-胡萝卜素，红棕油约三分之一是 α-胡萝卜素，深色叶菜提供叶黄素而 β-胡萝卜素较少。膳食类胡萝卜素不带补充剂的那些危害，有三个原因。第一，摄取和裂解受反馈调节：吸收的 β-胡萝卜素提高细胞内视黄酸，视黄酸诱导 ISX，ISX 抑制肠上皮细胞中的 SR-B1 和 BCO1，因此维生素 A 状态升高时吸收下降（Reboul E，Nutrients 2019;11(4):838，PMID 31013870；ISX 环路本身可追溯到 Lobo 等和 Widjaja-Adhi 等）。一粒油溶纯化 β-胡萝卜素胶囊把血浆浓度推到食物远达不到的水平，而 IOM 的 2:1 系数严格来说只适用于油溶纯化 β-胡萝卜素，用在微丸剂型上只是近似。第二，危害信号来自高危人群中的孤立大剂量：每天 20 mg 使男性吸烟者的肺癌发病率上升 18%（ATBC，N Engl J Med 1994;330:1029-35，PMID 8127329）；每天 30 mg 加 25,000 IU 视黄醇棕榈酸酯，在吸烟者和石棉暴露工人中多出约 28% 的肺癌，加权发病率 RR 1.36（95% CI 1.07 至 1.73，P = .01），死亡率 RR 1.59（CARET，Omenn 等，J Natl Cancer Inst 1996;88:1550-9，PMID 8901853）。CARET 的结果不能只归因于 β-胡萝卜素，因为试验同时给了大剂量预制型视黄醇。第三，胡萝卜吃过量产生的是胡萝卜素性皮肤黄染，一种无害的橙色变色，不会造成维生素 A 中毒，因为转化步骤受调节。吃胡萝卜和服用 20 mg β-胡萝卜素是两种不同的干预。还有几种日常来源没有列入表中，仅因为找不到可以填表的数据：干欧芹、干罗勒和干香菜、红椒粉、新鲜杏、柿子、番木瓜、甜红椒、春季甘蓝（spring greens）和宽叶羽衣甘蓝（collards）、西洋菜、瑞士甜菜和罗马生菜，它们都排在最初被选作叶菜代表的嫩菠菜之前。

Absorption吸收 Beta-carotene in raw carrot and raw spinach is locked in chromoplasts behind intact plant cell walls, so absorption from raw vegetables is low; chopping, pureeing, juicing, cooking and eating with fat all raise it, and cooking does not destroy it. The formal expression of this is the 12:1 food against 2:1 supplement-in-oil conversion factor (IOM 2001, DOI 10.17226/10026). One retention argument from the original entry has to be withdrawn: boiled carrot at 9,616 µg/100 g against raw carrot at 8,285 now compares a CoFID value with a USDA one, so it cannot be read as a within-dataset cooking effect. Conversion efficiency varies substantially between individuals through BCO1 genotype and vitamin A status, which is why plasma responses to the same carrot intake differ several-fold between people (PMID 31013870, a review stretched somewhat to cover the genotype point). Spinach needs its own correction: it is not the weak green the submission made it, since USDA raw spinach at 5,626 µg/100 g is about two thirds of raw carrot rather than under a fifth, and the honest caution about it is the oxalate load for people managing kidney stones.生胡萝卜和生菠菜中的 β-胡萝卜素被锁在完整植物细胞壁之后的有色体里，所以生蔬菜的吸收率低；切碎、打泥、榨汁、加热以及与脂肪同食都会提高吸收，加热也不会破坏它。这一点的正式表达就是食物 12:1 与油溶补充剂 2:1 的换算系数（IOM 2001，DOI 10.17226/10026）。原条目里有一条关于保留率的论证必须撤回：水煮胡萝卜 9,616 µg/100 g 对生胡萝卜 8,285，如今是拿 CoFID 数值与 USDA 数值相比，因此不能当作同一数据集内的烹饪效应来读。转化效率在个体之间差别很大，取决于 BCO1 基因型和维生素 A 状态，这也是同样的胡萝卜摄入量在不同人身上血浆反应相差数倍的原因（PMID 31013870，该综述用来支撑基因型这一点略有拉伸）。菠菜需要单独更正：提交材料把它写成弱势叶菜，USDA 生菠菜 5,626 µg/100 g 约为生胡萝卜的三分之二，远高于不足五分之一的说法；对它诚实的提醒是草酸负荷，关系到需要控制肾结石的人。

Data note数据说明 The load-bearing values are now USDA-anchored, since five food figures were checkable and have been replaced (raw carrot, baked sweet potato, raw and cooked spinach, dried apricots, butter beta-carotene), and the two OK values (kale, mango) were within 9% of USDA. The dose arithmetic and the IOM conversion factors are confirmed. What holds confidence down is that four remaining rows are unconfirmed CoFID codes, two of which now sit oddly against USDA values for the same vegetable (boiled sweet potato at about half the USDA baked figure), the published range for kale is unusually wide, and the four added foods rest on single indicative figures中。承重的数值现在以 USDA 为锚：五个食物数字可核对并已替换（生胡萝卜、烤红薯、生菠菜和熟菠菜、杏干、黄油 β-胡萝卜素），两个通过检验的数值（羽衣甘蓝、芒果）与 USDA 相差在 9% 以内。剂量算术和 IOM 换算系数均已确认。压低置信度的是：仍有四行是未证实的 CoFID 编码，其中两行与同一蔬菜的 USDA 数值对不上（水煮红薯约为 USDA 烤制值的一半），羽衣甘蓝已发表数值的范围异常宽，四种新增食物依赖单一指示性数字。

Who it is for适用人群Documented deficiency, which in practice means fat malabsorption: abetalipoproteinaemia, cholestatic liver disease, cystic fibrosis, short bowel.已证实的缺乏，实际上指脂肪吸收不良：无β脂蛋白血症、胆汁淤积性肝病、囊性纤维化、短肠。

Pros优点

  • Ataxia with vitamin E deficiency requires high-dose replacement, and that is a genuine indication.维生素 E 缺乏性共济失调需要大剂量替代治疗，这是一个真实的适应证。
  • There is a narrow niche in biopsy-proven non-diabetic non-alcoholic steatohepatitis, where 800 IU/d improved histology in the PIVENS trial. That is a hepatology decision, not a self-care one.在活检证实的非糖尿病性非酒精性脂肪性肝炎中有一个狭窄的适用面，PIVENS 试验中 800 IU/天改善了组织学表现。那是肝病科的决定，不是自我保健。

Cons缺点

  • A dose-response meta-analysis of 19 trials and 135,967 participants found high-dose trials produced 39 additional deaths per 10,000 persons (95% CI 3 to 74, P=0.035). Low-dose trials showed -16 per 10,000.一项纳入 19 项试验、135967 名受试者的剂量效应 meta 分析发现，高剂量试验每 1 万人多出 39 例死亡（95% CI 3 至 74，P=0.035）。低剂量试验为每万人 -16 例。
  • SELECT (n=34,887 men): 400 IU/d of synthetic all-rac-alpha-tocopheryl acetate raised prostate cancer incidence by 17%, HR 1.17 (99% CI 1.004-1.36, P=0.008). The excess emerged in extended follow-up after supplementation had already stopped.SELECT（34887 名男性）：400 IU/天的合成全消旋α-生育酚醋酸酯使前列腺癌发病率升高 17%，HR 1.17（99% CI 1.004-1.36，P=0.008）。这个超出部分是在补充已经停止后的延长随访中出现的。
  • Haemorrhagic stroke RR 1.22 (1.00-1.48) across 9 trials and 118,765 participants, which is one additional haemorrhagic stroke per 1,250 people treated.9 项试验、118765 名受试者中出血性卒中 RR 1.22（1.00-1.48），相当于每治疗 1250 人多出 1 例出血性卒中。
  • Contraindicated with warfarin, direct oral anticoagulants, aspirin, clopidogrel and other antiplatelets, because impaired coagulation is the endpoint EFSA used to set its limit.与华法林、直接口服抗凝药、阿司匹林、氯吡格雷及其他抗血小板药禁用，因为 EFSA 设定上限所依据的终点正是凝血功能受损。
  • USPSTF grade D. Note the limits diverge sharply: 1,000 mg/d supplemental alpha-tocopherol in the US, but 300 mg/d from ALL sources in the EU.USPSTF 为 D 级。注意上限差异悬殊：美国为补充剂α-生育酚 1000 毫克/天，而欧盟为全部来源合计 300 毫克/天。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose NOT reachable by eating靠吃达不到剂量 Data confidence: Medium数据可信度：中

Alpha-tocopherol is abundant in ordinary foods: seed and nut oils, sunflower seeds, almonds, hazelnuts, paprika and wheatgerm all supply meaningful amounts, and a normal diet covers the 15 mg/day RDA without effort. This is the clearest case in the group where the two questions come apart, because the nutrient is genuinely rich in food while the dose that defines this item is not obtainable from any diet. The original single RICH label sat directly above the entry's own sentence saying the dose 'cannot be reached by eating', which is why the two answers are now separated.α-生育酚在普通食物里很充足：籽油和坚果油、葵花籽、杏仁、榛子、红椒粉和小麦胚芽都能提供可观的量，普通饮食毫不费力就能覆盖 15 mg/天 的 RDA。本组中这一条最清楚地显示出两个问题会分开作答：这种营养素在食物中确实丰富，而定义本条目的那个剂量任何饮食都无法达到。原先单一的 RICH 标签，正好压在该条目自己那句“靠吃达不到”的话上面，因此现在把两个答案分开。
