To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 400 IU of natural vitamin E is 268 mg of RRR-alpha-tocopherol. Reaching that every day from food means about 762 g of sunflower seeds (roughly 4,450 kcal), or 1.05 kg of almonds, or 179 g of wheatgerm oil (about 13 tablespoons of neat oil), or 550 g of sunflower oil at the CoFID value and 654 g at USDA's lower one. If the capsule is synthetic all-rac (180 mg for 400 IU), it is still 512 g of sunflower seeds or about 8.9 tablespoons of wheatgerm oil daily. Habitual intakes cluster around 5 to 20 mg/day, so 400 IU sits one to two orders of magnitude above anything eating produces. No dietary pattern gets there.400 IU 天然维生素 E 等于 268 mg RRR-α-生育酚。每天从食物达到这个量，意味着约 762 g 葵花籽（约 4,450 kcal），或 1.05 kg 杏仁，或 179 g 小麦胚芽油（约 13 汤匙纯油），或按 CoFID 数值 550 g 葵花籽油、按 USDA 较低数值 654 g。如果胶囊是合成的 all-rac 形式（400 IU 对应 180 mg），每天仍需 512 g 葵花籽，或约 8.9 汤匙小麦胚芽油。习惯摄入量集中在 5 至 20 mg/天，400 IU 比吃出来的任何量高出一到两个数量级。没有任何饮食模式能达到。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Most 400 IU capsules contain all-rac-alpha-tocopheryl acetate, a synthetic mixture of eight stereoisomers of which only one eighth is the RRR form that human alpha-tocopherol transfer protein preferentially retains. Food contains only RRR, which is exactly why the label conversions differ (1 IU = 0.67 mg natural against 0.45 mg synthetic). Food also never delivers alpha-tocopherol in isolation: sunflower oil carries 48.7 mg alpha with 5.1 mg gamma per 100 g, rapeseed oil carries 18.4 mg alpha with 38.0 mg gamma (CoFID 17-045 and 17-041, both unconfirmed), red palm oil is tocotrienol-rich, and nuts add tocotrienols too. High-dose alpha-tocopherol actively removes part of what food supplies: 400 IU/day of RRR-alpha-tocopheryl acetate cut serum gamma-tocopherol by a median 58% (95% CI 51 to 66%) and reduced detectable delta-tocopherol in a two-month randomised placebo-controlled trial of 184 adult nonsmokers (Huang HY and Appel LJ, J Nutr 2003;133:3137-40, PMID 14519797, all elements confirmed). A 400 IU capsule is therefore something other than a concentrated handful of sunflower seeds; it shifts the balance of vitamin E forms in blood in a direction food never does.多数 400 IU 胶囊装的是 all-rac-α-生育酚乙酸酯，这是八种立体异构体的合成混合物，其中只有八分之一是人体 α-生育酚转运蛋白优先保留的 RRR 型。食物中只有 RRR 型，标签换算因此不同（天然型 1 IU = 0.67 mg，合成型 1 IU = 0.45 mg）。食物也从不单独提供 α-生育酚：葵花籽油每 100 g 含 48.7 mg α 和 5.1 mg γ，菜籽油含 18.4 mg α 和 38.0 mg γ（CoFID 17-045 和 17-041，均未证实），红棕油富含生育三烯酚，坚果也会带来生育三烯酚。大剂量 α-生育酚会主动清掉食物提供的一部分东西：在一项为期两个月、纳入 184 名成年非吸烟者的随机安慰剂对照试验中，每天 400 IU 的 RRR-α-生育酚乙酸酯使血清 γ-生育酚中位数下降 58%（95% CI 51 至 66%），并减少可检出的 δ-生育酚（Huang HY 与 Appel LJ，J Nutr 2003;133:3137-40，PMID 14519797，各项要素均已确认）。因此一粒 400 IU 胶囊与一把浓缩的葵花籽是两回事，它把血液中各种维生素 E 形式的比例推向食物从不会推的方向。

Absorption吸收 Alpha-tocopherol needs dietary fat and bile for absorption, which nuts and oils supply intrinsically, so food forms are absorbed efficiently in ordinary meals. Fractional absorption falls as the single dose rises, and hepatic alpha-TTP selectively retains only the 2R stereoisomers, so the 2S half of a synthetic all-rac dose is largely excreted. The useful fraction of a 400 IU synthetic capsule is therefore well below its stated IU, plasma alpha-tocopherol does not scale linearly with dose, and the displacement of gamma- and delta-tocopherol documented by Huang et al. (PMID 14519797) does.α-生育酚的吸收需要膳食脂肪和胆汁，坚果和油脂本身就自带这些，所以在普通餐食中食物形式吸收效率不错。单次剂量越大，吸收分数越低；肝脏的 α-TTP 只选择性保留 2R 立体异构体，因此合成 all-rac 剂量中占一半的 2S 部分大体被排出。这就使 400 IU 合成胶囊真正有用的比例远低于其标称 IU，血浆 α-生育酚不随剂量线性上升，而 Huang 等（PMID 14519797）记录的 γ-生育酚和 δ-生育酚被置换的现象确实随剂量上升。

Data note数据说明 Six of the food values were checkable against USDA and have been replaced or ranged, so the corrected list is USDA-anchored where it matters most. The dose arithmetic is the strongest part of the item: the 268 mg and 180 mg conversions and every food requirement recompute exactly, and the conclusion is insensitive to residual uncertainty of a few tens of percent. Against that, the sunflower oil figure is unverifiable, several added foods (hazelnut, almond, safflower and cottonseed oils, paprika, peanuts, corn and soybean oils) rest on single indicative figures from the verification report, and the remaining CoFID rows could not be confirmed中。六个食物数值可以与 USDA 对照，已经替换或改为范围，所以在最要紧的地方，修正后的清单以 USDA 为锚。剂量算术是本条目最扎实的部分：268 mg 和 180 mg 的换算以及每一项食物需求量都能精确重算，几十个百分点的残余不确定性也不影响结论。另一方面，葵花籽油的数值无法核实，几种新增食物（榛子油、杏仁油、红花籽油和棉籽油、红椒粉、花生、玉米油和大豆油）依赖核查报告中的单一指示性数字，其余 CoFID 行也无法确认。

References:文献： SELECT Klein PMID 21990298; Miller PMID 15537682; Schurks BMJ PMID 21051774; USPSTF PMID 35727271; EFSA J 2024 PMID 39099617
AVOIDSelenium at 200 µg/d硒 200 微克/天Grade A证据 A 级
Dose tested已验证剂量RDA is 55 µg/d and food intake meets it in most Western diets. 200 µg/d is the dose used in the failed and harmful trials.推荐摄入量为 55 微克/天，多数西方饮食通过食物即可满足。200 微克/天是那些失败并有害的试验所用剂量。
Who it is for适用人群People with genuinely low selenium status: low-soil regions, long-term parenteral nutrition, severe malabsorption.硒状态确实偏低的人：土壤低硒地区、长期肠外营养、严重吸收不良。

Pros优点

  • It prevents Keshan disease, a selenium-deficiency cardiomyopathy, in genuinely deficient populations. That is a real and important indication.在确实缺硒的人群中，它能预防克山病，一种缺硒性心肌病。这是一个真实且重要的适应证。
  • There is a Grade B signal for mild Graves orbitopathy in selenium-suboptimal European populations at 200 µg/d for 6 months, resting on a single 159-patient trial.在硒偏低的欧洲人群中，200 微克/天服 6 个月对轻度 Graves 眼病有一个 B 级信号，依据是一项 159 名患者的单一试验。

Cons缺点

  • Cochrane, 10 randomised trials and 27,232 participants: any cancer RR 1.01 (0.93-1.10) from the low-risk-of-bias studies. That is HIGH-certainty evidence of NO benefit. The cancer-prevention reputation rests on a secondary endpoint of a 1996 skin cancer trial that was not designed to test it.Cochrane 纳入 10 项随机试验、27232 名受试者：在低偏倚风险研究中，任何癌症 RR 1.01（0.93-1.10）。这是高确定性地证明无获益。它的防癌名声建立在 1996 年一项皮肤癌试验的次要终点上，而那项试验并非为此设计。
  • SELECT (n=35,533 men, 200 µg/d L-selenomethionine) found prostate cancer HR 1.09 (99% CI 0.93-1.27). No preventive effect, and the trial stopped early for futility.SELECT（35533 名男性，200 微克/天 L-硒代甲硫氨酸）显示前列腺癌 HR 1.09（99% CI 0.93-1.27）。没有预防作用，试验因无效提前终止。
  • Incident type 2 diabetes hazard ratio 1.55 (1.03-2.33) over a mean 7.7 years at 200 µg/d, with excess risk concentrated in those already in the highest tertile of baseline plasma selenium. This harm appears at HALF the US upper limit.在 200 微克/天下，平均 7.7 年内新发 2 型糖尿病风险比为 1.55（1.03-2.33），超额风险集中在基线血浆硒本已处于最高三分位的人身上。这个危害出现在美国上限的一半剂量处。
  • The therapeutic window is narrow. EFSA lowered its upper limit to 255 µg/d in 2023 with alopecia as the critical endpoint, and derived its lowest-observed-adverse-effect level of 330 µg/d from the SELECT trial itself.治疗窗很窄。EFSA 于 2023 年把上限下调至 255 微克/天，关键终点为脱发，其 330 微克/天的最低可观察不良作用水平正是取自 SELECT 试验本身。
  • Stacking is how people get there: a 200 µg tablet on top of a multivitamin containing 55-70 µg plus dietary intake.人们正是通过叠加达到这个剂量的：一片 200 微克的硒，加上含 55 至 70 微克的复合维生素，再加饮食摄入。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose reachable by eating靠吃可以达到剂量 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

Selenium is genuinely abundant in ordinary food, and offal and marine fish carry it most reliably: braised pork kidney is 312 ug per 100 g, braised lamb kidney 219 ug, cooked yellowfin tuna 108 ug and braised lamb's liver 111 ug. Brazil nuts are the richest known food source at a USDA average of 1,920 ug/100 g, about 96 ug in a single 5 g kernel, which makes them the one food where a supplement dose is met by two nuts, and that is a hazard rather than a reassurance because their selenium is set by the soil the tree grew in and varies more than thirty-fold between Amazon regions. Reference points used in the table: EFSA AI 70 ug/d for adults, and the EFSA tolerable upper intake level of 255 ug/d for adult men and women including pregnancy and lactation, set from alopecia as the critical endpoint with a LOAEL of 330 ug/d taken from the SELECT trial and an uncertainty factor of 1.3 (EFSA Journal 2023;21(1):e07704, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2023.7704; AI from EFSA, Dietary Reference Values for nutrients Summary report, doi 10.2903/sp.efsa.2017.e15121, Tables 5 and 7). The 200 ug/d dose comes from two landmark trials: selenised yeast in the Nutritional Prevention of Cancer trial and 200 ug/d L-selenomethionine in SELECT.硒在普通食物中确实丰富，内脏和海鱼提供得最稳定：炖猪肾每 100 g 含 312 ug，炖羊肾 219 ug，熟黄鳍金枪鱼 108 ug，炖羊肝 111 ug。巴西坚果是已知最富硒的食物，USDA 平均值为每 100 g 1,920 ug，单个 5 g 果仁约 96 ug，这使它成为唯一两颗就能达到补充剂剂量的食物，而这一点值得警惕，谈不上让人放心，因为其硒含量由树木生长的土壤决定，在亚马逊各地区之间相差三十多倍。表中使用的参考值：EFSA 成人 AI 70 ug/d；EFSA 可耐受最高摄入量为成年男性和女性 255 ug/d，包括孕期和哺乳期，以脱发为关键终点，取自 SELECT 试验的 LOAEL 330 ug/d 并使用 1.3 的不确定系数（EFSA Journal 2023;21(1):e07704，DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2023.7704；AI 来自 EFSA，Dietary Reference Values for nutrients Summary report，doi 10.2903/sp.efsa.2017.e15121，表 5 和表 7）。200 ug/d 这一剂量来自两项标志性试验：Nutritional Prevention of Cancer 试验中的富硒酵母，以及 SELECT 中的 200 ug/d L-硒代甲硫氨酸。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 There is almost no gap, and that is the finding. 200 ug/d is met by 2.1 average Brazil nuts (10 g), or 64 g of braised pork kidney, or 91 g of braised lamb kidney, or 185 g of cooked yellowfin tuna, or 180 g of braised lamb's liver, or 223 g of cooked blue mussels, or 243 g of simmered chicken liver, or 263 g of canned light tuna in oil, or 532 g of cooked cod, or 4 tins of sardines, or 13 eggs. Kidney and Brazil nuts overshoot in one normal portion: an 85 g portion of braised pork kidney is 265 ug, already 133 percent of the supplement dose and above the EFSA upper level on its own, and an 85 g portion of braised lamb kidney is 186 ug, 93 percent of the dose. Because the dose is so easy to reach, the useful calculation runs the other way. The EFSA AI is 70 ug/d and the EFSA upper level is 255 ug/d, a working margin of about 185 ug. A person on a 200 ug/d supplement plus an ordinary diet is at roughly 270 ug and already over the upper level; add two average Brazil nuts and they are at about 462 ug. The UL derives from alopecia observed in SELECT at a LOAEL of 330 ug/d, so this is an observed human effect at achievable intakes rather than a theoretical ceiling (DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2023.7704). Selenium is the case where food easily matches the supplement, and the honest advice is to pick one route.几乎没有缺口，这本身就是结论。200 ug/d 可由 2.1 颗平均水平的巴西坚果（10 g）达到，或 64 g 炖猪肾、91 g 炖羊肾、185 g 熟黄鳍金枪鱼、180 g 炖羊肝、223 g 熟蓝贻贝、243 g 文火煮鸡肝、263 g 油浸罐装淡金枪鱼、532 g 熟鳕鱼、4 罐沙丁鱼，或 13 个鸡蛋。肾脏和巴西坚果在一份正常份量里就会超出：85 g 一份炖猪肾含 265 ug，已是补充剂剂量的 133%，单独就超过 EFSA 上限；85 g 一份炖羊肾含 186 ug，为该剂量的 93%。由于这个剂量太容易达到，有用的计算要反过来做。EFSA AI 为 70 ug/d，EFSA 上限为 255 ug/d，可用余量约 185 ug。一个每天服用 200 ug 补充剂并保持普通饮食的人，大约在 270 ug，已经超过上限；再加两颗平均水平的巴西坚果，就到约 462 ug。该上限源自 SELECT 中在 LOAEL 330 ug/d 观察到的脱发，这是在可达到的摄入量下观察到的人体效应，并非理论推算的天花板（DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2023.7704）。硒是食物可以轻松匹配补充剂的例子，诚实的建议是两条路只选一条。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Brazil nuts are the textbook answer and a genuinely bad way to dose selenium deliberately, because the dose is unknowable at the point of eating. Median selenium varied from 2.07 mg/kg in Mato Grosso state to 68.15 mg/kg in Amazonas, which the authors attribute to soil selenium, soil pH and texture, location and genotype (PMID 28923728). On the 5 g kernel used throughout this item's table, one nut therefore supplies about 15 percent to about 490 percent of the 70 ug adult AI. The paper's own '11 percent to 288 percent' phrasing implies a 3.0 to 3.7 g kernel and cannot stand alongside a 5 g table, so the figures have been put on one basis. Nuts from the two extremes are visually identical, are not labelled by state of origin, and are routinely blended, so 'two Brazil nuts a day' is a dose ranging from about 20 ug to about 680 ug depending on a fact the eater cannot access, spanning deficient to well over the upper level. On form equivalence, selenium is unusual in a helpful way: the dominant species in Brazil nuts and cereals is selenomethionine, the same species used as the supplement in SELECT, so food and that supplement are pharmacologically comparable (PMID 18346307). But 200 ug of selenium is not one thing. The selenised yeast used in the earlier NPC trial was a poorly speciated mixture whose delivered selenium was variable, and the two trials produced opposite results, so the number 200 ug carries no single meaning across the literature (PMID 18346308, PMID 18346307). Finally, the case for supplementing collapses in a selenium-replete person: SELECT tested 200 ug/d L-selenomethionine in selenium-replete men, found no protection against prostate or other major cancers, and produced the alopecia signal that now defines the UL.巴西坚果是教科书答案，也确实是刻意补硒的糟糕方式，因为吃下去的那一刻剂量无从知道。硒的中位数从马托格罗索州的 2.07 mg/kg 到亚马逊州的 68.15 mg/kg，作者将其归因于土壤硒、土壤 pH 与质地、地点和基因型（PMID 28923728）。按本条目表中通用的 5 g 果仁计算，一颗坚果因此提供成人 AI 70 ug 的约 15% 到约 490%。论文自己的 11% 至 288% 的表述隐含的是 3.0 至 3.7 g 的果仁，无法与 5 g 的表格并存，因此这些数字已统一到同一基准。两个极端产地的坚果外观完全相同，不按产州标注，并且常规混装，所以每天两颗巴西坚果对应的剂量在约 20 ug 到约 680 ug 之间，取决于食用者无法获知的事实，横跨从缺乏到远超上限的范围。在形式等效性上，硒有一点很有帮助：巴西坚果和谷物中的主要形态是硒代甲硫氨酸，与 SELECT 使用的补充剂形态相同，因此食物与该补充剂在药理上可比（PMID 18346307）。但 200 ug 硒并不是一件事。更早的 NPC 试验使用的富硒酵母是形态不明确的混合物，实际提供的硒含量不稳定，而两项试验得出相反结果，所以 200 ug 这个数字在整个文献里没有单一含义（PMID 18346308，PMID 18346307）。最后，对硒充足的人来说，补充的理由完全崩塌：SELECT 在硒充足的男性中测试了 200 ug/d L-硒代甲硫氨酸，未发现对前列腺癌或其他主要癌症的保护作用，并产生了如今界定 UL 的脱发信号。

Absorption吸收 Selenium bioavailability depends on chemical species more than on food matrix. Selenomethionine, the form in Brazil nuts, cereals and meat, is absorbed almost completely and is incorporated non-specifically into body proteins as a storage pool, which is why it raises plasma selenium readily and why its kinetics differ from inorganic selenite and selenate (PMID 18346307, PMID 28412747). That has a practical consequence the composition tables hide: the selenium content of any plant food is a proxy for the soil it grew in rather than a property of the species. The USDA wholemeal bread figure of 25.7 ug/100 g and the wheat germ figure of 79.2 ug/100 g both reflect North American wheat grown on selenium-rich soils. European and UK wheat grows on selenium-poor soils, so the same bread and the same wheat germ cannot be assumed to deliver the same selenium, and the wide between-country variation in intake driven by exactly this mechanism is the central theme of the food-chain intake review (PMID 18346308). Animal foods hold their values better across countries, because livestock feed is commonly selenium-supplemented, which is why kidney, liver, tuna, mussels and eggs travel better than bread or nuts do. Ranking for a reader who wants reliable selenium without a variable dose: kidney and liver first, then marine fish and shellfish including canned tuna and mussels, eggs as a steady background contributor, and Brazil nuts last precisely because they are the richest source.硒的生物利用度主要取决于化学形态，食物基质的影响较小。硒代甲硫氨酸是巴西坚果、谷物和肉类中的形态，几乎完全被吸收，并以非特异方式掺入体内蛋白作为储存池，这就是它容易提高血浆硒、而其动力学又与无机的亚硒酸盐和硒酸盐不同的原因（PMID 18346307，PMID 28412747）。这带来一个成分表掩盖了的实际后果：任何植物性食物的硒含量都是其生长土壤的代理指标，物种本身的属性并不决定它。USDA 全麦面包 25.7 ug/100 g 和小麦胚芽 79.2 ug/100 g 这两个数值都来自生长在富硒土壤上的北美小麦。欧洲和英国的小麦长在贫硒土壤上，所以不能假定同样的面包和同样的小麦胚芽能提供同样的硒，各国摄入量差异巨大正是由这一机制驱动，也是那篇食物链摄入综述的核心主题（PMID 18346308）。动物性食物的数值跨国稳定得多，因为畜禽饲料通常补硒，这也是肾、肝、金枪鱼、贻贝和蛋比面包或坚果更经得起地域迁移的原因。对想要稳定补硒又不愿面对波动剂量的读者，排序是：肾和肝居首，其次是海鱼和贝类，包括罐装金枪鱼和贻贝，蛋作为稳定的背景来源，巴西坚果排在最后，恰恰因为它是最富硒的来源。

Data note数据说明 Every original per-100 g figure matched FoodData Central to the digit (312, 1,920, 108, 111, 37.6, 52.7, 36.1, 31.1, 25.7, 19.7), the Brazil nut state medians were confirmed verbatim from PMID 28923728, and the EFSA UL derivation was confirmed word for word: alopecia as critical endpoint, LOAEL 330 ug/d from SELECT, uncertainty factor 1.3, UL 255 ug/d including pregnancy and lactation. EFSA itself notes that consumers are unlikely to exceed the UL except regular users of food supplements or regular consumers of Brazil nuts. The seven added rows use conventional portion sizes rather than USDA measure-table entries, so their per-portion figures are derived and flagged in place高。原稿每一个每 100 g 数值都与 FoodData Central 逐位一致（312、1,920、108、111、37.6、52.7、36.1、31.1、25.7、19.7），巴西坚果各州中位数已从 PMID 28923728 逐字确认，EFSA UL 的推导也逐字确认：脱发为关键终点，来自 SELECT 的 LOAEL 330 ug/d，不确定系数 1.3，UL 255 ug/d，包括孕期和哺乳期。EFSA 自己指出，除了经常使用食品补充剂或经常食用巴西坚果的人，消费者不太可能超过 UL。新增的七行使用常规份量而非 USDA 计量表条目，因此其每份数值是推算的，并已就地标注。

References:文献： Cochrane Vinceti PMID 29376219; SELECT PMID 19066370 and PMID 21990298; Stranges PMID 17620655; EFSA 2023
AVOIDPreformed vitamin A at or above 10,000 IU预成型维生素 A 10000 IU 及以上Grade D证据 D 级
Dose tested已验证剂量RDA 900 µg RAE for men and 700 µg for women. The upper limit is 3,000 µg/d, which is exactly 10,000 IU.推荐摄入量：男性 900 微克 RAE，女性 700 微克。上限为 3000 微克/天，正好等于 10000 IU。
Who it is for适用人群Clinical vitamin A deficiency in low-income settings, fat malabsorption, cystic fibrosis. In replete Western adults, nobody.低收入地区的临床维生素 A 缺乏、脂肪吸收不良、囊性纤维化。在营养充足的西方成人中，没有适用人群。

Pros优点

  • WHO supplementation saves lives in vitamin-A-deficient children, particularly in measles. That is one of the highest-value public health interventions in existence, and it is not what an over-the-counter 10,000 IU capsule is for.在维生素 A 缺乏的儿童中，尤其是麻疹患儿，WHO 的补充方案能挽救生命。那是现存价值最高的公共卫生干预之一，但这不是一粒非处方 10000 IU 胶囊的用途。

Cons缺点

  • CARET showed net harm: 25,000 IU/d of retinyl palmitate plus 30 mg beta-carotene gave all-cause death RR 1.17 (1.03-1.33) and lung cancer death RR 1.46 (1.07-2.00).CARET 显示净危害：25000 IU/天棕榈酸视黄酯加 30 毫克β-胡萝卜素，全因死亡 RR 1.17（1.03-1.33），肺癌死亡 RR 1.46（1.07-2.00）。
  • Over-the-counter products at 10,000 IU/d sit exactly AT the upper limit, leaving zero headroom for diet, liver consumption or a second supplement.10000 IU/天的非处方产品正好卡在上限，饮食、吃动物肝脏或第二种补充剂都没有余量。
  • It is teratogenic. Preformed vitamin A above the upper limit in pregnancy is a hard contraindication, and prenatal products should use beta-carotene rather than retinol.它有致畸性。妊娠期预成型维生素 A 超过上限属硬性禁忌，孕期产品应使用β-胡萝卜素而非视黄醇。
  • Unlike beta-carotene, preformed vitamin A is not subject to feedback regulation on absorption, so chronic excess accumulates and causes hepatotoxicity, intracranial hypertension and bone loss.与β-胡萝卜素不同，预成型维生素 A 的吸收不受反馈调节，因此长期过量会蓄积，导致肝毒性、颅内压升高和骨质流失。
  • Contraindicated in liver disease of any kind, since retinol is stored in and toxic to the liver.任何类型的肝病禁用，因为视黄醇储存于肝脏并对肝脏有毒。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose reachable by eating靠吃可以达到剂量 Data confidence: Low数据可信度：低

Liver is far more concentrated in preformed retinol than the supplement: 10,000 IU is 3,000 µg retinol, and every common liver in the UK tables carries 10,500 to 25,200 µg per 100 g. Hard cheese, butter, fortified fat spreads and egg yolk supply an everyday retinol baseline of tens to about a hundred micrograms per portion on top of that. This is the one item in the group where the food beats the pill, which is why liver carries a public-health warning rather than a recommendation.肝脏中预制型视黄醇的浓度远高于补充剂：10,000 IU 相当于 3,000 µg 视黄醇，而英国食物成分表里常见的每一种肝脏，每 100 g 都含 10,500 至 25,200 µg。在此之上，硬质奶酪、黄油、强化脂肪涂抹酱和蛋黄还提供每份数十到约一百微克的日常视黄醇基线。本组中只有这一条是食物胜过药片，所以官方对肝脏发出的是公共卫生警告，谈不上推荐。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 There is no gap to close. About 12 g of fried calf liver supplies the full 3,000 µg (10,000 IU) of a high-dose retinol capsule, and a normal 100 g portion of any liver delivers 3.5 to 8.4 times that dose in one sitting. A 40 g serving of liver pate is functionally a 10,000 IU tablet at 2,920 µg (9,730 IU). A tablespoon of cod liver oil is 2,448 µg (8,160 IU). Anyone eating liver weekly is already taking supraphysiological preformed vitamin A intermittently, and a 10,000 IU supplement on top compounds a load the body stores rather than clears. For scale, the US tolerable upper intake level for preformed vitamin A is 3,000 µg/day, which is the supplement dose itself, against a UK RNI of 700 µg for men and 600 µg for women.这里没有需要填补的缺口。约 12 g 油炸小牛肝就能提供高剂量视黄醇胶囊的全部 3,000 µg（10,000 IU），而任何一种肝脏的常规 100 g 份量，一餐就能送来该剂量的 3.5 至 8.4 倍。40 g 肝酱含 2,920 µg（9,730 IU），功能上等同一片 10,000 IU 的药片。一汤匙鱼肝油是 2,448 µg（8,160 IU）。每周吃肝的人已经在间歇性摄入超生理量的预制型维生素 A，再叠加 10,000 IU 补充剂，只会加重身体倾向储存而非清除的负荷。作为参照，美国预制型维生素 A 的可耐受最高摄入量是 3,000 µg/天，恰好就是这个补充剂剂量本身，而英国 RNI 为男性 700 µg、女性 600 µg。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 The retinol in liver is the same molecule as the retinyl palmitate or acetate in capsules, absorbed by the same route and stored in the liver the same way, so the usual reassurance that food forms are safer does not apply here. Pregnancy is the sharp edge: UK advice is that people who are pregnant or who might become pregnant should avoid liver and liver products including pate, and should avoid supplements containing vitamin A including fish liver oils, because excess retinol is teratogenic (NHS pregnancy vitamins guidance). Cod liver oil is the common trap, bought for omega-3 or vitamin D and delivering 60,000 IU of retinol per 100 g, and the same trap has sharper versions that are eaten as ordinary food rather than dosed: canned cod liver (Icelandic and Polish tinned), which carries retinol in the cod-liver-oil range, and halibut liver oil, which is more concentrated again and sold in the same aisle. Liver is also eaten unnoticed as liver sausage, liverwurst, haggis, foie gras, and goose and duck liver, all in the same range as the livers tabulated. Outside pregnancy, chronic preformed retinol above the 3,000 µg/day UL is associated with reduced bone mineral density and fracture risk, which is why UK advice is to eat liver no more than once a week. Beta-carotene-rich foods are the safe substitute precisely because their conversion is regulated.肝脏里的视黄醇与胶囊里的视黄醇棕榈酸酯或乙酸酯是同一个分子，走同一条吸收途径，在肝脏中以同样方式储存，所以“食物形式更安全”这句常见的安慰话在这里不成立。孕期是最锋利的一处：英国的建议是，怀孕或可能怀孕的人应避免肝脏及包括肝酱在内的肝制品，并避免含维生素 A 的补充剂，包括鱼肝油，因为过量视黄醇有致畸性（NHS 孕期维生素指南）。鱼肝油是常见的陷阱，人们为了 omega-3 或维生素 D 买它，而它每 100 g 提供 60,000 IU 视黄醇；同一个陷阱还有更锋利的版本，那些是当作普通食物吃下去的，不是按剂量服用的：罐装鳕鱼肝（冰岛和波兰的罐头），其视黄醇含量与鱼肝油同一量级；还有大比目鱼肝油，浓度更高，就摆在同一排货架上。肝脏也常在不被注意的情况下被吃下：肝肠、德式肝肠（liverwurst）、苏格兰羊杂布丁（haggis）、鹅肝酱（foie gras），以及鹅肝和鸭肝，含量都与表中所列的肝脏处于同一区间。在孕期之外，长期摄入超过 3,000 µg/天 UL 的预制型视黄醇与骨密度下降和骨折风险相关，这也是英国建议每周吃肝不超过一次的原因。富含 β-胡萝卜素的食物是安全的替代，原因正在于其转化受到调节。

Absorption吸收 Retinyl esters from liver and from supplements are absorbed at high efficiency and, critically, absorption is not down-regulated when stores are full, so intake accumulates in hepatic stellate cells over weeks and months. Carotenoid absorption works the opposite way, feedback-limited through retinoic-acid induction of the intestinal transcription factor ISX and consequent repression of SR-B1 and BCO1 (reviewed in Reboul E, Nutrients 2019;11(4):838, PMID 31013870, DOI 10.3390/nu11040838; the feedback loop itself originates with Lobo et al. and Widjaja-Adhi et al.). Cooking concentrates liver retinol rather than destroying it, through water loss: CoFID shows raw lamb liver at 17,300 µg/100 g rising to 19,700 fried, and raw ox liver at 14,200 rising to 17,300 stewed (codes 18-413, 18-494, 18-415, 18-416, all unconfirmed along with the rest of the CoFID series).来自肝脏和来自补充剂的视黄酯吸收效率都很高，而且关键在于，储备充足时吸收并不会下调，因此摄入量会在数周到数月间累积于肝星状细胞。类胡萝卜素的吸收方向相反，受反馈限制：视黄酸诱导肠道转录因子 ISX，进而抑制 SR-B1 和 BCO1（综述见 Reboul E，Nutrients 2019;11(4):838，PMID 31013870，DOI 10.3390/nu11040838；该反馈环路本身出自 Lobo 等和 Widjaja-Adhi 等）。烹饪通过失水提高肝脏视黄醇的浓度，并不会破坏它：CoFID 显示生羊肝为 17,300 µg/100 g，油炸后升至 19,700；生牛肝 14,200，炖后升至 17,300（编码 18-413、18-494、18-415、18-416，与 CoFID 系列其余部分一样均未证实）。

Data note数据说明 The item's central claim is robust, since the conclusion that food exceeds the supplement dose survives any plausible revision of the numbers, and every IU conversion and dose equivalence recomputes exactly. But the entire liver series, which carries the whole argument, rests on McCance and Widdowson CoFID 2021 codes that could not be retrieved or confirmed, and the two values in this item that were checkable against USDA both came back overstated (butter retinol by 43%, egg yolk by 17%), so the precision quoted for the liver figures is not yet earned. The added cheddar and fortified spread figures are indicative only低。本条目的核心论断很稳固，食物超过补充剂剂量这一结论在任何合理的数字修订下都成立，而且每一项 IU 换算和剂量等效都能精确重算。但承载全部论证的整个肝脏系列依赖 McCance and Widdowson CoFID 2021 的编码，这些编码既无法取得也无法确认；本条目中两个能与 USDA 对照的数值都被高估（黄油视黄醇高估 43%，蛋黄高估 17%），所以肝脏数字所给出的精度还不配得上。新增的切达奶酪和强化涂抹酱数字仅为指示性。

Dose tested已验证剂量RDA is 1.3 mg/d. EFSA set the upper limit at 12 mg/d in 2023. The US IOM figure is still 100 mg/d.推荐摄入量为 1.3 毫克/天。EFSA 于 2023 年把上限定为 12 毫克/天。美国 IOM 的数字仍是 100 毫克/天。
Who it is for适用人群People on isoniazid, cycloserine, hydralazine or penicillamine, where B6 is protective against drug-induced neuropathy. Pregnant women with nausea and vomiting, at obstetric direction.服用异烟肼、环丝氨酸、肼屈嗪或青霉胺者，此时 B6 可预防药物性神经病。妊娠恶心呕吐的孕妇，需遵产科医嘱。

Pros优点

  • It genuinely prevents isoniazid-induced peripheral neuropathy at 10-50 mg/d, which is a real and important indication.在 10 至 50 毫克/天下，它确实能预防异烟肼引起的周围神经病，这是一个真实而重要的适应证。
  • Pyridoxine with doxylamine is a first-line option for nausea and vomiting of pregnancy, ahead of antiemetics.吡哆醇与多西拉敏联用是妊娠恶心呕吐的一线选择，优先于止吐药。

Cons缺点

  • This is the clearest case in this document where the product category actively causes the harm it claims to prevent. Nerve support, neuropathy and PMS formulas routinely deliver 50-100 mg of B6 to people with no deficiency, which is four to eight times the current European upper limit.这是本文中最清楚的一个例子：一个产品品类主动造成了它声称要预防的那种伤害。“神经营养”“神经病变”和经前综合征类配方常规给到 50 至 100 毫克 B6，而使用者并不缺乏，这是当前欧洲上限的 4 至 8 倍。
  • Sensory peripheral neuropathy is the dose- and duration-dependent toxicity: numbness, burning, ataxia and loss of proprioception. EFSA set its 12 mg/d limit on exactly this, from a reference point of 50 mg/d in case reports.感觉性周围神经病是剂量和时长依赖的毒性表现：麻木、烧灼感、共济失调、位置觉丧失。EFSA 正是据此把上限定为 12 毫克/天，参考点取自个案报告中的 50 毫克/天。
  • Choosing pyridoxal-5-phosphate (P5P) at a premium does NOT prevent it. The toxicity is not form-specific.花高价选择磷酸吡哆醛（P5P）并不能避免这一点。毒性与形式无关。
  • Audit your total intake. Anyone on a B-complex, a fortified energy drink and a nerve or stress formula can easily stack past 100 mg without noticing.要核算总摄入量。同时在吃复合 B 族、喝强化能量饮料、又吃“神经”或“抗压”配方的人，很容易不知不觉叠加超过 100 毫克。
  • An observational safety signal exists: in men, a 10-year average intake above 20 mg/d from individual supplements gave lung cancer HR 1.82 (1.25-2.65). Confounding by smoking is possible, but the direction is not reassuring.存在一个观察性安全信号：在男性中，通过单一补充剂十年平均摄入超过 20 毫克/天，肺癌 HR 为 1.82（1.25-2.65）。可能受吸烟混杂影响，但这个方向并不令人安心。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose NOT reachable by eating靠吃达不到剂量 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

Vitamin B6 itself is abundant and widely distributed, with fish, organ meat, poultry, potatoes, bananas, seeds, nuts and fortified cereals all carrying useful amounts, and dietary deficiency uncommon in people eating normally. The marketed high-dose object is a different thing: pyridoxine hydrochloride, a manufactured crystalline salt sold at 50, 100 and sometimes 250-500 mg per tablet, which is 40 to 400 times the 1.3 mg adult RDA and has no dietary counterpart at that concentration. Both statements are true at once, which is why the label is split here: the molecule is RICH in food (so RICH stands rather than being reclassified as synthetic), while the product as sold is unreachable by eating, which is what dose_from_food now records. All percentages below use the 1.3 mg RDA for ages 19-50; over 50 the RDA rises to 1.7 mg for men and 1.5 mg for women, so these percentages overstate the contribution for older adults.维生素 B6 本身分布广泛、含量充足，鱼、内脏、禽肉、马铃薯、香蕉、种子、坚果和强化谷物都带有可观的量，正常饮食的人很少出现膳食性缺乏。市面上的大剂量产品是另一回事：盐酸吡哆醇，一种人工制造的结晶盐，以每片 50、100、有时 250-500 mg 出售，相当于成人 RDA 1.3 mg 的 40 到 400 倍，膳食中没有任何东西达到这个浓度。两句话同时成立，所以这里把标签拆开：这个分子在食物中确实丰富（因此保留 RICH，不改判为合成），而以在售形态出现的产品靠吃达不到，这就是 dose_from_food 现在记录的内容。下面所有百分比都按 19-50 岁的 1.3 mg RDA 计算；50 岁以上 RDA 升至男性 1.7 mg、女性 1.5 mg，所以这些百分比高估了对年长成年人的贡献。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 A 100 mg pyridoxine tablet is 77 times the RDA. Matching it by eating, in one day, takes 7.46 kg of dried sunflower kernels, 8.93 kg of pistachios, 9.80 kg of braised beef liver, 10.7 kg of raw yellowfin tuna, 16.7 kg of roasted chicken breast, or 27.2 kg of banana, about 231 medium bananas. A 50 mg tablet still needs 4.46 kg of pistachios or 116 bananas. Even the regulatory ceiling sits outside dietary reach: EFSA's 2023 tolerable upper intake level of 12 mg/day for adults corresponds to about 1.07 kg of pistachios or 3.27 kg of banana, roughly 28 bananas, every single day. Nobody eats any of that. Ordinary diets deliver a few mg per day, an order of magnitude below the UL and two to three orders below the supplement, and that is the mechanical reason dietary B6 has never produced the sensory neuropathy that supplements produce: no food is concentrated enough to approach the toxic range. The syndrome was described in seven adults taking megadose pyridoxine (Schaumburg H et al., 'Sensory neuropathy from pyridoxine abuse. A new megavitamin syndrome', N Engl J Med 1983;309:445-8, PMID 6308447), all of whom improved after withdrawal; the widely quoted 2-6 g/day range is secondary-literature summary that does not appear in the abstract, so treat it as unconfirmed and source any dose figure to the full text or to EFSA's case tabulation. Cases have since been reported at far lower supplemental doses, and EFSA cut the adult UL from the SCF's 25 mg/day to 12 mg/day on peripheral neuropathy grounds, from a 50 mg/day reference point with an uncertainty factor of 4 (EFSA NDA Panel, EFSA J 2023;21:e08006, PMID 37207271, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2023.8006). Not one case has been attributed to food B6.一片 100 mg 的吡哆醇是 RDA 的 77 倍。要在一天之内靠吃达到同样的量，需要 7.46 kg 干葵花籽仁、8.93 kg 开心果、9.80 kg 炖牛肝、10.7 kg 生黄鳍金枪鱼、16.7 kg 烤鸡胸肉，或 27.2 kg 香蕉，约 231 根中等大小的香蕉。50 mg 的片剂也仍需 4.46 kg 开心果或 116 根香蕉。连监管上限都在膳食可及范围之外：EFSA 2023 年为成人定的可耐受最高摄入量 12 mg/天，相当于每天约 1.07 kg 开心果或 3.27 kg 香蕉，约 28 根香蕉。这些没有人会吃。普通饮食每天提供几 mg，比 UL 低一个数量级，比补充剂低两到三个数量级，这就是膳食 B6 从未造成补充剂那种感觉神经病变的机械原因：没有食物浓到能接近中毒范围。该综合征最初描述于 7 名服用超大剂量吡哆醇的成年人（Schaumburg H 等, Sensory neuropathy from pyridoxine abuse. A new megavitamin syndrome, N Engl J Med 1983;309:445-8, PMID 6308447），停用后全部好转；被广泛引用的 2-6 g/天这个区间出自二手文献的概述，摘要里并没有，因此按未确认处理，任何剂量数字都应回到全文或 EFSA 的病例汇总去核对。此后在低得多的补充剂量下也有病例报告，EFSA 以周围神经病变为依据，把成人 UL 从 SCF 的 25 mg/天下调到 12 mg/天，参考点为 50 mg/天，不确定系数取 4（EFSA NDA Panel, EFSA J 2023;21:e08006, PMID 37207271, DOI 10.2903/j.efsa.2023.8006）。没有一例被归因于食物中的 B6。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 This is a genuine case where the food is safe and the concentrated form is not, and the reason is dose plus kinetics rather than any exotic compound. Food B6 arrives as pyridoxal phosphate and pyridoxamine phosphate bound in the matrix, plus glycosylated pyridoxine in plant foods, released and absorbed gradually across a meal. A tablet delivers a bolus of free pyridoxine. The accepted mechanism for the neuropathy is that free pyridoxine at high concentration outruns conversion to pyridoxal 5-phosphate and acts at PLP-dependent sites in the dorsal root ganglion, which lacks a blood-nerve barrier. Pyridoxal-5-phosphate supplements are marketed as the safe alternative on the strength of that mechanism, but the human evidence is thin and EFSA applies its 12 mg/day UL to total B6 regardless of form, so treating P5P as exempt has no support. One practical consequence: because B6 is added to energy drinks, fortified cereals and B-complex products, people accumulate supplemental doses without intending to, and the UL is easy to cross by stacking products while eating a diet that contributes almost nothing to the risk.这是食物安全而浓缩形态不安全的一个真实案例，原因是剂量加动力学，与什么特殊化合物无关。食物中的 B6 以磷酸吡哆醛和磷酸吡哆胺的形式结合在食物基质里，植物性食物中还有糖苷化的吡哆醇，在一餐中被逐步释放和吸收。片剂送进去的是一次性的游离吡哆醇冲击量。公认的神经病变机制是：高浓度的游离吡哆醇超出了转化为 5-磷酸吡哆醛（PLP）的能力，并在背根神经节的 PLP 依赖位点上产生作用，而背根神经节没有血神经屏障。5-磷酸吡哆醛补充剂正是凭这套机制被当成安全替代品来卖，但人体证据薄弱，而且 EFSA 把 12 mg/天的 UL 用于各种形式的 B6 总量，所以把 P5P 当成例外没有依据。一个现实后果：由于能量饮料、强化谷物和复合 B 族产品里都加了 B6，人们会在无意中累积到补充剂级别的剂量，叠加几种产品就很容易越过 UL，而饮食对这个风险几乎没有贡献。

Absorption吸收 Roughly 75% of dietary B6 is absorbed. Plant B6 is partly pyridoxine-5'-beta-D-glucoside, which is about half as available as free pyridoxine and can act as a weak antagonist: a diet supplying 27% of its B6 as PNG lowered plasma total B6 and red cell PLP in women, an effect the authors quantified as a 15-18% loss of total B6 intake (Hansen, Leklem and Miller, J Nutr 1996;126:2512-8, PMID 8857512). That is a real discount on high-PNG plant diets and a modest one, so it should not be stretched into a claim that plant-food B6 numbers are broadly unreliable. Cooking removes more. USDA Table of Nutrient Retention Factors Release 6 (2007) gives B6 retention of 50% for roasted beef (code 0601), 35% for beef braised or simmered without the drippings (0651/0653), 45% for liver simmered without drippings (1152), 80% for roasted chicken (0805), 50% for legumes boiled 2-2.5 h (0541), 65% for legumes boiled 45-75 min and drained (0521) and 85% for greens boiled in water to cover (3005). A raw-basis figure such as the 0.933 mg/100 g for raw tuna is not what lands on the plate.膳食 B6 约 75% 被吸收。植物中的 B6 有一部分是吡哆醇-5'-β-D-葡萄糖苷（PNG），可利用率约为游离吡哆醇的一半，还能起弱拮抗作用：一份 27% 的 B6 以 PNG 形式提供的饮食，降低了女性的血浆总 B6 和红细胞 PLP，作者把这一效应量化为总 B6 摄入量损失 15-18%（Hansen、Leklem 与 Miller, J Nutr 1996;126:2512-8, PMID 8857512）。对 PNG 比例高的植物性饮食，这是一个真实而幅度有限的折扣，不应被放大成植物性食物 B6 数据普遍不可靠。烹饪损失更多。USDA 营养素保留系数表（Table of Nutrient Retention Factors）第 6 版（2007）给出的 B6 保留率：烤牛肉 50%（代码 0601），牛肉炖或煮且不计肉汁 35%（0651/0653），肝脏煮制不计肉汁 45%（1152），烤鸡 80%（0805），豆类煮 2-2.5 h 为 50%（0541），豆类煮 45-75 min 后沥干 65%（0521），绿叶菜加水没过煮 85%（3005）。像生金枪鱼 0.933 mg/100 g 这样的生品数值，与最终上桌的量不是一回事。

Data note数据说明 All nine composition values and all gram weights verified against named FoodData Central records, including the pistachio data-point count of 13 and its 0.484-1.80 analytical range, and every dose-gap quantity recomputed line by line. The EFSA 2023 opinion, its 12 mg/day UL, the 50 mg reference point and the uncertainty factor of 4 all check out. The one weak link is flagged in place: the 2-6 g/day figure attached to Schaumburg 1983 is secondary-literature summary and is not in the abstract, so it is presented as unconfirmed高。九个成分值和所有克重都已对照具名的 FoodData Central 记录核实，包括开心果的 13 个数据点及其 0.484-1.80 分析范围，每一项剂量差距的用量都逐行重算过。EFSA 2023 意见、其 12 mg/天 UL、50 mg 参考点和不确定系数 4 全部核对无误。唯一的薄弱环节已就地标注：附在 Schaumburg 1983 上的 2-6 g/天出自二手文献概述，摘要中没有，因此以未确认的形式呈现。

References:文献： EFSA PMID 37207271; Cochrane Matthews PMID 26348534; Brasky JCO PMID 28829668
AVOIDGreen tea extract (EGCG)绿茶提取物（EGCG）Grade B证据 B 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Commercial products commonly deliver 250-500 mg EGCG/d. EFSA found significant transaminase elevation at or above 800 mg/d.市售产品常提供 EGCG 250 至 500 毫克/天。EFSA 发现在 800 毫克/天及以上转氨酶显著升高。
Who it is for适用人群Nobody for the marketed indications. Drinking green tea is fine and is a different exposure.就其宣传的功效而言没有适用人群。喝绿茶没问题，那是完全不同的暴露方式。

Pros优点

  • Green tea as a beverage has no meaningful hepatotoxicity signal and is a perfectly reasonable drink.绿茶作为饮品没有有意义的肝毒性信号，是一种完全合理的饮料。

Cons缺点

  • EFSA was unable to identify ANY dose of EGCG from green tea extracts that can be considered safe, because catechin composition varies with cultivar, growing conditions and extraction method. That is an unusual regulatory conclusion.EFSA 无法确定绿茶提取物中任何一个可被认定为安全的 EGCG 剂量，因为儿茶素组成随品种、种植条件和提取工艺而变化。这是一个不寻常的监管结论。
  • NIH LiverTox documents more than 100 published cases of clinically apparent liver injury: median latency 42 days, 95% hepatocellular, severe in 35%, and transplantation in 8%, with fatal acute liver failure reported.NIH 的 LiverTox 收录了 100 例以上有明确临床表现的肝损伤：中位潜伏期 42 天，95% 为肝细胞型，35% 为重度，8% 接受肝移植，并有致死性急性肝衰竭的报告。
  • HLA-B*35:01 was present in 72% of green tea liver-injury cases versus 11-15% of controls, and essentially nobody is tested for it.在绿茶相关肝损伤病例中，72% 携带 HLA-B*35:01，对照组为 11 至 15%，而基本上没有人会去做这个检测。
  • The weight-loss claim, which is why most of it is sold, has clinically trivial effect sizes where measurable.减重这个卖点是它主要的销售理由，但在可测量的范围内，其效应量在临床上微不足道。
  • It was the second most used of six hepatotoxic botanicals in US national survey data. Avoid entirely with pre-existing liver disease, raised transaminases, or another hepatotoxic agent such as methotrexate, isoniazid, high-dose paracetamol or alcohol.在美国全国调查数据中，它是六种肝毒性植物里使用第二多的。已有肝病、转氨酶升高，或正在使用甲氨蝶呤、异烟肼、大剂量对乙酰氨基酚或酒精等其他肝毒性物质者，应完全避免。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose reachable by eating靠吃可以达到剂量 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

Green tea, matcha, white tea and gunpowder green tea all deliver EGCG at tens to over a hundred milligrams per cup or bowl from ordinary shop-bought products, so this is the one entry in the set where a normal beverage reaches the doses used in supplement trials. EFSA's exposure assessment puts mean adult intake at 86 to 321 mg EGCG/day across dietary surveys and high-level (95th percentile) intake at 308 to 866 mg/day, so the top of habitual tea drinking brushes the 800 mg supplement threshold. Oolong is often grouped in here, but no measured per-cup figure survived verification, so it gets no row; bottled ready-to-drink green tea is the commercially dominant form and is far weaker than anything listed, and it also lacks a verified figure here.绿茶、抹茶、白茶和珠茶都能以普通市售产品在每杯或每碗中提供数十至一百多毫克 EGCG，因此这是本组中唯一一项普通饮品即可达到补充剂试验剂量的条目。EFSA 的暴露评估显示，各项膳食调查中成人平均摄入量为每天 86 至 321 mg EGCG，高摄入人群（第 95 百分位）为每天 308 至 866 mg，习惯性饮茶的上限已逼近 800 mg 的补充剂阈值。乌龙茶常被归入此类，但没有每杯实测数值通过核实，故不单列一行；瓶装即饮绿茶是商业上的主流形态，含量远低于上列任何一项，此处同样缺少经核实的数据。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 800 mg EGCG, the dose at which supplements produce measurable liver enzyme rises, is about 4 to 5 cups of green tea at EFSA's mean brewed concentration of 70.2 mg/100 mL, or 10 to 16 cups of more weakly brewed retail tea, or about 7 to 8 bowls of matcha at 2 g each. EFSA's high-level consumers already reach 308 to 866 mg/day from infusions alone, so the top of that range is at the supplement dose. What differs is the vehicle: the tea drinker's 800 mg arrives spread over a day in two to three litres of water, usually with food, while the supplement delivers it as a single fasted bolus.补充剂在 800 mg EGCG 这一剂量上会造成可测得的肝酶升高。按 EFSA 冲泡液平均浓度 70.2 mg/100 mL 计算，这相当于约 4 至 5 杯绿茶，或 10 至 16 杯冲泡较淡的零售茶，或每碗 2 g 的抹茶约 7 至 8 碗。EFSA 的高摄入人群仅靠冲泡茶饮就已达到每天 308 至 866 mg，该区间上限正处在补充剂剂量水平。差别在载体：饮茶者的 800 mg 分散在一天两到三升水中摄入，通常还伴随食物，而补充剂是空腹一次性大剂量给药。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 State this plainly: the beverage carries no meaningful liver signal, the extract does. EFSA concluded that intake at or above 800 mg EGCG/day taken as a food supplement causes a statistically significant increase in serum transaminases, while catechins from green tea infusion prepared in the traditional way, and reconstituted drinks of equivalent composition, are in general considered safe. Same molecule, different product. Risk concentrates in high-dose, single-bolus, fasted dosing of concentrated extracts, and Commission Regulation (EU) 2022/2340 now prohibits supplements delivering 800 mg or more EGCG per day in the EU. Green tea extract is also the ingredient behind a large share of liver injury cases attributed to weight-loss and fat-burner blends, which is a warning about the extract rather than about tea.直说结论：饮品没有实质性的肝损伤信号，提取物有。EFSA 认为，以食品补充剂形式摄入每天 800 mg 及以上 EGCG 会导致血清转氨酶出现统计学显著升高；而传统方式冲泡的绿茶所含儿茶素，以及成分相当的复水饮品，总体上被认为是安全的。同一个分子，不同的产品。风险集中在浓缩提取物的高剂量、单次大剂量、空腹服用，欧盟委员会条例 (EU) 2022/2340 现已禁止在欧盟销售每日提供 800 mg 及以上 EGCG 的补充剂。绿茶提取物也是减肥和燃脂复方所致肝损伤病例中占很大比例的成分，这是针对提取物的警示，与饮茶无关。

Absorption吸收 Systemic bioavailability of EGCG is low, on the order of 0.1 to 1% of an oral dose as the unchanged compound, with heavy glucuronidation, sulfation and methylation plus colonic degradation. The critical modifier is food: fasted dosing raises EGCG Cmax severalfold compared with the same dose taken with a meal, and fasted administration is both the way extracts are typically taken and the condition associated with hepatotoxicity. Milk and food proteins bind catechins and blunt peak levels, so tea with milk is pharmacologically not tea on an empty stomach. Brewing extracts only part of the leaf's EGCG whereas matcha delivers the whole leaf. The corrected numbers support the point that matcha is no many-fold EGCG upgrade per gram of leaf: matcha measures 50.53 to 56.57 mg/g against gunpowder green tea at 70.22 mg/g in the same 15-product HPLC survey, which found no statistically significant EGCG difference across tea types.EGCG 的全身生物利用度很低，以原型化合物计约为口服剂量的 0.1 至 1%，伴有大量葡萄糖苷酸化、硫酸化和甲基化，以及结肠内降解。关键的调节因素是食物：空腹服用可使 EGCG 的 Cmax 比同剂量随餐服用高出数倍，而空腹服用既是提取物的典型服法，也是与肝毒性相关的条件。牛奶和食物蛋白会结合儿茶素、削平峰值浓度，因此从药理学上看，加奶的茶与空腹喝的茶是两码事。冲泡只能浸出茶叶中一部分 EGCG，抹茶则把整片叶子都送进体内。修正后的数据支持这样一个判断：按每克茶叶计，抹茶在 EGCG 上并没有成倍的优势。在同一项涵盖 15 种产品的 HPLC 调查中，抹茶实测为 50.53 至 56.57 mg/g，珠茶为 70.22 mg/g，该调查未发现不同茶类之间 EGCG 存在统计学显著差异。

Data note数据说明 Every EFSA figure verified exactly (70.2 mg/100 mL from 100 samples across 12 references, 7,116 mg/100 g dry leaf, the intake ranges, the 800 mg transaminase conclusion), and the corrected matcha and gunpowder values come from an HPLC survey of 15 commercial products. The white tea row is the only indicative entry高。EFSA 的每一项数据都逐项核实无误（来自 12 篇文献 100 个样本的 70.2 mg/100 mL、干茶 7,116 mg/100 g、各摄入量区间、800 mg 转氨酶结论），修正后的抹茶和珠茶数值来自一项 15 种市售产品的 HPLC 调查。白茶那一行是唯一的参考性条目。

AVOIDAshwagandha (Withania somnifera)南非醉茄（印度人参）Grade C证据 C 级
Dose tested已验证剂量300-600 mg/d of root extract standardised to about 5% withanolides. Liver injury occurred at ordinary retail doses.标准化至约 5% 醉茄内酯的根提取物 300 至 600 毫克/天。肝损伤发生在普通零售剂量下。
Who it is for适用人群No population with a demonstrated clinical need. Anyone with liver disease should be steered away entirely.没有任何人群有已证实的临床需要。有肝病者应完全避开。

Pros优点

  • There is a real but small and fragile efficacy signal: pooled Perceived Stress Scale -4.72 (-8.45 to -0.99), Hamilton Anxiety Scale -2.19 (-3.83 to -0.55) and serum cortisol -2.58 across 9 randomised trials and 558 patients.存在一个真实但微弱且脆弱的有效性信号：9 项随机试验、558 名患者中，感知压力量表 -4.72（-8.45 至 -0.99），Hamilton 焦虑量表 -2.19（-3.83 至 -0.55），血清皮质醇 -2.58。
  • A sleep meta-analysis of 5 trials and 400 participants found SMD -0.59, with larger effects at 600 mg/d or more over 8 weeks or longer.一项涵盖 5 项试验、400 名受试者的睡眠 meta 分析得出 SMD -0.59，在 600 毫克/天以上、8 周以上时效应更大。

Cons缺点

  • Hepatotoxicity is documented in a prospective case series from Iceland and the US DILIN network: jaundice with nausea, lethargy and pruritus after a latency of 2 to 12 weeks, cholestatic or mixed injury, symptoms lasting 5 to 20 weeks.肝毒性已被冰岛和美国 DILIN 网络的前瞻性病例系列记录：潜伏 2 至 12 周后出现黄疸伴恶心、乏力和瘙痒，损伤为胆汁淤积型或混合型，症状持续 5 至 20 周。
  • In an Indian case series, 5 of 23 patients had pre-existing chronic liver disease, 3 developed acute-on-chronic liver failure and ALL 3 DIED. Pre-existing liver disease is the hard contraindication.在一组印度病例中，23 名患者里有 5 人本已有慢性肝病，3 人发展为慢加急性肝衰竭，3 人全部死亡。已有肝病是硬性禁忌。
  • Denmark banned it in food supplements in 2023 after its national food institute concluded no safe intake level could be established.丹麦国家食品研究所认定无法确定安全摄入水平后，丹麦于 2023 年禁止其用于食品补充剂。
  • It raises T4 and can precipitate thyrotoxicosis or require a levothyroxine dose reduction. Published cases exist.它会升高 T4，可能诱发甲状腺毒症，或需要下调左甲状腺素剂量。已有公开病例。
  • Avoid in pregnancy (traditional abortifacient use), in autoimmune disease and in transplant recipients (immunostimulant effects), and with sedatives (additive).妊娠期（传统上有堕胎用途）、自身免疫性疾病和移植受者（免疫刺激作用）应避免，与镇静剂合用有叠加作用。
  • The trials are small, short, mostly single-centre and frequently manufacturer-sponsored, with subjective questionnaire endpoints and no hard endpoint anywhere in the literature.这些试验规模小、周期短、多为单中心，且常由厂商资助，终点是主观问卷，整个文献中没有任何硬终点。

Food sources食物来源

From a plant not eaten as food来自不作食物食用的植物 Dose NOT reachable by eating靠吃达不到剂量 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

Ashwagandha is the root, sometimes root plus leaf, of Withania somnifera, a small shrub in the Solanaceae. The root is a medicinal drug rather than a dietary item: bitter, taken as a churna or a decoction in milk, and present in no cuisine as an ingredient. The active steroidal lactones, withanolides such as withaferin A, withanolide A and withanone, occur in Withania and a few related genera and are absent from the food supply. The nightshades people actually eat, tomato, potato, aubergine, sweet and chilli peppers, contain a different class of steroidal compounds (glycoalkaloids such as tomatine and solanine), so botanical relatedness buys nothing here. A related species, Withania coagulans, has fruit used regionally as a vegetarian milk-clotting agent, which is a processing aid rather than a dietary source of withanolides.南非醉茄是 Withania somnifera 的根，有时是根加叶，该植物是茄科的一种小灌木。这个根属于药材，不属于膳食成分：味苦，通常做成 churna 药粉或用牛奶煎煮服用，任何菜系都不把它当配料。其活性成分是甾体内酯类，即睡茄内酯（withanolides），如 withaferin A、withanolide A 和 withanone，只见于醉茄属及少数近缘属，在食物供应链中不存在。人们真正吃的茄科作物，番茄、马铃薯、茄子、甜椒和辣椒，含的是另一类甾体化合物（番茄苷、茄碱等糖苷生物碱），所以植物学上的亲缘关系在这里没有帮助。近缘种 Withania coagulans 的果实在一些地区用作素食凝乳剂，那是加工助剂，并不构成睡茄内酯的膳食来源。

No food rows: there is no ordinary food that supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有食物条目：没有任何普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 Trials use 300-600 mg/day of standardised root extract. KSM-66 is a root-only extract standardised to a minimum 5% withanolides, Sensoril is a root-and-leaf extract at 10%, and Shoden is standardised to 35% withanolide glycosides, so a typical daily dose is roughly 15-60 mg of withanolides. Traditional practice uses 3-6 g/day of dried root powder to reach a comparable place. No food quantity supplies this at any size, because no food plant contains withanolides. Quoting an equivalent weight of an ordinary food would require inventing a content value, so the honest answer is that the dietary route does not exist.试验用量为标准化根提取物 300-600 mg/天。KSM-66 是仅用根的提取物，标准化到至少 5% 睡茄内酯；Sensoril 是根加叶提取物，含量 10%；Shoden 标准化到 35% 睡茄内酯糖苷。因此典型每日剂量约相当于 15-60 mg 睡茄内酯。传统做法用 3-6 g/天的干根粉达到大致相当的水平。任何份量的食物都无法提供这个量，因为没有食用植物含睡茄内酯。要给出某种普通食物的等效重量，就必须凭空编一个含量值，所以诚实的答案是：膳食途径不存在。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Plant part matters and so does the regulator's view. Root-only preparations have a better documented safety profile than preparations including leaf and aerial parts, which are richer in withaferin A, the most cytotoxic of the withanolides. Ashwagandha is banned in food supplements in Denmark, the Dutch national institute RIVM has published a risk assessment of Withania preparations (RIVM report 2024-0029), French authorities have advised against use in specific groups, the UK Food Standards Agency has logged rising incident reports and its committee reviewed associations with thyroid toxicity, hypoglycaemia and liver toxicity, and Australia's TGA issued a medicine safety update in July 2026 on continuing reports of ashwagandha-associated liver injury judged to be idiosyncratic. KSM-66's milk-based extraction is a marketing distinction rather than a safety one. Withanolide content also varies with chemotype, cultivation and plant part, so two products at the same milligram dose can differ several-fold in the compounds that matter.用哪个部位很关键，监管机构的态度同样关键。只用根的制剂，安全性资料比含叶和地上部分的制剂更完整，后者 withaferin A 含量更高，而它是睡茄内酯中细胞毒性最强的一个。丹麦禁止在食品补充剂中使用南非醉茄；荷兰国家研究院 RIVM 发布了醉茄属制剂的风险评估（RIVM 报告 2024-0029）；法国主管部门建议特定人群不要使用；英国食品标准局记录到不良事件报告上升，其专家委员会审查了与甲状腺毒性、低血糖和肝毒性的关联；澳大利亚 TGA 在 2026 年 7 月发布药品安全通报，指出与南非醉茄相关的肝损伤报告持续出现，判定为特异质性反应。KSM-66 的牛奶提取工艺是营销上的区别，谈不上安全性上的区别。睡茄内酯含量还随化学型、栽培条件和植物部位变化，所以同样毫克剂量的两个产品，在真正起作用的成分上可能相差数倍。

Absorption吸收 Human pharmacokinetic data are thin and no standard bioavailability figure can be quoted with confidence. Withanolides are lipophilic and poorly water-soluble, which is why traditional preparation uses milk or ghee and why modern products add phospholipid or cyclodextrin carriers. Withanolide glycosides (withanosides) are more water-soluble and are the markers Shoden standardises on, so percent withanolides on two labels may refer to chemically different pools measured by different assays. Because there is no food form there is no food-versus-supplement absorption comparison to make; the meaningful comparison is between extract types, and it is not standardised.人体药代动力学数据薄弱，无法有把握地给出标准生物利用度数值。睡茄内酯亲脂、水溶性差，这也是传统制备用牛奶或酥油、现代产品加磷脂或环糊精载体的原因。睡茄内酯糖苷（withanosides）水溶性更好，是 Shoden 标准化所用的标志物，因此两个标签上的“睡茄内酯百分比”可能指化学上不同的成分池，并由不同方法测定。由于没有食物形式，也就无从比较食物与补充剂的吸收；有意义的比较是不同提取物类型之间的比较，而这一点并未标准化。

Data note数据说明 for the food and dose determination. The NOT_FOOD call was challenged and upheld, the withanolide dose arithmetic (15-60 mg from 300-600 mg of extract at 5-10%) was verified as correct, and there are no food-composition figures in this entry to be wrong. The verification pass specifically endorsed the refusal to invent a withanolide food content value. The regulatory statements were outside the scope of the numeric verification食物与剂量判定为高。NOT_FOOD 判定经质疑后维持，睡茄内酯剂量的算术（300-600 mg 提取物按 5-10% 计得 15-60 mg）核实无误，本条目也没有可能出错的食物成分数值。核查环节明确认可了拒绝编造睡茄内酯食物含量值的做法。监管方面的陈述不在数值核查范围内。

References:文献： Bjornsson Liver Int PMID 31991029; Arumugam PMID 39348746; Cheah PMID 34559859; DTU Denmark 2020
AVOIDWeight-loss, fat-burner and energy blends减重、燃脂与能量复方Grade D证据 D 级

Who it is for适用人群No identifiable group. This is the worst-behaving corner of the entire supplement market.没有可界定的适用人群。这是整个补充剂市场表现最恶劣的角落。

Pros优点

  • None identified. The efficacy literature does not support clinically meaningful weight loss from these products.没有发现任何优点。有效性文献不支持这些产品能带来有临床意义的减重。

Cons缺点

  • Weight-loss and energy products account for 71.8% (67.6-76.1) of the supplement-related emergency department visits presenting with cardiac symptoms, out of an estimated 23,005 visits per year in the US.在美国每年约 23005 次补充剂相关急诊中，出现心脏症状的病例有 71.8%（67.6-76.1）来自减重和能量类产品。
  • Adults aged 20-34 accounted for 28.0% of all such visits, so the demographic bearing the harm is young and otherwise healthy.20 至 34 岁成人占全部此类就诊的 28.0%，也就是说承担危害的是年轻、本来健康的群体。
  • The FDA acted against Hydroxycut in 2009 after hepatotoxicity reports including a death. NIH LiverTox maintains a dedicated monograph for Garcinia cambogia acute liver injury including fulminant hepatic failure.2009 年，FDA 在收到包括一例死亡在内的肝毒性报告后对 Hydroxycut 采取行动。NIH LiverTox 为藤黄属的急性肝损伤（包括暴发性肝衰竭）专门设有专论。
  • These are proprietary blends, and 40.9% of all adulterated supplements in the FDA database are weight-loss products. Undeclared sibutramine, withdrawn from all major markets in 2010, and prohibited stimulants such as DMAA, deterenol, octodrine, oxilofrine and phenpromethamine are repeatedly found.它们是专有配方，而 FDA 掺假产品数据库中 40.9% 是减重产品。未标示的西布曲明（2010 年已从所有主要市场撤市）以及 DMAA、deterenol、octodrine、oxilofrine、phenpromethamine 等违禁兴奋剂被反复检出。
  • Serotonin syndrome has been reported with garcinia in combination with SSRIs, SNRIs and MAOIs. Contraindicated in liver disease, arrhythmia and hypertension.藤黄与 SSRI、SNRI 和 MAOI 合用已有 5-羟色胺综合征报告。肝病、心律失常和高血压者禁用。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose partly reachable靠吃只能部分达到 Data confidence: Medium数据可信度：中

This category holds four different answers and the earlier single TRACE label hid the most important one. Caffeine is RICH and is the only component with a consistent thermogenic effect, available from coffee and tea by the cup. p-Synephrine is RICH as well: citrus juices carry up to 25 to 40 mg per quarter litre and Seville orange juice about 13 mg per 240 mL glass, which sits inside the clinical dose range, so the earlier NOT_FOOD label for bitter orange was wrong. Garcinia gummi-gutta rind (kodampuli, Malabar tamarind) is a genuine culinary souring agent in Kerala and parts of Southeast Asia, used in fish curry and asam laksa, and carries hydroxycitric acid at 10 to 30% of dry weight. The remainder splits differently: raspberry ketone is TRACE (up to 4.3 mg/kg in raspberries against 100 to 1,400 mg/day sold), green coffee chlorogenic acids come from unroasted beans that nobody eats, yohimbe bark and Coleus forskohlii root are NOT_FOOD, and higenamine and DMAA are synthetic with no food origin at all.这一类别包含四种不同的答案，此前统一标为 TRACE 掩盖了其中最重要的一个。咖啡因属于 RICH，是唯一具有稳定生热效应的成分，一杯咖啡或茶即可获得。对羟基辛弗林（p-synephrine）同样属于 RICH：柑橘类果汁每四分之一升可达 25 至 40 mg，塞维利亚苦橙汁每 240 mL 一杯约 13 mg，落在临床剂量范围之内，因此此前把苦橙标为 NOT_FOOD 是错的。藤黄果（Garcinia gummi-gutta）果皮（kodampuli，马拉巴罗望子）在喀拉拉邦和东南亚部分地区确实是烹饪用的酸味料，用于鱼咖喱和亚参叻沙，羟基柠檬酸含量为干重的 10 至 30%。其余成分的归类各不相同：树莓酮属于 TRACE（树莓中最高 4.3 mg/kg，而在售剂量为每天 100 至 1,400 mg），绿咖啡的绿原酸来自没人会吃的未烘焙咖啡豆，非洲催情树（yohimbe）皮和毛喉鞘蕊花（Coleus forskohlii）根属于 NOT_FOOD，去甲乌药碱（higenamine）和 DMAA 为合成物，完全没有食物来源。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 Component by component. Caffeine: 200 mg is four to five 150 mL cups of filter coffee on the cited Brazilian table, or about two 240 mL US/UK mugs at roughly 95 mg each, or five cups of green tea, so this one is trivially reachable (guarana powder, yerba mate, cocoa and energy drinks belong in the same picture and appear in the same cited caffeine table, but no per-portion figure was verified here, so they get no row). p-Synephrine: a single 240 mL glass of Seville orange juice at about 13 mg already sits inside the 10 to 53 mg/day range used in the pooled overweight and obese subjects, whose individual study doses spanned 5.5 to 80 mg. Garcinia: 3 g of dried rind souring a pot for four carries 300 to 900 mg HCA at 10 to 30% w/w, about 75 to 225 mg per person against supplement doses of 72 to 900 mg HCA, and less again because HCA transfers only partly into the broth and the rind is fished out rather than eaten, so culinary use lands in the lower middle of the supplement range rather than at its top. Raspberry ketone: 100 mg, the smallest common dose, is about 23 kg of fresh raspberries at the highest natural concentration of 4.3 mg/kg, and the 1,400 mg top dose about 326 kg, so it is unreachable by three orders of magnitude, and the safety review notes even the lowest recommended dose is about 56 times the threshold of toxicological concern for its structural class. Green coffee: extracts standardised to 45 to 50% chlorogenic acids at 400 to 1,600 mg/day supply roughly 200 to 800 mg CGA, and the concentrated dose exists only because green beans are inedible; the cups-of-coffee comparison cannot be stated here, because the bean percentages it rested on were misattributed and have been withdrawn.逐个成分来看。咖啡因：按所引巴西数据表，200 mg 相当于四到五杯 150 mL 滤泡咖啡，或约两杯 240 mL 的美式/英式马克杯（每杯约 95 mg），或五杯绿茶，这一项轻易就能达到（瓜拉纳粉、马黛茶、可可和能量饮料同属这一图景，也出现在所引的同一张咖啡因表中，但此处没有核实过的每份数值，故不单列）。对羟基辛弗林：一杯 240 mL 塞维利亚苦橙汁约 13 mg，已落在超重和肥胖受试者汇总分析所用的每天 10 至 53 mg 范围内，其单项研究剂量跨度为 5.5 至 80 mg。藤黄果：3 g 干果皮为四人份的一锅菜提酸，按 10 至 30% w/w 计含 300 至 900 mg HCA，每人约 75 至 225 mg，而补充剂剂量为 72 至 900 mg HCA；实际还要更少，因为 HCA 只有部分转移到汤汁中，果皮通常被捞出而不吃掉，所以烹饪用量落在补充剂区间的中下段，达不到其上限。树莓酮：常见最小剂量 100 mg，按最高天然浓度 4.3 mg/kg 计约需 23 kg 新鲜树莓，1,400 mg 的最高剂量约需 326 kg，相差三个数量级，无法达到；安全性综述指出，即使最低推荐剂量也约为其结构类别毒理学关注阈值的 56 倍。绿咖啡：按 45 至 50% 绿原酸标准化的提取物，每天 400 至 1,600 mg 可提供约 200 至 800 mg CGA，这种浓缩剂量之所以存在，只是因为生豆不能吃；与咖啡杯数的对比在此无法给出，因为其依据的豆类百分比数据来源标注有误，已撤回。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 The governing pattern in this category is that the food is safe while the concentrate is not, and Garcinia is the cleanest illustration. Centuries of culinary use of the dried rind as a souring agent in South and Southeast Asian cooking carry no liver-injury signal, while concentrated HCA supplements have produced 34 published hepatotoxicity case reports including nine liver transplants and one death, plus more than 200 adverse events of liver injury and 93 international case reports reviewed by Health Canada, with 17 cases meeting CIOMS/RUCAM causality. The injury looks idiosyncratic rather than dose-dependent, with a proposed HLA-B*35:01 association, so the absence of harm from culinary use says something about the product form rather than about a lower dose, and on corrected arithmetic the culinary serving delivers the middle of the supplement HCA range rather than the top of it. The same shape repeats across the category: green tea extract in fat-burner blends against drinking tea (see that entry), and bitter orange p-synephrine stacked with caffeine and linked to cardiovascular events, where the honest food comparison is a glass of citrus juice carrying a similar p-synephrine dose without the stimulant stack. Yohimbe bark extract has no edible counterpart at all, and raspberry ketone at food flavouring levels of milligrams per kilogram bears no relation to 100 to 1,400 mg/day capsules with essentially no human toxicology. Add the labelling problem: proprietary blends routinely under-declare caffeine and stack multiple stimulants, so the only reliable comparison available is to count your caffeine in cups and treat the rest of the label as unquantified.这一类别的主导模式是食物安全、浓缩物不安全，藤黄果是最清楚的例证。南亚和东南亚烹饪中把干果皮当酸味料使用已有数百年，没有肝损伤信号；而浓缩 HCA 补充剂已产生 34 例已发表的肝毒性病例报告，其中 9 例接受肝移植、1 例死亡，另有 200 多例肝损伤不良事件，以及加拿大卫生部审阅的 93 例国际病例报告，其中 17 例符合 CIOMS/RUCAM 因果关系判定。这种损伤看起来属于特异质反应，并不呈剂量依赖，并有人提出与 HLA-B*35:01 相关，因此烹饪用法没有出现危害说明的是产品形态问题，与剂量更低无关；按修正后的算法，烹饪一份提供的量处于补充剂 HCA 区间的中段，达不到上限。同样的模式在这一类别中反复出现：燃脂复方中的绿茶提取物与喝茶的对比（见该条目），以及与咖啡因叠加、并与心血管事件相关联的苦橙对羟基辛弗林，其诚实的食物对照是一杯柑橘汁，提供相近的对羟基辛弗林剂量而不带兴奋剂叠加。非洲催情树皮提取物完全没有可食用的对应物；树莓酮在食品香料层面的用量为每千克若干毫克，与每天 100 至 1,400 mg 的胶囊毫无关系，后者基本没有人体毒理学数据。再加上标签问题：专有配方常常少报咖啡因并叠加多种兴奋剂，因此唯一可靠的比较办法是按杯数算自己的咖啡因摄入，把标签上其余部分视为未量化。

Absorption吸收 Caffeine is the outlier and the reason these blends do anything: it is almost completely absorbed, peaks in 30 to 60 minutes, and behaves much the same from coffee as from a tablet, with coffee's chlorogenic acids only modestly slowing absorption. Chlorogenic acids themselves are poorly bioavailable, with roughly a third absorbed in the small intestine and the remainder extensively metabolised by colonic microbiota into hydroxycinnamic acid derivatives, so the milligrams of CGA printed on a green coffee label map badly onto systemic exposure. Raspberry ketone is rapidly conjugated and cleared, which is one reason the human evidence for it is close to non-existent. Hydroxycitric acid absorption from Garcinia is incomplete and depends on the salt form (calcium, potassium or magnesium salts differ in solubility), which helps explain why the pooled human weight-loss effect is at best around 0.9 kg over placebo, despite doses in the same order as what a serving of Kerala fish curry supplies.咖啡因是这里的例外，也是这些复方能起作用的原因：它几乎被完全吸收，30 至 60 分钟达峰，来自咖啡与来自片剂的表现大致相同，咖啡中的绿原酸只是略微减慢吸收。绿原酸本身生物利用度差，约三分之一在小肠吸收，其余大量被结肠菌群代谢为羟基肉桂酸衍生物，所以绿咖啡标签上印的 CGA 毫克数与全身暴露的对应关系很差。树莓酮会被迅速结合并清除，这也是它的人体证据几近于零的原因之一。藤黄果中羟基柠檬酸的吸收不完全，且取决于盐的形式（钙盐、钾盐或镁盐的溶解度不同），这有助于解释为什么人体汇总分析中的减重效果最多只比安慰剂多约 0.9 kg，尽管其剂量与一份喀拉拉鱼咖喱所提供的量在同一数量级。

Data note数据说明 The BraCaffT caffeine table, the raspberry ketone occurrence and TTC figures, and the Garcinia hepatotoxicity case counts all verified exactly. The Garcinia rind HCA percentage and the supplement HCA dose range could not be traced to the cited review, the chlorogenic acid bean percentages were misattributed and have been withdrawn, and the p-synephrine figures come from the verification report's check rather than a direct read中。BraCaffT 咖啡因数据表、树莓酮的天然含量与 TTC 数值，以及藤黄果肝毒性病例数均已逐项核实无误。藤黄果果皮的 HCA 百分比和补充剂 HCA 剂量区间无法追溯到所引综述，绿原酸的豆类百分比数据来源标注有误、已撤回，对羟基辛弗林的数值来自核查报告的复核，并非直接查阅原文。

Pros优点

  • None. There is no hype-versus-reality gap to argue about, because the products contain drugs they do not declare.没有优点。这里不存在“宣传与现实”的落差可争论，因为产品里就含有它们没有申报的药物。

Cons缺点

  • The DILIN prospective series enrolled 44 men, mean age 33, median latency 73 days of use. 100% were jaundiced, 84% had pruritus, 71% required hospitalisation, and liver biopsy in 59% showed mild hepatitis with profound cholestasis.DILIN 前瞻性病例系列纳入 44 名男性，平均 33 岁，中位使用潜伏期 73 天。100% 出现黄疸，84% 有瘙痒，71% 需住院，59% 做了肝活检的患者显示轻度肝炎伴重度胆汁淤积。
  • Chemical analysis of the implicated products repeatedly finds anabolic androgenic steroids not declared on the label. These are controlled substances.对涉事产品的化学分析反复检出标签上未申报的合成代谢雄激素类固醇。这些属于受管制物质。
  • Of 44 products sold as SARMs, only 23 (52%) contained any SARM, 17 (39%) contained a different unapproved drug, 4 (9%) contained no active compound at all, and only 18 (41%) had accurate labels.在 44 款以 SARM 名义销售的产品中，只有 23 款（52%）含有任何一种 SARM，17 款（39%）含有另一种未获批药物，4 款（9%）完全不含活性成分，只有 18 款（41%）标签准确。
  • Muscle building accounted for 11.9% of adulterated products in the FDA database, and bodybuilding products caused 45 of 130 herbal and dietary supplement liver injury cases in the DILIN cohort.在 FDA 掺假产品数据库中，增肌类占 11.9%；在 DILIN 队列中，130 例草药与膳食补充剂肝损伤病例中有 45 例由健美产品引起。
  • ABCB11 gene variants were over-represented in cases versus ethnically matched controls, so some individuals are genetically far more vulnerable and have no way to know.与族裔匹配的对照相比，病例中 ABCB11 基因变异更常见，因此某些人在遗传上更易受害，而他们无从得知。

Food sources食物来源

No food source, manufactured无食物来源，人工合成 No dose to compare没有可比的剂量 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

There is no food source, because the active ingredients are undeclared anabolic androgenic steroids: manufactured pharmaceuticals and controlled substances. The label ingredients are largely decorative. Chemical analysis of the products implicated in liver injury repeatedly finds steroids the label does not mention.没有食物来源，因为其活性成分是未标示的合成代谢雄激素类固醇，也就是人工合成的药物和受管制物质。标签上列的成分基本是装饰。对那些造成肝损伤的产品所做的化学分析，反复检出标签上根本没写的类固醇。

No food rows: there is no ordinary food that supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有食物条目：没有任何普通食物能提供有意义的量。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 The legitimate food-adjacent route to the advertised outcome is dull and well evidenced: enough total protein to reach about 1.6 g/kg/day, and creatine monohydrate. Both have their own entries with food tables. Neither requires buying a proprietary blend.要达到广告宣称的效果，正当且贴近食物的路径既枯燥又有充分证据：把总蛋白摄入提到约 1.6 克/公斤/天，再加一水肌酸。两者本文都有各自的条目和食物表。都不需要买什么专有配方。

Pros优点

  • None. The only defensible use of this evidence is categorical avoidance.没有优点。这些证据唯一站得住的用途就是整类回避。

Cons缺点

  • Sexual enhancement is the single largest adulterated category: 353 of 776 products (45.5%) in the FDA tainted-products database, from 146 different companies.性功能增强是掺假最多的单一品类：在 FDA 掺假产品数据库的 776 个产品中占 353 个（45.5%），来自 146 家不同公司。
  • The adulterants are PDE5 inhibitors, chiefly sildenafil and structural analogues designed to evade detection. Undeclared sildenafil taken by someone on nitrates for angina is a route to catastrophic hypotension in a patient who does not know they took a PDE5 inhibitor.掺假物是 PDE5 抑制剂，主要是西地那非及为规避检测而设计的结构类似物。一个正在服用硝酸酯类抗心绞痛药的人吃下未标示的西地那非，会走向灾难性低血压，而他并不知道自己吃了 PDE5 抑制剂。
  • Enforcement does not work on this category. Of 27 FDA-recalled supplements still purchasable and re-analysed a mean 34.3 months after recall, 18 (66.7%) still contained banned drugs and 63% contained the same adulterant the FDA had already ordered removed.监管执法在这个品类上不起作用。在召回后平均 34.3 个月仍能买到并被重新检测的 27 款 FDA 召回产品中，18 款（66.7%）仍含违禁药，63% 含有 FDA 早已要求移除的同一种掺假物。
  • Tucker found 157 products (20.2%) contained more than one unapproved ingredient, and on resampling 19 of 28 repeatedly flagged products (67.9%) had merely switched to a different adulterant.Tucker 发现 157 个产品（20.2%）含有一种以上未获批成分，而重新取样时，28 个被反复标记的产品中有 19 个（67.9%）只是换成了另一种掺假物。

Food sources食物来源

No food source, manufactured无食物来源，人工合成 No dose to compare没有可比的剂量 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

There is no food source. The active ingredients are undeclared PDE5 inhibitors, chiefly sildenafil and structural analogues designed to evade laboratory detection. These are prescription pharmaceuticals, not nutrients, and they are present because the product would otherwise do nothing.没有食物来源。其活性成分是未标示的 PDE5 抑制剂，主要是西地那非以及为规避实验室检测而设计的结构类似物。这些是处方药，不是营养素，它们之所以在里面，是因为不放的话产品什么作用也没有。

No food rows: there is no ordinary food that supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有食物条目：没有任何普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 Not applicable. No quantity of any food contains a pharmaceutical PDE5 inhibitor.不适用。任何食物、任何数量都不含药用的 PDE5 抑制剂。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 The danger runs the other way from a normal form caveat. Here the product contains more than the label admits rather than less. Someone taking nitrates for angina who swallows an undeclared PDE5 inhibitor can reach catastrophic hypotension without knowing what they took.这里的危险与通常的“剂型差异”正好相反。这个产品含有的东西比标签承认的更多，而不是更少。一个正在服用硝酸酯类抗心绞痛药的人，吞下未标示的 PDE5 抑制剂，可能在不知道自己吃了什么的情况下走向灾难性低血压。

Absorption吸收 NONE. This entry is a product category rather than a single substance, so there is no single absorption comparison to make.不适用。本条目是一个产品类别，不是单一物质，因此没有单一的吸收对比可做。

AVOIDHigh-dose folic acid plus B12 for cardiovascular prevention以心血管预防为目的的大剂量叶酸加 B12Grade D证据 D 级
Dose tested已验证剂量The Norwegian trials used folic acid 0.8 mg/d plus B12 0.4 mg/d, with or without B6 40 mg/d.挪威试验用的是叶酸 0.8 毫克/天加 B12 0.4 毫克/天，有的另加 B6 40 毫克/天。
Who it is for适用人群Nobody for cardiovascular prevention. Periconceptional folic acid at 400 µg is a completely different indication and should not be conflated with this.以心血管预防为目的没有适用人群。围孕期 400 微克叶酸是完全不同的适应证，不应与此混为一谈。

Pros优点

  • B vitamins do reliably lower homocysteine, which was the mechanistic rationale. The mechanism worked. The clinical benefit did not follow.B 族维生素确实能稳定降低同型半胱氨酸，这曾是其机制依据。机制成立了，临床获益没有随之而来。

Cons缺点

  • The homocysteine hypothesis is dead as a cardiovascular target. HOPE-2 (n=5,522, 5 years) lowered homocysteine with no effect on major vascular events (RR 0.95, 0.84-1.07). SEARCH (n=12,064, 6.7 years) cut it 28% with RR 1.04 (0.97-1.12) for major vascular events.同型半胱氨酸作为心血管靶点已经死了。HOPE-2（n=5522，5 年）降低了同型半胱氨酸，对主要血管事件无效应（RR 0.95，0.84-1.07）。SEARCH（n=12064，6.7 年）使其下降 28%，主要血管事件 RR 为 1.04（0.97-1.12）。
  • There is a positive cancer harm signal. Pooled Norwegian trials in 6,837 patients with ischaemic heart disease: cancer incidence HR 1.21 (1.03-1.41), cancer mortality HR 1.38 (1.07-1.79), and all-cause mortality also raised.存在明确的癌症危害信号。挪威两项试验在 6837 名缺血性心脏病患者中的合并分析：癌症发病 HR 1.21（1.03-1.41），癌症死亡 HR 1.38（1.07-1.79），全因死亡同样升高。
  • Anyone with a history of cancer or at elevated cancer risk should not take high-dose folic acid for cardiovascular indications.有癌症史或癌症风险升高者，不应为心血管目的服用大剂量叶酸。
  • Vitamin B12 use before and during chemotherapy was associated with worse disease-free survival (HR 1.83, 1.15-2.92) and worse overall survival (HR 2.04, 1.22-3.40) in a prospective study nested in a phase 3 trial.在一项嵌套于三期试验的前瞻性研究中，化疗前及化疗期间使用维生素 B12 与更差的无病生存（HR 1.83，1.15-2.92）和总生存（HR 2.04，1.22-3.40）相关。
  • The upper limit for synthetic folic acid is 1,000 µg/d, and it was set to prevent masking of B12 deficiency neuropathy.合成叶酸上限为 1000 微克/天，设定这个上限的目的是防止掩盖 B12 缺乏性神经病。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 No dose to compare没有可比的剂量 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

Both nutrients are abundant in ordinary food, so see the folic acid and vitamin B12 entries for the food tables. The distinction that matters here is the dose and the purpose. Food folate and food B12 at dietary levels carry none of the cancer signal seen in the Norwegian trials, which used 0.8 mg/d of synthetic folic acid plus 0.4 mg/d of B12 for a cardiovascular indication.这两种营养素在普通食物中都很丰富，食物表见叶酸和维生素 B12 两个条目。这里真正要区分的是剂量和用途。膳食水平的食物叶酸和食物 B12 完全不带挪威试验中出现的癌症信号，那些试验用的是每天 0.8 毫克合成叶酸加 0.4 毫克 B12，目的是心血管预防。

No food rows: there is no ordinary food that supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有食物条目：没有任何普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 Not applicable as a target. There is no food quantity to aim for, because the trials that produced the cancer signal were testing a supplemental dose for a purpose that does not work. The dietary answer is to meet the reference intake from food and stop there.作为目标而言不适用。没有需要去凑的食物量，因为产生癌症信号的那些试验测的是一个用途根本不成立的补充剂剂量。膳食层面的答案是靠食物达到参考摄入量，到此为止。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 This is the clearest case in the document where the food and the supplement diverge on outcome rather than on amount. Periconceptional folic acid at 400 µg remains the strongest supplement result in existence; the same molecule at twice the dose given to cardiac patients raised cancer incidence. Same compound, different dose, different population, opposite conclusion.这是全文中食物与补充剂在结局上而非在剂量上分道扬镳最清楚的一例。围孕期 400 微克叶酸仍是现存最强的补充剂结果；同一个分子加倍剂量给心脏病患者，却升高了癌症发病。同一种化合物，不同剂量，不同人群，相反的结论。

Absorption吸收 NONE. This entry is a product category rather than a single substance, so there is no single absorption comparison to make.不适用。本条目是一个产品类别，不是单一物质，因此没有单一的吸收对比可做。

AVOIDAntioxidants during chemotherapy化疗期间的抗氧化剂Grade D证据 D 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Not applicable. No dose is recommended and the concern is temporal rather than numeric.不适用。不推荐任何剂量，问题在于时间点而非数字。
Who it is for适用人群Nobody. Documented deficiency should be corrected under oncology supervision, with timing discussed against the chemotherapy schedule.没有适用人群。已证实的缺乏应在肿瘤科监督下纠正，并就时间安排与化疗周期一并讨论。

Pros优点

  • A plain reference-intake-level multivitamin showed no adverse association in the same dataset, so ordinary nutritional support is not the concern here.在同一数据集中，普通参考摄入量水平的复合维生素未显示不良关联，因此普通营养支持不是这里担心的对象。

Cons缺点

  • The theoretical objection is direct and mechanistic: several cytotoxic classes including anthracyclines, platinum agents and alkylating agents work partly through oxidative damage, and radiotherapy works through free radical generation. Supplementing antioxidants may blunt the treatment.理论上的反对意见直接且机制明确：包括蒽环类、铂类和烷化剂在内的多类细胞毒药物部分通过氧化损伤起效，放疗则通过产生自由基起效。补充抗氧化剂可能削弱治疗。
  • SWOG S0221 (n=1,134 women with high-risk early breast cancer on cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin and paclitaxel): any antioxidant (vitamins A, C, E, carotenoids, CoQ10) taken both before and during chemotherapy gave recurrence adjusted HR 1.41 (0.98-2.04, P=0.06).SWOG S0221（1134 名接受环磷酰胺、多柔比星和紫杉醇治疗的高危早期乳腺癌女性）：化疗前及化疗期间服用任何抗氧化剂（维生素 A、C、E、类胡萝卜素、辅酶 Q10），复发的校正 HR 为 1.41（0.98-2.04，P=0.06）。
  • In the same study, vitamin B12 taken before and during chemotherapy gave disease-free survival HR 1.83 (1.15-2.92) and overall survival HR 2.04 (1.22-3.40). Iron was also associated with worse outcomes.同一研究中，化疗前及化疗期间服用维生素 B12，无病生存 HR 为 1.83（1.15-2.92），总生存 HR 为 2.04（1.22-3.40）。铁也与更差的结局相关。
  • SELECT establishes in a randomised setting that high-dose antioxidant supplementation can INCREASE cancer incidence: vitamin E 400 IU/d raised prostate cancer HR 1.17 in 34,887 men.SELECT 在随机试验的框架下确立了大剂量抗氧化剂补充可以增加癌症发病：在 34887 名男性中，400 IU/天维生素 E 使前列腺癌 HR 升至 1.17。
  • Honest caveat: SWOG S0221 is observational within a randomised trial, and the headline antioxidant hazard ratio crossed 1 with P=0.06. Nobody should overstate it. But cancer patients are the most aggressively targeted and least protected supplement consumers, and support your body through chemo is sold with no evidence and a plausible mechanism of harm.诚实的限定：SWOG S0221 是随机试验内部的观察性分析，其抗氧化剂主要风险比跨过了 1，P=0.06。谁都不该夸大它。但肿瘤患者是被最猛烈针对、又最缺保护的补充剂消费者，而“化疗期间给身体加把力”这个卖点，既没有证据，又有一个说得通的致害机制。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 No dose to compare没有可比的剂量 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

Vitamins A, C and E, carotenoids and CoQ10 are all present in ordinary food, and each has its own food table elsewhere in this document. Food is not the concern here. The concern is supplemental doses taken alongside cytotoxic treatment.维生素 A、C、E、类胡萝卜素和辅酶 Q10 在普通食物中都存在，本文别处各有其食物表。这里担心的不是食物，而是在细胞毒治疗期间同时服用的补充剂剂量。

No food rows: there is no ordinary food that supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有食物条目：没有任何普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 Not applicable, and deliberately so. Eating fruit and vegetables during chemotherapy is not the exposure that SWOG S0221 measured. That study looked at supplement use before and during treatment, at doses far above what food supplies.不适用，而且是刻意如此。化疗期间吃水果和蔬菜，不是 SWOG S0221 所测量的那种暴露。那项研究看的是治疗前及治疗期间服用补充剂，剂量远高于食物所能提供的水平。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 The gap between food and supplement is the whole point. A portion of berries and a 1,000 mg vitamin C capsule are not the same intervention. Nobody has suggested that dietary antioxidant intake during treatment is harmful, and no oncology body recommends restricting fruit and vegetables. Any change to supplements during cancer treatment belongs with the treating oncologist.食物与补充剂之间的差距正是关键所在。一份浆果和一粒 1000 毫克维生素 C 胶囊不是同一种干预。没有人提出治疗期间的膳食抗氧化摄入有害，也没有任何肿瘤学机构建议限制水果和蔬菜。肿瘤治疗期间对补充剂的任何调整，都应由主治肿瘤医生决定。

Absorption吸收 NONE. This entry is a product category rather than a single substance, so there is no single absorption comparison to make.不适用。本条目是一个产品类别，不是单一物质，因此没有单一的吸收对比可做。

AVOIDProbiotics in critical illness危重症患者使用益生菌Grade B证据 B 级
Dose tested已验证剂量Not applicable. The relevant ceiling is a population restriction rather than a milligram figure.不适用。真正的限制是人群禁忌，而不是一个毫克数字。
Who it is for适用人群Nobody in critical illness. See the strain-specific entry for the two indications where probiotics do work.危重症患者没有适用人群。益生菌确实有效的那两个适应证见菌株特异性条目。

Pros优点

  • None in this population. In non-critically-ill patients there are two narrow indications with real evidence, covered separately.在这个人群中没有优点。在非危重患者中有两个有真实证据的狭窄适应证，另有条目说明。

Cons缺点

  • PROPATRIA is the most important negative trial in this entire field. In 296 patients with predicted severe acute pancreatitis given a multispecies synbiotic enterally twice daily for 28 days: mortality 24 of 152 (16%) versus 9 of 144 (6%), RR 2.53 (1.22-5.25). Infectious complications were not reduced (RR 1.06).PROPATRIA 是整个领域最重要的阴性试验。296 名预测为重症急性胰腺炎的患者，经肠道每日两次给予多菌种合生元共 28 天：死亡 152 人中 24 例（16%），对照 144 人中 9 例（6%），RR 2.53（1.22-5.25）。感染性并发症并未减少（RR 1.06）。
  • Nine cases of bowel ischaemia occurred, eight of them fatal, versus zero on placebo. The plausible mechanism is that fermentable substrate plus bacteria in a gut with compromised splanchnic perfusion increases local oxygen demand.发生了 9 例肠缺血，其中 8 例死亡，安慰剂组为零。一个说得通的机制是：在内脏灌注受损的肠道里，可发酵底物加上细菌会增加局部氧需求。
  • The FDA warned providers after a preterm infant died of probiotic-associated Bifidobacterium sepsis, and cases of severe or fatal infection in premature infants receiving probiotics are documented.在一名早产儿死于益生菌相关双歧杆菌脓毒症后，FDA 向医疗机构发出警示，且早产儿接受益生菌后发生重症或致死性感染的病例已有记录。
  • Saccharomyces boulardii fungaemia is documented in ICU patients with central venous catheters, which is the dominant risk factor.在带中心静脉导管的 ICU 患者中已有布拉氏酵母菌血症的记录，而中心静脉导管正是主要危险因素。
  • Absolute contraindications: predicted severe acute pancreatitis, multi-organ failure, central venous catheter, neutropenia, severe immunocompromise, and preterm infants outside a supervised NICU protocol.绝对禁忌：预测为重症急性胰腺炎、多器官功能衰竭、中心静脉置管、中性粒细胞减少、重度免疫抑制，以及未在新生儿重症监护监督方案内的早产儿。

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 No dose to compare没有可比的剂量 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

Live microorganisms are abundant in fermented foods, and the counts are given in the probiotics entry. That is not the relevant question for this item, because the population is patients in intensive care.发酵食品中活微生物含量丰富，具体计数见益生菌条目。但对本条目而言这不是相关的问题，因为这里的人群是重症监护中的患者。

No food rows: there is no ordinary food that supplies this in a meaningful amount.没有食物条目：没有任何普通食物能提供有意义的量。

To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 Not applicable, and the direction is reversed. There is no food target to reach. The same caution that applies to probiotic capsules applies to fermented foods in these patients, and enteral feeding decisions in intensive care are made by the clinical team.不适用，而且方向是相反的。这里没有需要达到的食物目标。对益生菌胶囊适用的那些警示，同样适用于这些患者食用的发酵食品，而重症监护中的肠内营养决策由临床团队做出。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 Fermented foods are a reasonable habit for healthy people and are not a substitute for a named strain at a defined dose. In critical illness, compromised gut perfusion and mucosal barrier injury are what make live organisms hazardous, and that hazard does not care whether the organism arrived in a capsule or in a spoonful of yoghurt.发酵食品对健康人是合理的饮食习惯，但不能替代特定菌株在特定剂量下的作用。在危重症中，内脏灌注受损和黏膜屏障损伤才是活微生物变得危险的原因，而这种危险并不在意微生物是来自一粒胶囊还是一勺酸奶。

Absorption吸收 NONE. This entry is a product category rather than a single substance, so there is no single absorption comparison to make.不适用。本条目是一个产品类别，不是单一物质，因此没有单一的吸收对比可做。

AVOIDCalcium supplements on top of an adequate diet饮食已足够时再补钙Grade B证据 B 级
Dose tested已验证剂量The trials used at least 500 mg/d elemental calcium. Adult reference intake is 1,000-1,200 mg/d TOTAL from all sources.试验用的是元素钙至少 500 毫克/天。成人参考摄入量是全部来源合计 1000 至 1200 毫克/天。
Who it is for适用人群People with genuinely low dietary calcium, below about 600-700 mg/d, particularly institutionalised elderly, and patients on long-term glucocorticoids.膳食钙确实偏低（低于约 600 至 700 毫克/天）的人，尤其是养老机构中的老人，以及长期使用糖皮质激素的患者。

Pros优点

  • With vitamin D in frail, calcium-and-D-deplete institutionalised elderly, it cuts hip fracture: RR 0.84 (0.74-0.96) across 9 trials and 49,853 people. That population is real and the effect is real.在体弱、钙与维生素 D 双缺的养老机构老人中，与维生素 D 合用可降低髋部骨折：9 项试验、49853 人中 RR 0.84（0.74-0.96）。那个人群是真实的，效应也是真实的。
  • Correcting a genuine dietary shortfall is sensible, and food sources are preferable where possible.纠正真实的膳食缺口是合理的，能通过食物解决就优先用食物。

Cons缺点

  • It does very little for fractures in ordinary community-dwelling adults. WHI, the largest trial ever run (n=36,282 postmenopausal women, 1,000 mg calcium plus 400 IU vitamin D, 7 years) gained 1.06% hip bone density but produced hip fracture HR 0.88 (0.72-1.08) and spine 0.90 (0.74-1.10). Both null.在普通社区居住的成人中，它对骨折作用很小。有史以来规模最大的 WHI 试验（36282 名绝经后女性，1000 毫克钙加 400 IU 维生素 D，7 年）髋部骨密度提高 1.06%，但髋部骨折 HR 为 0.88（0.72-1.08），脊柱为 0.90（0.74-1.10）。两者均为阴性。
  • There is a cardiovascular harm signal. Bolland pooled 15 placebo-controlled trials of calcium at least 500 mg/d without vitamin D: patient-level myocardial infarction HR 1.31 (1.02-1.67, P=0.035) across 5 studies and 8,151 participants. A separate WHI reanalysis plus updated meta-analysis gave myocardial infarction RR 1.24 (1.07-1.45, P=0.004).存在心血管危害信号。Bolland 合并了 15 项不含维生素 D、钙剂量至少 500 毫克/天的安慰剂对照试验：5 项研究、8151 名受试者的个体数据显示心肌梗死 HR 1.31（1.02-1.67，P=0.035）。另一项 WHI 再分析加更新 meta 分析给出心肌梗死 RR 1.24（1.07-1.45，P=0.004）。
  • Kidney stones increased significantly in WHI, HR 1.17 (1.02-1.34). This is the clearest confirmed harm in that trial.WHI 中肾结石显著增加，HR 1.17（1.02-1.34）。这是该试验中最明确被确认的危害。
  • Supplementing on top of adequate dietary intake gets you the possible cardiovascular downside and no bone upside. Supplement the shortfall only.在饮食已足够的基础上再补，得到的是可能的心血管坏处，而没有骨骼上的好处。只补缺口。
  • Absorption falls above about 500 mg per dose, so split doses. Chelates levothyroxine, bisphosphonates, tetracyclines and fluoroquinolones. Avoid in hypercalcaemia, primary hyperparathyroidism, sarcoidosis and a history of calcium-containing stones.单次超过约 500 毫克后吸收率下降，所以要分次服。会与左甲状腺素、双膦酸盐、四环素类和氟喹诺酮类螯合。高钙血症、原发性甲状旁腺功能亢进、结节病和含钙结石史者应避免。

Food sources食物来源

Rich food sources食物来源丰富 Dose reachable by eating靠吃可以达到剂量 Data confidence: High数据可信度：高

Calcium is among the easiest nutrients to get from ordinary food. Dairy, calcium-set tofu, hard cheeses, tinned fish eaten with the bones, whole small fish, fortified plant milks and fortified juice each deliver 200 to 860 mg per normal portion, and low-oxalate brassicas add 150 to 270 mg per cooked cup with fractional absorption in the same band as milk. In the UK, non-wholemeal flour is fortified with calcium carbonate by law, so bread is one of the largest single contributors to national intake at about 50 mg per slice. The adult reference intake of 1,000 mg/day (1,200 mg for women 51+, Institute of Medicine 2011) is reachable in three or four food choices, and this entry concerns adding a supplement to a diet that already meets that target, which is a different question from correcting a real deficit.钙是最容易从普通食物获得的营养素之一。乳制品、以钙凝固的豆腐、硬质奶酪、连骨一起吃的罐装鱼、整条小鱼、强化植物奶和强化果汁，每份正常分量各提供 200 至 860 mg；低草酸的十字花科蔬菜每杯熟菜再提供 150 至 270 mg，吸收分数与牛奶处在同一区间。在英国，非全麦面粉依法用碳酸钙强化，因此面包是全国钙摄入最大的单一贡献者之一，每片约 50 mg。成人参考摄入量 1,000 mg/天（51 岁以上女性 1,200 mg，Institute of Medicine 2011）靠三四项食物选择就能达到。本条讨论的是在已经达标的膳食之上再加补充剂，这与纠正真实缺乏是两个不同的问题。
