To match the supplement dose要达到补充剂剂量 Calcium supplements are sold at 500 to 600 mg elemental per tablet, and the trials that generated the safety signals gave 1,000 to 1,200 mg/day on top of whatever participants were already eating. Matching 1,000 mg from food takes 3.6 cups of milk, or 141 g of Cheddar, or about 85 g of Parmesan, or one 1/2-cup serving of calcium-set tofu (861 mg) plus one cup of cooked kale (177 mg) for 1,038 mg, or 3.2 pots of low-fat yogurt (about 546 g), or two small cans of sardines plus a glass of fortified soy drink (1,001 mg). The 'three pots of yogurt' route quoted in the original submission is wrong: 3 x 311 mg is 933 mg, 93% of the target and short of it. Every one of the corrected routes is a normal day of eating, so in a person whose diet already provides 1,000 mg a 1,000 mg supplement does not fill a deficit, it doubles the intake and delivers the added half as a single soluble bolus. The supplement is additive rather than corrective, which is the whole point of this entry.钙补充剂每片售 500 至 600 mg 元素钙，而产生安全性信号的那些试验是在受试者原有饮食之上再给 1,000 至 1,200 mg/天。从食物达到 1,000 mg 需要 3.6 杯牛奶，或 141 g 切达奶酪，或约 85 g 帕玛森奶酪，或一份 1/2 杯以钙凝固的豆腐（861 mg）加一杯熟羽衣甘蓝（177 mg）共 1,038 mg，或 3.2 盒低脂酸奶（约 546 g），或两小罐沙丁鱼加一杯强化豆奶（1,001 mg）。原稿引用的“三盒酸奶”路线是错的：3 × 311 mg 等于 933 mg，只有目标的 93%，达不到。上面每一条修正后的路线都是正常的一天饮食，所以对膳食已提供 1,000 mg 的人来说，1,000 mg 的补充剂并不填补缺口，它把摄入量翻倍，并把多出来的那一半作为单次可溶性剂量送进体内。这里的补充剂只是在原有摄入之上叠加，起不到纠正作用，这正是本条的要点。

Food versus supplement食物与补充剂的差别 The harms recorded in the trials attach to supplements, not to dietary calcium, and the proposed mechanism is the form itself. Food calcium arrives in small amounts inside a matrix across a whole meal and produces no sharp rise in serum calcium; a 500-1,000 mg dose of calcium carbonate or citrate produces a measurable postprandial spike, and that spike is the hypothesised driver of the vascular signal. The specific findings: in the Women's Health Initiative randomised trial, 36,282 postmenopausal women given 1,000 mg calcium carbonate plus 400 IU vitamin D3 daily for a mean 7 years had more clinically diagnosed urinary tract stones, hazard ratio 1.17 (95% CI 1.02-1.34), unrelated to baseline calcium intake (PMID 21525191). Bolland and colleagues' meta-analysis of calcium supplements without co-administered vitamin D reported a 27-31% relative increase in myocardial infarction (BMJ 2010, DOI 10.1136/bmj.c3691). In the 10-year MESA follow-up of 5,448 adults, supplement users had higher incident coronary artery calcification while the highest quintile of dietary calcium was associated with lower risk (Anderson et al., DOI 10.1161/JAHA.116.003815). Observational work in the same populations consistently finds higher dietary calcium associated with fewer kidney stones, the opposite direction to the supplement result. This is contested territory: a 2016 National Osteoporosis Foundation and American Society for Preventive Cardiology review concluded there was no demonstrable cardiovascular harm at total intakes up to 2,000-2,500 mg/day, and the meta-analyses have been criticised for relying on secondary endpoints and self-reported events. The defensible summary is that food calcium has no such signal attached to it in any dataset, so where the diet already reaches the target the supplement carries risk without a corresponding benefit. Two practical form points: calcium carbonate requires gastric acid and must be taken with food, so it is a poor choice for anyone on a proton pump inhibitor or with achlorhydria (calcium citrate does not have this dependency), and doses above about 500 mg saturate absorption, so a single 1,000 mg tablet is worse value than two 500 mg doses.试验中记录到的危害出现在补充剂身上，膳食钙没有这类记录，而推测的机制就是形式本身。食物中的钙在一整餐里以小剂量到达，不会造成血钙的急剧上升；500-1,000 mg 的碳酸钙或柠檬酸钙则产生可测量的餐后峰值，这个峰值被假设为血管信号的驱动因素。具体发现如下：在妇女健康倡议（Women's Health Initiative）随机试验中，36,282 名绝经后女性每天服用 1,000 mg 碳酸钙加 400 IU 维生素 D3，平均随访 7 年，临床诊断的尿路结石增多，风险比 1.17（95% CI 1.02-1.34），且与基线钙摄入无关（PMID 21525191）。Bolland 等对未同时给维生素 D 的钙补充剂所做的荟萃分析，报告心肌梗死相对风险增加 27-31%（BMJ 2010，DOI 10.1136/bmj.c3691）。在 5,448 名成人的 MESA 十年随访中，使用补充剂者新发冠状动脉钙化更多，而膳食钙最高五分位与更低风险相关（Anderson 等，DOI 10.1161/JAHA.116.003815）。同一批人群中的观察性研究一致发现膳食钙越高肾结石越少，方向与补充剂的结果相反。这仍是有争议的领域：2016 年美国国家骨质疏松基金会与美国预防心脏病学会的一篇综述认为，总摄入量达到 2,000-2,500 mg/天 时没有可证实的心血管危害，而那些荟萃分析也因依赖次要终点和自报事件受到批评。站得住的结论是：任何数据集中都没有针对食物钙的这类信号，因此在膳食已达标的情况下，补充剂带来风险而没有相应获益。两点实用的形式问题：碳酸钙需要胃酸，必须随餐服用，对服用质子泵抑制剂或胃酸缺乏者是糟糕的选择（柠檬酸钙没有这种依赖）；超过约 500 mg 的剂量会使吸收饱和，所以一片 1,000 mg 不如分两次各 500 mg 划算。

Absorption吸收 Fractional absorption reorders the raw milligram ranking, though less dramatically than the original submission claimed. From the tabulated studies (Nutrients 2022 review, PMC8746734; Heaney et al., J Food Sci 1993;58:1378-1380), at an identical 83 mg load: kale 52.7%, bok choy leaves 52.0%, bok choy stems 51.9%, broccoli 47.8% and cow milk 46.3%, with the authors stating the differences were absolutely small and statistically insignificant. No vegetable can be called the best-absorbed calcium food, and the superlative attached to bok choy in the original entry is refuted by the experiment it cited. Across loads of 14.7 to 563 mg the milk range is 21.7-66.0%, about 30-32% at a typical 250 mg load, so milk's upper bound exceeds every brassica figure and the claim that brassicas beat milk holds only at matched loads where the difference is not significant. Calcium-set tofu is 39.0-49.3%, Cheddar 37.4%, yogurt 24.2%, calcium carbonate supplement roughly 22-24%, calcium citrate roughly 24%, and spinach 5.1%. Two conclusions survive. Low-oxalate brassicas comfortably beat the supplement forms per milligram consumed and match milk at comparable loads, so a cup of bok choy at 158 mg delivers about as much absorbed calcium as 250 ml of milk (roughly 82 mg against 83 mg). And spinach, rhubarb, beet greens and Swiss chard should be struck off calcium lists entirely, since oxalate precipitates the calcium in the gut and the food is close to useless for this purpose despite good label numbers. On fortified plant milks, the carbonate fortificant performs as well as dairy calcium: Zhao, Martin and Weaver (J Nutr 2005;135(10):2379, PMID 16177199) titled their paper on the finding that calcium-carbonate-fortified soymilk is equivalent to cow milk in young women (21.1% against 21.7% at a 250 mg load), and only the tricalcium phosphate form is genuinely lower at 18.1%. The sedimentation problem is real and separate: the added salt is insoluble and settles to the bottom of the carton, so an unshaken carton delivers a fraction of the label value and the last glass delivers a dose nobody intended.吸收分数会重排毫克数的排名，只是幅度不像原稿声称的那么大。根据表列研究（Nutrients 2022 综述，PMC8746734；Heaney 等，J Food Sci 1993;58:1378-1380），在同样 83 mg 负荷下：羽衣甘蓝 52.7%，小白菜叶 52.0%，小白菜茎 51.9%，西兰花 47.8%，牛奶 46.3%，作者明确指出这些差异在绝对值上很小且统计上不显著。因此没有哪种蔬菜能被称作吸收最好的钙食物，原条目给小白菜加的这个最高级说法，被它自己引用的实验否证。在 14.7 至 563 mg 的负荷范围内，牛奶的区间是 21.7-66.0%，典型 250 mg 负荷下约 30-32%，所以牛奶的上界高于任何一个十字花科数值，“十字花科蔬菜按毫克胜过牛奶”的说法只在负荷匹配、差异并不显著的条件下成立。以钙凝固的豆腐为 39.0-49.3%，切达奶酪 37.4%，酸奶 24.2%，碳酸钙补充剂约 22-24%，柠檬酸钙约 24%，菠菜 5.1%。有两个结论站得住。低草酸的十字花科蔬菜按每毫克摄入量计算明显优于各种补充剂形式，在可比负荷下与牛奶相当，所以一杯 158 mg 的小白菜提供的可吸收钙与 250 ml 牛奶差不多（约 82 mg 对约 83 mg）。另外，菠菜、大黄、甜菜叶和瑞士甜菜应当从钙的清单里彻底划掉，草酸会在肠道内把钙沉淀下来，尽管标签数字不错，这类食物在补钙上接近无用。关于强化植物奶，碳酸钙强化剂的表现与乳钙一样好：Zhao、Martin 和 Weaver（J Nutr 2005;135(10):2379，PMID 16177199）的论文标题就是这一发现，碳酸钙强化豆奶在年轻女性中与牛奶等效（250 mg 负荷下 21.1% 对 21.7%），只有磷酸三钙形式确实较低，为 18.1%。沉降问题是真实存在的另一回事：添加的钙盐不溶，会沉到纸盒底部，没摇过的盒子倒出来只有标签值的一部分，最后一杯的剂量则是谁也没打算给的。

Data note数据说明 for composition and arithmetic. Verification traced every cited FDC ID to USDA SR Legacy April 2018 and every CoFID code to CoFID 2021, with every food description, per-100 g value and portion weight matching, and all per-portion multiplications reproducing. The corrections here are inference-level (three claims that misstated their own cited sources) plus one arithmetic slip on the yogurt route. Lower confidence is confined to items flagged in place: the whitebait, fortified milk powder and fortified oat cereal portion weights are conventions rather than dataset portions, the SR Legacy kale value sits at the high end of current data, and the silken tofu comparator is a single branded product组成与算术为高。核查把每个引用的 FDC ID 追溯到 USDA SR Legacy 2018 年 4 月、每个 CoFID 代码追溯到 CoFID 2021，食物描述、每 100 g 数值和分量重量全部吻合，所有按分量的乘算也都能复现。这里的修正属于推断层面（三处说法与其自身引用的来源不符），外加酸奶路线的一处算术错误。置信度较低的只限已就地标注的项目：银鱼、强化奶粉和强化燕麦谷物的分量重量属于惯例，并非数据集分量；SR Legacy 的羽衣甘蓝数值处在当前数据的高端；嫩豆腐（silken tofu）的对照值来自单一品牌产品。

References:文献： WHI Jackson NEJM PMID 16481635; Bolland BMJ 2010 PMID 20671013; Bolland BMJ 2011 PMID 21505219; Cochrane PMID 24729336

8  Dose and upper-limit reference八、剂量与上限速查

Where the US and EU disagree, both are given. These are not rounding differences; they change what counts as safe. Vitamin B6 is the one most likely to matter to an ordinary consumer, because nerve-support and B-complex products routinely sit between the two figures.美欧不一致的地方，两个数字都列出。这不是四舍五入的差别，它改变了“安全”的定义。对普通消费者最可能造成实际影响的是维生素 B6，因为“神经营养”和复合 B 族产品的剂量常常正好落在两个数字之间。

Elemental mass is the commonest labelling deception in the mineral aisle. Magnesium oxide is about 60.3% elemental magnesium, citrate about 16%, bisglycinate about 14%. Zinc gluconate is 14.3% elemental zinc, zinc acetate dihydrate about 29.8%. Ferrous sulfate is about 20% elemental iron, so a 325 mg tablet delivers 65 mg. A capsule labelled 500 mg magnesium citrate delivers roughly 80 mg of magnesium.元素质量是矿物质货架上最常见的标签误导。氧化镁约含 60.3% 的元素镁，柠檬酸镁约 16%，甘氨酸螯合镁约 14%。葡萄糖酸锌含 14.3% 的元素锌，二水醋酸锌约 29.8%。硫酸亚铁约含 20% 的元素铁，所以一片 325 毫克的药片提供 65 毫克。一粒标着“柠檬酸镁 500 毫克”的胶囊，实际提供的镁约为 80 毫克。

10  How to buy, if you are buying十、如果你要买，怎么买

  1. Decide what deficiency or endpoint you are treating. If you cannot name it, the answer is no supplement.先确定你要处理的是哪种缺乏、或哪个终点指标。如果说不出来，答案就是不吃。
  2. Prefer single ingredients at tested doses. Proprietary blends hide doses behind two words, and that is where adulteration lives.优先选择单一成分、剂量经过验证的产品。“专有配方”四个字把剂量藏了起来，而掺假正是藏在那里。
  3. Know what each certification does NOT cover. Informed Sport tests every manufactured batch against the WADA list and is the only appropriate standard under anti-doping strict liability. NSF Certified for Sport screens 280 or more banned substances on a variable batch model. USP Verified covers identity, declared potency, dissolution and contaminant limits, and does NOT screen for substances banned in sport, so a USP Verified product can legally contain a prohibited stimulant. None of the three assesses whether the product works.搞清楚每种认证不覆盖什么。Informed Sport 对每一个生产批次都按 WADA 清单检测，在反兴奋剂严格责任原则下这是唯一合适的标准。NSF Certified for Sport 按可变批次模式筛查 280 种以上违禁物质。USP Verified 覆盖成分鉴定、标示含量、崩解度和污染物限值，但不筛查运动违禁物质，所以一款 USP 认证的产品完全可能合法地含有违禁兴奋剂。三者都不评估产品是否有效。
  4. A seller-supplied certificate of analysis is not certification. Ask which lot it covers, which laboratory produced it, whether that laboratory is ISO 17025 accredited, and who chose the laboratory.卖家自己提供的检测报告不算认证。要问清楚：它对应哪一批、由哪家实验室出具、那家实验室是否通过 ISO 17025 认可、以及实验室是谁挑的。
  5. Categorically avoid anything marketed for erections, rapid fat loss, or anabolic and test-booster effects, from any retailer, at any price.凡是主打勃起功能、快速减脂、增肌或提升睾酮的产品，一律不碰，不论在哪买、卖多少钱。
  6. Read the US disclaimer literally. The sentence stating that the claim has not been evaluated by the FDA and the product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease is the regulator actual assessment of the product, and it is the most informative sentence on the bottle.认真读美国产品上的免责声明。那句“本声明未经 FDA 评估，本产品不用于诊断、治疗、治愈或预防任何疾病”，就是监管者对该产品的真实评价，也是瓶子上信息量最大的一句话。
  7. Treat FDA registered facility and FDA regulated as marketing phrases. Neither is a safety finding.把“FDA 注册工厂”和“受 FDA 监管”当作营销话术。两者都不是安全性结论。
  8. Tell your doctor and pharmacist what you take, especially before surgery, before starting an anticoagulant, and during cancer treatment. Post-market surveillance is the entire safety system and its sensitivity depends on clinicians reporting.把你在吃什么告诉医生和药师，手术前、开始抗凝治疗前、以及肿瘤治疗期间尤其要说。上市后监测就是整套安全体系的全部，而它的灵敏度取决于临床医生是否上报。

An honest limitation on certification. No published head-to-head study shows that certified products fail less often than uncertified ones. The case for certification is inferential and rests on how badly uncertified products perform in the surveys in Figure 4.关于认证的一个诚实的局限。没有任何已发表的头对头研究表明认证产品的不合格率低于未认证产品。支持认证的理由是推断性的，依据是图 4 中未认证产品有多糟。

11  Method, and what to distrust here十一、方法，以及本文中哪些内容需要打折扣

Construction. Ten domain researchers ran live literature searches under a rule that only papers located in a search result with a resolvable PMID or DOI could be cited. Each submission then went to an independent adversarial fact-checker instructed to default to does-not-exist if a paper could not be confirmed, to re-check every dose against NIH ODS, EFSA and IOM/NASEM, and to flag over-generous grades.构建方式。十名领域研究员进行实时文献检索，规则是：只有在检索结果中找到、且 PMID 或 DOI 可解析的文献才可引用。每份稿件随后交给一名独立的对抗式核查员，其指令是：无法确认存在的文献一律按“不存在”处理，对照 NIH ODS、EFSA 和 IOM/NASEM 复核每一个剂量，并标出过于宽松的分级。

Result of the fabrication hunt: nothing. Across 428 citation checks in ten domains the verifiers found zero fabricated papers, zero invented PMIDs and zero wrong DOIs. Effect sizes reproduced to the decimal in the large majority of cases. The papers most likely to be hallucinations, recent 2026 publications with implausible-looking identifiers, all turned out to be real.查找虚构文献的结果：一条也没有。在十个领域、428 条引用核查中，核查员发现虚构文献 0 条、编造的 PMID 0 个、错误的 DOI 0 个。绝大多数效应量精确复现到小数位。最可能是幻觉的那几篇，也就是标识符看起来不太可信的 2026 年新文献，全部确认为真实存在。

What the verifiers caught, and what was done about it:核查员发现了什么，以及如何处理：

Defect缺陷 Correction applied已作的修正
Evidence grades set roughly half a grade too generously证据分级普遍偏高约半级Corrected here. Over-the-counter fish oil is no longer Grade A for cardiovascular outcomes, calcium is no longer Grade A for fractures, dietary nitrate and beta-alanine moved to C, and vitamin K2 as MK-4 moved to D.已在本文修正。非处方鱼油在心血管结局上不再是 A 级，钙在骨折上不再是 A 级，膳食硝酸盐和 β-丙氨酸下调至 C，维生素 K2 的 MK-4 形式下调至 D。
Five materially wrong doses五处实质性剂量错误Including a sickle-cell L-glutamine figure that overstated the FDA-approved maximum, an EFSA child-selenium table transposed from the infant row, a VSL#3 CFU figure understated fourfold, and an MSM trial dose reported as 3-6 g/d when the trial used 2 g/d.包括：镰状细胞病 L-谷氨酰胺剂量高于 FDA 批准的上限；EFSA 儿童硒上限表格误取了婴儿那一行；VSL#3 的 CFU 数被低估四倍；MSM 的试验剂量被写成 3 至 6 克/天，而试验实际用的是 2 克/天。
Selective reporting by omission以省略实现的选择性报告Results quoted for the flattering subgroup with the null overall effect left out. Corrected throughout, most importantly for beta-alanine and dietary nitrate, where the capacity result was quoted and the null performance result was not.只引用好看的亚组结果，把总体阴性效应略去。全文已修正，其中最重要的是 β-丙氨酸和膳食硝酸盐：此前引用了运动能力的结果，却没有引用成绩为阴性的结果。
One unverifiable regulatory claim一条无法核实的监管说法A stated Polish limit on ashwagandha could not be traced to any primary or indexed source and has been removed. The Danish ban is corroborated and remains.关于波兰对南非醉茄限量的说法，无法追溯到任何原始或被收录的来源，已删除。丹麦的禁令有独立佐证，予以保留。

Residual limitations. NIH ODS fact sheets return HTTP 403 to automated retrieval, so reference-intake values here come from the underlying IOM/NASEM reports and EFSA opinions, which are the primary sources ODS itself cites. Several entries rest on single unreplicated trials and say so in the Cons column. Market-size figures are unaudited commercial estimates and should be read as orders of magnitude with the vendor name attached.仍然存在的局限。NIH ODS 的资料页对自动抓取返回 HTTP 403，因此本文的参考摄入量数值取自其背后的 IOM/NASEM 报告和 EFSA 意见书，而这些正是 ODS 自己引用的原始来源。若干条目依赖的是单项未经重复验证的试验，这一点已写在“缺点”栏里。市场规模数字是未经审计的商业估算，读的时候应当带上估算机构的名字，只当作数量级看。

The pattern across all ten domains. Marketing spend runs roughly inversely to evidence. The best-evidenced items here, folic acid, vitamin D3 for the genuinely deficient, B12 for vegans and metformin users, creatine monohydrate, psyllium and iodine in pregnancy, are cheap, generic and unglamorous. The most heavily promoted, NAD+ precursors, collagen, multivitamins, generic probiotics, adaptogens and nootropic stacks, are either null on clinical endpoints or have never been tested against one.十个领域共同的规律。营销投入与证据强度大致成反比。本文中证据最扎实的那些，叶酸、给真正缺乏者的维生素 D3、给纯素者和二甲双胍使用者的 B12、一水肌酸、洋车前子壳、孕期补碘，都便宜、通用、毫不性感。而营销最猛的那些，NAD+ 前体、胶原蛋白、复合维生素、泛泛的益生菌、各类适应原、益智复方，要么在临床终点上是阴性，要么根本就没拿临床终点测过。

Compiled 29 July 2026 from a 20-agent research workflow: 10 domain literature sweeps plus 10 independent adversarial verification passes. 456 papers, 428 citations re-checked, 1,309 tool calls. Every effect size is quoted with its confidence interval where the source reported one. Press L to switch language.
